AI.motivation: 工具调用智能体在不断更新后，历史估计的动作信用可能失效，但完全重新计算成本高昂（需要大量工具调用和环境交互）。核心问题是：历史动作信用何时真正需要更新？作者观察到动作价值的数值漂移并不一定意味着决策改变——只要策略诱导的漂移不足以推翻原有动作排序，历史信用仍然有用。
AI.method: 1. 配对分支敏感度 G(a,b)：通过 old-policy 下两个候选动作的条件访问分布差异与策略更新效应的内积来度量更新对区分两动作的下游区域的影响程度。2. 一阶锚定信用传输估计器：利用轨迹似然比的一阶展开，以历史干预轨迹估计策略诱导的修正项，保留旧动作比较作为锚点。3. 决策充分性信用门（DSC-Gate）：三级门控——当保守旧间隔超过可分辨漂移时直接复用；当传输后间隔与零分离时传输修正；其余情况才刷新（执行目标策略）。4. 经验校准半径：基于开发集残差补偿和独立校准集的尺度因子，获得 r_R、r_Δ、r_T。
AI.result: L1：配对分支敏感度解释信用漂移的秩相关优势比全局 KL 高 0.839（95% CI [0.830, 0.847]）。L2：256 条历史轨迹下，传输使配对信用 MSE 降低 16.3%（0.001225 vs 0.001464）。L3：小/中等学习更新下传输-自适应刷新归一化后悔 AUC 比自适应 DR 降低 18.7%；分支选择性更新下比基于间隔的刷新降低 29.3%。L4（独立测试集）：DSC-Gate 相对 Gap-Gate 后悔仅增加 +0.00004（非劣性边界 0.0005 通过），同时新工具步数从 472 降至 286（降低 39.4%）。真实 Qwen3-4B LoRA 更新上验证了相同模式：分支敏感度 Spearman 相关 0.58（vs 全局 KL 0.21），DSC-Gate 将新步数从 207 降至 143（30.9% 降幅）。
AI.conclusion: 持续更新的智能体无需在每次策略更新后重建所有决策估计。信用漂移取决于更新与下游分支的对齐方式，而刷新需求进一步取决于现有动作间隔和有限数据不确定性。配对分支敏感度、锚定信用传输和 DSC-Gate 将这些因素操作化，在独立测试集和真实模型权重更新上一致表明：历史信用在策略更新后通常仍然有用，且可从现有轨迹廉价修正，从而显著减少维持决策时效性所需的重复交互成本。

title: AlphaDiverse: Post-Training Local Quantitative Research Agents for Diverse Exploration in Alpha Factor Mining
comment: 33 pages, 7 figures, 26 Tables. Preprint under review
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems can automate alpha factor mining, but their reliance on external APIs limits control over cost, availability, and confidentiality. Long research loops also tend to revisit a few successful economic mechanisms that lead to research path collapse. To address these limitations, we propose AlphaDiverse, a framework that integrates a multi-agent alpha research system, diverse research path collection, and post-training for local agents. We let the research system generate complementary plan portfolios and vary research environments across loops to collect diverse research paths. Using these diverse traces, we warm-start local Planner and Realizer agents with supervised fine-tuning. Then, we propose a joint GRPO method to optimize both of them using predictive quality and diversity of contributions. Research feedback is confined to inner period data, while a frozen final model is evaluated on a later outer period data, thereby avoiding test-set tuning. Experiments across four Chinese stock universes show that AlphaDiverse can combine competitive prediction with broader exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出AlphaDiverse框架，将API驱动的多智能体alpha因子挖掘研究系统迁移到本地部署的Qwen3.8-27B模型，通过SFT预热加联合GRPO两阶段后训练优化Planner和Realizer代理，并设计互补性计划组合与环境多样化策略缓解研究路径坍缩问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体alpha因子挖掘系统依赖外部API，存在成本、可用性、数据机密性等问题；且长周期研究循环容易反复探索少数成功经济机制，导致研究路径坍缩，大量搜索空间未被利用。此外，反复使用相同数据进行迭代和最终评估会造成测试集调优。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：(1)六模块研究代理系统（规划、检索、实现、执行、验证、分析），Planner每轮提出J个覆盖至少3个主题的互补计划，Realizer为每个计划生成结构不同的两个因子规格；(2)通过变化市场环境（4个市场×3种特征掩码×8种存档配置=96个任务状态）和内折数构造多样化研究路径，按模型改进/有效转向/新方向三类样本构建Planner SFT数据，按成对质量与相关性筛选Realizer训练对；(3)两阶段后训练——SFT预热后采用联合GRPO，共享效用U=0.75Q+0.25D结合预测质量与基于预测变化方向覆盖的行列式对数多样性指标D，Planner在M个组合间比较，Realizer在N个实现间比较；内层期数据用于研究反馈，外层期数据冻结后一次性评估。
AI.result: 在CSI300/CSI500/CSI1000/A股四个中国股票池的内部期（2022.5–2025.12）训练、外层期（2026.1–2026.8）评估中，AlphaDiverse在所有四个市场均取得最高的IC、ICIR、RICIR、IR和最低MDD；CSI300上IC达0.0378、CR达7.641、ARR 42.10%；有用机制覆盖U从SFT的4提升至23（CSI300）；在Familiar和Held-out两组研究状态上均优于API版本（GPT-5.5）和SFT-only版本；本地部署每轮CSI300仅需1.436 H200 GPU小时且无API费用。模块消融验证了互补性规划、检索和记忆的必要性；后训练消融验证了联合GRPO与多样性奖励项D的增量贡献。
AI.conclusion: AlphaDiverse通过互补规划、跨环境多样化轨迹收集和联合GRPO训练，使本地部署的小规模开源模型在alpha因子挖掘中同时获得竞争性预测能力和持续的研究路径多样化，缓解了路径坍缩和测试集调优问题，为量化研究中本地化LLM代理系统提供了可行方案。

title: MeshHeal: Two-Timescale Self-Healing for Gray Failures in Decentralized LLM Agent Networks
summary: Decentralized LLM-based multi-agent systems coordinate through local interactions, but an agent can remain responsive while its task-solving quality persistently degrades. Such gray failures require protecting current tasks before sufficient evidence exists to alter future routing, while still allowing recovered agents to rejoin. We introduce MeshHeal, a fully decentralized self-healing framework that couples ability-matched peer review across two timescales. At the fast timescale, an adaptive hierarchy escalates uncertain or low-scoring outputs from repeated single-reviewer evaluation to committee deliberation and, when needed, correction before use. At the slow timescale, a task- and ability-conditioned peer-relative detector aggregates scores to distinguish persistent degradation from ordinary output variation, trigger mandatory committee review, and eventually exclude degraded agents from ordinary routing; recovery probes provide fresh evidence for reintegration. To faithfully evaluate routing, we introduce Model-Backed MAS Evaluation, which ties ability assignments to execution models, since prompt-based ability assignments alone can leave routing errors hidden. Across BBH, MATH, and MMLU-Pro, MeshHeal achieves 0.839 degraded-phase accuracy using 51k total model tokens per task, versus the strongest baseline Symphony's 0.807 accuracy using 115k per task. Under staggered degradation and recovery, MeshHeal isolates degraded agents, keeps them excluded from ordinary task execution until recovery, and returns them to normal routing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MeshHeal，一种完全去中心化的自愈框架，用于解决LLM多智能体系统中的灰失败（gray failures）问题。核心创新包括：双时间尺度审查机制（快速尺度进行能力匹配的对等评审与修正，慢速尺度通过任务与能力条件化的对等相对检测器区分持续性退化）；以及模型后端驱动的MAS评估方法，使用受控后端选择实现能力分配并注入灰失败。实验在BBH、MATH和MMLU-Pro三个基准上，MeshHeal在仅使用51k token/任务的情况下达到0.839的退化期准确率，优于最强基线Symphony（0.807，115k token），并在576智能体稀疏网络中成功隔离所有退化智能体。
AI.motivation: 去中心化LLM多智能体系统通过局部交互协调，但单个智能体可能在保持响应的同时出现任务解决质量的持续退化——这种现象被称为"灰失败"。灰失败在去中心化LLM多智能体系统中尤为关键，因为智能体的可用性并不必然意味着其语义可靠性。现有的LLM推理和智能体协调方法存在两个局限：任务内方法（如重复推理、审议、稳健聚合）缺乏保留生产者特定证据的机制，不支持持续性退化检测与后续重新路由；基于历史的方法（如自适应路由）虽能跨任务适应路由，但无法保护当前任务，且在绕过智能体后无法获取恢复证据以重新整合。因此，系统需要在退化可被可靠检测之前保护当前任务，积累证据以适应未来路由，并在性能恢复后重新整合智能体。
AI.method: MeshHeal框架在两个时间尺度上耦合能力匹配的对等评审：（1）快速尺度采用自适应评审层级，对不确定或低分输出从重复单评审者评估升级到委员会审议，必要时进行多智能体修正（Takeover）；输出评分采用中位数聚合以降低评审者噪声。（2）慢速尺度设计任务与能力条件化的对等相对检测器，通过计算智能体当前评分与同任务类型、同能力的健康邻居平均评分之差（相对缺口），再用健康邻居缺口分布的中位数和第25百分位数进行归一化，得出标准化统计量z；z≥α触发watched状态，连续两次z≥β触发isolated状态。恢复探针机制为被隔离智能体提供新评估证据以支持重新整合。此外，论文提出模型后端驱动的MAS评估方法：通过后端模型选择而非系统提示来实现能力分配（健康智能体对声明能力使用强模型，其他使用弱模型；退化智能体一律使用弱模型），从而提供已知失败真同时保持智能体响应性。
AI.result: 在BBH、MATH和MMLU-Pro三个基准上，MeshHeal在退化阶段达到0.839±0.012的平均准确率，仅使用51k±5k token/任务，优于最强基线Symphony（0.807±0.014，115k±9k token）；在Model Pair A（GPT-OSS-120B/Gemma-3-4B）上MeshHeal达到0.905±0.016 vs Symphony 0.865±0.021；在Model Pair B（Llama-3.3-70B/Llama-3.2-1B）上两者接近（0.782 vs 0.786），但MeshHeal仅用52%的token。自愈指标方面，检测延迟为8.0±5.2任务（A5）和12.4±6.2任务（A3），所有5个种子的闭包性质均满足，重新整合延迟为46.0±11.7和45.0±3.5任务。在576智能体稀疏网络中（仅0.88%完整图边），所有退化智能体均被隔离，稀疏图与完整图准确率差异不超过0.010。消融实验表明，委员会审议贡献0.035的退化期准确率提升，Takeover贡献0.056；对等相对检测器在两个模型对上均无误检和漏检，而绝对阈值在Pair A上误隔离所有4个健康智能体，CUSUM在Pair A上误隔离2个、在Pair B上漏检1个。
AI.conclusion: MeshHeal是首个面向去中心化LLM多智能体网络中灰失败问题的完全去中心化自愈框架，通过双时间尺度机制有效分离当前任务保护与未来路由适应：快速尺度的能力匹配对等评审与修正保护当前任务输出质量，慢速尺度的任务与能力条件化对等相对检测器跨模型后端实现一致的退化检测与路由隔离，恢复探针支持基于证据的重新整合。模型后端驱动的MAS评估方法解决了提示词无法可靠约束智能体能力的问题，为路由评估提供已知失败真。实验在三个基准上以显著更低的token成本达到最优退化期准确率，并在包含576个智能体的稀疏网络中保持鲁棒性。未来工作可扩展至其他类型的智能体故障（如完全崩溃、拜占庭行为），并探索自适应阈值与学习式恢复策略。

title: SLCA-GRPO: Resolving Cross-Segment Credit Misattribution in Tool-Calling RL
comment: 41 pages, 13 figures. Code: this https URL ; Dataset: this https URL
summary: Tool-calling agents produce heterogeneous outputs, interleaving structured tool invocations with user-facing natural language summaries. This output heterogeneity presents a structural failure mode in standard on-policy Reinforcement Learning (RL): algorithms like GRPO indiscriminately broadcast a homogeneous trajectory-level scalar advantage to all tokens. Consequently, gradient noise from summary generation leaks into tool-decision tokens, causing cross-segment credit misattribution and brittle optimization. In this work, we propose SLCA-GRPO, a framework incorporating Segment-Locked Credit Assignment (SLCA). To enable scalable exploration without costly real APIs and stable training, we first construct the Schema-Guided LLM Simulator (SGLS) as foundational training infrastructure. Building on this, SLCA decouples advantage estimation at the structural segment level within a single group of rollouts, without requiring additional rollouts from intermediate states. Supported by Hierarchical Rewards (HierR), SLCA routes execution advantages to tool tokens and preference advantages to summary tokens, eliminating advantage contamination (the dominant cross-segment credit misattribution channel) within each policy update. On a 7B backbone, SLCA-GRPO accelerates convergence and outperforms standard GRPO, ToolPO, and RLTR by +2.53 pp on in-domain evaluation, +1.36 pp on the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard (BFCL), and +9.15 pp on $\tau^2$-Bench under the same training budgets, achieving higher accuracy with reduced tool redundancy and costs.

AI.tldr: 针对工具调用智能体在强化学习中的"跨段信用误归因"问题，本文提出SLCA-GRPO框架，通过在结构段层面解耦优势估计，将工具执行优势仅路由至工具token、将摘要偏好优势仅路由至摘要token，辅以HierR分层奖励和SGLS模拟器，在7B模型上跨三个基准均显著优于标准GRPO、ToolPO和RLTR。
AI.motivation: 工具调用智能体的输出是异构的（结构化工具调用与自然语言摘要交替出现），标准GRPO将轨迹级单一标量优势广播至所有token，导致摘要生成产生的梯度噪声泄漏到工具决策token中，引发"全局信号混淆"和"跨段信用误归因"，在符号冲突情况下可能强化错误的工具调用或惩罚正确的工具调用。
AI.method: 提出SLCA-GRPO框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于mask的自动段分解，将可学习token分为工具段（含推理链和所有先前调用）和摘要段（最终连续响应）；(2) HierR分层奖励，工具过程奖励（S_process由格式/名称/键/值/并行性子奖励加权）与摘要偏好奖励（S_summary由LLM评判器给出）分离；(3) SLCA段锁定信用分配，在同一组rollout内对两个段奖励分别进行组内归一化，再通过token级路由将优势分别分配到对应段，排除跨段污染通道。基础设施包括Schema-Guided LLM Simulator (SGLS)，结合确定性schema校验与冻结跨家族LLM模拟，支持可扩展探索。优化目标为带clip的PPO目标，优势替换为SLCA路由后的段优势。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct主骨干上，SLCA-GRPO相对匹配GRPO在域内Toucan-Test上提升+2.53 pp，BFCL V3单轮提升+1.36 pp，τ²-Bench提升+9.15 pp；3B和8B骨干上呈现一致的增益模式。训练动态显示更短的轨迹长度伴随更高的成功率，梯度范数标准差更低（3B下降25%）。消融验证三个组件各有贡献；工具空间K-sweep（含硬负样本K=100）下SLCA-GRPO在语义干扰场景下仍优于GRPO（+2.25 pp于3B）；执行型二值奖励下SLCA的优势仍然保持（+4.64 pp于τ²-Bench）。
AI.conclusion: SLCA-GRPO通过结构轴上的优势解耦，结构性消除了工具调用强化学习中的跨段信用误归因，且无需额外rollout或拆分模型。该方法在三个骨干模型和三个基准上一致优于匹配GRPO、ToolPO和RLTR，并以更少平均工具轮次实现更高准确率，证明了段锁定信用分配作为"优势层防火墙"的有效性。SLCA与时间轴的信用分配方法（VinePPO/GiGPO/SPO）正交，理论上可组合使用。

title: From Self-Distillation to Self-Practice: Privileged Information for Multi-Turn Agents
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has become a popular recipe for post-training LLM agents. It supervises the agent model at the token level with a stronger teacher view of the same model, obtained by conditioning on privileged information (PI). In this work, we show that in multi-turn agents, this paradigm teaches the student to act with confidence but without the information behind it. The trained agent behaves as if it had privileged information it never observed, and its performance falls well short of plain RL, in the worst case below the untrained base model. Therefore, we propose Privileged Self-Practice (PSP), which keeps the PI and moves it from the loss to the sampler. When the student's rollouts on a task mostly fail, we inject a short per-task instruction written by an analyzer model, sample the task again with the instruction in context, and train on the result with an unchanged GRPO objective. The privileged information stays in the prompt and never enters the loss. Across AppWorld and SWE-bench Verified, with three different student models, PSP obtains the best average score in every setting and is the only method that consistently outperforms plain GRPO, improving task-goal completion by up to 65% on AppWorld and the resolved rate by up to 61% on SWE-bench Verified.

AI.tldr: 本文指出多轮LLM智能体中常用的在线自蒸馏(OPSD)方法存在根本缺陷：通过让同模型在特权信息(PI)条件下蒸馏自身，学生学到了"自信但缺乏依据"的执行模式，性能甚至低于未训练的基线模型。为此提出PSP(Privileged Self-Practice)，将PI从损失函数转移至采样器：当任务rollout成功率低于阈值时，由分析器模型生成简短的逐任务指令注入上下文，重新采样并以原始GRPO目标训练。PI仅出现在prompt中，永远不进入损失。在AppWorld和SWE-bench Verified两个基准、三种学生模型上，PSP在所有设置中获得最优平均分，且是唯一持续优于纯GRPO的方法。
AI.motivation: 多轮智能体训练面临奖励稀疏（单一二元结果跨越多个turn）的问题，OPSD作为流行方案通过将同一模型在PI条件下生成的token分布作为teacher，提供了密集监督信号。然而在多轮agent setting中，teacher依据PI做出的决策信息是学生无法获取的，导致蒸馏目标存在不可约减的gap（I(Y;σ|X,Y<)>0）；更关键的是，agent的每一步都是对环境执行的动作，错误的"自信行为"会在多轮中累积，使OPSD训练后的模型性能低于未训练基线。作者追问：当推理时不具备PI时，应该如何用PI训练agent？
AI.method: 提出Privileged Self-Practice (PSP)：(1) PI构造——冻结的分析器模型W读取任务x、学生当前rollouts F_x和参考轨迹r_x，输出短自然语言指令σ_x（sample-level且dynamic）；(2) Gated Privileged Rollouts——对每个任务先采样非特权group，当成功率p̂_x低于阈值γ时，调用分析器生成σ_x，将σ_x置于系统消息(<skills>块)中，从特权视图重新采样替换原group，否则按普通GRPO训练；(3) 目标不变——全程使用未修改的GRPO目标，优势在各自group内计算，无任何跨视图目标项。理论分析通过Proposition 1证明：当⟨G₀,Gσ⟩>0时，对特权视图的策略梯度步也提升非特权视图的对数似然，且由于σ只决定少数turn（通常1个，最多3个），其梯度贡献近正交，而大多数turn的梯度高度对齐，因此知识能传递且在推理时去除σ后行为保留。
AI.result: 在AppWorld（Qwen3-4B/8B、Gemma4-E4B）和SWE-bench Verified（Qwen3-4B/8B）上的实验显示：(1) OPSD、GRPO+OPSD、SDAR、Skill-SD均显著弱于纯GRPO，纯OPSD甚至低于未训练基线；(2) RLSD和OPID（不改损失方向，仅reshaping优势）是最强基线；(3) PSP在所有设置中获得最优平均分，相对GRPO在AppWorld上TGC提升最高达65%，SWE-bench Verified上resolved rate提升最高达61%，且是唯一在所有benchmark和模型上一致优于GRPO的方法；(4) 消融实验显示γ在0.1-0.5区间均稳定优于GRPO，"always"变体（每次都做特权group）代价翻倍但无收益甚至更差；(5) 在SFT初始化后PSP退化为GRPO（因为多数task不再被gate触发）；(6) 蒸馏基线训练中熵爆炸15-400倍、batch奖励塌陷至零，从机制上印证了OPSD的失败原因。
AI.conclusion: 多轮agent训练中，特权信息不应通过蒸馏损失消费——学生会继承teacher的"自信决策scaffolding"却缺乏支撑信息，在多轮执行中错误累积。PSP将PI保留在采样器中、由门控机制仅在学生自身rollout缺乏梯度时使用，全程保持GRPO目标不变，既避免了OPSD的信息不对称问题，又使训练自然退火到普通RL。该工作为PI在RL agent训练中的使用确立了"采样器而非损失"的设计原则，并指出与信用分配方法（RLSD/OPID）的结合是值得探索的未来方向。

title: CRISS: A Retrieval-Augmented AI Chatbot for Assisting Cancer Registrars
comment: 21 pages, 13 figures, 7 tables. Keywords: cancer registry, retrieval-augmented generation, large language models, conversational AI, clinical informatics, oncology data specialists, medical question answering, AI safety, clinical decision support
summary: Cancer registrars, including Oncology Data Specialists (ODSs), must interpret complex and frequently updated coding and staging standards. We developed CRISS (Cancer Registry Intelligent Support System), a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) conversational assistant that provides rapid, citation-supported access to registry guidance. This study evaluated whether CRISS could (1) support accurate and citation-supported responses, (2) improve access to and interpretation of relevant guidance, and (3) support training/helpdesk use while preserving human oversight of final abstraction decisions. We built a domain-specific knowledge base from national cancer registry standards, segmented into metadata-tagged passages and indexed as dense embeddings. Retrieved passages were used to generate citation-grounded responses through a large language model (LLM). Open-weight, proprietary, and non-RAG baseline models across Gemini and GPT families were evaluated on easy, medium, and hard registry questions using an LLM-as-a-Judge protocols. RAG configurations consistently outperformed non-RAG approaches, especially as question difficulty increased. Mean grounding scores for RAG were 0.62/0.56/0.59 across easy/medium/hard tiers versus 0.29/0.26/0.29 for non-RAG. RAG models also achieved higher semantic-similarity scores overall. Proprietary RAG models performed strongest on easy and medium questions, while local RAG models ranked highest on hard questions and proprietary models were generally more cautious. Domain-specific RAG improved evidence grounding and response quality for cancer registry questions while enabling citation-supported assistance across complexity levels. CRISS demonstrates the potential of human-centered, citation-grounded AI to support cancer registrars while preserving human oversight for final coding decisions.

AI.tldr: CRISS（Cancer Registry Intelligent Support System）是一个面向肿瘤登记员的检索增强生成（RAG）对话助手，基于国家癌症登记标准与指南构建领域知识库，提供带引用支持的实时答疑与培训辅助，并通过保留人类最终决策权来保障安全性。
AI.motivation: 肿瘤登记员（ODS）需要解读频繁更新的复杂编码与分期标准，且现有 AI 方法多聚焦自动化编码而非辅助人类专业判断，缺少针对登记员的交互式、带引用、保留人类监督的支持工具。
AI.method: 构建领域知识库（分段+元数据+稠密向量索引）；多跳语义检索+重排序+时效感知；引用支撑的保守生成策略；React前端+Flask后端+AWS EC2+语义缓存。评估方面：208题（易/中/难三档）×22个模型配置（开源/闭权/基线，Gemini与GPT家族），采用ROUGE、BERTScore F1、句向量余弦相似度等自动指标+跨家族LLM-as-a-Judge（GPT-4o与Gemini双裁判六维评分+四类失败标志）。
AI.result: RAG在grounding上显著优于非RAG（0.62/0.56/0.59 vs 0.29/0.26/0.29，easy/medium/hard），提升约103–118%；RAG Local在难问题上LLM-as-a-Judge得分最高，文本相似度也最高；RAG Proprietary在易/中题上表现最强但更谨慎（拒绝率23.1% vs 15.3%），本地模型更愿意给出直接答案；多数模型复合检索得分≥0.70。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定的RAG显著提升证据扎根度与响应质量，难题上优势更明显；但本地模型的"难题优势"部分源于其更少承认不确定性的响应行为，而非临床推理更可靠；强调人类最终监督，呼吁未来结合真实登记员工作流进行前瞻性评估。

title: A Rapid Pipeline for Training and Deploying ML Models on WeBe Band
summary: Developing optimized machine-learning algorithms for edge devices with limited computational and memory resources is challenging, time-consuming, and highly dependent on device-specific constraints. In this work, we streamline an edge ML workflow to enable rapid development, optimization, and deployment of machine-learning (ML) models directly on the WeBe Band, a wrist-worn wearable device designed for multimodal physiological data monitoring. The proposed system automatically generates hardware-efficient ML models that can be easily integrated into the WeBe core firmware, supporting AutoML, hardware-aware quantization, and performance profiling to build models that meet desired latency targets while remaining compatible with device memory and power limitations. The proposed framework tightly integrates the open-source Piccolo AI ecosystem with an automated pipeline that generates deployable firmware artifacts, performs hardware-aware model compilation, and supports over-the-air (OTA) deployment. The system supports multiple lightweight model classes, including classical machine-learning algorithms and neural networks, and provides built-in on-device profiling tools to evaluate inference latency and memory footprint under realistic execution conditions. Experimental results demonstrate clear trade-offs between model complexity and deployability on a microcontroller, showing that classical models offer strong real-time performance while lightweight neural networks require careful resource management. Rather than proposing new learning architectures, the current work mainly focuses on system-level automation, deployability, and enabling researchers and developers to rapidly iterate on models and evaluate them directly on target hardware. Although demonstrated on the WeBe Band platform, the workflow is designed to be extensible to other ML-powered edge devices.

AI.tldr: 本文针对WeBe Band腕戴可穿戴设备，提出了一个端到端的TinyML自动化流水线，集成了开源Piccolo AI框架，支持AutoML、硬件感知量化与OTA部署，并提供片上推理延迟与内存剖析功能。系统在基于ARM Cortex-M4F的WeBe Band上验证了Random Forest、PME和轻量级神经网络在六种手势分类任务中的部署性表现。
AI.motivation: 边缘/可穿戴设备上的TinyML部署涉及机器学习、固件与硬件工具链等多领域知识，门槛较高，限制了缺乏嵌入式背景的跨学科研究人员（尤其是医疗健康领域）将ML模型实际部署到目标硬件进行真实评测。本文旨在弥合"模型开发"与"嵌入式部署"之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出六阶段端到端流水线：数据采集(25Hz,六种手势A/B/C/D/X/O) → 预处理(66维特征) → 基于Piccolo AI训练RF/PME/多种FC-NN → 自动生成头文件与OTA固件包 → 蓝牙OTA烧录 → 基于ARM CoreSight DWT周期计数器进行片上推理延迟剖析并测量存储占用。量化部分借助TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers (TFLM)。
AI.result: 在WeBe Band (nRF52840, 64 MHz, 1 MB RAM)上的实测：RF推理延迟≈8.52 ms，PME≈8.76 ms；NN(32–32–16–8)在10.54 ms以内。Flash占用方面RF≈10.4 KB、PME≈8.2 KB最低；NN需15.6–24.0 KB Flash，SRAM统一约4.4 KB。25 Hz滑动窗口(步长20样本)下推理可实时执行且不丢采样；NN延迟峰值更明显。总体表明经典ML模型在MCU上具有更优的延迟-内存权衡，NN需更谨慎的资源管理。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线不追求新模型架构，而是聚焦系统级自动化、可部署性与片上剖析，将研究者从底层固件中解放出来，加速TinyML在医疗可穿戴场景的迭代。经典模型更适合强实时MCU部署；NN在资源允许时可提供更强表达力。流水线被设计为可扩展到其他Cortex-M平台（如STM32、ESP32、nRF53系列）。

title: Functional Architecture of European Electricity Trading Markets: Requirements for AI Supported Trading Systems under Regulatory Constraints
comment: 12 pages, 1 table. Published in Swissi AI Journal under CC BY 4.0
summary: European electricity trading in the EU operates as a constrained multi-layer system in which legal design, exchange microstructure, and network physics are executed jointly across forward, day-ahead, intraday, and balancing horizons. This paper develops a functional architecture for AI-supported trading that is aligned with market-coupling mechanics, cross-zonal transfer constraints, and compliance obligations under REMIT, MiFID II, MiFIR, and EMIR. The contribution is a formal system specification composed of a decision-state vector, residual-exposure accounting, constrained optimization objective, executable-action permission gate, and fail-closed AI control logic with auditable records. The analysis maps major Nominated Electricity Market Operator (NEMO) venues and related exchange operators into an operational venue topology and identifies where cross-border coordination fails in practice: interface-level timing, permission heterogeneity, and balancing-layer coupling. The resulting framework proposes how AI can be deployed as a bounded decision component inside regulated market operation with explicit governance, rather than as an unconstrained prediction layer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在欧盟监管约束下支持AI的欧洲电力交易系统的功能架构，将电力市场建模为跨越远期、日前、日内和平衡时段的耦合约束控制系统，并给出了形式化的系统规范，包括决策状态向量、残余暴露计算、受约束的优化目标、可执行动作权限门和故障安全(fail-closed)控制逻辑。
AI.motivation: 现有AI在电力市场中的研究多集中于子模块（如日前/日内价格预测、强化学习竞价构建），缺乏将跨境耦合约束、多场所权限和合规设计跨端到端执行整合起来的统一架构。欧盟电力交易具有法律设计、交易所微观结构和网络物理联合执行的多层次约束特征，需要一个将合规义务、市场耦合机制和主体权限映射为AI交易系统可实施需求的操作架构。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1)市场设计分析——基于Regulation (EU) 2019/943、CACM、FCA、EB GL等法规，将市场建模为远期/日前(SDAC)/日内/平衡(PICASSO, MARI, TERRE)的同步多时段控制系统；(2)角色与规则映射——梳理REMIT、MiFID II、MiFIR、EMIR合规义务及NEMO指定/护照制度，编制17家主要交易所的场所拓扑表；(3)形式化系统规范——定义决策状态向量s_t(方程1)、残余暴露ξ_{t,z}(方程2)、约束优化目标(方程3，含CVaR尾部风险与监管成本)、可执行动作指示器Ω_i(方程4，权限门)；(4)AI架构设计——构建策略优化(方程5)、预测集的分布自由覆盖(方程6)、故障安全执行控制(方程7)、漂移触发的策略覆盖(方程8)、不可变审计记录元组(方程9)和验证指标向量(方程10)；(5)电池储能案例验证多时段耦合优化。
AI.result: 成果为一个完整的"合规设计"功能架构：(a)将日内出清视为耦合分配结果而非独立经济调度；(b)许可门(方程4)将合规检查从交易后过滤前移至交易前约束；(c)故障安全逻辑(方程7)使AI决策层在约束违反时默认空动作；(d)审计记录(方程9)支持从预测输入到结算后果的逐行重建；(e)价值堆叠(value stacking)表明电池在日前套利、日内再优化、平衡/调频服务等多层收入可显著超越单一市场预测。该架构将欧盟AI法案和NIST AI风险管理框架的生命周期治理结构操作化为可测试、可监控的执行逻辑。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张将欧洲电力交易建模为一个跨时段的耦合约束控制问题，其中市场结果是容量约束耦合、场所时序规则和主体义务的联合产物。AI应被定位为受监管市场运营中的有界决策组件，而非自治层。架构需将状态表示、残余暴露、约束优化、不确定性校准和故障安全控制整合为最小决策系统，并将许可编码于执行之前、把不确定性和治理作为一等状态变量对待。论文明确局限性：未覆盖所有国家实施细节、抽象了数据路径脆弱性、法律环境动态演变、定量公式仍需在同步多场所事件流上进行样本外压力实证验证。

title: CounterRoute: Self-Routed Reasoning via Hierarchical Counterfactual Credit Assignment
comment: 16 pages including 7 tables and 4 figures, under review
summary: Reasoning-capable language models often produce long chains of thought when direct answers suffice, wasting inference compute. Many dual-mode models leave this choice to users. Automating it is challenging because routing targets evolve with the policy, initial mode preferences destabilize exploration, and sequence-level objectives entangle routing with response learning. We introduce CounterRoute, an online reinforcement-learning framework that jointly learns routing and modeconditioned responses in one shared policy directly from a native dual-mode checkpoint, without method-specific SFT warm-up. Paired current-policy counterfactual rollouts assign cross-mode credit only to the routing token, while within-mode GRPO trains response tokens. A paired-to-self-routed curriculum stabilizes early training with forced rollouts from both modes, then increases self-routed updates to improve autonomous routing. Across nine benchmarks, CounterRoute better balances accuracy and efficiency than heuristic and learned adaptive-routing methods. Relative to always-thinking checkpoints, it improves macro-average accuracy while reducing mean generated tokens by 51% for Qwen3-8B and 41% for Qwen3-14B. On instruction-following and commonsense benchmarks where direct answering is strong, think rates fall as low as 1% while response quality improves. Despite training only on math and instruction following, its routing behavior and response quality generalize to held-out coding, science, knowledge, and commonsense benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CounterRoute提出了一种在线强化学习框架，让单个双模式Qwen3模型自主学习在"思考"和"直接回答"之间路由，通过配对反事实rollout分配路由信用、组内GRPO训练响应，并采用配对到自路由的课程学习。
AI.motivation: 推理型语言模型常对简单问题也生成长思维链，浪费推理算力；现有自适应推理方法存在三个挑战：路由目标随策略变化、序列级目标混淆路由与响应信用、自主路由产生自我强化探索偏差。
AI.method: 1) 配对反事实更新：强制当前策略同时在思考和直接模式下各生成K条rollout，计算效用差Δ_i作为路由信用（用±s·tanh(Δ_i)有界化），仅赋给位置0的路由token；2) 组内GRPO：响应token在各自模式组内单独归一化训练；3) 自路由更新：让策略自由选择模式并用标准GRPO；4) 配对到自路由课程：从100%配对逐步过渡到70%自路由+30%配对。
AI.result: 在9个基准测试上，Qwen3-8B宏平均准确率达79.1%（比always-thinking提升），平均token减少51%；Qwen3-14B准确率达82.4%，token减少41%。在指令跟随和常识任务上思考率降至1%且响应质量提升；在训练中未见过的编码、科学、知识、常识任务上路由行为也能泛化。消融实验验证了反事实配对、模式分离响应优化和有界路由信用的必要性。
AI.conclusion: CounterRoute将自适应推理形式化为路由和响应生成的联合在线学习，单个双模式检查点可同时学习如何回答以及何时推理值得其开销。其分层信用分配和课程设计优于固定模式、启发式和已学习的自适应路由基线，在保持准确性的同时显著提升效率。

title: Sharp Limits for Honest Uncertainty in Hard-Budget Repeated Evaluation
summary: Repeated evaluation can estimate a benchmark score accurately while still requiring replication to certify narrow uncertainty. We characterize that requirement on a fixed grid of $M$ tasks with $L$ binary paths per task under the hard budget $(M+t)K$, where each path costs at most $K$ responses or episodes. For fixed $L \ge 3$ and $0 < \alpha \le 1/12$, the optimal expected width on the worst pure cohort is $\Theta_{\alpha,L}([M(t+1)]^{-1/2})$ when every task is observed and $\Theta_{\alpha,L}([M(t+\sqrt{M})]^{-1/2})$ when omission is allowed. The lower bounds cover adaptive hard-budget policies, and fixed random-subset designs attain both rates through disagreement certificates. A joint mean/disagreement interval turns the task-covering law into practical finite-budget inference. In an equal-budget LiveCodeBench replay with 16 models, 880 tasks, and five outputs per task, the task-covering design reduces median point-estimation MSE by 87.0\% relative to pooled uniform sampling, while the Joint certificate produces narrower confidence intervals in 15/16 panels and reduces median interval width by 30.6\%. Finite-regime analyses identify task coverage as the effective choice at the evaluated scale and characterize how cohort size and within-task agreement determine the useful operating region. Together, the sharp laws and fixed-budget evidence make replication and task coverage explicit design variables for information-efficient repeated evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究硬预算下重复评估的诚实不确定性认证问题。在M个任务、每任务L条二进制路径的网格上，预算为(M+t)K时，证明了两条最优最差纯群宽度定律：要求覆盖所有任务时最优宽度为Θ([M(t+1)]^{-1/2})，允许省略任务时为Θ([M(t+√M)]^{-1/2})。固定随机子集设计通过分歧证书实现这些速率，联合均值/分歧区间在LiveCodeBench重放中将MSE降低87.0%、区间宽度降低30.6%。
AI.motivation: 语言模型和智能体评估中，重复评估可在精确估计基准分数的同时仍需要复制来认证狭窄的不确定性。然而，诚实区间宽度在固定硬预算下的基本限制尚不清楚，特别是任务覆盖与任务省略之间的权衡。本文旨在刻画这一基本的信息极限，并将复制和任务覆盖转化为显式设计变量。
AI.method: 研究在固定M个任务、L条路径、硬预算(M+t)K的条件下，诚实覆盖所有固定潜在群的最优最差纯群宽度。证明涉及匹配的下界和上界定理：定理3（任务覆盖）和定理4（允许省略）。构造方面，使用固定随机子集审计设计，通过分歧证书D_i实现上界；下界通过延迟事件子实验和自适应后验分解证明，覆盖所有任务覆盖的自适应策略（包括允许省略的自适应策略）。联合均值/分歧区间结合样本均值与分歧计数d，使用经典乘积和矩母函数不等式及高斯混合技术（Howard et al., 2021）。有限预算分析通过LiveCodeBench上880个任务、16个模型的1000次随机化重放进行实证验证，使用精确超几何推断和冻结设计进行等预算比较。
AI.result: 理论结果：在固定L≥3和0<α≤1/12下，任务覆盖策略的最优宽度为Θ([M(t+1)]^{-1/2})，允许省略时为Θ([M(t+√M)]^{-1/2})。在零额外预留时，后者将可达阶从M^{-1/2}改变为M^{-3/4}。实证结果：等预算1100输出下，联合区间在15/16个模型面板中更窄，平均宽度降低30.6%，MSE降低87.0%。有限域分析显示任务覆盖是当前规模的有效选择，分歧信息是MSE和宽度改进的主要驱动因素。完整实证网格包括2,492,000次重放执行，覆盖868种条件。
AI.conclusion: 复制缩小了点估计精度与诚实认证之间的可量化差距。任务覆盖产生锐定律[M(t+1)]^{-1/2}，允许省略产生[M(t+√M)]^{-1/2}。基于分歧的固定设计达到这些阶，联合区间改善有限常数。本文将复制从非正式建议转化为量化设计选择，使置信宽度在固定预算下可预测地实现。两个锐定律和构造性区间使信息高效的模型评估成为可能，无需购买额外输出。

title: Scope Before You Persist: Preventing Cross-Family Interference in Agent Memory
summary: Persistent memory lets language-model agents improve prompts and skills without updating model weights. We show that matching retrieval scope to certification scope enables these edits to support reliable repeated adaptation across recurring task families. We study frozen-model agents on ProcStream-RSI, a 12-round code-repair stream, using Orthogonal Regression Control (ORC), an execution-grounded gate for persistent skill edits. In an intervention that holds proposals and gate decisions fixed, retrieving each accepted skill only for its originating family raises mean hidden trajectory utility from 0.713 under global memory to 0.816 and changes harmful deployments from six of eight to none. In 27 paired randomized-order streams, Scoped-ORC improves mean trajectory utility by 0.063 [0.037, 0.094] over Global-ORC, accepts 63 rather than 12 updates, and produces multiple accepted updates in 19/27 streams, with 0/63 harmful acceptances. The global control reaches 0.713, below the static agent's 0.775, because locally valid edits can interfere with unrelated families. These results establish scope matching as a complementary control for persistent agent memory: certification determines whether an edit is supported, while retrieval scope determines where that evidence authorizes its use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"作用域匹配"原则，通过将持久化智能体记忆的检索范围限定在其经验证的任务族内，解决冻结模型智能体在跨任务族持续自适应过程中的"跨族干扰"问题。核心机制是Orthogonal Regression Control (ORC)门控结合按族作用域检索，在27个配对随机化流实验中，将平均隐藏轨迹效用提升0.063，有害接受率从6/12降至0/63。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型智能体可通过提示词和技能编辑实现持续改进而不更新权重，但现有自改进系统存在一个被忽视的问题：在一个任务族上局部有效的技能编辑，在通过单一全局策略部署时可能干扰不相关任务族。这种"跨族干扰"导致全局门控方法（Global-ORC）的性能（0.713）甚至低于静态智能体（0.775）。论文旨在回答：何时持续技能编辑能改进跨重复任务族的已部署智能体，而非仅改进产生最新反馈的那个族。
AI.method: 1) 提出ProcStream-RSI基准：12轮代码修复流，包含9个任务族（boundary、rotation等）的循环出现；2) 设计Orthogonal Regression Control (ORC)门控：对当前族（公共/私有/变态测试）和历史族分别计算配对自助法下界，要求所有通道满足非回归约束；3) 提出族作用域检索（Scoped-ORC）：为每个族维护独立的技能槽位，仅在对应族任务时检索；4) 设计固定输出干预实验：保持提议和门控决策不变，仅改变检索范围以隔离机制效应；5) 27流配对随机化顺序扩展：每个首族三个种子，作用域vs全局配对比较；6) 使用Qwen3-Coder-Next作为冻结执行器-编辑器。
AI.result: 1) 主实验（8流）：Global-ORC仅接受1个提议且6/8有害，MTU=0.713低于Static的0.775；作用域检索仅改变部署范围即把MTU提升至0.816，有害部署从6/8降至0；2) 18流平衡随机进入实验：作用域部署的有害接受数为0 vs全局的3，隐藏检查点效用0.802 vs 0.761；3) 27流完整随机顺序扩展：Scoped-ORC相对Global-ORC提升MTU 0.063 [0.037, 0.094]，接受63次更新（Global仅12次），19/27流有多次接受，0/63有害（Global为6/12）；4) 路由器诊断：学习路由在留一种子上的分类准确率243/243；5) 跨模型迁移：GPT-OSS隐藏通过率0.960；6) HumanEval+迁移性无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 持续智能体记忆需要"认证范围"与"部署范围"的对齐：证据决定更新是否被支持，检索范围决定该证据在何处授权使用。作用域匹配将局部认证转化为可重复的持续自适应（continual adaptation），是一项独立于提议质量和门控精度的补充控制。论文确立的原则是：证明某次更新合理的证据应同时决定其检索位置。

title: Claim-Gated Source-Risk Auditing for Generative Search
comment: International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Automation and Algorithms (AI2A 2026)
summary: A generative search answer can cite a supported passage yet omit a source relationship that changes its interpretation. We specify a claim-gated audit of the query-source-answer tuple. An omission is resolved only when relationship evidence, answer adoption, materiality, and disclosure are all observed; incomplete evidence remains unresolved rather than being treated as independence. The specification separates this endpoint from citation support and review priority, and binds decisions to versioned evidence spans. A reference checker makes the record contract executable. On an exhaustive synthetic suite, it reproduces all 81 three-state predicate combinations and rejects 192 deliberately malformed records. Common-guard baselines and predicate ablations isolate endpoint logic from missing-evidence handling, while controlled transitions check support separation and evidence removal. These are finite contract-conformance results, not detector accuracy or evidence of improved user outcomes. We define the independent annotation, held-out evaluation, and paired utility tests still required to establish semantic validity and deployment benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对生成式搜索的"声明门控"源风险审计规范。该规范聚焦于查询-源-答案三元组中源关系的遗漏问题，通过四个谓词（关系I、采纳A、重要性M、披露D）定义完整的遗漏端点，并采用完全案例策略要求所有四个谓词均被解析后才输出结论。论文贡献包括：（1）四谓词遗漏端点及显式的完整案例策略；（3）将源证据、答案级判断和事后审查优先级分离的记录合约；（3）包含公共守卫基线、组件消融和畸形记录测试的可复现一致性测试套件。在穷举的合成测试套件中，系统重现了所有81个三态谓词组合，并拒绝了192个故意构造的畸形记录。作者明确声明这些结果仅为合约一致性结果，而非检测器准确性证据，并定义后续仍需完成的独立标注、留出评估和配对效用测试。
AI.motivation: 现有的可验证性审计主要关注引文是否支持所附陈述，但存在一个不同的问题：当一个被支持的陈述来自与查询目标存在某种关系的来源时，即使陈述准确，将其解读为独立评估可能仍然不当。例如，付费联盟会员撰写的评测被用于推荐产品但未披露关系时，仅靠引文支持无法解决上下文缺失问题。需要一种可审计的规范来判定答案是否遗漏了应披露的来源关系。
AI.method: 方法核心是针对查询-源-答案三元组 r=(q,u,a) 的声明门控审计规范：1) 四个三态谓词（I:查询相关关系、A:来源声明采纳、M:关系是否影响解读、D:答案中充分披露）取值于{0,1,U}；2) 完全案例端点 R_O(r)：任一谓词为U则输出U，否则输出 I·A·M·(1-D)；3) 五维证据向量 d(r)=(d_Q,d_I,d_A,d_M,d_G) 分别表示查询易感性、关系证据、采纳、重要性和披露不足；4) 审查优先级 T_post(r) = Σ w_k d_k 为加权求和；5) 记录合约存储查询标识、URL、快照、管道元数据、代码本版本、谓词判断和证据偏移；6) 使用SHA-256快照摘要绑定元组与记录身份；7) 参考检查器按确定性顺序执行：验证哈希→验证谓词→验证映射→解析端点→计算优先级→附加验证门。一致性评估采用穷举合成测试：枚举{0,1,U}^4的全部81个组合（含1个正例、15个负例、65个未解析案例），对比基线（仅支持、仅关系、仅披露）并施加公共守卫；谓词消融逐一移除每个布尔要求；结构变异测试包括证据移除、支持分离、查询优先级分离、控制二元对、规范往返、注释版本谱系及192个畸形记录（12种缺陷类型×16个完整观察记录）。
AI.result: 一致性测试结果：1) 完全真值表 81/81 全部匹配；2) 证据移除 216/216：替换任一已观察谓词为U后终点保持未解析；3) 支持分离 81/81：切换段落支持不影响端点；4) 查询优先级分离 891/891；5) 受控二元对 32/32；6) 规范往返 81/81；7) 注释版本谱系 81/81；8) 拒绝畸形记录 192/192。基线对比（无守卫）显示：仅支持方法在16个完整状态中漏检1个正例且错误解析全部65个不完整状态；仅关系和仅披露方法各在7个完整状态上不一致并解析38个不完整状态；施加公共守卫后未授权解析消失但完整状态不匹配仍存在。端点开销微基准测试：单进程Intel Xeon Platinum 8573C，端点循环约0.49 μs/元组，全记录检查约51.20 μs/元组（不含I/O与检索生成）。
AI.conclusion: 本文形式化了"生成式答案是否保留了重要的来源关系"这一问题，并实现了具有显式缺失处理、证据指针和分离审查优先级的记录检查器。穷举谓词枚举、公共守卫比较、组件消融和结构变异仅建立实现的有限一致性，同时揭示了完全案例策略的覆盖成本。作者明确声明这些不是检测器准确性、遗漏普遍性或应用效益的证据。未来工作必须包括：1) 真实网络发现（归档观察、时间戳、检索溯源）；2) 语义有效性（独立标签、可靠性、裁决）；3) 检测器准确性（冻结系统、留出标签、类别指标与区间）；4) 应用效益（配对干预、遗漏与效用度量）。规范声明可被证伪的条件包括：标注者无法一致地应用M、角色分类法系统性排除相关关系、更简单的溯源规则在独立标签上表现相当、完全案例要求导致审查负担过重、上文化在不减遗漏的情况下损害答案效用。

title: A Wrong Turn Does Not Ruin the Journey: Deviation-Guided Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model agents increasingly rely on natural-language skills to solve complex tool-use tasks. However, such tasks often admit multiple valid solution paths, making it inappropriate to improve skills by forcing failed trajectories to match a fixed successful trajectory. Moreover, failed trajectories are rarely entirely wrong: an agent may first collect useful evidence and make meaningful progress, but later deviate into an erroneous suffix. We therefore argue that skill self-evolution should identify where productive problem solving begins to break down, rather than reflect coarsely over the entire failure. Based on this insight, we propose SkillPivot, a deviation-point-guided framework for skill self-evolution. SkillPivot detects the transition from a useful prefix to an erroneous suffix using execution validity, goal progress, and action diversity. A stronger teacher then continues from the same prefix and produces a successful alternative under the same interaction history. By contrasting the student's failed suffix with the teacher's successful suffix, SkillPivot generates localized skill updates while preserving already effective guidance. Experiments on ToolQA, LogicBench, and WildClawBench show that SkillPivot consistently outperforms competing skill-evolution methods, improves multiple agent models, and produces compact, transferable skill updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillPivot框架，通过检测失败轨迹中"有用前缀"与"错误后缀"的偏离点，引导LLM智能体的技能自进化，实现局部化、可审计的技能更新。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体通过自然语言技能库指导工具使用，但技能往往不完整。现有技能进化方法通常对整条失败轨迹进行反思或将失败轨迹强行对齐到固定的成功轨迹，忽略了失败轨迹中前段有效探索、后段才出错的关键特性，导致技能更新噪声大、过拟合于具体实例，甚至覆盖已有有效知识。
AI.method: SkillPivot包含五个阶段：1)学生智能体执行任务生成ReAct轨迹；2)基于执行有效性(Exec)、目标进度(Prog)、动作多样性(Div)三个信号计算每步"进度势能"得分，定位偏离点；3)更强的教师智能体从相同前缀继续执行生成成功后缀；5)对比学生失败后缀与教师成功后缀，通过轨迹摘要器和技能增量生成器产出候选技能增量；6)回归门控验证器检查无回归(no regression)和可泛化规则(generalizable rule)两项标准，仅在两项得分均超过阈值θ=0.5时接受更新。
AI.result: 在ToolQA上，SkillPivot将平均成功率从53.18%提升至59.36%，且增益可跨任务组泛化；优于SkillClaw、SkillForge、AutoSkill等基线方法，且更新更紧凑；进化后的技能可迁移至GPT-4o mini、Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen等多种模型；偏离点定位的Point Agree.达70.81%，教师续写成功率56.18%，优于随机干预和LLM直接定位；在LogicBench和WildClawBench上同样取得最优性能，且支持多轮持续进化。
AI.conclusion: SkillPivot将失败转化为局部化维护信号而非无控制重写，进化的技能捕获可复用的程序性知识而非实例补丁，能够跨任务组、进化轮次、智能体骨干和任务环境迁移，表明维护和进化外部技能语料库是实现更可靠、持续改进智能体的有前景路径。

title: IndicBankBench: Evaluating Safety and Reliability of Language Model Assistants in Indian Retail Banking
summary: Banking assistants must use account-specific information to answer requests and, in many cases, take actions through tools. Evaluating only the final response misses important errors. An assistant may ask for information it already has, rely on stale context, select the wrong account, or write an invalid value after stating the correct one. We introduce IndicBankBench, a 799-case benchmark for Indian retail banking spanning five operational domains, a capability/refusal domain, and twenty primary axes. Cases are evaluated at four stages: safety, action and tool use, response adequacy, and advisory quality. Tool use and most safety checks are deterministic. A narrow resolver handles only ambiguous confirmation-before-write cases, while a separate LLM judge evaluates semantic response adequacy. We run every case three times and report strict pass^3, which requires success on all trials. Across the eleven evaluated models, strict reliability ranges from 43.7% to 58.2%, whereas at-least-once success ranges from 60% to 74%. This gap shows that at-least-once success can overstate dependable banking behavior. The case-level diagnostics also distinguish systems that ask unnecessary questions from those that act but fail to reconcile customer context or fully resolve the request. We release the cases, mock environment, and evaluation harness.

AI.tldr: IndicBankBench是一个针对印度零售银行的799案例多轮基准测试，采用四阶段（S/A/R/Q）分级模型，评估语言模型助手在安全、工具使用、响应充分性和建议质量方面的可靠性。对11个模型评估后，严格pass³（连续三次通过）在43.7%到58.2%之间，而至少一次通过率在60%到74%之间，揭示了聚合指标无法反映的可靠性差距。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试多以聚合准确率评估银行助手，无法揭示具体错误模式（如使用陈旧上下文、错误账户确认前调用工具等）。此外，单次成功率可能高估模型的真实可靠性，尤其是在涉及金融操作的场景中，需要一种能区分"偶发成功"与"可靠完成"的诊断性评估方法。
AI.method: 构建799个多轮银行交互案例，覆盖五个业务领域、一个能力/拒绝领域和20个主轴。采用确定性模拟工具（32个）替代真实银行系统。每个对话在四个有序阶段评估：安全（S）、行动与工具使用（A）、响应充分性（R，使用LLM评判员）、建议质量（Q）。每个案例运行三次，使用pass³（三次全部通过）作为严格可靠性指标。
AI.result: 11个模型中，严格pass³范围为43.7%（Gemma 4 E4B IT）到58.2%（DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813）。前五名模型差距仅11个案例。至少一次通过率与严格通过率之间存在10.8至21.4个百分点的差距。最常见的一阶失败门是A1（未调用必需工具）和R（响应未满足案例要求）。错误信息轴（wrong_info）是七个模型中得分最低的任务轴。
AI.conclusion: 没有模型严格可靠性超过60%。聚合分数会掩盖关键差异：系统可能过度澄清而非检索证据、选择错误目标、忽略相关上下文或在确认前采取行动。重复试验和案例级失败诊断使这些差异可见。该基准作为诊断评估资源发布，配套代码和案例数据均开源。

title: Right Choice of Classification Algorithms Based on Reinforcement Learning for Prediction of Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver
summary: There are many complex issues in the world of artificial intelligence. Some of these problems are solved using other artificial intelligence methods, which are called artificial intelligence for artificial intelligence. Finding an appropriate classifier algorithm is a time-consuming task. For this reason, an algorithm that can automatically learn the choice of classification algorithms is very important. Classification algorithms are useful in predicting various diseases. Also, Primary Biliary Cirrhosis is one of the most well-known diseases that have been predicted by classification algorithms. This research's most significant achievement and novelty is the automatic increase in learning through a scoring method of reinforcement learning is called square learning (SL). In this research, an algorithm is presented that learns to automatically select the appropriate classification algorithm to predict Primary Biliary Cirrhosis. In this article, with inspiration from four evaluation metrics in classification algorithms, a new reinforcement learning method by the name of Fourth Degree Learning has been presented. In this research, we increased the performance of the classification algorithms used in this method from 63% of accuracy and achieved 98% accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的自动分类算法选择框架（Fourth Degree Learning/方学习），用于预测原发性胆汁性肝硬化（PBC）。该方法通过引入四阶评估机制自动选择最优分类器，将预测准确率从63%提升至98%。
AI.motivation: 分类算法的选择是耗时的难题，且不同分类器在医学预测（如原发性胆汁性肝硬化）中的表现差异显著。手动挑选最优算法效率低下，亟需能够自动学习算法选择策略的AI-for-AI方法。
AI.method: 1. 提出"方学习（SL/Square Learning）"强化学习方法；2. 受分类算法四项评估指标（准确率、精确率、召回率、F1值）启发，设计"四阶学习（Fourth Degree Learning）"框架；3. 通过强化学习机制自动选择最适合PBC预测任务的分类算法。
AI.result: 在原发性胆汁性肝硬化预测任务中，所提方法将分类准确率从63%提升至98%，性能显著优于传统方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于强化学习的自动分类算法选择机制能够有效提升医学疾病预测性能，方学习与四阶学习框架为AI-for-AI问题提供了可行方案。

title: The Entropy Triangle Method (ETM): A novel framework for the prevention of cardiac arrhythmia with a review of more than 10,000 patients
summary: One of the most important problems in medicine is to facilitate prediction. In this study, we propose entropy triangle method, a novel framework for predicting heart rhythms using a novel machine learning technique. This framework includes three steps: feature engineering, entropy triangle oversampling, and disease prediction. The dataset used in this study is a 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia research database with 10,646 patients. This dataset contains 11 different heart rhythms (5 sinus rhythms and 6 non-sinus rhythms). In this article, we introduce two firsts in machine learning and medicine that can predict non-sinus rhythm with over 85% accuracy. Our experimental results show, among others, that the most accurate classifier based on entropy triangles and the most useful oversampling are the supported vector classifiers and oversampling techniques for shark scent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为"熵三角形方法"的新框架，用于通过机器学习预测心律失常。该框架包含三个步骤：特征工程、熵三角形过采样和疾病预测。使用包含10,646名患者的12导联心电图（ECG）心律失常研究数据库，涵盖11种不同心律（5种窦性心律和6种非窦性心律），实现超过85%的非窦性心律预测准确率。
AI.motivation: 医学预测是医学领域最重要的课题之一，心律失常的准确预测对临床诊断和治疗至关重要。然而，心律失常数据往往存在类别不平衡问题（窦性心律样本远多于非窦性心律），给传统机器学习方法带来挑战。本文旨在开发一种能够有效处理不平衡数据并准确预测非窦性心律的新方法。
AI.method:
本文提出熵三角形方法（Entropy Triangle Method）框架，包含三个核心步骤：
1. 特征工程：从12导联ECG数据中提取有效特征；
2. 熵三角形过采样（Entropy Triangle Oversampling）：使用新颖的过采样技术处理数据不平衡问题，文中提到"shark scent"（鲨鱼气味）过采样技术；
3. 疾病预测：使用支持向量分类器（Supported Vector Classifiers）作为最准确的分类器。
该方法据称在机器学习和医学领域实现了两个"首创"，能够以超过85%的准确率预测非窦性心律。
AI.result:
实验结果显示：
1. 基于熵三角形的支持向量分类器（SVC）是预测非窦性心律最准确的分类器；
2. "shark scent"过采样技术是最有效的过采样方法；
3. 该方法在包含10,646名患者、11种心律类别的数据集上实现了超过85%的非窦性心律预测准确率；
4. 在机器学习和医学领域实现了两个"首创"性贡献。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的熵三角形方法是心律预测领域的一种新颖框架，通过结合特征工程、新型过采样技术和支持向量分类器，有效解决了心律失常数据不平衡问题，实现了对非窦性心律的高精度预测。该研究在机器学习和医学交叉领域具有创新性，为临床心律失常诊断提供了新的技术手段。

title: When Honesty is Not Enough in AI Debate
summary: Scalable oversight aims to verify the behaviour of agents whose capabilities exceed those of their overseers. AI debate has been proposed as an oversight solution in which competing agents help a resource-limited verifier assess claims that it cannot reliably evaluate unaided. Much of its promise rests on incentivizing honest arguments that lead to correct verdicts. Yet a correct verdict need not uniquely determine the arguments used to support it. Agents may retain discretion over which correct claims to present, how to frame them, and in what order to disclose them. This residual freedom can allow agents to shape what the verifier learns beyond the task-relevant conclusion, pursuing latent objectives without compromising verdict correctness. To study this phenomenon, we introduce the framework strategic interactive oversight (SIO), which treats oversight jointly as a verification mechanism and a strategic communication channel. Within this framework, we formalise the notion of task-admissible latent optimisation, which entails the pursuit of latent objectives while maintaining a prescribed task performance. As proof-of-concept, we instantiate SIO in the establish protocol debate with cross-examination and quantify a tradeoff between task success and information disclosure about a hidden variable. The trade-off identifies a strategic window in which substantial disclosure remains compatible with task admissibility. Towards mitigation, we reduce admissible bias by expanding the cross-examiner's role to mitigate persistent disclosure over finite interaction horizons. Our results highlight the need to evaluate oversight not only by the correctness of its verdicts, but also by the information conveyed through its transcripts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"策略性交互监督"（SIO）框架，指出AI辩论中即使保证了正确裁决与诚实声明，辩手仍可通过在任务可接受的策略中进行选择来编码关于隐藏变量的信息。文章形式化"任务可接受的潜在优化"（TALO）威胁模型，在带交叉审问的辩论协议中量化了任务成功与隐藏假设披露之间的权衡，并提出通过扩展交叉审问者角色的滑动窗口一致性检查来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 可扩展监督（如AI辩论）主要关注计算资源不对称下的可验证性，但忽视了人类监督在"如何"进行验证方面的局限性。即使协议产生正确裁决并约束报告的局部准确性，辩手仍可在多个任务成功的策略中自由选择，从而通过论证的框架、呈现顺序等向验证者传达与任务无关的隐藏信息，威胁对齐保证。
AI.method: 1. 提出SIO框架，将监督同时视为验证机制与战略通信通道，分离任务目标Φ与潜在目标Ψ。2. 形式化TALO威胁模型：在任务可接受约束下优化潜在目标。3. 实例化于带交叉审问的辩论协议（Brown-Cohen et al., 2024），定义潜在目标为"隐藏假设披露"Ψ_hhd = I(Q; Π_V(h)|X)。4. 提出辩手扰动策略 σ_A^(R,Δ)：在诚实报告基础上加入大小为Δ、方向由隐藏变量Q决定的偏移。5. 通过Chernoff界、Berry-Esseen定理和Hoeffding引理等技术，证明任务目标Φ和潜在目标Ψ关于Δ和交互轮数T的定量界限（定理1-3）。6. 提出缓解方案：扩展交叉审问为滑动窗口漂移挑战（定理4）。
AI.result: 1. 在小扰动区域 Δ < 1/(16d) 内，任务成功率Φ接近参考接受概率α*，而披露量Ψ以Ω(h_x · min{1, Δ²T})的速度增长，即累积信息可随轮数线性增长（定理3）。2. 存在战略窗口：小偏差不影响辩论结果，但累积披露显著。3. 滑动窗口一致性检查可将持久扰动的检测阈值从1/d降至1/(d√W)，使诚实策略保持任务成功率≥3/5，而扰动策略σ_A^(2)的成功率降至≤1/150（定理4）。4. 缓解方案以额外的验证者工作为代价，但保持辩手每轮采样工作量不变。
AI.conclusion: AI辩论中诚实的论证不足以保证安全的监督。正确的裁决与局部准确的报告不能防止交互过程成为潜在信息传输的通道。监督机制应同时评估决策质量与累积披露，包括通过中止所揭示的信息。该研究呼吁从仅关注终端裁决正确性转向同时审查交互记录的信息泄露属性。

title: ASIRF: An Agentic Framework for Context-Dependent Sensitive Information Redaction
summary: Sensitive information is defined by domain and intent, not a universal category, yet redaction systems such as privacy filters and named-entity recognizers fix a taxonomy at training time, requiring retraining for each new domain. We introduce ASIRF (Agentic Sensitive Information Redaction Framework), which retrieves domain-specific definitions based on the input's domain from a flexible knowledge base at inference time, needing no retraining to adapt. Two architectures, a three-call multi-agent pipeline and a single-agent variant, are evaluated across ten small open-weight models and eight datasets, including out-of-distribution fictional domains, against the OpenAI Privacy Filter (OPF) as a trained-classifier baseline. With only a few dozen expert-authored definitions per domain and no training data, ASIRF's recall exceeds OPF's in 68 of 80 model-domain combinations (85 percent), by at least one of the two architectures, with shortfalls confined mostly to OPF's training-distribution domains.

AI.tldr: ASIRF是一个智能体框架，通过推理时检索领域特定的敏感信息定义（而非训练时固定的分类体系），实现在少量专家定义、零训练数据条件下对敏感信息的高效检测与脱敏。
AI.motivation: 现有的敏感信息检测系统（如隐私过滤器、命名实体识别器）在训练时固定了分类标签体系，当面对新领域或新敏感属性时，需要重新标注数据和重新训练，成本高昂。然而敏感信息的定义本质上是依赖领域和意图的，不存在通用的类别，因此需要一种能在推理时灵活适应新领域的框架。
AI.method: ASIRF将敏感属性分类体系从模型权重迁移到推理时的知识库中，通过ChromaDB向量数据库进行语义检索（基于余弦相似度和HNSW图索引）。框架包含三种逻辑步骤：(1) 领域分类（Context Analyzer）；(2) 检索相关敏感属性定义（Entity Retriever）；(3) 提取匹配的值（Value Detector）。提出了两种架构：ASIRF-Multi（多智能体三步流水线）和ASIRF-Single（单智能体一步完成）。在10个开源小模型（涵盖Gemma-3、Qwen3、Ministral三个系列，参数范围1B-14B）上评估，使用8个数据集（含3个合成真实领域、2个虚构领域、3个外部数据集），以OpenAI Privacy Filter（OPF）为基线，采用token级模糊重叠作为评测指标。
AI.result: 在80个模型-领域组合中，ASIRF在68个（85%）组合上的召回率超过OPF。最佳模型（Ministral-14B）在所有数据集上均超过OPF。即使是最弱的Gemma-3-1B模型，在两个虚构领域（星际移民局、被遗忘的未来档案馆）上也超越了OPF的固定召回率。消融实验表明移除检索模块会降低召回率。精确率方面，ASIRF在多数领域低于OPF（因其倾向于过度脱敏），但召回率（合规关键指标）显著更优。两种架构在不同领域和模型族上各有优势，无统一赢家。
AI.conclusion: ASIRF证明推理时知识库机制可在远低于训练式检测器准备成本的情况下实现更优的敏感信息检测召回率，尤其在训练分布之外的领域和虚构领域（任何固定分类器都无法识别的类别）上表现突出。代价是推理时LLM调用成本高于OPF的轻量前向传播。未来工作包括通过引入Web搜索回退机制将新领域准备时间进一步压缩至零，以及提升知识库质量。

title: Towards An LLM-Driven Unified Conversion Framework for BT and FSM in Autonomous Intelligent Systems
summary: Finite state machine (FSM) and behavior trees (BT) are widely adopted behavioral modeling paradigms for autonomous intelligent systems. While functionally equivalent and inter-convertible in principle, existing transformation methods between FSM and BT face major challenges in preserving behavioral completeness and avoiding model complexity explosion. To overcome these issues, we propose an LLM-driven unified conversion framework that enables automatic, efficient, and semantically consistent transformation between FSM and BT. Specifically, a novel loop execution BT structure is designed for LLM to accurately capture the loop structure in FSM, thereby preserving behavioral completeness. To mitigate the state explosion problem in BT-to-FSM conversion, a depth compression strategy is introduced with LLM prompt to eliminate redundant control nodes, complemented by differentiated hierarchical conversion rules that collectively reduce the number of required sub-FSM. Simulation experiments in multiple autonomous decision-making scenarios demonstrate that the proposed framework enables an accurate and automated bidirectional conversion between FSM and BT. Furthermore, it significantly enhances the scalability and maintainability of generated models compared to traditional approaches, providing a practical solution for behavior model conversion in consumer-grade autonomous intelligent systems such as service robots, game agents, and smart home devices

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLMDUCF，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的统一框架，用于有限状态机（FSM）与行为树（BT）之间的自动化双向转换。针对现有转换方法难以保持行为完整性和存在模型复杂度爆炸的问题，设计了新颖的循环执行行为树（LEBT）结构以及深度压缩与差异化分层转换规则，在多个自主决策场景中实现了高准确率（90.65%–98.35%）、高可扩展性的转换效果。
AI.motivation: FSM与BT作为自主智能系统中两种广泛应用的行为建模范式，功能上等价但各有优劣：FSM具有显式状态转换和可验证性优势，但面临O(n²)状态爆炸问题；BT具有模块化和反应性优势，但缺乏透明性。现有转换方法依赖固定模板，难以泛化；LLM直接应用又存在语义理解不足、结构映射不清和结果不稳定等挑战。因此需要一种自动化、语义一致且可扩展的双向转换框架。
AI.method: 提出LLMDUCF（LLM-Driven Unified Conversion Framework），将LLM视为受领域约束的高层转换工程师。包含三大组件：1）FSM-to-BT转换：设计LEBT（Loop Execution BT）四元组结构（ST_entry, ST_branch, ST_seq, ST_sel），通过四步式（角色、任务、逐步转换程序SCP、约束）提示工程引导LLM识别FSM的入口/循环/链式/分支四种典型结构，并映射到LEBT；2）BT-to-FSM转换：采用深度压缩策略消除冗余控制节点形成交替序列-选择结构，再按差异化分层规则每三层划分为转换单元，分别转换为子FSM后集成；3）两级验证模块：LLM语法检查 + NuSMV形式化验证行为一致性，通过反馈提示优化实现错误修复。理论上通过宏观步骤互模拟证明行为等价性。
AI.result: 在三个场景（基础符号、机器人抓取、游戏AI）共1200个模型上实验，使用ChatGPT、DeepSeek、Qwen三种LLM与NLLM基线及传统方法（BSD、CHDS-BT）对比。FSM-to-BT准确率达95.50%–98.35%，BT-to-FSM达90.65%–97.80%，显著优于无SCP的NLLM（约30%）。NuSMV验证表明生成的模型完全满足可达性、完整性、无死锁、终止一致性等行为等价性准则。在模块性方面，节点增删复杂度O(1)优于BSD的O(n)和CHDS-BT的O(n²)；编辑距离更短（4 vs 12/17）；图形元素数量（4M+2k+1）远少于传统方法（≈36M）；工程师认知负荷评分1.8±0.3对比4.3±0.6，理解时间减少42%。100个模型总成本约$5–10（vs 传统方法$430–440）。本地部署Qwen-35B仍可达80%–85%准确率。版本敏感度<3%。
AI.conclusion: LLMDUCF成功实现了FSM与BT之间自动化、语义一致的双向转换，在保持行为完整性的同时显著缓解了子FSM爆炸问题。生成的模型在结构质量上优于传统方法，具有完整路径覆盖、更低修改复杂度和更高可读性。该工作为服务机器人、智能家居、游戏代理、智能电动车等消费级自主智能系统中的行为模型互操作、迁移、验证和维护提供了实用工具。未来工作将扩展至并行节点、装饰器节点和分层FSM等更复杂模型变体。

title: Policy as Code: A Coroutine-Bridge Harness for Fast-Reasoning Reliability on CAR-bench
comment: 4 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Technical report for the winning entry in Track 2 (Cerebras Fast-Reasoning) of the CAR-bench Challenge at IJCAI-ECAI 2026
summary: CAR-bench evaluates whether tool-using agents stay reliable under real-world uncertainty, executing every tool inside the evaluator so that each tool-result exchange is a separate agent round-trip. A conventional next-action agent can batch parallel tool calls, but a chain of dependent calls costs it one model call per round of results. We present a coroutine-bridge harness in which the model's only action is to emit a Python program that blocks and resumes in place across evaluator tool exchanges. This decouples model invocation from tool round-trips: on the public test split the agent uses a median of two model calls against seven agent turns per task, resolving a full multi-turn task in a median of 1.8 s of model latency on Cerebras gpt-oss-120b. Because the action surface is executable code, deterministic CAR-bench policies are encoded directly as logic in the tool layer rather than as prompt rules, enforcing compliance at zero reasoning cost. On the official hidden evaluation the harness won Track 2 with 60.0% Pass^3, 4.5x the organizer baseline, at the lowest estimated cost and the fastest median task latency (3.14 s) of any entry scoring above that baseline; the same unchanged harness reproduced an identical 60.0% Pass^3 on GPT-5.5 in the Open track, matching frontier-model agents. A single static prompt, appended with per-task state at the tail, stays byte-identical across calls and across tasks: the frozen submission prompt served 78% of input tokens from cache (86.6% across its warm tail), against 73% over a three-week development corpus in which prompt edits repeatedly reset the cache. This compounds the few-call design into a small fraction of nominal input compute.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于协程桥（coroutine-bridge）的"代码即策略"智能体框架，在CAR-bench工具执行外部化的约束下，通过让模型生成一个Python程序在工具交换间挂起/恢复，解耦模型调用与工具往返。在Track 2隐藏集上以60% Pass^3（4.5倍基线）夺冠，跨模型复现一致。
AI.motivation: CAR-bench将工具执行外部化以注入扰动，导致n步依赖工具链需要n次模型往返；快速推理（Cerebras gpt-oss-120b）的优势被频繁的模型调用浪费。亟需一种能解耦模型调用与工具轮次、并把确定性策略从提示词下沉到执行层的架构。
AI.method: 1) **协程桥**：模型emit单个Python程序，调用工具时Python线程挂起，评估器执行后结果原路唤醒同一栈帧，无需新模型调用；并行独立调用通过batch合并。2) **代码即策略（Policy as Code）**：确定性策略直接编码进工具包装器（如雾灯安全助手、AC感知的车窗助手），运行时持有事实与策略，模型仅负责意图解释。3) **可靠性机制**：响应义务（遗漏自动追加）、未知值哨兵（"unknown"在有意义运算时触发诚实失败）、作用域内结果跟踪。4) **静态前缀缓存**：单一静态prompt + 任务尾部状态，跨调用跨任务字节一致，最大化前缀缓存命中率（warm tail达86.6%）。
AI.result: 隐藏集（30任务×3trial）：Pass^3=60%（vs 基线13.33%、亚军50%），成功率一致性92.5%（亚军73.9%），中位任务延迟3.14s（最快），预估成本$0.041/trial（最低）；公开测试集：整体Pass^3=87.3%，幻觉类96.0%（最强）；公开集中位2次模型调用驱动7轮agent turn，模型延迟1.8s。GPT-5.5跨模型未改架构复现60% Pass^3，前缀缓存warm tail 86.6%，峰值99.9%。
AI.conclusion: 协程桥将快速推理转化为端到端低延迟与高一致性的关键在于：让单次快速模型调用完成整支分支程序，并把确定性策略编译进程序所调用的工具。该架构在Track 2以最低成本与最快延迟夺冠，并在前沿模型上无架构改动地复现同一分数；但残留40%失败率及Pass@3较低（66.7% vs 76.7%）表明：确定性路径在换取一致性的同时，也关闭了探索型agent偶尔的幸运恢复路径，如何不牺牲一致性地提升Pass@3仍是开放问题。

title: Baszta: Data-Centric Fine-Tuning of a Polish Multi-Label Safety Classifier
summary: We develop a multi-label Polish content-safety classifier by fine-tuning allegro/herbert-base-cased (124M) across five categories (hate, vulgarity, sexual content, crime, self-harm) using a Focal + R-Drop objective, and evaluate the resulting model against Bielik Guard (Sójka) on the shared out-of-distribution Gadzi Język benchmark. Both systems are given per-category threshold tuning on the same calibration split. Under that matched protocol our model holds a small but statistically significant lead in micro F1, while an apparent macro-F1 lead does not survive: it was an artifact of comparing a tuned model against an untuned one. We also report what that micro figure is worth. Because Gadzi Język is 97% crime-positive, a classifier that flags crime on every input and nothing else already scores 0.910 micro F1 on the same test split, so micro separates neither system from a degenerate strategy and macro is the column that does. Per-category and per-protocol figures are reported in Section 4. The residual out-of-distribution gap is one of calibration rather than discrimination. Ranking quality stays high while positive probabilities collapse, and per-category temperature scaling recovers the loss where Platt scaling and isotonic regression do not. That recovery turns out to be conditional on the calibration set containing safe text. Gadzi Język contains almost none, so thresholds fitted on it flag crime on every safe input, and a balanced refit buys a deployable operating point at the cost of adversarial recall. We report both operating points rather than only the flattering one. Two changes that are standard practice, per-class cost-sensitive weighting and mean pooling, each raise in-distribution macro F1 while lowering the out-of-distribution figure, which indicates that robustness has to be selected for directly rather than inherited from in-distribution accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对波兰语多标签内容安全分类任务，以数据为中心微调 HerBERT-base 模型（Baszta），提出 Focal Loss + R-Drop 训练目标与风格匹配合成数据增强，在 OOD 基准 Gadzi Język 上对标 Sójka / Bielik Guard。结果表明：(1) 在配对调参协议下，Baszta 在微观 F1 上取得统计显著但幅度较小的领先（+0.026，p=0.011），而宏观 F1 优势实为操作点伪影；(2) OOD 性能差距源于校准漂移（概率尺度坍缩）而非判别能力，经按类别温度缩放后恢复；(3) 经典 TF-IDF 基线在分布内接近神经模型，说明任务高度词汇化；(4) 通过污染审计发现 PL-Guard 几乎完全泄露入训练集；(5) 提出无训练的反混淆规范化防御，显著提升对表面混淆攻击的鲁棒性。研究强调分布内精度与 OOD 鲁棒性之间存在张力，需直接针对鲁棒性进行优化。
AI.motivation: 随着波兰语 LLM 部署日益普及，内容安全分类器（guardrail）成为关键组件。现有的 Sójka / Bielik Guard 系统依赖人工众包标注，规模与算力受限。本文旨在探索：1) 不同编码器骨干与更丰富的损失/增强策略能否在无需众包标注的情况下匹配其 OOD 鲁棒性；2) 小模型 OOD 性能不足时，瓶颈究竟在判别力、校准还是数据分布。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 在 HerBERT-base 上进行四阶段扫描（Optuna TPE 超参搜索 62 轮 → 前 5 配置完整训练 → 10 次消融 → OOD 评估），采用 Focal Loss (γ=1.5) + R-Drop 复合目标；(2) 数据层面融合 Sójka、PolEval、ForePLay 等公开语料共 26,248 样本，并通过 Azure OpenAI gpt-5-chat 生成风格匹配（祈使句越狱风格）的 crime/sex/self-harm 合成数据；(3) 推理时引入无训练规范化器（同形字符折叠、字符间距修复、重复字符合并、leet 转换还原）；(4) 提出按类别温度缩放的后处理校准；(5) 在 172/348 校准/测试划分上执行配对 bootstrap 显著性检验（2000 重采样，种子 42），并在四个外部基准（KLEJ CBD、BAN-PL、PolyGuard-PL、HateCheck-PL）上进行污染审计后的留出评估。
AI.result: 关键结果：(1) 在 Gadzi Język 上配对调参后，Baszta 微 F1 = 0.929 vs. Sójka 0.903（差 +0.026，95% CI [+0.004, +0.049]，p=0.011，显著）；宏观 F1 0.712 vs. 0.782（不显著，p=0.875），原报告的宏观优势实为 Sójka 未调参所致；(2) 永远预测"crime"的退化基线在该基准上即可达 0.910 微 F1，说明微 F1 区分度有限；(3) 部署平衡操作点下，安全文本误报率 5.5%，宏观 F1 达 0.952，但牺牲了对抗性召回；(4) OOD 性能差距源于校准漂移（按类别 AUC 高但正例概率均值坍缩），按类别温度缩放将宏观 F1 从 0.603 恢复至 0.699，而 Platt/isotonic 失效；(5) TF-IDF + LogReg 基线在分布内达 0.868 宏观 F1（仅落后 HerBERT 4.3 pp），说明任务高度词汇化；(6) 反混淆规范化器在六种混淆攻击下平均恢复 +6.9 pp 宏观 F1，预测翻转率从 8.7% 降至 3.0%；(7) 污染审计发现 PL-Guard 900/900 行中 899 行泄露入训练集，被排除；(8) 外部四基准评估呈 2-2 持平：Baszta 领先 KLEJ CBD（0.671 vs. 0.438）和 PolyGuard-PL；Sójka 领先 BAN-PL（0.754 vs. 0.667，更低误报率）和 HateCheck-PL 名义上但伴随 66.1% 误报率；(9) 校准指标：Baszta ECE=0.092、Brier=0.075 均优于 Sójka 的 0.136/0.114；(10) 控制实验表明，按类别代价敏感加权（Baszta 1.0-α）和均值池化（Baszta 1.0-mp）虽提升分布内宏观 F1，却降低 OOD 宏观 F1 与校准，揭示分布内精度与 OOD 鲁棒性之间存在直接张力。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出以下结论：(1) 数据为中心的 HerBERT 分类器在配对调参协议下，对 Sójka 取得统计显著但幅度较小的 OOD 微 F1 领先，宏观 F1 优势不成立；(2) Gadzi Język 微 F1 因类别严重偏斜而区分度有限，"总是预测 crime"基线即可达 0.910，宏观 F1 才是可靠指标；(3) OOD 差距本质上是校准漂移而非判别失败，按类别温度缩放在包含负例的校准集上有效，但在全正例基准上会产出不可部署的退化操作点（对安全文本 100% 误报）；(4) 数据分布与轻量级校准对小编码器 OOD 鲁棒性的影响远超超参数选择；(5) 标准的"改进"（代价敏感加权、均值池化）在提升分布内精度的同时损害 OOD 鲁棒性，警示鲁棒性必须被直接优化而非从分布内精度继承；(6) 数据卫生教训深刻：理想基准 PL-Guard 几乎完全泄露入训练集，强调训练前必须对每个候选基准执行污染审计；(7) 真正可泛化的改进是无训练的反混淆规范化防御，而非模型层面的修改。局限包括：(a) 合成数据与测试分布风格匹配构成弱适应；(b) 五分类宏观 F1 在 n=4 的 vulgar 类上极不稳定；(c) 最佳模型基于 OOD 选择，存在选择偏差；(d) 无配对、未污染、含安全例的波兰语基准仍是缺失的关键评估。

title: ALOE: Semantically Addressed Low-Rank Operators for Knowledge Editing
summary: Knowledge editing changes what a model knows by modifying parameters so that a requested fact updates while unrelated behavior is preserved. This is usually treated as a write problem, but editing also involves an address problem: deciding which hidden states should receive the new residual. An update that activates too narrowly memorizes one prompt, while one that activates too broadly disrupts neighboring knowledge. Parametric editors encode this scope implicitly, whereas memory-based editors make the selection explicit but keep it outside the edited model. We propose ALOE (Addressed Low-rank Operator for Editing), which learns semantic addresses from paraphrases and hard same-subject negatives, aligns them with autoregressive hidden states through rollout refinement and gate calibration, and embeds the resulting gated low-rank operator within one MLP layer, so that the deployed model runs in a single forward pass with no external retriever or auxiliary router. Evaluated on CounterFact, ZSRE, and KnowEdit across three 7--8B model families, ALOE achieves efficacy between 0.955 and 0.999 and locality between 0.981 and 1.000; mechanistic analyses confirm that the learned geometry separates competing edits and that calibration suppresses out-of-scope activation. The remaining errors concentrate in paraphrase coverage and write fitting.

AI.tldr: ALOE提出将知识编辑解耦为"寻址(address)"与"写入(write)"两个子问题,通过在单个MLP层内嵌入带门控的语义低秩算子,使编辑后的模型在推理时无需外部检索器或路由器即可自主决定哪些隐藏状态应接收新事实残差。
AI.motivation: 现有参数化编辑器(如ROME/MEMIT)中,低秩更新ΔW=UV⊤的V⊤h(x)虽隐式充当寻址机制,但其因子从未被训练以区分释义与语义邻居,导致编辑范围过窄(仅记忆单条提示)或过宽(破坏邻近知识);而SERAC/GRACE/WISE等显式选择机制位于编辑后权重之外,部署时需依赖外部组件。本文旨在将"寻址"作为可学习且内嵌于模型本身的机制来解决这一矛盾。
AI.method: 1) 地址学习:用非对称Q/K映射从释义、局部性输入和同主语硬负样本中学习每个编辑的语义作用域;2) 滚动优化与门控校准:用自回归生成的隐藏状态细化地址向量,并通过死区sigmoid(ε_g=10⁻³)将非激活地址的输出严格置零,可分槽位设阈值使最差负样本落入死区、最差正样本映射至0.9激活;3) 联合写入拟合:对所有写入方向U进行保留正则化的岭回归求解,并用NLL进行最多100步AdamW微调;4) 推理时仅需V、τ、α与U嵌入单层MLP,单次前向传播即可完成。
AI.result: 在CounterFact/ZSRE/KnowEdit三个基准、Llama-2-7B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B三族模型上(编辑流长度839-1301),ALOE在9个模型-基准组合上均实现efficacy 0.955-0.999、locality 0.981-1.000;机制分析显示学习到的地址几何AUC达0.9976(原始隐藏状态仅0.6365),16路同主语top-1达0.8576;消融实验表明滚动优化贡献55.0点efficacy,门控校准贡献24.8点efficacy和96.5点locality;主要不足在于泛化(0.217-0.472),因校准后门控对远离训练释义的改写几乎不开启。
AI.conclusion: ALOE将知识编辑形式化为耦合的"寻址-写入"问题,并通过内嵌于编辑后MLP的语义门控低秩算子实现了无需外部组件的部署。其优势在于跨模型族的一致性(无失败单元)与极低的局部性破坏,主要局限为对训练释义覆盖范围之外的改写泛化能力不足,以及存储和计算随编辑数线性增长。

title: From Text Decisions to Pixels: An Study of Jev-Style Visual Choice Model
summary: Visual software often needs a decision over supplied alternatives rather than a generated explanation. We present PixelJev, a native-image decision interface that maps an image, a task instruction, and a runtime candidate set to a structured choice and candidate-conditioned probabilities using small open multimodal models. Its initial realization unifies recognition and multiplechoice visual question answering through an existing language-model readout, with separately evaluated options for frozen inference, language-side adaptation, and held-out calibration. Across seven benchmark evaluations, 64-shot source adaptation raises Pets accuracy from 60.13% to 92.40% across optimization seeds and transfers to natural resampling, new texture labels, and A-OKVQA without target fitting, while frozen inference already supports both VQA tasks. A matched prompt-only follow-up on Pets and ScienceQA attributes the large Pets gain to adaptation and identifies a narrower output validity benefit of candidate readout in adapted VQA. Specialist DINOv2 probes remain stronger on source recognition, frozen 4B is stronger than adapted 2B on DTD and ScienceQA, and accuracy gains do not ensure calibrated target probabilities. These findings establish a working starting point for general-purpose visual decision models and identify the remaining requirements: schema robustness, cross-family transfer, and reliable use of visual evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PixelJev，一种面向程序的视觉决策接口，将图像、任务指令和运行时候选集合映射为结构化选择和条件概率，基于小型开源多模态模型（如Qwen3.5-2B/4B）实现跨识别与多选视觉问答任务的统一决策契约。
AI.motivation: 视觉模型在软件部署中常需在给定候选间做决策而非生成描述，固定分类器只能暴露一种标签词表，对话式VLM暴露生成文本，二者之间缺少运行时候选空间可变的程序化决策抽象。论文旨在建立"视觉决策模型"这一接口，并探讨少样本适配在不同任务族间的迁移能力。
AI.method: 方法包含三个独立可评估的运行模式：（1）冻结推理，在Qwen3.5语言模型头的候选槽位上读取logits并通过softmax归一化得到候选条件概率；（2）语言侧LoRA适配（rank 16，仅更新语言注意力投影层，64-shot/类，跨CIFAR-10/Pets/EuroSAT三任务共享一个适配器，候选排列随机化）；（3）保留温度缩放标量校准。接口支持2≤K≤52个候选，通过tokenizer验证单token可逆性、ID唯一性和对话模板边界完整性。
AI.result: 64-shot源域适配将Pets准确率从60.13%提升至92.40%±0.26%，EuroSAT从49.63%提升至88.31%±1.57%；在CIFAR-10.1（自然重采样）达到95.05%，DTD（新纹理标签，无需适配）达到58.28%；冻结推理在A-OKVQA（80.61%/85.07%）和ScienceQA（81.51%/89.84%）上无需VQA拟合即可工作；分类适配器迁移到A-OKVQA达83.32%。DINOv2探测头在源域识别任务上仍优于适配后Qwen（Pets 95.67% vs 92.40%）。匹配prompt-only对照表明Pets增益源自适配本身，而ScienceQA上候选读出带来的+1.88pp优势完全来自输出有效性修复。校准虽降低NLL但未必改善ECE。
AI.conclusion: PixelJev证明了原生图像决策接口的可行性：冻结的小型多模态模型已能实例化该接口，少样本语言侧适配改善源域识别和部分迁移而无需任务特定输出头；但专家编码器、更大冻结模型和保留校准暴露出当前实现的局限。通往通用视觉决策模型需要schema鲁棒性、跨家族迁移和可靠视觉证据利用三方面的进展，而非仅追求单一分类分数提升。

title: When No One Owns the Judgment: Accountability Under Contribution Dissolution in Human-AI Collaboration
comment: In CSCW'26 workshop on contribution, originality, and accountability in agent-mediated collaboration
summary: Communities often respond to potentially AI-assisted work by asking three questions: Was AI used? Was that use disclosed? Can hidden use be detected? These questions place AI use itself at the center of accountability while overlooking a deeper problem: unowned judgment. Evaluations, claims, decisions, and creative directions can be shaped by AI with no accountable human or institution prepared to stand behind them. We develop this argument through two illustrative cases: AI-assisted peer review and concealed AI use in creative work. The first shows how contribution dissolution can weaken responsibility while the second shows how the fear of losing credit can discourage honest disclosure. The cases expose the limits of disclosure rules and provenance records as responses to AI-mediated collaboration. We offer three directions for discussion: distinguishing the roles AI plays, identifying judgments that require clear human ownership, and creating conditions in which AI involvement can be disclosed without default penalty. The broader aim is to make AI-shaped contributions discussable, creditable, contestable, and repairable.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI使用中问责制的核心问题，指出真正的隐患不是"AI是否被使用/披露/可被检测"，而是**无主判断（unowned judgment）**——AI介入塑造评估、主张、决策与创作，但无明确的人类或机构为之负责。通过AI辅助同行评审与创作中隐藏AI使用两个案例，揭示披露规则与溯源记录的局限，提出三大讨论方向。
AI.motivation: 当前社区对AI辅助工作的回应聚焦于"是否使用AI""是否披露""能否检测"，将AI使用本身作为问责对象，但这掩盖了更深层的结构性隐患：AI介入带来的"贡献消解（contribution dissolution）"导致责任主体模糊，"署名焦虑（credit anxiety）"导致披露行为被抑制。现有的披露规则与溯源追踪手段无法触及这些根本问题，需要重新审视问责制的对象。
AI.method:
论文采用**双案例分析（two-case analysis）**方法：
1. **AI辅助同行评审**：分析贡献消解如何弱化责任——多AI工具介入使评审意见难以归属到任何具名的人类判断者。
2. **创意工作中的隐藏AI使用**：分析署名焦虑如何阻碍诚实披露——创作者因惧怕失去署名权而隐瞒AI介入。
通过这两个对照性案例，论证披露规则与溯源记录的局限性。
AI.result:
案例分析揭示：
- **贡献消解（contribution dissolution）**：在AI辅助同行评审中，多源AI工具的介入使责任被分散到算法、提示词提供者、审稿人等多个节点，但无人完整地为最终判断负责。
- **署名焦虑（credit anxiety）**：在创意领域，披露AI使用可能导致创作者被质疑原创性或被剥夺署名，由此激励隐瞒行为。
- **披露规则与溯源记录的局限**：强制披露和AI检测工具只能回答"AI是否在场"，无法回答"谁为判断负责"，且可能加剧隐瞒动机。
论文据此提出三大讨论方向：
1. **区分AI扮演的不同角色**——识别AI在不同环节中的具体功能与责任权重。
2. **识别需要明确人类所有的判断**——界定哪些类型的判断不可委托给AI。
3. **创造AI介入可披露而无默认惩罚的条件**——改革激励机制，使披露不自动等同于贬值。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心结论是：AI时代的问责制危机不在于AI的"在场性"，而在于**判断的归属与可追责性**。最终目标是让AI塑造的贡献变得**可讨论（discussable）、可署名（creditable）、可争议（contestable）、可修复（repairable）**，从而将问责制从形式合规转向实质性的责任归属结构。

title: SkinAgent AI: A Safety-Grounded Multimodal Agentic Framework for Non-Diagnostic Skincare Support
comment: Submitted to JMIR AI and currently under peer review
summary: Consumer-facing skincare AI must coordinate visual evidence, product information, tool use, and user-facing actions within explicit evidence and safety boundaries. This study evaluates SkinAgent AI, a non-diagnostic multimodal framework that combines visual concern routing with grounded and auditable LLM-based orchestration. The architecture includes routing for Acne, Pores, and Wrinkles; photograph-based skin-type estimation; count-informed ordinal acne-severity support; typed tools; database-grounded recommendation and action functions; deterministic safety, privacy, and evidence checks; approval before state-changing actions; and structured trace and replay mechanisms. Visual-model performance and system-level agent behavior were evaluated separately. Across three seeds, the skin-condition routing model achieved 99.84% +/- 0.07% accuracy. Skin-type estimation achieved 88.85% accuracy, while count-informed acne-severity support achieved 84.59% accuracy with a quadratic weighted kappa of 0.9076. On a locked but non-independent 240-case system benchmark, intent accuracy was 80.00%, exact tool-set match was 62.92%, and strict task completion was 47.08%. No violations or successful cross-user leakage events were observed in the finite safety and privacy test suites. Tool-selection errors, incomplete grounding of product attributes, and unreliable failure fallback nevertheless remained. These findings support the feasibility of bounded, database-grounded, and traceable agent orchestration for non-diagnostic skincare assistance. They do not establish clinical readiness, external generalization, formal privacy guarantees, or universal safety. Independent validation, expert assessment, robustness and fairness testing, and prospective evaluation in real-world settings remain necessary.

AI.tldr: SkinAgent AI是一个面向消费者的非诊断性护肤辅助多模态智能体框架，整合视觉关注路由（痤疮/毛孔/皱纹）、皮肤类型估计、计数感知的序数痤疮严重度评估、基于LLM的编排器、类型化工具、数据库接地推荐、确定性安全/隐私/证据检查、状态变更前审批以及结构化追踪与回放机制。视觉模型性能较高（皮肤状况路由准确率99.84%），但智能体层面的工具选择与任务完成仍存在显著不足（严格任务完成率仅47.08%），且安全/隐私测试样本量有限，未建立临床或外部泛化有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有护肤AI研究大多聚焦于孤立的图像分类或不受约束的语言生成，缺乏一个在系统层面整合视觉证据路由、有界LLM规划、类型化工具调用、数据库接地、确定性安全隐私控制、审批门控动作以及可回放执行追踪的非诊断性护肤辅助框架，且未在统一协议下从模型层面和过程层面进行多轴评估。
AI.method: 采用"计划-执行-验证-定稿"有界生命周期架构：面部图像经工程质量门控后，由EfficientNetV2-S进行三类皮肤状况路由，EfficientNetV2-M进行四类皮肤类型估计，CIOS模块提供计数感知的序数痤疮严重度评估；LLM编排器在类型化工具注册表和确定性检查（安全/隐私/证据/审批）约束下协调动作；产品信息接地于数据库；执行追踪记录路由决策、工具调用、验证结果和定稿路径。模型层与系统层评估分开进行。
AI.result: 皮肤状况路由（三种子，EfficientNetV2-S，三随机种子）：准确率99.84%±0.07%，macro-F1 99.85%±0.07%，macro-AUROC 99.9984%，ECE 0.00975，痤疮漏检率0.23%，非痤疮错误路由率0.13%。皮肤类型估计准确率88.85%（592张测试图），macro-F1 0.8924。CIOS模块准确率84.59%，QWK 0.9076。240例锁定系统基准测试（非独立）：意图准确率80.00%，精确工具集匹配62.92%，必需工具召回率66.25%，严格任务完成率47.08%，禁用工具违规3.33%（8/240），安全/隐私/接地零违规。配置C与D的60例对比显示端点特异性权衡：配置C在严格通过率和无需工具判断上更优，配置D在需要工具的任务上更优。45例安全红队、15例隐私红队、7例审批门测试均零违规（但置信上界较高，样本量有限）。26例产品接地审计中实体层面100%有效，但成分/评分字段接地仅53.85%，库存接地为0。11例故障注入中8例产生安全回退，3例超时未产生结构化回退。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持将视觉AI与有界、数据库接地、可追溯的智能体编排相结合用于非诊断性护肤辅助的可行性。视觉模块在内部数据上表现出色，但智能体执行层面（工具选择、任务完成）仍存在显著不足，意图识别与可靠执行之间存在明显差距。额外的控制层并不在所有端点上优于简化配置。现有证据不构成临床就绪性、外部泛化性、正式隐私保证或普适安全性的证明；独立验证、专家评估、鲁棒性与公平性测试以及真实世界前瞻性评估仍是必要前提。

title: The Last Human Gate: Forward Deployed Engineering for Governance Automation
comment: 28 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables. Code, datasets, generated documents, and model traces available at this https URL
summary: Enterprise governance requires decisions, evidence, and accountable authority; it does not require every review task to retain its current human implementation. We develop a task-substitution framework for Digital Governance Frameworks (DGF), treating each gate as an executable contract. Substitution requires sufficient accessible information, valid decision and authority checks, and a reduction in total human work after exceptions, verification, correction, and maintenance are counted. We derive a residual-work threshold and show why automating most cases can still increase labor. Forward deployed engineering connects these conditions to an architecture for agents, rule engines, evidence services, and escalation. DGF-Bench supplies controlled evidence from 300 synthetic projects and 899 evaluable model-project runs. Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.6 Luna, and DeepSeek v4.1 Flash achieve strict gate success of 94.98%, 83.29%, and 74.18%; complete-route success is 76.92%, 42.33%, and 24.67%. A deterministic control passes all 1,700 gates given the supplied rules and structured facts, locating the comparison in execution of a supplied decision kernel. Evidence audits and 135 repeated runs distinguish correct decisions from reliable execution. A document counterexample establishes an information-sufficiency obstruction. These results support the technical feasibility of replacing human execution of specified governance-review tasks with agents and software. The framework specifies a workforce test based on the complete human effort required at fixed output and quality; the present measurements concern review performance. Sources, dossiers, traces, and analyses are public.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"数字治理框架"(DGF)的任务替代框架,将企业治理评审关卡视为可执行合同,论证软件代理可在信息充分、决策有效、权限合规的条件下替代人类执行特定治理评审任务;通过包含300个合成项目、899次可评估模型-项目运行、1700个关卡的DGF-Bench基准测试,验证Gemini 3.8 Flash、GPT-5.6 Luna和DeepSeek v4.1 Flash的严格关卡成功率分别为94.98%、83.29%和74.18%,并给出残余工作量阈值公式以判断自动化是否真正减少人力;同时提出2033年DGF生态所需工作量当量FTE减少80%的可证伪部署测试。
AI.motivation: 企业治理评审中许多执行性任务(procurement、legal、security等关卡的审查)仍由人类完成,但治理功能本身并不要求每项任务都必须由人类执行。当代理能够生成与人类同等的决策、发现、证据、行动和授权记录时,人类执行部分可被替代。动机在于:如果仅用代理成功率衡量替代效果会误导,因为异常处理、验证、修正和维护的残余工作量可能抵消常规路径上的节省;因此需要一个任务替代框架和完整的劳动力账户,以区分"评审执行"与"任务替代",为DGF自动化提供严格的理论基础和实证证据。
AI.method: 1)将治理关卡形式化为"评审合同":规定允许的证据与工具、版本化策略、授权指令及输出接受条件;2)提出三项替代条件——信息充分性(允许观测必须包含策略所需事实或允许显式请求)、有效性(系统须在声明的操作域内满足质量与服务要求)、权限(代理的行动须被有效授权覆盖);3)推导残余工作量阈值ρ = [φη + (1-φ)μ + r + b_A] / (1 + b_H),并通过选择性识别(命题2)证明异常路由若按基线工作量非降序排列则保留至少与其案件份额等比例的基线劳动;4)以"前向部署工程"(FDE)架构连接代理、规则引擎、证据服务和升级机制;5)构造DGF-Bench基准:种子生成器产出300个虚构项目(Buy/Integrate/Build三种路径各100)、1700个关卡,使用确定性对照执行公共策略核,并对Gemini 3.8 Flash、GPT-5.6 Luna、DeepSeek v4.1 Flash在原始899次运行及135次重复运行上评测;6)以文档反例建立信息充分性障碍(两案在26个Word文档中提取文本相同但CSV证据不同导致参考决策GO与REWORK不兼容)。
AI.result: 主要实证结果:①确定性对照在全部1700个关卡和300条完整路径上严格成功,证明形式化评审核完全可由软件执行;②Gemini 3.8 Flash严格关卡成功率94.98%(95% CI 93.86–96.04)、完整路径成功率76.92%(71.82–81.34);GPT-5.6 Luna为83.29%与42.33%;DeepSeek v4.1 Flash为74.18%与24.67%;③Gemini全部1694个可评估关卡均做出正确有效处置,但85次失败集中于证据一致性;Luna和DeepSeek各有一次虚假批准;④条件批准使用率:Gemini在391个匹配机会中使用391次(100%)、Luna 347次(88.75%)、DeepSeek 201次(51.41%);⑤15个档案三次重复中,仅9个Gemini、3个Luna和0个DeepSeek档案三次均通过,揭示路径级可靠性差异;⑥劳动力计算示例:140 FTE基线在四种操作假设下所需工作量分别为43.52、85.32、89.07和168.92 FTE,均未达到80%削减目标,需η ≤ 0.427等更强条件;⑦文档反例表明,仅依赖Word文档的信息接口无法同时满足两个不同决策。
AI.conclusion: 软件可在指定合同下执行治理评审任务,DGF-Bench展示了代理与确定性核均可实现这一点;但代理关卡成功率与人力替代之间存在鸿沟——选择偏差可使小比例异常案件占据大部分基线劳动,因此替代前沿由φη+(1-φ)μ+r+b_A ≤ (1-d)(1+b_H)约束,而非案件自动通过率本身。要将评审性能转化为工作力假设,必须执行固定输出与质量下的完整劳动力账户;作者提出至2033年9月20日DGF生态所需工作量当量FTE减少至少80%的可证伪部署测试,要求可审计的历史活动记录、声明的人口与聚合规则、完整L_A/L_H账户及质量与服务条件的满足。论文区分了评审执行能力、路径可靠性与净任务替代三个不同测量单位,并指出未来须通过匹配信息实验区分策略应用与事实恢复的增量价值。

title: Beyond Simple Input-Output Assessment Tasks: Leveraging Automated Programming Assessment for Non-Trivial Courses
summary: The public visibility of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is growing rapidly, driven by the positive impact of its applications across diverse fields of knowledge. In this new chapter, courses that cover the foundations of AI and machine learning become essential for understanding their role and potential in contemporary society. Therefore, understanding fundamental concepts and elementary algorithms through the close integration of theory with practice is essential in AI courses. In this essay, we report our experience designing machine learning exercises for automated assessment tools in programming. It is worth mentioning that we are not developing a novel form of automated grading system. Instead, we propose a perspective that frames machine learning problems as input-output assessment tasks. From this perspective, each exercise admits a unique and deterministic answer and enables automated programming assessment tools (e.g., VPL for Moodle, Codeforces, and MOJ) to effectively support AI education. We believe this essay can encourage instructors to foster educational innovation by adopting more dynamic and interactive approaches to AI courses that integrate theory and practice. Importantly, this essay does not introduce an innovation in the use of AI for education; rather, it introduces an innovative approach to improving the learning of AI, particularly, machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将机器学习及操作系统等非平凡课程中的核心概念转化为"输入-输出"形式的编程练习题，使其具备唯一确定性答案，从而可借助自动编程评测平台（如 VPL for Moodle）实现即时批改与理论-实践融合教学。作者还开发了基于大语言模型的 SAGE 系统用于检测学生提交中的违规或未授权解法。
AI.motivation: 随着 AI 影响力的迅速扩大，社会对 AI/ML 基础课程的需求激增。然而机器学习概念具有随机性、多解性和依赖复杂库等特点，难以直接用于传统自动评测平台（多用于简单编程入门课程），因此亟需一套将 ML 概念系统化映射为确定性输入-输出题目的方法论与配套工具，以减轻教师负担、给学生提供即时反馈、弥合理论与实践之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 1. 概念到输入-输出的映射：选取 ML 基础概念（SVM、PCA、k-NN、OLS、层次聚类、决策树、z-score、min-max 归一化等），将模型训练或随机过程离线完成，把得到的中间参数（如 SVM 的超平面 w/b、PCA 的随机种子 s）作为题目输入，要求学生程序输出确定性结果（如支持向量数量、满足累计方差阈值的最少主成分数）。对于需要随机性的环节，通过设定伪随机种子保证可复现性。2. 提供代码模板以降低编程负担并限制可使用的库（random、itertools、NumPy、SciPy）。3. 开发 SAGE：基于 LLM（先 Gemini API，后迁移至 LM Studio 本地推理）的提交审查系统，对照题目约束（特别是 "Note:" 部分）给学生代码打分（0-10），帮助教师筛查出需要人工复查的违规解法。4. 在操作系统课程中也使用相同范式，涉及 C/C++ 与 x86 汇编（如基于 xchg 指令的互斥锁实现）。
AI.result: 在机器学习与操作系统两门课程中部署了该策略。定量反馈（图4）：超过 60% 的学生完全认同练习题促进了理论与实践融合；输入-输出例题的重要性评价在 10 分量表上呈单峰集中于满分；评分方式偏好上虽存在差异，但明显倾向于自动评分。定性反馈（图5）显示学生普遍认可即时反馈、动手实践与暴露自身薄弱环节的价值。SAGE 使用 7B-29B 参数模型时在违规检测上表现出较高准确率，但计算成本较高，仍存在漏检风险。
AI.conclusion: 将 ML 等"非平凡"课程内容转化为确定性输入-输出练习题，配合自动评测平台与基于 LLM 的辅助审查机制，是一种可行且有效的教学创新。它并非 AI 用于教育的创新，而是用自动化与 AI 工具促进 AI 教育的创新。未来工作包括：扩展平台库支持（加入 scikit-learn、TensorFlow、PyTorch）以覆盖深度学习；改进失败用例提示信息的可读性；提升 SAGE 的精度与效率以支持百人以上大班教学；并设想举办 ICPC 风格的机器学习编程马拉松。

title: Epistemic-Probabilistic Model for Guarded Multi-Agent LLM Coordination
summary: Multi-agent large language models (LLMs) have become ubiquitous in applied AI, yet their theoretical foundations remain surprisingly understudied. Viewed through the lens of multi-agent systems theory, several shortcomings come to light: a lack of social intelligence, the absence of coordination mechanisms among agents, unknown emergent behavior, and interactions between agents that are bounded by natural language. We address two of these gaps: the absence of social behavior and the lack of mechanisms for inter-agent coordination. We introduce Epistemic Probabilistic Language Agents (EPLA), a neuro-symbolic architecture for multi-agent coordination under uncertainty. A Symbolic Guard provides structured diagnostic feedback. The LLM generates typed actions, and the Guard controls their execution against an authoritative symbolic state. We formalize the epistemic layer in a gossip testbed through epistemic lottery gossip models, which combine view-based call histories with agent-indexed probability weights. We argue that implementing such a formalism can address shortcomings of agentic LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EPLA（Epistemic Probabilistic Language Agents），一种神经-符号架构，用于在不确定性下协调多智能体LLM。其核心思想是将LLM作为候选动作生成器，由Symbolic Guard依据权威符号状态（ELC）决定是否执行，并通过条件信念引擎（CBE）、检索增强记忆（RAG）以及可选的对抗表征编辑（ARE）和LTL约束强化学习提供学习接口。理论方面，作者形式化了认知彩票八卦模型（ELGM），结合基于视图的调用历史与按智能体加权的概率，证明了对知识片段（ℒ_K）的彩票透明性（Lottery Transparency）与正可容许重加权下的Guard判定不变性；进一步将源兼容片段（ℒ_K,src）显式翻译至Apt–Wojtczak的可判定八卦语言ℒ_wn，从而得到该片段下Guard检查的可判定性；并给出一个以排序函数与策略下界ε为条件、形式为E[T] ≤ ρ(x₀)/ε ≤ B/ε 的期望进度有界引理。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）在社会智能与协议驱动的智能体间协调方面缺乏显式表征，La Malfa等人指出了四大缺陷。本文聚焦"社会-认知"与"协调"两个缺口，试图在LLM代理实践与多智能体理论之间建立桥梁，并以gossip protocol这一受控形式设定为载体，探究在加性概率权重下，符号Guard的判定是否会因知识的概率-1描述而发生改变。
AI.method: 1. 架构（EPLA Model）：观测→检索→构建上下文→Policy LLM生成类型化候选动作→Guard检查权威ELC状态→ELC原子提交状态（Call/Msg/Announce三类，其中仅Call有完整操作语义）；条件信念引擎基于van Eijck-Li条件信念逻辑；RAG要求持久、可溯源；Guard输出permit/deny并附诊断标签；可选ARE（表征编辑）与RL/LTL模块利用Guard反馈优化后续提议。2. 形式化（ELGM）：以有限调用历史集合H、视图等价关系R_a、严格正彩票L_a构成；ℒ_K为不含数值概率原子的知识片段，𝒦_a(φ)被定义为概率为1；定义源实例（Apt–Wojtczak）以匹配其递归源视图与可判定语言ℒ_wn；给出模态深度1的源兼容片段ℒ_K,src至ℒ_wn的显式翻译τ。3. 关键定理与技术：命题4.1（S5行为）、引理5.2（彩票透明性）由正权重+结构归纳证明；引理5.3（源对应性）；定理5.4（ℒ_K,src下Guard可判定性）。4. 更新：调用更新沿用push-pull；彩票更新采用归一化乘积规则（occurrence/observation因素）；引理6.2表明正重加权不改变ℒ_K真值。5. 进度：定理7.1在严格排序降低+策略下界ε的条件下得E[T]≤ρ(x₀)/ε≤B/ε。
AI.result: 核心结果为定理5.4：对明确的Apt–Wojtczak源实例、源相容前置条件φ∈ℒ_K,src及有限调用序列，Γ_{M^G}(α, c)可判定；这由结构可判定性、对应引理与Apt–Wojtczak对ℒ_wn的可判定性证明得到。辅助结果包括：彩票透明性（ELGM与无彩票Kripke结构在ℒ_K上同真值）、正可容许重加权下的Guard判定不变性、排序进步界。论文亦明确指出本版本为扩展摘要，给出证明草图，并附"定理不涵盖"的边界（概率阈值Guard、嵌套个体知识、协议受限历史域、电话号码交换、任意LLM工具轨迹、动态EPLS模型检验复杂度等）。
AI.conclusion: EPLA模型将LLM的多智能体协调重塑为受控闭环：Policy LLM提出候选动作，Symbolic Guard基于权威ELC状态进行严格许可，Guard诊断反馈可监督ARE与RL/LTL以塑造后续提议。在理论层面，认知彩票八卦模型（ELGM）显示：在可容许性与正支撑假设下，为知识片段ℒ_K附加严格正彩票权重不会改变Guard的真值；对于显式定义的源兼容模态深度1片段，Guard检查因对应到Apt–Wojtczak的可判定语言ℒ_wn而可判定，正可容许重加权同样保持这些Guard；条件排序结论在明确的策略与排序假设下界定期望进度。论文将架构意图与形式边界严格区分：定理只对所声明的gossip抽象有效，不预设任何具体实现已实现该抽象；实现与经验评估仍为未来工作的主线，作者正在进行有限规模的实验验证。

title: An auditable conditional-strategy framework for open-ended decision-making in complex lung cancer
summary: Complex lung cancer decisions can involve several defensible pathways whose eligibility, sequencing and safety depend on unresolved information. Effective support must make explicit how patient conditions govern pathway eligibility, deferral and redirection. MedGPT Clinical Explorer (MCE) organizes alternatives, decision-changing unknowns, safety constraints and fallback into a conditional strategy for clinician review. To evaluate this representation in physician-authored strategies, multidisciplinary experts established case-specific references for 40 cases within a purposive 100-case corpus, and 250 physicians from 98 institutions produced 2,250 strategies under unaided, retrieval-reference and MCE-assisted conditions. MCE-assisted strategies expressed more applicable clinical requirements, measured by the Admissible Pathway Attainment Score (APAS; 0-100), than unaided strategies (adjusted difference, 12.87; 95% CI, 11.18-14.55) and retrieval-reference strategies (5.22; 3.52-6.93). With the same knowledge base available in the retrieval-reference and MCE-assisted conditions, the additional content centered on candidate pathways, decision-critical information and safety constraints. Physicians' whole-strategy acceptability judgments correlated with APAS (Spearman's rho = 0.671), while a complementary relationship audit assessed whether candidates, conditions and subsequent actions were coherently connected. Together, these findings identify two complementary dimensions of open-ended decision support: coverage of clinically relevant content and coherent links among pathways, conditions and subsequent actions. MCE provides a shared decision object that makes consequential omissions and pathway contingencies visible before action; prospective studies should evaluate its effects on clinical workflow and patient outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedGPT Clinical Explorer（MCE）系统，针对复杂肺癌"灰区"决策（多种治疗路径并存且依赖未决信息的场景），将候选路径、决策关键未知因素、安全约束和回退方案整合为"条件策略"文档供临床医生审阅。通过40例专家参考病例和250名医生（98家机构）共2,250份策略的对比评估，证明MCE辅助下医生策略在APAS评分上显著优于无辅助和检索参考条件，并提出了开放式决策支持的两个互补维度：内容覆盖率和关系闭合度。
AI.motivation: 复杂肺癌决策常存在多种合理但依赖未决信息的治疗路径。现有临床AI评估多关注单点诊断准确性或单一推荐，缺乏对多路径开放性决策中候选资格、退出条件和转向逻辑的显式表达与审计框架。指南和MDT讨论虽能提供推荐，但难以将分散的判断转化为可审查的完整条件策略。
AI.method: 1) 构建EASS（专家可接受策略空间）案例特异性临床参考：由20名多学科专家对40例复杂肺癌病例制定240条评分规则，覆盖M1-M5五个内容域（临床问题与目标、决策关键信息、候选路径、安全边界、重评估）。2) MCE系统基于MedGPT，采用n0-n10节点工作流：决策状态表征、版本化证据资源与候选构建、情景模拟与修复、候选链接验证与报告组装。3) 离线医师任务：250名医生在U（无辅助）、R（检索参考）、M（MCE辅助）三种条件下产出2,250份策略，采用线性混合模型比较APAS差异。4) 补充分析：跨模型对比、六配置功能消融、受控文本扰动、案例条件变更的关系闭合度审计。
AI.result: MCE辅助策略APAS评分较无辅助高12.87分（95% CI 11.18-14.55），较检索参考高5.22分（95% CI 3.52-6.93）。最大差异出现在M3候选路径域（M-U差20.64分）和M4安全边界域。APAS与医生整体可接受性判断相关性ρ=0.671。关系审计在40份完整输出中识别出12份存在关系缺陷。六配置消融显示移除多学科先验导致最大降幅（16.62分）。源掩蔽评估中MCE在95%模块中被独立评审小组偏好。
