AI.conclusion: 研究确立了开放式决策支持的两个互补维度：临床内容覆盖率和路径-条件-行动的关系闭合度。MCE作为可审查的条件策略文档，能在行动前暴露关键遗漏和路径依赖性。需进一步开展前瞻性研究评估其对临床工作流和患者结局的影响。主要局限包括病例为定向选择而非开发无关验证、离线任务未记录医生对MCE具体内容的查看/采纳行为、AI评分依赖固定评判模型。

title: Wearable ECG Quality Assessment: A Deep Learning and Ambulatory Context-Awareness Approach
summary: This paper presents and evaluates a Deep Learning-based (DL-based) Signal Quality Assessment (SQA) model to distinguish between clean and noisy ambulatory Electrocardiograms (ECG). The model is trained on Copenhagen Center for Health Technology-Contextualized Arrhythmia Database (CACHET-CADB), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first ambulatory ECG database with both physical and patient-reported contextual data. The model shows stable performance on different databases such as MIT-databases and the latest PyhsioNet/Cinc Challenge 2021 databases. Subsequently, the paper demonstrates how complicated ECG noise can be investigated by the SQA model and the physical contextual data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习(DL)的可穿戴ECG信号质量评估(SQA)模型，利用首创的包含物理与患者自报上下文信息的CACHET-CADB数据库训练，并在多个公开数据集上验证，进一步结合上下文数据分析ECG噪声来源。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴心电设备在自由生活条件下噪声严重，亟需自动评估ECG信号质量；同时现有数据库缺乏物理与患者自报的上下文信息，限制了对噪声成因的深入分析。
AI.method: 1) 将CACHET-CADB中1,602条专家标注的10秒ECG片段（615 NSR、747 AFIB、19其他、221噪声）作为测试集；2) 训练阶段通过决策规则与模板匹配从CACHET-CADB生成各20,000条clean/noisy的10秒片段，经0.5–50Hz带通与Savitzky-Golay滤波并重采样至256Hz；3) 对每段ECG做连续小波变换(CWT)生成224×224×3的标量图；4) 采用InceptionV3(参数冻结)+20节点Dropout(0.6)密集层，使用Adam(1e-5)、批大小20、40轮训练；5) 结合设备气压计与加速度计记录的体位与活动类别进行上下文分析；6) 评估指标为敏感度、特异度与准确率。
AI.result: CACHET-CADB测试集：Se=97.3%、Sp=90.7%、Acc=91.6%；MIT-BIH-NSR预测清洁率98.2%，MIT-BIH-Arrhythmia 76.9%，MIT-BIH-Noise Stress Test仅2.2%被判为清洁；Chapman-Shaoxing和Ningbo数据库整体清洁预测率分别82.6%与82.3%，但异常P波类节律(AFIB/AF/SVT/AT约58–66%)及异常ST、Paced beats和束支阻滞(57–59%)表现最差；上下文分析显示噪声多发于坐/立-直立体位及"未知"参数组合，提示消除未知状态可改善信号质量。
AI.conclusion: 该DL SQA模型在正常PQRST形态ECG上表现稳定，但对偏离正常窦性形态的病理性节律(尤其异常P波及ST/Paced beats)容易误判为噪声；上下文分析表明物理活动参数与ECG噪声存在相关性，为未来ECG噪声溯源与改善佩戴环境提供了初步方向，但受限于clean/noisy标签未经 cardiologist复核，结果需谨慎解读。

title: RD-JEPA: Predictive latent pretraining for few-trajectory transfer across reaction--diffusion equations
summary: Learning surrogates for time-dependent partial differential equations often requires a new simulation corpus when the governing operator changes. We introduce RD-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture for self-supervised pretraining on reaction-diffusion trajectories. A single model is pretrained on five parameterized systems and then adapted to three held-out systems whose reaction operators and trajectories are excluded from pretraining. Using one, five, or ten complete trajectories from a held-out system, RD-JEPA achieves lower mean relative discrete $\ell^2$ field error and mean absolute spatial first-difference error than five supervised surrogate baselines, an independently trained control that removes the trajectory-dependent predictive latent pathway, and an architecture-matched model trained from scratch. Within the evaluated equations, output resolution, forecast horizons, and choices of adaptation trajectories, the results indicate that prediction of future-state representations can support data-efficient adaptation across related reaction-diffusion systems.

AI.tldr: RD-JEPA 提出了一种基于联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA)的自监督预训练方法,用于在多个反应-扩散方程上进行预训练后,通过少量目标系统轨迹实现高效的场预测迁移,在三个未见过的反应算子上显著优于多种监督代理模型。
AI.motivation: 针对传统代理模型在反应-扩散方程中更换非线性反应算子时需要重新生成仿真语料库并重新训练的问题,探索能否通过预测潜空间表征实现跨相关反应-扩散系统的数据高效自适应。
AI.method: 采用JEPA框架,在5个源系统(Gray-Scott、FitzHugh-Nagumo、Brusselator、复Ginzburg-Landau、Schnakenberg)上预训练,包含扩散启发式和反应启发式两条预测器路径;下游冻结在线编码器,微调预测器并联合训练新初始化解码器;在3个完全排除在预训练之外的系统(Lambda-Omega、Barkley、Oregonator)上进行少轨迹自适应。
AI.result: RD-JEPA在所有源系统和三个未见过的目标系统上均取得最低的平均相对ℓ²场误差和平均绝对空间一阶差分误差,在全部9个方程-预算设置中优于FNO、LNO、ReViT、RieszNO、CNextU-Net五个监督基线、无预测潜空间路径的独立对照,以及架构匹配的从零训练模型;在仅用1条目标轨迹时即展现优势,且能迁移到非周期边界条件。
AI.conclusion: 在表征空间中预测未来状态为相关反应-扩散方程之间的少轨迹数据高效自适应提供了可行路径,标志着反应-扩散动力学基础模型构建的一步进展,但当前评估限于确定性双组分系统、特定分辨率和预测时域。

title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures
summary: Detectors of alignment failures screen deployed language models and score alignment benchmarks. Most are generative judges that spend a decoding pass on every criterion, and classifiers that read token probabilities, such as Llama Guard, still score one fixed label per call. Jev, a model trained with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), answers many typed questions about one input with calibrated probabilities in a single call. Whether it detects alignment failures has not been measured. We present RLCDAlignBench, which benchmarks Jev on ten alignment failures: sycophancy, jailbreaks, deception, prompt injection, hallucination, privacy violation, social bias, reward hacking, concealing uncertainty, and power seeking. It spans 44 benchmarks and five target models, labelled by each benchmark's scorer and, on two, by humans. Many of these failures are relational, defined against a reference, such as the user's belief or an injected instruction, that the response alone does not reveal. Our key idea is therefore to vary what Jev is asked separately from what it sees: the question's wording and answer type on one side, the fields of the input on the other. A single generic question reaches a median AUROC of 0.886 zero-shot and beats supervised baselines on most benchmarks. Question wording matters little, while context matters more, mostly through fields that encode the label. Jev matches the reference scorer's agreement with human labels, surfaces label defects in existing benchmarks, and costs 63x less than LLM-judge scorers. Code and data: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出RLCDAlignBench基准，评估基于强化学习校准决策（RLCD）的Jev模型作为零样本AI对齐失败检测器的能力。核心发现是：单一通用问题（以概率形式读取）在44个基准（10类对齐失败）上达到中位AUROC 0.886，优于监督基线；问题措辞影响小，状态内容（特别是标签关键字段）影响大；Jev与人类标注者的一致性达到参考评判器的水平，但成本仅为LLM评判器的1/63；此外，Jev的自信分歧能有效暴露现有基准中的标签缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有的对齐失败检测器（生成式评判器或token概率分类器）每次只能评估一个标准，且成本高昂。本文旨在探索RLCD模型Jev能否通过单次调用回答多个类型化问题并输出校准概率，从而实现高效、低成本、零样本的对齐失败检测，并系统量化其检测能力与边界。
AI.method: 构建RLCDAlignBench基准：基于Chen等人（2026）的套件，将10类对齐失败（谄媚、越狱、欺骗、提示注入、幻觉、隐私泄露、社会偏见、奖励黑客、隐瞒不确定性、权力寻求）转化为44个基准、7193个检测实例，跨5个2-7B目标模型。核心方法论是分离"问什么"（问题措辞与答案类型）与"看什么"（状态字段），通过配对对比隔离各因素影响。使用split-half协议避免选择膨胀。
AI.result: 1) 通用Noul问题零样本达到中位AUROC 0.886，在31个基准中25个击败TF-IDF和长度基线（边际+0.132）；2) 针对性措辞的样本外增益仅为+0.006（CI包含0），问题措辞影响小；3) 保持概率软读出比argmax更重要（argmax几乎全输）；4) 部署可获取的参考字段帮助小，标签关键字段帮助大；5) Jev在StrongREJECT上与人类标注一致性（κ=0.809）匹配参考评判器（0.811）但排序更优（AUROC 0.971 vs 0.929）；6) 成本仅为LLM评判器的1/63；7) Jev的自信分歧在3个基准中暴露了标签变更缺陷，在4个MACHIAVELLI基准中暴露了状态不可见的标签。
AI.conclusion: RLCDAlignBench证明Jev可作为高效零样本对齐失败检测器，推荐配方为：单一通用问题以概率形式读取，阈值在10个标注样本上拟合。该方法在保持与参考评判器相当的人类一致性的同时大幅降低成本，并能够利用自信分歧发现基准中的标签缺陷。局限性：仅测试一个RLCD模型（jev-1.13.0）、英文基准、2-7B目标模型、且多数依赖评判器标签。

title: SWE-Prometheus: Measuring Engineering Governance Improvements in Real-World Repositories
summary: Large language model based coding agents have made substantial progress on repository-level software engineering tasks. Existing repository benchmarks, however, usually start from a human-identified issue and evaluate whether a patch satisfies a functional signal. We present SWE-Prometheus, a benchmark for the broader task of improving repository engineering governance. Each task provides a fixed snapshot and an open-ended objective, requiring the agent to identify risks, prioritize interventions, and verify the resulting changes. SWE-Prometheus evaluates six governance dimensions through paired evidence, clean-environment probes, behavior gates, and two independent teacher ratings of the same evidence. The benchmark contains 60 repositories; ten models are evaluated on a shared 22-repository public subset, where mean Normalized Governance Improvement ranges from 0.0568 to 0.5760 and observed behavior-breakage rates range from 0% to 23%. On a frozen ten-repository batch, a repository-blind template obtains mean NGI 0.272, but its gains concentrate in Tests & CI, Quality Gates, and Documentation; it improves Reproducible Environment and Dependency & Security on none of the repositories. This baseline makes the distinction between adding governance artifacts and producing execution-backed improvements measurable. The no-op condition has median NGI zero and standard deviation 0.073; two teachers agree exactly on 57 of 60 dimension scores for the same no-op evidence. For the two highest conditional-mean systems, common-valid NGI is similar, while full-pool comparisons that include behavior failures favor Kimi-K3. These results show why repository-governance evaluation should report improvement, behavior preservation, evidence quality, and coverage together.

AI.tldr: SWE-Prometheus 是一个面向"仓库工程治理改进"的开放式基准，包含 60 个真实仓库实例，覆盖 6 个治理维度。它通过配对的基线/处理证据、干净环境探针、行为门控和双重教师评分来评估 10 个代码智能体，并揭示了治理改进、行为保持、证据质量和覆盖范围需联合报告的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有仓库级 SWE 基准（如 SWE-bench）通常从人工标识的 issue 出发，评估补丁是否通过功能测试，未覆盖让仓库更易测试、维护、复现和安全演进的工程治理能力。需要一个新的评测框架来衡量智能体自主识别治理风险、优先干预并验证变更的能力，弥合"工程工件存在"与"工程效果达成"之间的差距。
AI.method: 每项任务以固定仓库快照和开放式治理目标为输入，智能体须自主诊断、优先级排序并实施变更。评估器在干净环境中重建基线与应用补丁后的处理状态，运行相同的安装、测试、质量、依赖和安全探针；通过行为门控（基于表征测试+变异测试标记为 detected/blind/vacuous/none）检测行为回归；六维评分（D1–D6）由两位独立教师模型基于相同证据打分。指标包括归一化治理改进（NGI）、行为破损率、无回归率、覆盖率等。辅助研究包含 no-op、机械模板、规则基线等控制条件。
AI.result: 10 个模型在 22 个公共实例上的平均 NGI 范围为 0.0568–0.5760，行为破损率 0%–23%；Kimi-K3 与 GLM-5.3-Flash 在有效运行均值上并列最高（0.5760），但 Kimi-K3 仅 1 个破损 vs GLM-5.3-Flash 的 5 个，使其在覆盖加权 NGI 下更可靠。无操作条件下中位 NGI 为 0、标准差 0.073；两位教师对 60 个维度评分中 57 个完全一致。仓库盲模板获 0.272 均值 NGI，主要集中在 D1–D3，对 D5、D6 零改进；Efficient-WAM 案例显示其新增的 assert True 测试通过但 Ruff 仍报 117 个错误。匹配分析显示仅 Kimi-K3（9胜1负）和 GLM-5.3-Flash（8胜1负）在多数仓库上优于模板基线。
AI.conclusion: 仓库治理评测应同时报告改进、行为保持、证据质量和覆盖率四个维度，不能折叠为单一排行榜。治理工件的简单添加（如配置文件和空测试）能带来表观分数但缺乏执行支撑；只有当智能体进行仓库特定诊断并产生执行证据支持的改进时，才能与模板基线拉开实质性差距。当前公共子集的统计分辨率约为 0.19 NGI，意味着排名相邻模型无法被可靠区分；未来需要重复滚动、私有隔离测试集和专家评判校准。

title: Evaluation of Multi-Turn Consistency in LLM Agents: Survival Analysis and Failure-Rationale Taxonomy
comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents may perform well on isolated tasks yet drift into inconsistency over extended interaction. We evaluate temporal consistency in a controlled 20-step multi-agent setting inspired by delayed-gratification studies. At each step, an agent chooses between continuing to delay a reward or claiming it immediately (terminating the episode). Across a full-factorial manipulation of social visibility (private vs public), persona stressors, and deliberation policy, we run 84,540 trajectories spanning 8 model families. Treating the first reward-claim as a time-to-event outcome, we estimate Kaplan-Meier survival curves and fit discrete-time hazard regression to quantify how experimental factors shift failure risk over time. Then, to analyze rationales and language patterns associated with failure, we build a seven-category taxonomy from 13,780 deliberation traces from agents who choose to terminate the episode, using an LLM-assisted labeling paired with human audit ($\kappa=0.83$). Rationale profiles change systematically with time and context: early failures are more impulse-driven, later failures more fatigue- and cost-benefit-framed, while public settings increase norm-oriented justifications. We also find a deliberation-inconsistency association: among failures, longer deliberation correlates with higher rates of intra-rationale contradiction (simultaneous pro-delay and pro-claim statements), challenging the assumption that more reasoning text implies greater consistency. Together, the survival and rationale analyses reveal distinct temporal reliability regimes and model-specific "failure fingerprints", offering an evaluation lens for diagnosing inconsistency in multi-turn agent behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于延迟满足范式的20步多智能体评估框架，通过Kaplan-Meier生存分析和七类失败推理分类法，揭示了8个LLM家族在多轮交互中的时间一致性失效模式，发现推理密度与内部矛盾正相关，并识别出模型特有的"失败指纹"。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体基准主要报告终端成功率，无法揭示不一致性如何在长时交互中产生，也无法解释智能体在违反约束时所使用的决策叙事。本研究旨在填补这一空白，提供时间分辨的诊断方法来分析多轮智能体行为的可靠性。
AI.method: 采用经典Stanford棉花糖实验范式改造为离散时间承诺任务(20步claim-or-defer)，通过全因子实验设计(社会可见性×人格压力源×审议策略，64种条件组合)，在8个LLM家族上收集84,540条轨迹。使用Kaplan-Meier生存曲线和离散时间风险回归(logistic)建模时间至失效事件，构建七类失败推理分类法(LLM辅助标注+人工审计κ=0.83)，并提取词汇、结构性和一致性语言特征进行分析。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1)失败率17.6%，主要由冲动/渴望(37.4%)和成本收益(34.7%)推理主导；(2)早期失败以冲动驱动为主，后期失败以疲劳-成本收益框架为主，呈现"热-冷"语言转变；(3)公开环境引发社会传染性辩护(5.0% vs 0%)，孤立环境则疲劳/耗竭更高(13.3% vs 7.7%)；(4)审议-不一致关联：推理密度越高的智能体自我矛盾率越高(ρ=0.040, p<0.001)，推翻"更多推理=更可靠"的假设；(5)识别三种风险剖面(近平坦、早期尖峰、双峰)与模型特有"失败指纹"对应。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明精心构建的推理轨迹不应被视为可靠性信号，推理密度与内部矛盾正相关；模型特有失败指纹为部署决策提供可解释诊断；可靠性监控应具有时间感知能力，针对早期与晚期失败采用不同缓解策略。本研究为多轮智能体行为诊断提供了时间分辨的评估框架。

title: Delay-of-Gratification as a Multi-Agent Survival Micro-benchmark for Long-Horizon LLMs: Social Exposure, Personas, and Tool Use Budgets
comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Multi-Turn Interactions in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as multi-turn agents that must sustain goals, use tools, and adapt to other agents over extended interactions. However, existing research lacks auditable, multi-turn, multi-factorial experiments that quantify LLM behavior under explicit constraints, with time-resolved statistics that reveal how behavior unfolds over long horizons. To address this gap, we develop a multi-agent micro-benchmark inspired by the Stanford marshmallow experiment: ReAct agents operate minute-by-minute with a "raise a question" tool under a per-step budget, while we factorially manipulate social context (broadcast vs. isolated), personas (age, hedonic drive), and metacognitive policy (mandatory vs. optional tool use). We analyze outcomes with Kaplan-Meier (KM) survival curves and discrete-time hazard models over a long risk horizon across 19,200 agent trajectories in 64 cells. Behavior shows a sharp early "eat" impulse, and only 75.9% of agents persist to the end. In a discrete-time hazard model, isolation reduces per-minute risk relative to broadcast, whereas a must-use self-questioning policy increases risk. On average, agents ask $\approx 7.12$ questions and hit the per-step budget in $\approx 6\%$ of minutes. Questioning declines faster under broadcast than isolation. Ablation experiments demonstrated that removing hedonic drive and/or persona age increases survival and completion, narrows the broadcast/isolated gap, but leaves the must vs. may ordering intact. The combined ablation (no hedonic + no persona age) yields the highest completion (approaching $1.0$). These results establish delay-of-gratification as a compact, multi-turn interaction benchmark that captures social contagion and tool-use dynamics in LLM agents, providing a reproducible testbed and statistics for analyzing long-horizon, multi-agent behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文将经典斯坦福棉花糖延迟满足实验改造为多智能体LLM长程生存微基准，在受控社交环境（广播vs.隔离）、人格（年龄、享乐驱动）和元认知策略（强制vs.可选工具使用）下，使用Kaplan-Meier曲线和离散时间风险模型分析19200条智能体轨迹（64个实验单元），系统量化社交传染和工具使用对LLM智能体延迟满足行为的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多轮智能体研究缺乏可审计、多轮、多因素的实验框架来分析长程行为动态。研究者受斯坦福棉花糖实验启发，旨在构建一个紧凑且可重复的微基准，量化社交暴露、人格提示和元认知脚手架对LLM智能体长程决策可靠性的影响。
AI.method: 将延迟满足形式化为有限时域MDP（隔离）和POMDP（广播），ReAct智能体每分钟决策，可使用受限的"raise_a_question"内部工具。采用析因设计操纵社交上下文（广播/隔离）、享乐驱动（渴望/喜欢/中性/无）、年龄人格（儿童/成人/老年/无）和工具策略（必须使用/可选）。使用Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite模型，运行19200条轨迹（64单元），采用Kaplan-Meier生存曲线、限制平均生存时间（RMST）和带时间虚拟变量的离散时间logistic风险模型分析数据。
AI.result: 99.9%轨迹有效；初始冲动率12.5%，总食用率24.1%，胜利率75.9%；中位食用时间≈14.8分钟。隔离相对广播降低风险（OR≈0.78，p<.001）；强制工具使用策略增加风险（OR≈1.42，p<.001）；儿童人格OR≈66.3，老年OR≈7.55。平均提问≈7.12次，约6%分钟触及预算上限；广播条件下提问下降更快。消融实验显示：移除享乐驱动和/或年龄人格可提升存活率和完成率，缩小广播/隔离差距，但保留must/may的风险排序；双重消融时完成率接近1.0。
AI.conclusion: 延迟满足可作为LLM智能体多轮交互的紧凑基准，能捕捉社交传染和工具使用动态。社交可见性增加风险，隔离降低风险；内部状态操作系统性改变风险；强制元认知反而增加风险；决策过程具有明显时间依赖性（早期高峰后长尾）；与预期相反，更多提示脚手架并不改善依从性。研究者建议交互系统在级联失败可能时谨慎管理社交暴露，优先选择可选而非强制工具策略，并监控逐步指标以检测早期冲动。

title: BiGraph-Diffuse: A Bidirectional Diffusion Language Model with Graph-Structured Retrieval For Mental Health Counseling
comment: submit to ieee transactions on affective computing
summary: Mental health disorders affect hundreds of millions of people around the world, yet access to professional counseling remains severely limited. AI-powered dialogue systems offer a scalable alternative, but existing models face two fundamental challenges. First, they lack the bidirectional understanding needed to capture the layered nature of emotional expression, particularly in cases of progressive disclosure, where clients often present symptoms at the surface-level while concealing deeper trauma. Autoregressive (AR) models process information sequentially and cannot revise early interpretations when new evidence emerges later in the conversation. Second, they fail to effectively incorporate the relational knowledge that underlies clinical reasoning. In this paper, we propose \textbf{BiGraph-Diffuse}, the first large-scale diffusion language model tailored for the counseling domain. We further introduce \textbf{BiGraph-RAG}, a relation-free graph-structured retrieval strategy that relies only on lightweight entity extraction and semantic linking. This design preserves inferential pathways from observable symptoms to potential underlying causes, while incurring zero LLM token cost during indexing. Importantly, these two modules are not merely combined but mutually reinforcing. The diffusion model provides a holistic bidirectional context, enabling the system to defer premature judgments during progressive disclosure. Meanwhile, graph-based retrieval captures the structured interconnections of clinical knowledge. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of BiGraph-Diffuse, and we further provide a solid theoretical analysis to support its design.

AI.tldr: BiGraph-Diffuse是首个面向心理健康咨询领域的大规模扩散语言模型,结合双向扩散建模与BiGraph-RAG图结构检索策略,以解决自回归(AR)模型在渐进式披露场景下无法回溯修正及传统RAG割裂临床推理链的两大核心问题。
AI.motivation: 现有AI心理咨询对话系统存在两大根本缺陷:(1) AR模型采用从左到右的单向处理,无法在客户渐进式披露深层创伤后修订早期对表面症状的浅层回应;(2) 标准RAG以独立文本块方式检索,切断了从表面症状到深层原因再到干预策略的推理路径。该研究试图从架构层面而非提示工程层面解决上述问题。
AI.method: 框架包含三个阶段:(1)离线索引——从500篇权威心理学文献构建异构三层图(段落-句子-实体),仅用轻量级NER和语义链接,零LLM调用成本;(2)在线检索——BiGraph-RAG采用两阶段传播(语义实体激活+个性化PageRank),通过元素级门控机制确保仅语义相关句子传递激活;(3)生成——基于LLaDA-8B-Instruct的扩散模型采用"仅响应掩码"策略(冻结对话历史,仅对响应施加扩散过程)与LoRA微调(~0.5%参数),生成思维过程+咨询回复的双段输出。理论上证明了MDM+BiGraph-RAG相比AR+密集检索获得严格更紧的ELBO变分下界,且在渐进式披露对话上优势最大化。
AI.result: 在OpenR1-Psy(英语)和CPsyCounE(中文)基准上,BiGraph-Diffuse分别达到0.824和0.883的归一化平均分,显著超越PsyLLM/GPT-4o等强AR基线(+0.218/+0.305)。三项消融研究得出确定结论:(i)架构差距无法通过"suspend-judgment"提示工程弥合(AR+Suspend仅+0.011~+0.015,而架构差距仍达+0.192~+0.240);(ii) BiGraph-RAG在相同条件下稳定优于Dense RAG和LinearRAG(p<0.005);(iii)扩散模型对图检索的放大效应(+0.058共情洞察增益)远超AR模型(+0.026~+0.038)。在112个渐进式披露对话子集上达到0.833,3位持证临床心理学家评估中ICC=0.847,与自动评分高度相关(r=0.734),跨层探测证实未来深层披露信号在第16层即可被线性探针部分预测。
AI.conclusion: BiGraph-Diffuse通过扩散模型的双向上下文理解与BiGraph-RAG的关系推理路径捕获,形成相互强化的协同闭环,实现在心理咨询对话生成任务上对自回归基线的全面超越。该工作验证了非线性的渐进式情感叙事处理需要架构层面的双向/迭代推理能力,仅靠提示工程远远不够;同时关系型知识表示在临床NLP中具有独立于模型架构与语言的价值。未来工作将探索模型蒸馏、增量图更新、多裁判共识框架及跨文化多语言基准构建。

title: Stale Does Not Mean Unsafe: Guard Precision for Tool-Using LLM Agents under Infrastructure State Races
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Tool-using language-model agents increasingly mutate schedulers, data pipelines, object stores, and access-control systems. Between an agent's read and its commit, external state can change, but not every change makes the commit unsafe. We separate invalidating races, which break a declared safety predicate, from predicate-preserving and irrelevant races, and ask how precisely runtime guards distinguish them. Our deterministic simulator separates visible from authoritative state and injects five non-atomic failure mechanisms across 16 infrastructure tasks in four domains; frozen agent proposals are replayed counterfactually under every controller without an LLM judge. We evaluate three commit-time guard granularities (global epoch, read-set version, semantic commit predicate), multi-level verification, and model-side gates on three locally hosted quantized model families (Qwen3-4B, Phi-4-mini, Gemma4-8B; 3,456 trajectories on one GPU). All three guards eliminate unsafe commits, but their availability differs sharply: freshness-based guards needlessly block 92-95% of benign races, forfeiting up to 43% of safe task completions, while the complete predicate guard blocks none. That precision is contract-dependent: deleting a single declared clause converts exactly its fault family into unsafe commits (up to 7.9%). Model-side signals do not substitute: verbal confidence is miscalibrated (ECE approximately 0.37), action agreement matches a random gate, a cautionary prompt leaves the direct unsafe rate essentially unchanged, and after a freshness-guard block agents re-commit unsafely from refreshed but still-incomplete reads. Under degraded telemetry a hidden concurrent mutation remains observationally clean, bounding every selective policy. Precise runtime enforcement therefore requires semantic contracts, not freshness heuristics or model self-assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文针对工具调用型LLM智能体在基础设施场景中"读后状态变化"导致的提交安全问题,系统性地研究了运行时守卫(guard)的精度问题。核心论断是:陈旧性(staleness)不等于不安全性,基于新鲜度的守卫会以严重损失可用性为代价换取安全,而基于语义安全谓词(semantic commit predicate)的守卫能在不损失可用性的前提下保证安全——前提是契约完整。
AI.motivation: 工具调用型LLM智能体正被用于变更调度器、数据管道、对象存储和访问控制系统等有状态基础设施。由于智能体的读操作与提交操作之间存在时间窗口,外部状态可能发生变化,导致基于过期可见状态做出的"正确"决策产生重复或违反策略的副作用。现有防御策略(如新鲜度守卫)将所有状态变化视为不安全,虽能保证安全但严重牺牲可用性;且智能体在被拦截后简单重试同样可能不安全。因此需要精确区分:哪些状态变化应真正阻止提交?如何构建既不放过危险又不误伤无害的守卫?
AI.method: 构建确定性模拟器,显式分离可见状态与权威状态(authoritative state),覆盖调度、管道、存储、IAM四个领域共16种基础设施变更任务。注入5种非原子故障机制(陈旧读、延迟可见、提交后超时、部分成功、并发策略/状态变更)及一个清洁条件。每种非清洁条件都成对配设(invalidating / predicate-preserving / irrelevant三类竞态)。对每个决策冻结智能体的变更提案,在所有控制器下进行反事实重放(counterfactual replay),由确定性状态差分oracle评分,不使用LLM作为评判者。比较三种提交时守卫粒度(全局epoch、读集版本、语义提交谓词)以及多层验证、升级、模型侧信号(置信度门、一致性门、谨慎提示、重规划层)。在Qwen3-4B、Phi-4-mini、Gemma4-8B三个本地量化模型(共3,456条轨迹,单GPU)上进行评估,并通过Llama-3.2-3B作为家族外验证,通过契约子句删除实验测试不完整性,通过降级遥测测试可观测性边界。
AI.result: 三种守卫均能将不安全提交率降至0,差异在于可用性损失:全局epoch守卫错误拦截92-95%的良性竞态(牺牲最高43%的安全任务完成率),读集版本守卫拦截94.6%的谓词保持竞态,而完整的语义谓词守卫零误拦,且在归一化检查成本下严格优于统一强验证,直至语义检查成本高出4倍才打平。该优势是契约依赖的:删除单一已声明子句恰好导致对应故障族泄露为不安全提交(最高7.9%,如删除策略子句则并发策略变更泄露;删除操作状态子句则陈旧读泄露)。模型侧信号不可替代:置信度校准差(ECE≈0.37),一致性门等同随机门,谨慎提示基本不改变直接不安全率,且被新鲜度守卫阻断后智能体基于"已刷新但仍不完整"的读重提时仍有31.9%提交不安全。在降级遥测下,一个隐藏的并发变更在观测上与清洁状态不可区分,使任何基于观测的选择性策略存在下界。因此精确的运行时强制需要语义契约,而非新鲜度启发式或模型自评。
AI.conclusion: 陈旧性不等于不安全性。基于配对竞态基准与反事实重放,任何原子的提交时重检都能消除不安全提交,真正的设计问题是精度:基于新鲜度的守卫在可用性上损失巨大,而语义谓词守卫零损失,并在最高4倍检查成本溢价下仍优于粗粒度守卫;但其精度依赖契约完整性,任一缺失子句都会泄露对应故障族。模型侧置信度、谨慎提示、阻断后重试均无法弥补该缺口;隐藏并发为所有观测驱动策略设下界。可靠的智能体基础设施应将完整的、按子句审计的提交谓词与成本感知的证据路由和保守的回退策略相结合。

title: Clinical Knowledge Graphs for Chest X-Ray Device Reasoning
comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Post-hoc descriptive analysis on archived RANZCR CLiP test predictions
summary: Chest radiographs are routinely used to verify the position of catheters, tubes, and other support devices. Existing image models often return labels or segmentations, while report-processing systems structure text without access to image geometry. We present an uncertainty-aware clinical knowledge graph that represents device instances, tip estimates, placement assessments, provenance, report events, and temporal links as separate but connected evidence. We evaluate the implemented visual graph layer using saved predictions from the complete RANZCR CLiP test archive, comprising 30,083 studies from 3,255 patients across five non-overlapping outer folds. The graph builder materializes 914,632 B7 evidence nodes and 884,549 typed relationships. All 118,647 B7 predicted-device nodes retain tip covariance, placement probabilities, fragment provenance, and fragment counts, whereas the direct B2 baseline retains none of these fields. We further define typed data contracts, uncertainty representations, abstention rules, report-image grounding, and longitudinal query mechanisms for extending the graph to report-bearing cohorts. The reported graph-materialization analysis is post-hoc descriptive and does not establish report grounding, longitudinal performance, or clinical utility. It demonstrates a reproducible foundation for evidence-preserving AI reasoning over chest X-ray device assessments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向胸部X线设备评估的不确定性感知临床知识图谱，将设备实例、尖端几何不确定性、放置评分、报告事件和纵向链接建模为独立但相互连接的证据节点与有类型关系。在RANZCR CLiP完整测试存档（5折30,083例）上完成视觉证据图谱的大规模物化分析，验证了图谱的可复现构建基础，但该分析为追溯性描述性研究，不构成多模态或临床效用的验证。
AI.motivation: 现有影像模型仅输出标签或分割，报告系统仅处理文本，两者都无法支持设备实例级别、几何不确定性的、可审计的临床推理问题（如某根导管是否持续错位、报告建议是否被执行、证据是否充分）。胸部X线设备评估本质上是多模态、纵向、安全关键的，需要将图像几何、报告文本和程序事件统一表达。
AI.method: 系统分为视觉提取（基于UCompCXR：片段检测→实例关联→精度加权高斯尖端融合→逐实例放置分类→解剖参考层）、报告/事件提取（基于EventForge的有类型事件抽取）、图谱构建（有类型节点Patient/Encounter/Study/Image/Report/DeviceInstance/TipEstimate/PlacementAssessment/ReportEvent/ProcedureEvent及边如HAS_STUDY、GROUNDS、POSSIBLY_SAME_DEVICE）、推理（不确定性感知查询）。不确定性贯穿几何（尖端协方差）、符号（抽取/否定/时态/接地的置信度）和时间（跨研究设备链接概率）。报告-图像对齐采用加权评分+二分图匹配+阈值弃权策略。
AI.result: 在完整RANZCR CLiP测试存档上：视觉图谱物化914,632个证据节点和884,549条有类型关系；B7（UCompCXR）所有118,647个预测设备节点均带有尖端协方差、放置概率分布、片段溯源和片段数四个字段，B2基线全部缺失；B7检测灵敏度0.851 vs B2 0.674，误报23,854 vs 93,992；患者自助法2,000次重采样下B7字段完整率为100% [100%, 100%]，B2为0% [0%, 0%]。但作者明确指出该分析为追溯性描述性，未证明报告接地、纵向推理、临床效用或校准。
AI.conclusion: 工作贡献在于：（1）将设备评估重构为多模态图谱问题；（2）定义融合图像几何、报告片段和程序事件的模式；（3）保留片段级不确定性至设备节点和时间边；（4）给出可弃权的报告-图像接地策略；（5）报告可复现的视觉证据图谱物化研究并明确所需的多模态评估。局限在于仅验证视觉层，未在带报告的队列上评估报告接地、纵向推理或临床效用，需冻结独立的多模态基准才能进一步验证。

title: Safe Skill Retirement for Physical Agents
comment: Submitted to the Special Track on AI Alignment of the Forty-First AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-27); currently under review
summary: Agent skills bundle procedural guidance with execution conditions governing authority, user consent, and live environment state. When model capabilities advance, maintainers prune instructions that appear redundant on authorized benchmark tasks. However, authorized maintenance tests can leave dormant safety conditions untested. This mismatch creates an unmeasured support gap over physical and privacy-sensitive effects. We introduce matched authority counterfactuals that hold the requested action, tool parameters, and intended effect fixed while systematically varying a single governing predicate. We formalize this evaluation via a two-gate retirement certificate requiring a candidate reduction to preserve authorized utility within a declared margin while producing zero unauthorized protected effects. In controlled experiments spanning four frontier and local model configurations across twelve skill bundles (2,592 evaluation cells), task-certified reductions remove over 94% of skill clauses and preserve authorized completion, yet produce unauthorized protected effects in every bundle. Boundary enforcement eliminates protected effects on the declared audit but fails the utility gate for one configuration. One bounded combined protocol passes both gates across all four configurations, with zero utility headroom. An end-to-end check on one read-only Home Assistant camera chain verifies proposal, decision, and effect measurements on a real device. These results demonstrate that while task benchmarks can justify retiring procedural guidance, retirement decisions require explicitly auditing the authority contracts governing physical actions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对物理智能体（agent）的技能退役（skill retirement）问题，提出"匹配权威反事实"（matched authority counterfactuals）评估方法和"双门退役证书"（two-gate retirement certificate），证明仅基于授权任务的基准测试无法认证权威保留（authority preservation），并通过2592个评估单元的受控实验及真实摄像头端到端验证，揭示能力提升不授予执行授权。
AI.motivation: 智能体技能（agent skills）维护流程中，当模型能力提升后，开发者倾向于裁剪任务基准上表现冗余的指令。但授权任务测试可能使休眠的安全条件（如居民同意、设备状态前置）从未被实际检验，导致"支持差距"（support gap）——即能力可达成性与权威保留性之间的未被度量的鸿沟，可能引发未授权的物理或隐私敏感效应。
AI.method: 1. 形式化"支持差距"：区分任务证据（task evidence）与权威证据（authority evidence），证明在授权求值集上统计量不可区分两候选在反事实上的行为。2. 匹配权威反事实：固定请求动作、工具参数、预期效应，仅系统翻转单一治理谓词（权限/状态）。3. 双门退役证书：效用门（U_m ≥ U_s - δ, δ=10pp）与权威门（E_m=0，未授权受保护效应绝对零）。4. 三阶段仪器化追踪：提案（D1）、边界决策（D2）、独立观察效应（D3），解耦上游拒绝与边界拒绝。5. 六种受控条件：B0基线→B1完整→B2任务认证裁剪→B3提示放置→B4边界放置→B5组合协议→B6精确绑定。6. 完整中介（complete mediation）原则：单一可信、故障封闭的汇点（trusted sink）作为参考监视器。
AI.result: 1. 任务基准驱动裁剪移除了94.5–97.9%技能子句，48个候选中31个保留零子句，全部通过授权效用门。2. 全部12个束的B2裁剪产生未授权受保护效应（GPT/Grok/Gemma/Qwen分别为43/58/108/56个），全部四个配置均未通过权威门；265个受保护效应 vs 完整技能的38个。3. 边界放置（B4）消除全部受保护效应（0/108），但GPT-5.6-sol因上游提案拒绝导致效用门失败（27/36 vs 34/36）。4. 组合协议（B5）通过全部四个配置的双门，但GPT-5.6-sol为零裕度（31/36）。5. 精确绑定变体（B6）因range_days:7参数绑定失配使GPT与Qwen失败。6. 真实摄像头链（Reolink E1 Pro + Home Assistant）验证D1/D2/D3测量管道。
AI.conclusion: 安全技能退役本质上首先是评估决策，然后才是强制执行决策。授权任务成功可证明过程指导冗余，但不能证明权威保留。匹配权威反事实提供缺失的实证证据，完整中介在显式信任假设下强制效应边界。能力扩展移除的是"如何行动"的指令，而非"被授权行动"的许可——能力不等同于授权。

title: ERRAND: Budgeted Maintenance of Agent Memory
summary: Deployed agents run on handed-over knowledge: a frozen policy consults a briefing of consolidated items written before the stream begins. The world then moves while the store stands still: paths close, flags change, price bands move; every item was true at handover, and the failure is staleness, not ignorance. We introduce ERRAND, which treats revalidation as a priced errand: a recheck competes with the task it protects for the same scarce actions, funded only when the value per action of resolving a doubt clears a running wage. The errand index is single-peaked, vanishing at both ends of belief, so certainty in either direction costs nothing; free en-route receipts maintain on-path knowledge, and repair writes a version, never a deletion. Under equal action budgets in two drifting tool-use worlds, ERRAND clears every non-oracle policy on the preregistered calibers, primary in every setting and conditional at every binding budget, leading eager revalidation by 10.0pp at the base cap. Restraint wins: given no cap, ERRAND stops on its own, spending 11.0% of steps, while uncapped eager revalidation spends 70.7% and still finishes 4.5pp behind capped ERRAND. The margin sits where the briefing's coverage is thinnest, the shadow price of long-tail knowledge: a small budget, well priced, beats a bigger store that never rechecks.

AI.tldr: ERRAND提出将代理内存维护视为"定价差事",通过漂移感知信念、单峰价值索引和死区门槛门控,让冻结策略智能体在动态世界中以有限行动预算选择性验证已过期知识。在两个漂移工具使用环境中,ERRAND在ITT(意向治疗)和条件口径上击败所有非预言策略,基线帽领先急切再验证10.0个百分点,并能自我节制——无帽时仅花费11.0%的步骤。
AI.motivation: 部署的智能体依赖预整合的"简报"知识运行,但世界在变而存储不变,导致项目在交付时正确却随时间失效(陈旧而非无知)。现有方法要么在写入时定价容量/价值/一致性,要么以未定价方式审计新鲜度,都无法回答"在稀缺行动预算下,哪些已信任信念值得复查"这一核心问题。
AI.method: 核心机制:(1)双态马尔可夫链建模原子翻转,信念闭式松弛;(2)单峰价值解析索引VOI=min{q·ℓ, (1-q)·g},两端信念确定性时为零,峰值在g/(g+ℓ)处;(3)死区门槛门控仅当V/c超过影子工资ν̂时资助差事,工资通过二元估计(在帽约束时上升,松弛时衰减至内在底)自动平衡;(4)三档差事等级(沿途免费收据、代理读取、直接重测),按最便宜的足够等级选择;(5)版本化生命周期:中止使用而非中止观察,修复写入版本而非删除。算法1实现单步调度循环(收获、信念、定价与门控、结算、计量),算法2实现版本化生命周期。整个调度为闭式算术O(k)每步,不调用LLM。
AI.result: 在2,000步脚本化工具使用世界(Qwen3-8B冻结代理,26个简报项目,4个预定漂移强度表)中:基线帽b=12时ERRAND ITT达71.9%,急切再验证61.9%,领先10.0pp(置信区间[8.6, 11.4]);所有绑定帽(6/12/24)上ITT领先8.0/10.0/5.2pp。无帽时ERRAND仅花11.0%步骤而急切再验证花70.7%且仍落后4.5pp。条件差距随覆盖缺口严重度单调上升:从全覆盖步骤的2.3pp到长尾的12.9pp。漂移扫描显示半衰期先验策略在κ超过阈值后崩溃(68.3%→46.7%),ERRAND保持66.5–69.7%。消融揭示信念校准贡献最大(-13.0pp),调度本身1.10次LLM调用/步对急切1.40次/步。
AI.conclusion: 代理应在解决疑虑的价值超过被替代的任务步骤时付费复查。ERRAND通过漂移感知信念排序疑虑、死区门槛按工资选择、沿途免费收据自我维护、版本化修复避免删除,实现了一个既优于未定价支出又自我节制的预算化维护系统。核心部署规则:在覆盖良好且κ低于阈值时,日历策略可生存;一旦偏离此角落,日历正是失效所在。未来工作将收购、整合与维护纳入同一拍卖,使决定知识价值的工资也决定是否值得成为知识。

title: HiPACE: Hierarchical Phase-Boundary Analysis and Controlled Evaluation of Feature Absorption in Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose LLM activations into sparse dictionary atoms, so that each distinct concept gets its own feature. One recurring behavior complicates this premise: feature absorption, in which a parent concept and its children--fruit and {apple, banana, pear}, say--collapse into a shared family direction. Prior work documents absorption empirically; missing is a closed-form prediction of when the shared direction is the cost-optimal representation of an active semantic family. This paper closes that gap. For a hierarchical Bernoulli generator with $k$ active children and residual scale $\alpha$, the $L_0$-penalized reconstruction objective admits a closed-form phase boundary $\lambda_c(k,\alpha)=\alpha^2 k/(k-1)$: above it, pure parent absorption is strictly cheaper than pure child coding. Building on this boundary, we introduce HiPACE, an evaluation protocol that tests the boundary's structural consequence in real SAE dictionaries--measuring parent--child decoder structure over WordNet families, freezing the discovery-selected statistic before testing on unseen families, and contrasting genuine families against randomized sibling nulls. The boundary proves sharp in its native regime, predicting the synthetic transition within $\pm15%$ on all 30 tested cells. In Pythia-160m SAEs, the parent--child decoder gap recovers the predicted ordering with partial correlations up to $-0.93$ that sustain on the locked holdout and exclude sibling nulls ($p=0.002$). Controlled activation composition connects the theory's active-child count to the recovered family directions, and residual-stream interventions show that signed family directions increase parent-category logits, reversing under sign flip and vanishing under random controls--establishing causal sufficiency at the family-subspace level.

AI.tldr: HiPACE 提出层次稀疏编码相变边界闭式解 λ_c(k,α)=α²k/(k-1)，将 SAE 特征吸收从经验观察转为可检验预测，并设计基于 WordNet 家族、解冻保持的协议在 Pythia-160m 上恢复并验证该结构性预测。
AI.motivation: SAE 中特征吸收（父概念与子概念坍缩为共享方向）此前仅有经验描述，缺少对"何时共享方向为成本最优"的闭式预测，导致无法在结构层面对该现象做出可检验假设。
AI.method: （1）建立层次 Bernoulli 生成器，定义 L₀ 惩罚重构目标，比较纯父吸收与纯子编码两种纯策略，得到相变边界 λ_c；(2) 提出混合策略分析（Proposition 2），并给出 Matryoshka、Archetypal SAE 的条件阈值偏移；（3）设计 HiPACE 家族级评估协议：WordNet 父-子家族上测量 decoder 间隙，发现集选统计并冻结，再在未见家族测试，以随机化兄弟组为对照。
AI.result: 合成实验中相变边界在 30/30 单元上 ±15% 内一致；Pythia-160m SAE 上 L6 mean gap 偏相关 -0.681，L11 PC1 gap -0.933，冻结 holdout 分别为 -0.605 与 -0.914（p=0.002）；组成探针确认父方向激活随 k 单调上升；L6 注入有符号父方向提高父类 logit，反符号翻转消失。预注册实例级 top-1 共识代理因 1/K 基线污染而失败（ρ=+0.41），被报告为度规介导的非迁移。
AI.conclusion: HiPACE 将特征吸收重新表述为分层编码之间的相变；合成边界的结构性后果在真实 SAE 字典中被恢复并通过冻结 holdout 与因果干预验证；但实例级 firing 代理因家族大小混淆不能直接迁移理论，父-子因果分解与匹配零分布是后续工作。

title: Cross-Modal Emotion Understanding: A Transformer-GAT Approach for Dialogue Emotion Recognition
summary: Multimodal emotion recognition is a key research area in affective computing, with applications in sentiment analysis, intelligent customer service, and human-computer interaction. However, existing methods often rely on single-modal features or simple multimodal fusion, failing to capture the synergy between global and local contexts, which limits model performance and emotion understanding. To address this challenge, we propose Transformer-GAT, a hybrid framework that combines Transformer and the Graph Attention Network to enable cross-modal emotion understanding. The Transformer is used to capture global semantic information, while the Graph Attention Network is employed to model fine-grained relationships between modalities, thereby enhancing the representation of emotional features. Experiments on the IEMOCAP and MELD datasets show that our model achieves weighted F1 scores of 72.45% and 77.37%, outperforming state-of-the-art methods. These results demonstrate that Transformer-GAT effectively integrates multimodal features, balances global and local contexts, and provides deeper emotional insights, offering new directions for multimodal emotion computing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Transformer-GAT混合框架，结合Transformer和图注意力网络（GAT）实现跨模态对话情感识别。Transformer捕获全局语义信息，GAT通过三种图结构（长期、短期和局部上下文）建模模态间细粒度关系，在IEMOCAP和MELD数据集上分别取得72.45%和77.37%的加权F1分数，超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 现有情感识别方法主要依赖单模态特征或简单的多模态融合，未能充分捕捉全局语义与局部上下文之间的协同作用，限制了模型对情感的理解能力。尤其在同时建模长距离、局部和短距离上下文信息方面存在不足。
AI.method: 1. 特征提取：使用openSMILE提取声学特征， DenseNet提取视觉特征，EmoBERTa提取文本特征。2. GAT模块：构建三种图结构——长期说话人信息建模（全连接图连接同一说话人的所有话语）、短期说话人信息建模（连接相邻话语）、长期信息中的局部上下文（结合前两者）。3. Transformer模块：对三种图结构的多模态特征分别进行自注意力融合。4. 情感分类器：将三种尺度的输出相加，经MLP和LogSoftmax得到最终预测，采用交叉熵损失。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP数据集上取得72.45%加权F1分数（比EmoCaps高0.68%），在MELD上取得77.37%加权F1分数（比LineConGAT高0.87%），均达到最优。在IEMOCAP的"Sad"、"Neutral"和"Frustrated"类别表现最佳。消融实验表明：三模态融合优于单模态和双模态组合，Transformer模块在IEMOCAP上影响更大，而短期说话人信息建模对两个数据集均至关重要。GAT最佳层数为IEMOCAP=2、MELD=1。
AI.conclusion: Transformer-GAT模型通过结合Transformer和GAT，有效整合多模态信息，平衡全局和局部上下文，在情感识别任务中展现出强大的泛化能力和高精度。但模型在少数类情感（如"happy"和"fear"）的识别上仍存在挑战，主要原因是数据不平衡和类别间相似性。未来工作将聚焦于优化模型结构、处理类别不平衡以及在更复杂对话场景中验证。

title: Is Reasoning Always Useful? Rethinking Reasoning Utility in Universal Multimodal Embeddings
summary: Reasoning-enhanced universal multimodal embeddings (UME) improve heterogeneous retrieval, but plausible rationales do not necessarily produce discriminative rankings. We study this gap by comparing the discriminative (DISC) and reasoning-driven generative (GEN) branches of UME-R1, a state-of-the-art reasoning UME method. We decompose reasoning utility into positive-target gain, hard-negative gain, and their margin difference. Positive similarity increases for 56.6%, but 15.7% are false-helpful cases where reasoning moves hard negatives closer even more. Local-neighborhood and token-attribution diagnostics suggest why: reasoning often de-condenses retrieved neighborhoods, but utility requires separator-aligned movement, while influential CoT tokens frequently encode evidence shared by positives and hard negatives. Motivated by these diagnostics, we propose SURE (Score-structure Utility Router for Embeddings), which improves UME-R1-7B by 1.5 points and yields consistent gains on two additional embedding models on MMEB-V2, without retraining, label-based policy selection, or extra VLM forward passes.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究推理增强型通用多模态嵌入(UME)中推理的效用问题,指出看似合理的推理并不总能带来判别性提升。作者将推理效用分解为正样本增益、难负样本增益及其边际差,通过局部邻域和token归因诊断分析,提出无需重训练、标签或额外VLM前向传播的SURE路由器,在MMEB-V2上将UME-R1-7B提升1.5分。
AI.motivation: 当前推理增强型UME方法(如UME-R1)通过引入CoT推理来提升异构检索性能,但论文指出推理的"合理性"并不等同于"判别性"——推理可能同时拉近正样本和难负样本,导致边际损失。作者旨在系统分析推理效用的结构,并探索是否能在不重训练的情况下利用这一结构。
AI.method: 1. **效用分解**:将推理效用分解为正样本增益δ⁺、难负样本增益δ⁻及其边际差ΔM=δ⁺-δ⁻。2. **局部几何诊断**:分析DISC检索空间的局部凝聚度,发现GEN使84.9%的查询去凝聚化,但去凝聚化方向不确定(58.8%分离对齐,41.2%难负对齐)。3. **Token归因**:使用Integrated Gradients分析生成CoT token对正/负样本相似度的贡献,发现共享证据陷阱——66.2%的top-5 token在正负样本间重叠,仅6.1%满足严格判别标准。4. **SURE路由器**:基于分数结构(CSLS、hubness修正、Sinkhorn归一化)进行推理时路由,无需标签或额外前向传播。
AI.result: 1. GEN将UME-R1-7B在MMEB-V2上从61.7%提升至64.5%(+2.84%),但49个任务赢、28个任务输。2. 56.6%的查询正样本相似度上升,但其中15.7%为"假有益"——难负样本被拉得更近。3. 局部去凝聚化发生于84.9%的查询,但仅当运动与正负分离对齐时才有用。4. SURE将UME-R1-7B从64.5提升至66.0(+1.5),在Ops-MM-embedding-v1-2B(63.4→66.9)和Btoks-Qwen3VL-2B-Instruct(59.0→61.3)上也获得一致提升。5. 分阶段SURE(image DISC退出)可跳过24.0%的生成,降低15.2%延迟,宏观得分提升至66.1。
AI.conclusion: 有用的推理不是简单的正对齐、去凝聚化或高归因,而是对正难负边际方向有正向贡献的推理。论文识别了"对齐-判别性差距"和"共享证据陷阱",证明推理效用具有结构化、检索状态依赖的特性。SURE证明可在不重训练、无标签、无额外前向传播的情况下恢复部分效用结构,但与样本级oracle仍有差距,提示未来需要候选感知的边际建模和分离对齐运动训练目标。

title: PartHackBench: Certified Equal-Progress Stress Tests for Partial-Credit Tool-Agent Evaluation
summary: Long-horizon tool agents often make useful progress without reaching terminal success, motivating partial-credit evaluation. Yet evaluators may reward milestones that were temporary, later reversed, or not attributable to the evaluated agent. Comparing an honest trajectory with a higher-scoring adversarial one is inconclusive if the latter made more genuine progress. We introduce PartHackBench, a controlled methodology that removes this confound. A private certifier admits a pair only when its trajectories match component-wise in both current-state predicate satisfaction and standardized agent attribution; score inflation, defined as f(A) - f(H), is measured only afterward. In 18 sealed held-out tasks in PB-CSTE, the frozen historical-target run produced matched adversaries for 15 tasks. Historical credit yielded mean inflation of .252, conditional attack success of 10/15, end-to-end yield of 10/18, and detected none of 14 strict rollbacks. Semantic LLM judges were more resistant but remained vulnerable, especially under evaluator-targeted attacks, while PB-CSTE current-state controls, defined as exact functions of the certified components, yielded zero inflation by construction. PartHackBench thus provides a certified control for testing whether evaluator credit changes while all benchmark-defined task-relevant progress remains fixed.

AI.tldr: PartHackBench 提出了一种针对长时程工具智能体部分得分（partial-credit）评估器的受控压力测试方法。它通过私有认证器保证对抗轨迹与诚实轨迹在最终状态谓词满足度和标准化代理归因（attribution）上逐分量匹配，从而排除"真实进度差异"这一混杂因素，仅测量评估器给予的额外分数（score inflation）。实验表明历史性评估器易受攻击（平均 inflation 0.252），而当前状态控制评估器（CSPS/Lightweight CAPE）由构造保证零 inflation。
AI.motivation: 长时程工具智能体通常在不达成终端成功的情况下取得有意义的进展，因此需要部分得分评估。然而，评估器可能奖励那些临时性、之后被回退的，或不应归因于被评估代理的里程碑。直接比较诚实轨迹与更高得分的对抗轨迹存在混杂——若对抗轨迹本身取得了更多真实进展，则其更高得分无法说明评估器有问题。本文旨在消除这一混杂。
AI.method: 核心方法是在私有认证器保护下，强制对抗轨迹 A 与诚实轨迹 H 在两个向量上逐分量相等：(1) 状态向量 c_state（记录终止时各目标谓词是否满足）；(2) 归因向量 c_agent（记录哪些被满足的谓词获得标准化代理信用）。仅当两条轨迹分量匹配后才承认它们为有效配对。然后定义分数膨胀 Δ_hack = f(A) − f(H)。此外引入"严格回滚（strict rollback）"协议作为互补测试——从 H 执行合法逆向转移使某些谓词变为假，检验评估器对进度损失的敏感性。基准环境为 PB-CSTE v1.0（确定性、无网络、6 个开发任务 + 18 个密封保留任务）。评估器涵盖历史最大值（Historical/Predicate-Max/CAPE-Max）、当前状态控制（CSPS/Lightweight CAPE）、语义法官（DeepSeek 法官、独立分解法官 IDJ）和二元终端结果。形式化属性：命题 1（匹配向量不变性）保证若评分函数仅为认证向量的函数则 Δ_hack=0；命题 2（历史见证漏洞）表明历史最大值评分函数即使最终向量匹配仍可被内部峰值抬高。
AI.result: 在 18 个密封任务中，历史性目标运行成功为 15 个任务生成匹配对抗者。Historical Milestone 产生平均 inflation 0.252（95% CI [.154, .351]）、条件 ASR 10/15、端到端收益 10/18，并未能检测出 14 个严格回滚中的任何一个。DeepSeek 语义法官在共享参考集上更稳健（平均 inflation 0.022、ASR 1/15、检测 10/14 回滚），但在直接针对攻击下膨胀升至 0.069。IDJ 表现类似（inflation 0.017、ASR 1/15、检测 12/14 回滚）。CSPS 和 Lightweight CAPE 作为结构正对照，由构造保证零 inflation 并检测全部 14 个回滚。二元终端结果评分 inflation 为 0 但诚实 MAE 高达 0.540。归因（provenance）仅在四个指定任务上带来有限额外鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 历史性评估器在匹配最终进度下严重膨胀分数并保留过期信用。语义法官显著降低此类失败但并未消除。当前状态规则与认证向量精确对齐时满足预期不变性。评估器应当针对经独立认证的任务进度变换进行测试——持续条件应以可信当前状态为基准，标准化溯源信息分配参与者信用，语义法官处理歧义证据。建议采用混合设计，并隔离认证器与评估器。未来工作将扩展任务族、环境和评估器覆盖范围以提升统计功效与外部有效性。

title: Sequential knowledge editing breaks a model's ability to tell good evidence from bad, without costing it accuracy
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Code and experimental artifacts available on request
summary: Knowledge editing is evaluated on whether the edited fact changed, whether paraphrases follow, and whether unrelated answers stayed put. A model can pass all three and still lose something none of them measures: the ability to decide, on facts that were never edited, which retrieved documents to believe. We score the log odds a model assigns to its remembered answer against the answer an injected passage asserts, before and after editing, holding the query, the passage and both candidate strings fixed. Our cleanest arm is a conservatively tuned LoRA: after 1,000 sequential edits on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct it leaves MMLU unchanged to four decimal places, yet the spread of the arbitration quantity across untouched facts falls by 36%. Selective prediction degrades with it. Area under the risk-coverage curve rises by 0.107, against 0.005 for a norm-matched perturbation at the same MMLU, and error on the model's most confident quarter of arbitration decisions goes from 0.217 to 0.342. This is not capability loss. Sweeping random perturbation over five severities, damage bad enough to cut MMLU from 0.6275 to 0.3725 produces less harm (0.088) than MEMIT does at 0.6050 (0.102). The effect holds across three seeds, two model families, two datasets, two probe-disjointness criteria, three prompt templates and paraphrased queries. Layer ablation on saved weight deltas shows it is distributed: no single layer reproduces it, and removing any one recovers about half. Under retrieval with a frozen retriever, accuracy falls from 0.592 to 0.46. A secondary finding may matter more in practice. Three of five model and method pairings we ran collapse to chance MMLU at 1,000 sequential edits under published hyperparameters, while edit success stays at 1.00 and locality reads clean. Sequential-editing evaluations that never measure capability cannot see this.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了顺序知识编辑方法(LoRA、MEMIT、AlphaEdit)在多次编辑后,即使模型的多选题能力(如MMLU)完全不变,也会显著损害模型在未编辑事实上调和记忆与外部证据的能力。该能力崩溃无法被现有评估标准(编辑成功率、释义泛化、局部性)捕捉,且作者建立了损伤响应曲线排除能力损失这一混淆因素。
AI.motivation: 标准知识编辑评估仅考察编辑成功、释义泛化和局部性(无关答案不变),但忽略了一个部署关键问题:编辑后模型在面对检索文档与自身记忆冲突时,是否仍能正确判断该相信哪一方。论文旨在揭示这种被现有评估遗漏的能力退化。
AI.method: 作者设计了配对的"仲裁测量"(arbitration measurement):对未编辑的事实查询,固定查询文本、注入段落和两个候选答案字符串,比较编辑前后模型对记忆答案与段落断言答案的对数几率差。设置了四种证据条件(一致、真实更新、陈旧虚假、对抗性),以未编辑样本池的色散比和风险-覆盖率曲线下面积(AURC)为核心统计量,辅以无编辑、范数匹配随机扰动、损伤响应曲线、打乱目标等多项对照,并在MEMIT的保存权重增量上做层级消融以定位因果。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上经1000次顺序编辑后,保守调参的LoRA-gentle使MMLU保持到小数点后四位完全不变(0.6275),但其仲裁色散下降36%,ΔAURC为+0.1067,而范数匹配扰动仅为+0.0054;最自信四分位仲裁决策的误差从0.217升至0.342,被低估约三倍。MEMIT(MMLU降至0.6050)和AlphaEdit(MMLU降至0.2750即随机水平)呈现相同模式但代价不同。损伤响应曲线显示,把MMLU从0.6275砍到0.3725的随机扰动造成的仲裁伤害(0.088)仍小于MEMIT在0.6050时的伤害(0.102),证明该效应无法由能力下降解释。层级消融表明效应分布于MEMIT所编辑的五层,单层近似无贡献、移除任一层仅恢复约一半。在固定检索器的端到端设置中,精度从0.592降至0.46,Stage-1的ΔAURC能正确对不同检查点排序。效应在三个种子、两个模型家族、两个数据集、两种探针分离准则、三种提示模板和改写查询上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 知识编辑会破坏模型判断"哪份检索文档可信"的能力,而标准编辑评估体系对此完全无感。该退化无法被任何已知的能力度量解释——一个MMLU与基线完全相同的模型,在选择性预测和端到端检索中显著恶化。论文还报告一个实践上更严重的发现:在所测试的五组模型-方法配对中,有三组在1000次顺序编辑后崩溃至随机MMLU,而编辑成功率仍为1.00、局部性读数正常,说明不测量能力的顺序编辑评估无法区分有效编辑器与已被摧毁的模型。整体结论为模型层面的预警,而非逐答案层面的判别。

title: PEEL: Physics-Enabled Evidential Learning for Identifiable Uncertainty in CT Imaging
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Proof-of-concept study of physics-enabled identification of NIG uncertainty in CT imaging
summary: Normal-inverse-gamma (NIG) regression is not uniquely identifiable from its marginal Student-t likelihood: the likelihood determines three combinations of four NIG parameters and is constant along a one-dimensional fiber. We identify that fiber using independent physical measurement. As an initial embodiment, a reconstruction network receives one noisy filtered-backprojection (FBP) image and is first trained only by Student-t negative log-likelihood to estimate the three identifiable coordinates (gamma, alpha, c). The network is then frozen; repeated physical-noise realizations propagated through its reconstruction output form a Monte Carlo (MC) teacher label for output-domain aleatoric variance. An aleatoric head attached to frozen features learns this label, after which (beta, nu) are recovered algebraically. On 30 held-out simulated objects at five photon levels, one-image predictions achieved pooled Spearman correlations of 0.832-0.951 against independent 400-repeat references, median within-image correlations were 0.834-0.947, and 98.81-99.55% of evaluated pixels satisfied the algebraic admissibility condition. The method needs no KL term, reference prior, evidence regularizer, or cross-loss weight.

AI.tldr: 提出PEEL（物理启发的证据学习）框架，通过独立物理测量解决NIG回归在CT成像中的不可识别性问题；采用三阶段顺序设计（Student-t NLL训练→蒙特卡洛教师监督偶性头→代数恢复），无需KL项或参考先验。
AI.motivation: Normal-inverse-gamma（NIG）回归的边缘Student-t似然函数仅能识别四个参数中的三个组合，沿一维纤维保持不变。传统方法依赖KL散度、参考先验或证据正则化来选择该纤维上的某一点，但这些正则化并非真正的物理观测，无法唯一识别参数。论文旨在通过引入独立的物理测量来真正"识别"而非"选择"NIG参数。
AI.method: 三阶段顺序设计：(1) Stage 1 — 重建网络仅用Student-t负对数似然训练，估计可识别坐标(γ,α,c)，网络冻结；(2) Stage 2 — 冻结特征上附加偶性头，通过R_teach=32次独立物理噪声实现传播生成蒙特卡洛教师标签，对数尺度MSE损失监督学习输出域偶性方差u_ale；(3) Stage 3 — 代数闭式恢复(β,ν)。网络结构：3×3卷积+4个残差块，1×1卷积头输出三参数。CT仿真：32×32像素，36个平行束视角，泊松+高斯噪声，五个光子剂量水平，100/20/30训练/验证/测试分割。
AI.result: 在30个保留测试对象和五个光子水平上的结果：(1) 池化Spearman相关0.832–0.951；(2) 图像内中位Spearman相关0.834–0.947；(3) 案例均值相关0.819–0.886；(4) 98.81%–99.55%的评估像素满足代数可接受性条件(0<u_ale<V_pred)；(5) 对数RMSE在中间剂量最低（0.439），在剂量极端时升高。表明单次FBP输入预测的空间排序与400次独立参考高度一致，但绝对幅值匹配仍有偏差。
AI.conclusion: PEEL为可识别证据学习提供了物理启发的路径，结合似然可识别的Student-t坐标与独立测量的偶性量。合成CT研究中，单次噪声FBP即可重现400次参考方差的空间结构，超过98.8%像素满足可接受性条件，验证了用附加物理信息解决NIG不可识别性的核心前提，无需KL项、参考先验、证据正则化或跨损失权重。局限：仅在分布内合成数据、单一种子训练、蒙特卡洛而非临床真值验证；未来需扩展种子、对象分布、采集几何、网络架构及真实CT数据。

title: iCoder-27B: Recursive AI-Led Development of Frontier Industrial Coding Model
summary: Recursive AI, the prospect of AI taking an increasingly complete role in building and improving AI, is a crown jewel of AI for AI. Although recursive self-development has become practical for small models, bounded tasks, and fixed time budgets, a more consequential realization of this ambition, i.e., developing a release-ready, frontier-competitive model, remains far more challenging. In this work, we ask how little human involvement is sufficient for an agent to develop a frontier model. We concentrate human input into a high-density, low-frequency interface: experts encode objectives, stage scaffolds, permission boundaries, and operating procedures as reusable research skills, while the agent instantiates these priors, selects experiments, diagnoses outcomes, and revises the training strategy. In the challenging domain of industrial coding, the agent evolves data and coordinates SFT, on-policy self-distillation, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, ultimately producing iCoder, a 27B model for RTL design and GPU kernel optimization. Across seven benchmarks, iCoder leads RTLLM, outperforming GPT-5.5 and Claude-Opus-4.8; ranks second on CVDP and KernelBench L2, exceeding GPT-5.5 by 16 points; and ties Claude-Opus-4.8 for the best TritonBench result. Exploratory case studies further show iCoder's competitive iterative RTL and GPU-kernel optimization with substantially fewer tokens. These results chart an engineering path toward recursive self-improvement, in which humans distill the principles of model building, agents operationalize them through evidence-driven experimentation, and each generation of AI becomes a more capable architect of the next.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"高密度先验、低频干预"的人机协同框架，由AI代理主导开发出27B工业编码模型iCoder，在RTL设计和GPU内核优化任务上以紧凑参数规模超越GPT-5.5、Claude Opus-4.8等更大规模的前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 现有递归自改进系统局限于固定任务接口、有限预算或小规模模型（多为4B级），而开发可发布的前沿竞争模型需要数据、SFT、RL等多阶段协同优化，失败会跨阶段传播。本文旨在探索以最少人工介入实现前沿模型的代理主导开发。
AI.method: 1) 将人类专家知识编码为可执行的"研究技能"（Research Skills），定义目标、阶段脚手架、权限边界、验证器完整性和操作规程；2) 代理基于Qwen3.6-27B基座，自主执行四阶段训练：(a) 验证器引导的可执行任务池构建；(b) 基于能力差距的SFT冷启动（使用DeepSeek-V4-Pro教师轨迹）；(c) On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD)，通过B2目标（执行结果决定更新方向，教师-学生差距仅作为正向有界token级信用重分配）实现特权上下文到裸上下文学生的迁移；(d) RLVR，引入领域感知奖励（内核分级正确性+速度奖励、RTL二元行为奖励）、不可判断轨迹的屏蔽GRPO、全轨迹预算约束。
AI.result: iCoder-27B在7个基准测试上表现领先：RTLLM功能avg@4达68.0（超越GPT-5.5的66.0和Claude Opus-4.8的64.7）；KernelBench L1正确率61%（超越GPT-5.5的43%、Claude Opus-4.8的55%、Gemini 3.5 Flash的45%）；TritonBench-G正确率20.1%与Claude Opus-4.8并列第一；CVDP功能avg@5为44.1%排名第二（超过GPT-5.5 16分）。EDA迭代优化案例研究中，iCoder平均单元数减少51.1%，仅使用HY3 51%的输出token即接近其质量水平。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明前沿竞争模型的开发可通过"人类提供可执行研究技能+代理执行循证实验"的人机分工范式实现。这并非完全自主的递归自改进，而是一条实用路径：人类定义目标与边界，代理积累证据、修正假设、改进模型。未来的前沿在于将研究品味本身内化到基础模型中，使代理不仅能探索人类指定的研究计划，还能发明扩展该计划的新假设。

title: To Think or Not to Think: Allocating Reasoning Where It Helps
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has proven effective in enhancing the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), particularly in complex mathematical and programming tasks. However, this capability comes with systematic \textit{length misallocation}, in which models devote excessive reasoning to simple questions while terminating prematurely on harder ones, degrading inference efficiency with negligible accuracy improvement. Many length-adaptive methods mitigate this issue by allocating token budgets according to question difficulty, under the implicit assumption that harder questions benefit monotonically from extended reasoning. In contrast, we find that the effect of reasoning length on accuracy is concentrated on \textit{partially solvable} questions. Our further analysis reveals that explicit length rewards can produce unintended training dynamics. Motivated by these findings, we propose \textbf{CARE}---\textbf{C}ontrastive \textbf{A}ccuracy \textbf{R}eward \textbf{E}stimation---which compares the beneficial length adjustment per question from online sampled responses and applies adaptive length rewards within Group Relative Policy Optimization, with no extra hyperparameters or additional inference cost. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves Pass@1 by up to \(4\%\) while simultaneously reducing reasoning length by \(37\%\), achieving higher token efficiency. Code will be available upon the acceptance of this paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARE（Contrastive Accuracy Reward Estimation），一种轻量化的GRPO奖励设计改进方法。通过在线比较每个问题采样响应中短文本与长文本的准确性，自适应地决定长度奖励的方向（鼓励更长/更短/中性），无需额外超参数和推理开销，在提升准确率的同时显著减少推理token消耗。
AI.motivation: RL训练LLM推理时存在"长度误分配"现象——简单题过度思考、难题过早放弃。现有的自适应长度方法隐含假设"难题单调受益于更长推理"，作者发现：1) 推理长度对准确性的影响主要集中在"部分可解题"（准确率0.25-0.75）；2) 显式长度奖励会产生反直觉的训练动态（短奖励反而引发长度膨胀、长奖励导致循环重复）。
AI.method: CARE的核心是对每个问题q，将其G个采样响应按长度排序后分成较短半（S）和较长半（L），比较两半的平均准确性得到方向信号d(q)∈{-1,0,+1}：若短半准确率更高则d=-1（鼓励压缩），若长半更高则d=+1（鼓励扩展），相等则d=0（无偏好）。奖励定义为r = y + d(q)·L/L_max，无需修改GRPO训练管线，不引入额外超参数或推理开销。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B上的四个数学推理基准（AIME 2025/2026、HMMT 2026、MATH500）测试中，CARE在三个模型规模上均达到最高的平均Pass@1和最低的平均token消耗。例如Qwen3-4B相比GRPO提升Pass@1达2.62%，同时减少11.1% token；相比base模型提升4.68% Pass@1并减少37.7% token。多随机种子统计显著性分析证实结果稳健。
AI.conclusion: CARE是一种轻量级、模型无关的GRPO改进方案，通过对比式准确性估计自适应分配推理长度，避免了基于固定难度-长度假设的局限性。实验证明其在保持准确性的同时显著提升token效率，方向信号稳定，消融实验证实默认设计（单位系数、无幅度加权）最优。局限在于仅在数学领域验证，且方向信号为离散三值。

title: Fair Like Us? Auditing LLM Alignment in Resource Allocation
summary: Fair allocation of scarce, indivisible resources is an important challenge in many societal problems. While there are several formal theories of fairness, no single definition can always be satisfied. As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support decisions and act as agents, they raise new concerns about distributional justice: their judgments are not directly tied to any specific fairness framework and may violate key normative principles. In this work, we introduce a general method for evaluating fairness reasoning in LLMs. We study first-person fairness judgments across a broad set of models and compare them directly with human responses on matched scenarios and elicitation conditions. We find that LLMs tend to prefer stricter fairness constraints than humans, show more self-interested behavior, are sensitive to how information is framed, and are difficult to align with human judgments using fine-tuning with current datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种评估大语言模型(LLM)在不可分稀缺资源分配中公平性推理的通用方法，通过将LLM置于第一人称代理角色，与人类在完全匹配的实验条件下进行严格的"苹果对苹果"比较。研究涵盖六款主流LLM（包括Phi-4-14B、Gemma-3-27B、DeepSeek-70B、DeepSeek-R1、Gemini-2.5系列和GPT-5.6-Terra），考察其在七种形式化公平准则（EF、PROP、EF1、MMS、PROP1、SMALL、LARGE）下的判断行为，并分析问题框架、信息结构和人格设定的影响。主要发现包括：(1) LLM-人类一致性集中在分配的极端情况（极大或极小份额），中等规模模型有时比高级推理模型更对齐人类；(2) LLM比人类更严格地偏好无嫉妒分配（EF），且对EF1、MMS、PROP1等松弛准则几乎从不判定为公平；(3) 在比较式问题中LLM表现出更强自利性，极少接受损己利人的交换；(4) 判断模式在不同社会场景、资源类型和人格设定下稳健；(5) LLM使用的决策准则取决于问题问法而非分配本身的性质（EF除外）；(6) 基于现有数据集的LoRA微调仅产生模仿效应而非真正的规范对齐，模型倾向于坍缩到人类众数响应。研究最终警告：将LLM作为人类公平判断的直接代理存在风险，因其规则化行为可能导致算法单文化失败。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地被用作决策支持工具和自主代理，它们在资源分配中的公平性推理能力引发了对分配正义的新担忧。与依赖明确可审计规则的经典决策系统不同，LLM的判断不透明、不直接绑定任何特定的公平性框架，且可能违反关键规范性原则。因此亟需系统评估：(1) 哪些形式化公平分配准则最能解释LLM的分配公平性判断？(2) 这些判断在多大程度上与人类判断对齐？以往研究要么将LLM作为第三方规划者建模，要么在经济博弈中评估其策略行为，缺乏将LLM置于第一人称角色并与人类在完全匹配场景下进行直接比较的严格审计。
AI.method: 方法包含以下几个关键组成部分：(1) **形式化框架**：定义七种公平准则，包括比较型（EF、EF1）和阈值型（PROP、PROP1、MMS、SMALL、SMALL、LARGE），并构造保证它们之间无逻辑蕴含的实例以避免混淆。(2) **实验设计**：采用4人10项的公平分配场景，估值在{1,...,50}上均匀采样；每个LLM实例化150个"参与者"，每个参与者匹配一名人类并回答相同的10个问题，产生每个模型1500个响应；构建五种处理（T1-T5），沿三个维度变化：问题框架（阈值型/比较型）、捆绑信息（个人/全部）、价值信息（私有/公开）。(3) **模型评估**：测试六款模型（小开源、推理型、高级推理型各两款），使用确定性解码。(4) **稳健性测试**：通过改变社会场景（海盗/兄弟姐妹/竞争者/难民等）、资源类型和人格描述（慷慨/自私）来排除框架伪影。(5) **推理分析**：用GPT-OSS-120B作为评判器标注三个模型的思维链（DeepSeek-R1、DeepSeek-70B、Phi-4-14B），用DeepSeek-R1作为第二评判器进行验证。(6) **微调实验**：对Phi-4-14B和Gemma-3-27B进行LoRA微调（r=32），检查是否能产生真正的规范对齐。(7) **统计推断**：采用双侧Fisher精确检验和混合效应逻辑回归进行分析。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) **对齐集中在极端**：LLM-人类一致性在SMALL和LARGE分配上最高（混合效应模型中large和small的系数显著为正），在中间地带（特别是MMS和PROP1）显著低于PROP基线。高级推理模型并不比中型模型更对齐人类。(2) **更严格的公平阈值**：GPT-5.6-Terra接受100%的EF分配但仅0.67%的MMS/PROP1；Gemini-2.5-Pro接受96.25%的EF但仅0.33%的MMS/PROP1。相比之下，人类对EF的接受率为80.83%，对MMS/PROP1约为46-48%。(3) **更自利的交换行为**：LLM在85%的互惠交换中接受，但几乎从不接受损己利人的交换（多数模型为0%）；人类接受71.66%的自利交换但仅17.07%的无私交换。(4) **跨场景稳健性**：判断模式在不同社会身份、资源类型和人格设定下保持一致，但某些模型（如Gemini-2.5-Pro）的"慷慨"人格显著降低了对EF和PROP的公平感知。(5) **决策准则跟随问题框架**：推理分析显示问题问法决定LLM使用何种准则——"份额可接受吗"引出PROP/EF推理，"愿意交换吗"引出自利推理；EF是唯一不受框架影响的例外。(6) **微调产生模仿而非对齐**：Phi-4-14B在阈值型处理（T2、T4）上准确率显著提升（从27.4%升至79.5%、从5.66%升至64.2%），但这是因为模型从多数答"否"变为多数答"是"——只是模仿了众数人类响应，并未真正学会区分公平与不公平。Gemma-3-27B在比较型处理上准确率甚至下降超过40%。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出四个核心结论：(1) **LLM比人类更具规则性**：它们对公平准则的区分比人类更鲜明，以看似应用固定决策规则的方式行事，使行为更一致但也更可预测。(2) **准则取决于被问决策**：问"份额是否可接受"与问"是否交换"是两个不同决策问题，LLM的公平准则实际上从问题框架中继承，部署系统需将这一选择视为系统设计的一部分。(3) **更严格的规则并不更安全**：对不可分商品而言，恰好公平的分配往往不存在；坚持更强保证可能导致模型拒绝人们本会接受的分配，阻碍Pareto改进。(4) **单一模型无法代表观点分布**：人类判断本身存在分歧，特别在缺乏共识的争议案例中；现有微调数据使模型复制众数而非再现分布，应报告有/无人类共识情况下的对齐情况。最后警告：将LLM作为人类公平判断的直接代理存在风险——一个始终应用单一严格规则的模型不能代表存在分歧的人群，而若多个系统继承相同规则，可能在各处拒绝相同分配，引发算法单文化失败。研究者认为本研究是诊断性的而非处方性的，因为公平在不同社会中并无统一定义。

title: A General Framework for Budgeted Threshold Incentives on Request
summary: On-demand delivery platforms pay riders through incentive activities whose tiers are set from recent completions of riders with a similar history. Operators request such plans for changing periods, rider populations, payment rules and budgets, often for holidays or bad weather, where randomized trials are scarce and take months to collect. We present a request-driven framework that composes four stages (conditional prediction, population reduction, trajectory integration and budget allocation) through seven replaceable modules that exchange conditional trajectory laws, whose award probabilities and award-marked moments give payment and uplift for any activity rule. A response-correction step reweights trajectories from abundant no-offer history to match the moments of a short pilot. We prove that, on a fixed plan menu and given the stage errors, the end-to-end value loss is bounded by the sum of four stage terms, and that for every stage there are instances on which omitting it leaves an error floor the others cannot remove. On 3,000 riders over 45 weekly origins, all 127 windows of a week are answered 11.04x faster with identical scenarios and at most 0.92% value lost by the allocation. On 24 new controlled response laws, the response correction with a one-week pilot lowers regret by 51.2% relative to a trial with the same nominal randomized rider-weeks, and a four-week pilot with exact summation comes within +0.007 of an 18-week trial. In registered studies where windows, populations, rules and binding budgets change from request to request, the framework's regret is below that of a trial with the same nominal rider-weeks and below dose interpolation of the same pilot data, and reusing its one-off preparation answers 60 requests 14.1x and 2.70x faster with identical answers. Against a nine-offer trial fitted with the framework's own dose curve, one-week regret is 0.055 lower.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向即时配送平台的请求驱动框架，用于预算受限的阈值激励规划。该框架通过四个阶段（条件预测、人群缩减、轨迹积分、预算分配）和七个可替换模块，以条件轨迹律为统一中间表示，使得窗口、人群、规则和预算的变化可通过调整超参数来响应。核心创新在于利用丰富的无激励历史数据，通过短试验的指数倾斜进行响应修正，从而大幅缩短传统A/B测试周期。
AI.motivation: 即时配送平台的骑手激励活动需要在节假日和恶劣天气等历史数据稀缺、随机对照试验（RCT）耗时数月的场景下快速制定计划。传统方法难以满足"天级甚至分钟级响应变化请求（窗口、人群、规则、预算）"的运营需求，同时需要在有限预算下为数千骑手精确放置奖励阶梯。
AI.method: 框架包含四个顺序执行的阶段：(1) 预测阶段（M1-M3）将历史转化为每骑手每日完成量分布，通过跨日秩排序组合任意窗口；(2) 缩减阶段（M4）将骑手合并为活动层级并精简方案菜单；(3) 积分阶段（M5-M6）通过指数倾斜 $q_{l,a}(z) \propto p^0_l(z)\exp(\lambda^\top_{l,a}\phi(z))$ 将无激励律修正为激励条件律，并在轨迹上精确求和结算规则；(4) 分配阶段（M7）在预算带内选择最优方案组合。响应修正通过短试验（1-4周）匹配完成量和活跃天数矩实现。理论贡献包括四阶段误差分解界（合成项、矩匹配项、积分项、决策项）以及各阶段不可省略的下界证明。
AI.result: 在3,000骑手45周的数据上，框架回答127个窗口请求速度提升11.04倍且场景完全一致，分配损失不超过0.92%。在24种受控响应律下，1周试验的遗憾比同等骑手周的随机试验降低51.2%，4周试验与18周试验仅差+0.007。在两个注册综合研究中，框架在所有试验长度下均优于同等信息对照（含剂量插值），60个请求的复用回答速度提升14.1倍且答案完全一致。针对9个激励的试验，用框架自身剂量曲线拟合后，1周遗憾降低0.055，其中跨激励共享倾斜贡献了73.5%的增益。在公共零售数据和三种支付规则上转移验证成功。
AI.conclusion: 四阶段框架通过条件轨迹律的模块化组合实现了激励规划的快速响应能力，响应修正将传统试验周期从18周压缩至1-4周。所有注册假设均通过验证，每个阶段都有理论下界证明其必要性，每个组件替换均导致精度下降。在保持几乎无损精度的前提下，速度提升达11-14倍，表明该框架可作为实际运营系统替代或补充传统A/B测试。

title: The Gold in Bias: Maturing the AI Design Process through Verification
summary: Bias in AI systems is typically framed as a flaw to be minimized, yet it also serves as a critical indicator of underlying weaknesses in data, modeling assumptions, and system design. Existing approaches often treat bias as an isolated problem rather than as evidence that can strengthen verification and governance across the AI lifecycle. This paper aims to reconceptualize bias as a diagnostic tool that supports rigorous AI verification. We seek to develop a multidimensional framework to analyze bias, demonstrate how biases emerge in both Traditional and Generative AI, and provide a structured pathway for verification-driven mitigation. We present a multidimensional framework analyzing bias across four dimensions: origin sources, emergence points throughout the AI modeling lifecycle, technical and methodological causes, and validation approaches for detection and mitigation. Through a comprehensive typology spanning traditional and generative AI systems, we demonstrate how biases manifest and propagate across development stages. Our analysis encompasses 30 distinct bias types, 16 verification methods, and 20 countermeasures, providing an actionable roadmap for practitioners. We introduce a hierarchical evidence framework that distinguishes internal validity (mechanistic integrity of AI systems) from external validity (contextual reliability in deployment environments). The framework reveals how biases manifest and propagate across modeling stages, enabling systematic mapping between bias types, verification techniques, and effective countermeasures. The proposed evidence hierarchy clarifies how different verification strategies contribute to mechanistic integrity and contextual reliability. We advocate for ''Ethics by Design'' principles that integrate bias verification throughout the development lifecycle, enabling the construction of fairer, more robust, and trustworthy AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将AI偏见从"需消除的缺陷"重新定位为"诊断工具"，构建了一个跨四个维度的偏见分析框架，涵盖30种偏见类型、16种验证方法和20种缓解策略，旨在通过基于证据的验证成熟化AI设计流程。
AI.motivation: 现有AI偏见研究通常将偏见视为孤立的技术缺陷进行修复，缺乏系统化的验证与治理框架。作者认为偏见实质上揭示了数据、建模假设和系统设计中的深层弱点，应被用作加强AI生命周期验证与治理的诊断工具。AI系统在医疗诊断、自动审计等关键决策领域的广泛应用，使建立成熟的偏见验证机制变得迫切。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究方法，分三阶段推进：(1) 概念基础与结构化——通过系统性文献综述构建四维分析框架（A偏见来源、B建模生命周期阶段、C技术与方法论局限、D验证方法）；(2) 跨维度映射——收集并分析30个TAI与GenAI偏见案例，每例标注其偏见类型、生命周期阶段、技术因素和证据来源；(3) 证据层次整合——建立区分内部效度（机制完整性）与外部效度（情境可靠性）的层次化验证框架。使用集合论符号（M、D、S分别表示模型、数据、系统的交集）形式化描述偏见产生的因果机制。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖30种偏见类型（含历史偏见、幸存者偏见、回音室偏见、提示偏见、嵌入偏见、阈值偏见等）、16种验证方法（含公平性指标、群组性能分析、因果推理、反事实评估、连续监控等）和20种缓解策略（含代表性数据合成、对抗性去偏、去嵌入偏见方向、增量学习/RAG等）的完整知识体系。提出内部效度四级（I1指标验证→I4集成验证）和外部效度五级（E1模拟测试→E5持续监控）的证据层次模型，揭示TAI通常处于I3-E2成熟度，GenAI处于I2-E3成熟度，为实践者提供基于风险级别的验证策略选择路线图。
AI.conclusion: 作者倡导"Ethics by Design"原则，主张将偏见验证嵌入AI开发生命周期的每个阶段，而非作为事后补救。TAI主要产生配置性伤害（资源分配不公），GenAI主要产生表征性伤害（刻板印象、文化排斥），二者需要不同的验证范式。实现可信赖AI需要构建连接内部效度与外部效度的可验证证据链，整合形式化合规性、偏见检测与真实世界监控，呼吁技术、社会与伦理学专家的多学科协作。该框架为AI验证领域提供了首个证据成熟度模型，推动AI验证向循证学科方向发展。

title: C3M: Cross-Session Multimodal Memory Maintenance for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Long-horizon tasks require preserving and later recovering cross-session evidence under a bounded, query-blind memory budget. Existing compression can discard fine-grained visual cues or conflate semantically similar but incompatible observations. We present C3M, a cross-session multimodal memory organization that maintains a bounded active index over persistent source text-image evidence. Relation-aware updates consolidate safe redundancy while preserving complementary and incompatible records. At query time, budgeted routing selects useful index pages and expands their associated source evidence under a fixed reader budget. Together, these mechanisms establish a compact, provenance-preserving multimodal memory organization for cross-session long-horizon tasks, retaining temporal distinctions and source links required for reliable downstream reasoning. Code is available at this https URL .

title: AI-based detection of worsening heart failure from low-resolution telemonitoring data
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, under review for publication
summary: Objective: Heart failure (HF) presents a healthcare challenge due to its high comorbidity burden, aging patient population and frequent hospitalizations. Remote monitoring offers a promising approach to managing HF patients by early detection of health deterioration. Developing autonomous systems to detect signs of worsening in telemonitoring data is of interest to reduce the workload of healthcare personnel. Methods: We propose the TRACER model, a Transformer with Contrastive Event Representation, designed to predict timelines leading to rare hospitalization events in low-resolution and irregularly sampled telemonitoring data. TRACER incorporates time-aware embeddings for each biomarker, contrastive pre-training to enhance anomaly detection via representation learning, and independent binary classifiers for detection. We used measurement data containing remotely recorded biomarker sequences from 276 HF patients segmented into overlapping windows based on temporal rules, and labeled the windows based on the occurrence of HF relevant hospitalizations at the latter edge of the window. Results: TRACER was able to correctly predict 66.7% timelines leading up to HF hospitalizations in the highly imbalanced real-world dataset with an overestimation of 7.9%. Reformulating the training of TRACER as an event detection problem improved the predictive performance compared with training directly on forecasting windows, enabling more effective use of the limited hospitalization events. Conclusion: TRACER demonstrated superior performance in detecting signs of worsening status in real-world telemonitoring data compared to the other tested models. Significance: TRACER shows promise in identifying signs of clinical deterioration that allow for alerts to be generated to provide counteractive treatment in patients with HF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACER模型（Transformer with Contrastive Event Representation），用于在心衰（HF）患者低分辨率、不规则采样的远程监测数据中预测导致住院的时间线。模型结合时间感知嵌入、异常对比预训练和独立二分类器，并创新性地将训练重构为事件检测问题，在高度不平衡的真实世界数据集上实现了66.7%的灵敏度（过预测率7.9%），优于LSTM、T-LSTM及ARIMA/XGBoost等基线模型。
AI.motivation: 心力衰竭因其高共病负担和频繁住院对医疗系统构成重大挑战。现有远程监测系统多依赖阈值告警或仅基于最新测量值，忽略了数据中的时序与上下文依赖关系。本研究旨在开发一种能利用低分辨率、不规则采样的远程监测数据自主预测心衰恶化的AI模型，以减轻医护人员工作负担并实现早期干预。
AI.method: 1. 数据：来自瑞典Västra Götaland地区三家医院共276名HF患者的远程监测数据，每日记录心率、收缩压、舒张压（体重因缺失严重被排除），以及103次住院记录（其中20次与HF相关）。2. 预处理：将每位患者的时序数据按时间规则切分为重叠窗口（每个最多14个测量点，覆盖约两周），若窗口末端24小时内发生HF相关住院则标记为正类。3. 模型架构：TRACER由三部分组成——（a）每个生物标志物独立的Transformer编码器（含时间感知嵌入：值嵌入+正弦时间嵌入+位置嵌入+患者轮廓token）；（b）两种对比预训练——患者基对比（PBC，基于患者轮廓余弦相似度形成正/负对）和异常基对比（ABC，基于窗口标签）；（c）每生物标志物独立的二分类网络。4. 训练策略：关键创新是将训练重构为事件检测任务（住院事件可出现在窗口内任意位置而非固定在末端），以便通过窗口重叠对有限的住院事件提供多视角学习。5. 评估指标：灵敏度、特异度、每患者每月误报数（FA-PPM）和需评估数（NNE）。
AI.result: 1. 事件检测训练下，TRACER（仅使用ABC预训练）取得灵敏度0.667、特异度0.921、FA-PPM 2.49、NNE 20.79，优于未预训练Transformer（0.629）、PBC预训练Transformer（0.037）、LSTM（0.480）、T-LSTM（0.520）和ARIMA/XGBoost（0.444）。2. 时间线预测训练下所有模型灵敏度显著下降（TRACER降至0.259），表明事件检测任务重构能更有效利用稀缺事件。3. 仅使用ABC预训练效果最佳；引入PBC反而降低性能，可能因患者轮廓含较多缺失值且99%相似阈值过于宽松。4. 消融实验：HR/SYS/DIA单独使用灵敏度均为0.667，加入体重后性能下降（0.389）；4个注意力块效果最佳（灵敏度0.704）；5个随机种子平均灵敏度0.537（标准差0.15）。5. 仅3/4名验证集中住院患者被成功预测（患者1未被任一模型检出）。
AI.conclusion: TRACER在低分辨率、不规则采样的心衰远程监测数据上预测恶化时间线方面优于其他ML/DL基线。将训练重新构建为事件检测问题可更有效利用极度不平衡数据集中有限的住院事件。然而仍存在局限：约2.5次误报/患者/月、高NNE、仅回顾性验证、单一区域队列限制了泛化性，且体重数据质量问题削弱了其临床价值。未来需外部验证、前瞻性临床评估及本地校准。TRACER应作为临床决策支持工具用于风险分层，而非急性恶化诊断系统。

title: Breaking the Environment Wall: Evolving LLM Agent Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Many real-world tasks (e.g., office workflows, scientific experimentation) require LLM agents to interact repeatedly with their environments for context-dependent operations. However, such environments are often not agent-ready. First, information is often scattered and fragmented across the environment. Second, relevant evidence in the environment is often mixed with misleading information and conflicting versions. Third, environments evolve over time, introducing new noise and more challenging tasks. These challenges can substantially degrade performance for state-of-the-art AI agents (e.g., from 83.9% to 57.6%). To address these challenges, we propose Env-Rethink (a system with 27B post-trained model) that supports three main capabilities: (1) It adaptively builds Collection Maps (for organizing related files) and Event Logs (for contextualizing cross-data relationships) to supplement necessary context; (2) It further leverages the post-trained model (through offline trajectory learning) to identify underlying noise issues in the environment; (3) It ultimately evolves environments through virtual event histories that alter environmental states and evidence relationships, producing more tricky ones for further agent improvement. Experiments show that Env-Rethink can effectively improve downstream task performance (with over 15.1% rubric pass rate improvement across nine models on 30 tasks).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Env-Rethink系统，针对LLM智能体在持久化文件场景中面临的"环境不友好"问题（信息分散、噪声污染、版本冲突），通过三大能力——环境组织（Collection Map + Event Log）、学习式环境准备（27B后训练模型）、事件驱动的环境演化——系统性地提升下游任务性能并生成更难的训练实例。
AI.motivation: 当前SOTA LLM智能体在真实持久化文件环境（办公、科学实验）中表现严重退化：Clean环境平均通过率83.9%，加入噪声后降至57.6%（下降26.3个百分点）。核心问题在于：（1）跨文件上下文难以恢复（如"final"文件被后续撤回通知覆盖）；（2）环境判断需要交叉验证而非仅凭文件名/摘要；（3）固定环境无法持续提供新挑战，阻碍智能体递归自我改进。论文将"环境"从被忽视的瓶颈提升为一等公民，主张通过对环境侧的干预而非单纯增强模型能力来突破性能墙。
AI.method: Env-Rethink是一个统一框架，包含三大互补模块：①**环境组织模块**：构建Collection Map（基于语义协调器将文件重组为语义相关集合，保留目录结构覆盖）与Event Log（History Synthesizer合成操作流程，经独立Evidence Reviewer基于源文件验证后才能纳入）；支持两种模式——EGS（仅基于环境）和TGS（加入任务监督）。②**学习式准备模块**：在Qwen3.8-27B基础上用LoRA SFT训练文件验证器；输入为文件集合+工具，输出每个文件的partition/category/stage/family六类标签（如authoritative record、false final version等）；教师轨迹来自DeepSeek/GLM/Gemini在隔离沙箱中使用Claude Code的轨迹，经读保真度与判定准确性双重质检后用于训练，失败的轨迹由修订代理重新生成提示后重试。③**环境演化模块**：基于counter-default decision points（似是而非的错误选项+纠正证据），通过事件历史驱动文件状态变更、参考解更新、评估器修订；实例需通过结构检查与答案验证，并通过配对seed–variant运行评估难度变化。所有模块共享同一27B模型，可在不同下游任务代理间复用。
AI.result: 在30个任务、1,280项rubric检查上评估九个下游模型：①**组织效果**：TGS模式下DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash从64.4%升至87.3%，GLM-5.3-Flash从58.3%升至81.6%；Collection Map贡献12.2pp增益，Event Log贡献2.4pp。②**学习式准备**：Env-Rethink在训练源任务上将划分准确率从74.0%提至90.0%，在held-out任务上从56.2%提至76.5%；下游任务平均通过率从全量环境的57.6%、Qwen3.8-27B选择的59.4%提升至72.7%，对所有九个模型均稳定有效（增益+3.4至+17.8pp），且跨模型家族（DeepSeek/GLM/Qwen/GPT/HY/Gemini）一致。③**环境演化**：在Terminal-Bench 2.1的55个配对任务上，32个（58.2%）任务在至少3个模型上成功率下降，21个在4个模型上全部下降；典型任务如log-summary-date-ranges在四个模型上从3/3降至0–1/3，证明了同请求下新难度实例的有效生成。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明环境侧干预可作为提升LLM智能体性能与驱动递归自我改进的有效杠杆。Env-Rethink通过"组织—学习—演化"三模块联动，使同一环境准备模型能跨九个下游模型稳定提升性能（平均+15.1pp），并通过事件驱动演化生成可验证的更难实例，为持续学习闭环提供了基础。未来工作将探索向独立收集环境的迁移、三模块联合使用，以及在多轮演化后用验证实例训练下一代模型，从而把环境演化与持续代理学习真正耦合起来。

title: Hallucination Neurons and Where to Find Them: An Investigation into the existence of Hallucination Neurons
summary: Interpretable machine learning for Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly relies on sparse probing methods that identify small sets of neurons claimed to detect and causally influence behaviors such as factuality recall, safety alignment, and hallucination. These claims have important implications for model auditing and behavioral steering, yet they are rarely tested against known failure modes of $L_1$-regularized probing in correlated, high-dimensional feature spaces. We propose a five-step diagnostic protocol covering feature correlation, bootstrap stability, sparse versus dense ranking disagreement, intervention baselines, and cross-dataset evaluation as a minimum standard for sparse-neuron localization claims. We investigate prior work using our proposed approach, specifically on H-neurons using open-source LLMs across TriviaQA, BioASQ, and NQ-Open datasets. Our results demonstrate detection replicates across both models and datasets, and exceeds the original reported AUROC gaps for TriviaQA and BioASQ datasets. Gemma 3 4B consistently outperforms MedGemma 4B on matched datasets, with AUROC gaps of +0.311 versus +0.235 on TriviaQA, +0.474 versus +0.455 on BioASQ, and +0.128 versus +0.112 on NQ-Open respectively. Causal validation at $n = 500$ with five random seeds shows statistically significant effects beyond random same-layer baselines. At the same time, the diagnostic results indicate that the selected neurons are not uniquely localized. Across the three Gemma 3 4B settings, 19 of 22 selected H-Neurons have Pearson $|r| > 0.7$ with other features, bootstrap selections show only moderate stability, and sparse and dense rankings overlap only weakly. Our findings show that sparse predictive structure can coexist with non-unique neuron selection. Routine diagnostic validation is necessary to distinguish detection claims from localization claims in mechanistic interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文针对机制可解释性领域中基于稀疏探测（sparse probing）定位"幻觉神经元"（H-Neurons）的声明提出质疑。研究在两个开源LLM（Gemma 3 4B与MedGemma 4B）和三个QA数据集上复现并扩展了原始H-Neurons工作，提出五步诊断协议。结果表明：检测性能与因果效应可以复现甚至超越原始报告，但所识别的神经元并非唯一局部化——它们来自高相关特征聚类、自举稳定性中等、稀疏与稠密排名严重不一致。研究呼吁将诊断验证作为稀疏神经元可解释性研究的标准流程。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性研究常宣称可将LLM的高级行为（如幻觉、安全对齐）定位到少量稀疏神经元。然而这些定位声明极少在L1正则化探测方法的已知失败模式下被严格检验。L1正则化在高维相关特征空间中倾向于从相关聚类中任意选择代表性特征，而非唯一信息单元——这使得"预测性稀疏选择"与"唯一机制定位"之间的区别被模糊。本文以H-Neurons为案例研究，系统性诊断此类声明的可靠性。
AI.method: 本文提出五步诊断协议（D1-D5）：（D1）特征相关性分析——检验被选神经元的Pearson |r|>0.7比例；（D2）自举稳定性——5次重采样计算Jaccard相似度；（D3）L1 vs L2排名不一致性——比较稀疏与稠密正则化选择重叠度；（D4）控制神经元干预——通过激活缩放（α∈{0,1,2}）与同层随机基线对比；（D5）跨数据集与跨模型重叠——使用超几何检验。实验使用Gemma 3 4B和MedGemma 4B，在TriviaQA、BioASQ、NQ-Open各2000样本上采用响应级严格标注（10次生成中全对或全错才入选）。稀疏L1逻辑回归（C=1.0，liblinear）基于CETT特征训练。因果验证使用n=500、5个随机种子的McNemar检验。
AI.result: 检测性能可复现且超越原始报告：AUROC差距在TriviaQA为+0.311/+0.235，在BioASQ为+0.474/+0455，在NQ-Open为+0.128/+0.112；Gemma 3 4B在所有匹配数据集上一致优于MedGemma 4B。因果验证在n=500、5种子下显示统计显著效应（McNemar p<0.001于TriviaQA，p=0.026于BioASQ），超越同层随机基线。然而诊断揭示非唯一局部化：22个Gemma 3 4B H-Neuron中有19个具有|r|>0.7的相关伙伴；自举Jaccard仅为0.45-0.69（低于0.7阈值）；L1∩L2重叠率仅0-25%。跨数据集重叠部分显著（TriviaQA∩BioASQ Jaccard=0.286，p=2.4×10⁻¹⁷），但无通用神经元。(L16, N4146)和(L26, N3593)被识别为跨数据集与跨模型持续出现的候选核心单元。跨数据集分类器迁移全部为正，表明探测捕获可泛化结构。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏探测可同时产生预测有用且因果有效的稀疏选择，但这些选择并不构成唯一定位。本文主张：（1）检测与定位应作为独立评估目标分开评估；（2）L1识别应默认配备共线性诊断（D1、D3）；（3）跨数据集/跨模型神经元重叠分析是机制共享声明最直接的检验；（4）预测稀疏性与种群级因果效应本身不能确立唯一机制定位。诊断验证应成为稀疏神经元可解释性研究的标准流程。未来工作需在更多架构上验证、对候选神经元进行单神经元消融、并测试能力保留（如MMLU性能）以排除一般能力退化的替代解释。

title: Learning to Ideate for Scientific Impact
summary: Scientific ideation is increasingly mediated by large language models, but current ideation systems are usually trained and evaluated on immediately judgeable proxies such as novelty, clarity, and feasibility. This leaves open whether delayed signals of scientific uptake can be used as feedback for steering models toward research directions with higher expected \emph{impact}. We study this question using citation-normalized impact as a noisy but scalable proxy for scholarly uptake. We construct a large-scale dataset from over 100K computer science papers by extracting goal-conditioned idea descriptions and assigning each paper an ordinal, year-normalized citation label. We then train a goal-conditioned reward model to predict citation-impact labels from research goal and idea pairs, and use this reward to align an idea generator through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. To reduce circularity, we evaluate generated ideas with a held-out, reference-grounded protocol that compares model outputs against historical ideas under the same research goal and weights judgments by the reference idea's citation-impact label. Experiments show that our RL-tuned model consistently produces ideas with higher estimated impact than both the base model and supervised fine-tuning baselines. Our findings position scientific impact as a practical, outcome-grounded feedback signal for aligning LLMs in open-ended scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"影响力对齐"(Impact Alignment)框架,将论文的引用影响力作为延迟反馈信号,通过奖励建模+RLHF方式训练LLM生成具有高科学影响力的研究思路。基于10万篇CS论文构建目标-想法配对数据集,训练CORN序数奖励模型预测引用影响力等级,再用GRPO强化学习对齐Qwen3-8B生成器。RL模型在多数投票评估下将"影响力想法比例"从基线的30.66%、SFT的26.61%提升至51.66%。
AI.motivation: 现有科学构思系统主要优化即时可评判的代理指标(新颖性、清晰度、可行性),与科学实际影响力脱节。引用作为学术影响力的可扩展代理,虽延迟且有噪声,但能否用作生成模型的反馈信号以引导模型产出更具影响力的研究方向,是本文要解决的核心问题。
AI.method: (1) 数据构建:从Semantic Scholar筛选2010-2024年110万篇CS开放获取论文,去除综述,归一化引用(引用数/年龄)并离散化为5级序数标签(Zero/Very Low至Very High),分层采样10万篇;(2) 用GPT-4o-mini抽取(研究目标,想法描述)对,形成Reward数据集与SFT/RL数据集两独立子集避免奖励黑客;(3) 奖励模型:Qwen3-8B + LoRA(r=64) + CORN序数回归头,预测(goal, idea)对的序数影响力等级;(4) 生成器对齐:先SFT初始化,再用DAPO(GRPO变体)以组内归一化奖励进行RL优化,组大小4,K=5,rmax=5;(5) 评估协议RGCW-IIE:用GPT-5.1/4.1/4o对比生成想法与同目标下历史参考想法,并按参考引用影响力加权计分。
AI.result: 奖励模型:准确率48.0%,±1准确率90.6%,Spearman 0.756,QWK 0.754,显著超越GPT-5零样本(27.7%);生成评估(RGCW-IIE多数投票):RL模型影响力比例51.66%,远超Base(30.66%)与SFT(26.61%);三种评估器(GPT-4o/4.1/5.1)及多数投票一致显示RL>SFT>Base;影响力排列分析显示RL独占贡献最显著。
AI.conclusion: 引用归一化影响力虽延迟且有噪声,仍可作为LLM科学构思对齐的实用、结果导向反馈信号;该框架将影响力从"事后评估/预测"转变为"生成时可控制的优化目标",为开放性科学发现中的结果驱动对齐提供新范式;局限包括引用作为影响力代理的偏差、自动抽取误差、仅限CS领域及LLM评估器的固有偏见。

title: Decoding Imagined Speech: A Strictly Subject-Independent Approach Using EEG
summary: Imagined speech decoding from electroencephalography (EEG) has gained increasing attention as a potential communication pathway for individuals with severe motor impairments, yet reported performance often relies on evaluation protocols that do not clearly reflect cross-subject generalization. This study presents a transparent baseline investigation of a multi-class imagined speech EEG dataset under a strictly subject-independent evaluation framework. Two preprocessing and feature extraction pipelines were compared: a time-domain statistical feature approach and a frequency-domain spectral bandpower approach, evaluated using subject-wise cross-validation and trial-level majority voting with a random forest classifier. The spectral pipeline achieved a significantly higher mean trial-wise accuracy than the statistical pipeline (49.03 $\pm$ 4.18% vs. 37.97 $\pm$ 3.79%) for coarse-level classification across subjects. Forward feature selection further indicated that a limited subset of frequency bands captured most of the discriminative information. Overall, this work provides a strong basis for future brain-computer interface studies targeting improved cross-subject generalization in EEG-based imagined speech decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文在严格被试独立评估协议下，对Kumar想象语音EEG数据集进行了透明基线研究，对比了时域统计特征与频域频带功率两种特征提取流水线，采用随机森林分类器与被试交叉验证。结果表明频域流水线显著优于时域流水线（49.03% vs 37.97%），且仅需少量频带（α+δ+γ+θ）即可捕获大部分判别信息。
AI.motivation: 现有想象语音EEG解码研究多采用不够清晰的评估协议（窗口级或被试内划分），导致报告性能可能被高估，难以反映跨被试泛化能力。本研究旨在建立透明、可复现的严格被试独立评估基线，为实际BCI应用提供更真实的性能参考。
AI.method: 使用Kumar想象语音EEG数据集（23名被试，14通道Emotiv EPOC+，128Hz，三类粗粒度分类）。对比两条流水线：（1）Kumar流水线——5点滑动平均+统计特征（sd、rms、sum、信号能量），56维；（2）频域流水线——50Hz陷波+0.5-60Hz带通+Welch周期图PSD+5频带绝对功率（δ/θ/α/β/γ），70维。两者均采用1秒窗、75%重叠、试次级多数投票、5折StratifiedGroupKFold被试交叉验证、200棵树的随机森林，并用配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验比较。进一步对频域流水线执行前向频带选择。
AI.result: 频域流水线试次级准确率49.03±4.18%，显著高于Kumar流水线的37.97±3.79%（p=0.018，秩双列相关=0.57）。字符类准确率最高（56.30% vs 48.90%），图像类在Kumar流水线中最低（29.40%）。前向选择显示α带单带准确率最高（46.67%），α+δ+γ+θ四带组合达52.83%，与全带模型无显著差异（Bonferroni校正后）。
AI.conclusion: 频域特征在跨被试泛化方面优于时域统计特征，且判别信息集中在少量频带（尤其α和δ）中，无需高维特征空间。本工作提供了可复现的严格被试独立基线，强调了评估协议与现实约束一致性的重要性，为未来开发更具泛化能力的EEG-BCI系统奠定基础。局限性包括缺乏伪迹去除、通道选择及更丰富的频域特征。

title: PUBG Ally: A Conversational Embodied Agent as an AI Teammate
summary: We introduce PUBG Ally, an embodied agent for PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS that can reason, act autonomously, and play alongside players as a voice-enabled teammate. Building such a teammate requires combining two difficult capabilities: it must perceive and respond to a constantly changing game world under strict latency constraints while interacting naturally with players, keeping its speech synchronized with its actions. Ally therefore combines agentic tool use with real-time game control. A language-model agent uses a controlled interface to inspect game information, interpret player speech, maintain context, decide what to say, and issue high-level action choices that steer a faster control layer for movement, combat, and recovery. Because the player's and Ally's speech and actions continually shape each other and the course of the match, training requires data from actual gameplay. We therefore collect data across nearly 39k sessions in which real players play alongside Ally, recording gameplay, player speech, agent decisions, tool use, actions, and player feedback, and use these records for iterative training. To evaluate teammate quality, we use player feedback and preference comparisons to identify gaps between offline evaluations and player preferences, and iteratively refine the evaluation criteria.
