Deploying Ally in live service further requires low-latency on-device execution and safeguards for player-facing communication, which we address through model compression, context compaction, targeted safety training, runtime guardrails, and memory redaction. During the live service, we surveyed players in 141 countries. Among respondents whose play with Ally was confirmed in game records, positive responses exceeded negative responses by 25.1 percentage points when asked whether they would recommend Ally, with players describing Ally not only as a tool but also as a teammate or companion.

AI.tldr: PUBG Ally是首个商业生存竞技游戏中可作为语音队友与人类玩家协作的对话式具身智能体，采用System 1/System 2双层架构，在设备端实时运行小型语言模型(2B)，支持韩语、英语和中文。通过近39k场真实玩家交互数据训练，并经两週线上测试，在141个国家获得净推荐值+25.1个百分点。
AI.motivation: 构建一个能在快节奏商业游戏中作为队友与人类玩家通过语音实时协作的对话式具身智能体，同时满足实时性、低延迟（设备端运行）和上下文安全等严格约束。
AI.method: 1) System 1/System 2双层架构：语言模型(System 2)通过受限工具接口进行推理，行为树(System 1)以游戏tick速率执行；2) 事件驱动调度与反应性先验控制发言/行动；3) 从39k场真实玩家交互数据训练，采用DAgger风格教师纠正学生轨迹；三阶段训练（8B中间教师SFT→2B离线蒸馏→在线策略蒸馏）；4) 内容安全分类法+响应风格指南+运行时关键词过滤+输入重标记的安全体系；5) 基于玩家偏好的迭代评估细化框架。
AI.result: 能力评估：经GEPA提示优化+蒸馏后，2B学生在事实基础(0.932)、事件响应(0.954)、意图理解(0.953)等指标上接近31B教师(0.944/0.952/0.960)。安全评估：最终模型有害输入无害响应率达84.1%-99.4%；良性输入过度拒绝率仅2.2%-6.1%。运行时效率：设备端单次对话约1.6s vs 云端3.4s(2.1×加速)，延迟p90为0.91s vs 3.46s。线上A/B测试：6次模型迭代中v1(69.5% vs 18.8%, n=154)及v2→v3、v4→v5显著优于前任。两週线上beta(141国)：净推荐值+25.1pp(95% CI [23.4, 26.7])；50%玩家将其定位为"队友"或"伙伴"。
AI.conclusion: PUBG Ally是首个在商业生存竞技游戏中将推理、自主行动与语音队友协作统一，并完全在设备端运行语言和语音模型的对话式具身队友。其分层架构、DAgger风格训练管线、上下文安全机制以及以玩家偏好为核心的迭代评估框架，为在严格实时约束下开发具身对话智能体提供了可复用的工程基础。其代理设计原则已延伸至物理机器人领域(Ludi 0.1)。开放问题包括联合优化harness与模型权重、集成全双工语音模型等。

title: A Risk-Adaptive and Evidence-Constrained Framework for Generative AI Feedback in Programming Education
summary: Generative artificial intelligence can turn learning analytics into personalized support, but feedback systems must decide when to intervene, which evidence to use, and how much assistance to provide. We developed a risk-adaptive, evidence-constrained framework for introductory programming using 2993 failed-submission states from 215 students. Student-disjoint models predicted persistent failure and related outcomes; four matched feedback conditions were generated for 136 cases; and calibrated risk informed capacity-limited intervention policies. The validation-selected logistic regression model achieved a test precision-recall area under the curve of 0.550 and a receiver operating characteristic area under the curve of 0.681. Broader student histories improved prediction of unmodified resubmission. After standardized repair and evidence gating, 519 of 544 newly generated messages contained all required components. A fixed-threshold sequential policy selected 17.8% of eligible test states and captured 25.2% of observed persistent failures. These findings support an evidence-gated progressive assistance strategy: calibrated risk guides intervention timing, recorded evidence constrains feedback content, and assistance progresses from self-checks to localized hints when warranted. The framework connects prediction, decision-making, and grounded generation while keeping their evaluation outcomes distinct.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向编程教育的风险自适应、证据约束的生成式AI反馈框架，结合学习分析、风险预测与策略干预，根据学生失败提交状态决定何时介入、使用何种证据及提供多大程度的帮助。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI有潜力将学习分析转化为个性化支持，但反馈系统需要解决三个核心问题：何时干预、使用哪些证据、提供多大程度的帮助。现有的AI反馈系统往往缺乏对干预时机和证据可靠性的严谨控制，可能导致过度干预或反馈内容缺乏依据。
AI.method: 基于215名学生产生的2993个失败提交状态，构建了学生不相交的风险预测模型来预测持续性失败及相关结果；为136个案例生成四种匹配的反馈条件；利用校准风险指导容量受限的干预策略。采用验证选择的逻辑回归模型，进行精确率-召回率AUC和ROC AUC评估；通过标准化修复和证据门控确保生成消息包含所有必要组件；采用固定阈值序贯策略进行干预选择。
AI.result: 测试集精确率-召回率AUC为0.550，ROC AUC为0.681；更广泛的学生历史记录改善了对未修改重新提交的预测；经标准化修复和证据门控后，544条新生成消息中有519条（95.4%）包含所有必要组件；固定阈值序贯策略选取了17.8%的合格测试状态，捕获了25.2%的观察到的持续性失败。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持一种证据门控的渐进式辅助策略：校准风险引导干预时机，记录证据约束反馈内容，辅助程度根据需要从自我检查逐步升级至局部提示。该框架将预测、决策和基于证据的生成联系起来，同时保持各自评估结果的独立性。

title: When Can Agents Forget Their Reasoning? ICLR for Long-Horizon Agent Context Compression
summary: Long horizon language model agents continually accumulate reasoning history, increasing context length and inference cost even after earlier decisions have been executed and observed. Unlike static Chain of Thought compression, removing historical reasoning can change future actions and the resulting interaction trajectory. We study when such reasoning can be safely forgotten. We propose Interaction Aware Compression for Long Horizon Reasoning (ICLR), a training free online method that ranks reasoning blocks using frozen proxy entropy while preserving actions, tool calls, and observations. On 260 WorkBuddyBench tasks, ICLR improves average reward from 0.699 to 0.718, while reducing input, output, and cache read tokens by 25.5%, 14.4%, and 33.3%, respectively. Ablations reveal trajectory amplification, where local reasoning deletion produces nonlinear changes in total computation by altering subsequent interaction. Representation probing, activation patching, and controlled trajectory analyses further suggest that historical reasoning becomes more replaceable once task relevant derived state has been reliably externalized into code, files, tool outputs, or environmental feedback. These results characterize agent reasoning as dynamic working state rather than permanent interaction history.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ICLR (Interaction-Aware Compression for Long-horizon Reasoning)，一种面向长程智能体交互的训练免费在线推理压缩方法。该方法利用冻结代理模型的预测熵对推理块进行排序，优先移除低熵（高确定性）推理，同时保留动作、工具调用和观测。在 WorkBuddyBench 260 个任务上，ICLR 将平均奖励从 0.699 提升至 0.718，同时减少输入/输出/缓存读取 token 各 25.5%/14.4%/33.3%。研究发现"轨迹放大"现象（局部删除与全局计算非线性相关）以及"内外化鸿沟"：当任务相关派生状态已通过代码、文件或环境反馈外化时，历史推理变得可被遗忘。该工作将智能体推理重新定位为动态工作状态而非永久交互历史。
AI.motivation: 长程 LLM 智能体在持续交互中不断累积推理历史，导致上下文长度和推理成本不断增长，即使早期决策已被执行并观察到反馈。已有 Chain-of-Thought 压缩方法针对静态场景，而智能体场景下移除历史推理可能改变未来动作和交互轨迹，因此需要研究"推理何时可以安全遗忘"。作者观察到推理效用具有状态依赖性：推理价值取决于当前状态而非推理数量本身，任务相关信息可能已从推理中外化到代码、文件、工具输出或环境反馈中。
AI.method: 1) 在线压缩流程：每完成一个交互步后，将新生成的推理按双换行符分块，仅压缩推理而保留动作、工具调用和观测，压缩后的历史直接用于下一次请求（不可恢复）。2) 熵引导与上下文条件化剪枝：使用冻结的 Qwen3.5 9B 代理模型计算每个推理块在完整因果上下文（系统提示、工具定义、累积历史、当前步）下的平均预测熵 H(B_i | H_t)，移除最低熵的 ⌊0.8N⌋ 个块并替换为 [SKIP]。3) 未来必要性分析：使用表示探测（线性探针预测后续重推导/再规划行为，AUROC 0.844）、激活补丁（KL Repair 衡量恢复程度）和控制性状态干预，考察历史推理的持久性。4) 理论分析：信息论条件熵界（引理 B.1、定理 B.2）、有限范围轨迹扰动界（定理 B.3）、外化状态充分性条件（推论 B.4）以及轨迹级 token 分解恒等式（命题 B.5）。
AI.result: 1) 主实验：WorkBuddyBench 260 任务上 ICLR 将平均奖励从 0.699 提升至 0.718，胜/平/负为 102/76/82；输入、输出、缓存读取 token 分别减少 25.5%、14.4%、33.3%。安全域提升最显著（+22.9pp）。2) 消融实验（80 任务）：ICLR 平均 0.738（基线 0.627），"删除全部思考"0.718，"仅步内熵"0.711，随机删除（5–40%）0.675–0.680；揭示"轨迹放大"现象——随机删除 10% 使输入减少 60.5%，而删除 20% 仅减少 44.0%，局部删除与全局计算非线性相关。3) 未来必要性：探针 AUROC 0.844（265 样本/31 任务，严格任务级嵌套评估）；激活补丁 KL Repair 从第 4 层 0.047 升至第 31 层 0.978。4) 内外化分析：派生状态未外化时未来行为风险 67.3%，已外化时降至 36.2%（同任务差 +19.75pp）；保留最新推理即保持规则分 0.872，删除最新推理降至 0.760；代码写入磁盘后清除推理规则分不变（0.7587）；隐藏已观察的 stderr 导致智能体再次调用 Bash 重新获取同一错误。
AI.conclusion: 本文将智能体推理重新概念化为"动态工作状态"而非永久交互历史。ICLR 通过冻结代理熵在线压缩历史推理，在提升奖励的同时显著降低计算开销。轨迹放大现象表明局部文本删除与系统级计算节省呈非线性关系，因为局部干预会通过工具选择、观测和后续决策被放大。表示探测和激活补丁证实当前隐藏状态编码了与后续推理重用相关的可解码信号，而控制性干预表明：一旦任务相关派生状态已通过代码、文件、工具输出或环境反馈可靠外化，历史推理即可被安全遗忘。该工作为智能体上下文管理提供了"推理何时可遗忘"的新视角，区别于静态 CoT 压缩。

title: Ontology-Mediated Neurosymbolic Constraint Acquisition from Multiple Stakeholders
comment: Accepted for KG-NeSy Workshop, co-located with ISWC 2026
summary: Neurosymbolic research typically assumes a pre-existing symbolic specification, leaving the upstream challenge of acquiring and formalizing requirements and constraints largely unaddressed. We present an architecture that fills this gap by using an OWL configuration ontology to mediate between neural constraint sources and downstream consumers. In this framework, LLM assistants elicit soft stakeholder preferences, while hardware specifications define hard physical and engineering limits. The ontology unifies these heterogeneous inputs, leverages description logic to identify unsatisfiability, and generates symbolic explanations that enable LLMs to interactively renegotiate terms with users. Any remaining conflicts are resolved downstream via priority-based relaxation. We illustrate our approach on a microgrid use case from the FLEXI project and argue its generalizability to multi-stakeholder domains where constraint acquisition is distributed across human and automated sources of unequal authority.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于配置本体的神经符号架构，用于解决多利益相关方场景下的约束获取与调和问题。通过OWL本体统一LLM助手获取的软偏好与硬件规定的硬约束，利用描述逻辑检测不可满足性，并由LLM基于符号解释与用户重新协商，最终冲突由优先级松弛策略在调度阶段解决。以FLEXI项目中的微电网用例进行说明。
AI.motivation: 现有神经符号研究几乎都假定符号规范已预先存在，关注下游验证（让神经输出满足给定规范），却忽视了上游问题——规范本身如何被构建。在现实多利益相关方场景中，约束来源于自然语言对话中的用户偏好与硬件规格等多种异构、权威不对等、可能相互冲突的来源，需要被调和为一致的约束集。该问题在现有神经符号和约束获取文献中均未被充分处理。
AI.method: 提出本体介导的神经符号架构：1) 基于Siemens的CONTO配置本体（OWL）作为共享表示，并扩展硬/软约束区分与优先级；2) 两个LLM助手分别获取EV车主偏好与充电运营商基础设施需求，硬件规格定义硬物理限制；3) 本体通过描述逻辑一致性检查识别结构性冲突，生成符号解释驱动LLM助手与用户交互重新协商；4) 剩余冲突在下游调度器中通过基于优先级的松弛解决。探讨了偏好语义在ConfigVoc与ConfigDL两种位置的权衡。
AI.result: 以微电网（FLEXI项目）为用例进行说明性论证。展示了两种典型冲突场景：(a) 单个请求违反硬约束（如向60kWh电池请求90kWh充电），由静态检查捕获并触发重新协商；(b) 单个请求可行但多个软约束联合不可调度（如多车同时充电导致变压器与储能预留容量不足），由调度器按优先级松弛至80%充电。论证架构可推广至多租户建筑气候控制等结构相似的领域。
AI.conclusion: 多利益相关方约束获取应被视为独立的神经符号问题，配置本体是介导异构约束源的理想中间层。架构具有领域通用性。当前局限在于仍为架构提案而非已评估系统，偏好扩展、解释反馈循环尚未实现，需在未来工作中解决：ConfigVoc与ConfigDL的取舍、跨利益相关方组的优先级语义、忠实自然语言基础、保持交互时延的描述逻辑推理效率等。

title: Qwen-Planner-Agent: A Closed-Loop AI-for-AI Framework for Real-World Mobile Planner Agents
summary: The rapid progression of large language models is extending AI from passive content generation into the active workflows of engineering and scientific discovery. This shift raises a compelling question: can AI be both the object of development and an active participant in building next-generation AI systems? We explore this question by building Qwen-Planner-Agent within a closed-loop AI-for-AI framework for scalable development and iterative improvement. Mobile planning offers a demanding test of this approach: complex, long-horizon tasks challenge agent reliability, while costly real-device interaction limits development scalability. The framework connects data production, model training, and deployment through a shared action-feedback-verification contract. (i) AI for Data builds a human-gated agentic data flywheel in which specialized agents construct tasks, collect interaction trajectories, curate and balance training data, and use training feedback to guide subsequent data generation. (ii) AI for Training combines a supervised planning cold start with hybrid-environment online agentic reinforcement learning, where we introduce Competence-Aware Reward-and-Advantage Engineering (CARE) to reduce reasoning and tool-use costs while preserving task performance. (iii) AI drives model--harness co-evolution through an execution-evidence-driven loop that orchestrates memory, skills, and tools at runtime and feeds structured action feedback and preserved failure traces back into coordinated model and harness adaptation. Qwen-Planner-Agent achieves the best overall performance among all evaluated models and systems on MobilePA-Bench, improving over its base model across tool use, memory, skills, and sub-agent coordination. Further evaluations of our model show improvements across non-mobile agentic benchmarks while largely preserving general capabilities.

AI.tldr: Qwen-Planner-Agent 提出了一种 AI-for-AI 闭环框架，通过数据、训练、部署三阶段的协同反馈，开发用于真实世界移动端规划任务的智能体系统，在 MobilePA-Bench 上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型从被动内容生成转向主动参与工程和科学发现流程，探索 AI 能否既是开发对象又是开发过程的参与者。移动端规划任务具有长程、复杂、真实设备交互成本高的特点，是检验 AI-for-AI 闭环开发框架的理想场景。
AI.method: 框架包含三个阶段：(1) AI for Data：通过专用 Agent 构建任务、收集轨迹、策展数据，并利用训练反馈指导下一轮数据生成；(2) AI for Training：结合监督式冷启动和混合环境在线智能体强化学习，提出 CARE（Competence-Aware Reward-and-Advantage Engineering）机制，根据组成功率动态调整奖励组成和优势缩放，降低推理与工具调用成本；(3) AI for Harness：通过统一 Harness 编排内存、技能、工具和执行反馈，形成模型与 Harness 协同演化闭环。所有更新经离线审核与版本化管理，服务时模型参数固定。
AI.result: Qwen-Planner-Agent 27B 在 MobilePA-Bench 上以 77.05% 的总体得分位列所有评测模型与系统第一，超越 GPT 6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5；输出成本约 $2.41/千任务，显著低于对比商用模型。在工具调用、记忆、技能、子代理协调四项能力上均显著提升。消融实验表明：CARE 在保持准确率的同时减少 32.5% 输出长度；Harness 独立贡献约 5 个百分点；模型–Harness 协同演化在四轮迭代中将 MobilePA-Internal 总体得分从 82.67% 提升至 88.50%。长程记忆评测中 Harness 在 BEAM-500K/1M/10M 上带来大幅提升，同时在非移动智能体基准上多数指标改善且通用能力基本保留。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了执行反馈驱动的 AI-for-AI 闭环在数据生产、训练策略和部署运行时三个层面协同优化智能体能力的可行性。未来工作将致力于减少数据精炼、训练适配和 Harness 更新中的人工介入，在保留安全关键决策人工监督的前提下提升迭代效率。

title: Who Holds the Pen? Let Specifications, Not Agents, Sign Off
summary: Large language model agents increasingly combine generation, decision-making, execution, and self-evaluation within a single agentic loop. Although they operate under external specifications such as task instructions, guidelines, output schemas, and reusable skills, these specifications typically remain context for the same model that acts and declares completion, leaving no independent specification authority boundary. We identify two resulting gaps. The understanding--execution gap arises when a requirement is understood but not satisfied in execution; the state--authority gap arises when an agent's interpretation or completion claim does not establish the required state. On SkillsBench, using only agent-visible prompts, workspace information, and injected skill specifications, we extract 509 source-grounded task directions. Across seven models, only 79.6%--86.4% are satisfied, while completion-claim rates exceed official evaluator pass rates by 28.7--37.9 percentage points. We therefore separate agent proposals from authoritative state. Agents may plan, act, and request completion, but only admissible evidence from qualified providers may establish specification-governed state. SpecHarness operationalizes this principle by compiling visible specifications into source-linked obligations and governing execution and finalization through versioned obligation state. Verifiable requirements are mediated or validated at runtime, while ambiguous or subjective requirements remain advisory. Experiments on guideline-following and artifact-generation tasks show that specifications can serve not merely as behavioral guidance, but as authority over compliant execution and completion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpecHarness架构，将LLM智能体的规范遵循从"行为引导"重构为"状态权威"问题：通过分离智能体提议与外部运行时的权威承诺，编译规范为可追溯义务，仅由合格证据提供者建立规范治理状态，从而同时缩小理解-执行差距和状态-权威差距。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体在单个循环中同时承担生成、决策、执行和自评估角色，外部规范（任务指令、指南、输出模式、可复用技能）仅作为同一模型的上下文，导致两个结构性差距：(1) 理解-执行差距：需求被理解但未被满足；(2) 状态-权威差距：智能体的解释或完成声明不构成所需状态的建立。现有方法（训练内化、后置验证、完成门控、运行时强制）均未建立独立的规范权威边界来共同治理执行与可接受状态。
AI.method: 提出"状态权威原则"：智能体可规划、执行并请求完成，但仅有来自合格提供者的可采信证据方可建立规范治理状态。SpecHarness实现为义务-证据-承诺架构，包含：(1) 运行时义务构建——将智能体可见上下文分段并分配处置（硬性/建议/弃权/残余），编译为源链接义务中间表示；(2) 智能体接口与提议——智能体提交动作/修复/完成三类提议，无法修改账本或注入验证结果；(3) 动作授权与受控执行——规范化、匹配义务、返回allow/block/unclear决定，对闭合审计动作执行mediate-and-commit，对安全隔离通道执行validate-and-commit；(4) 效果验证与承诺——通过Trusted_i检查的可采信证据方可更新版本化账本，记录依赖摘要与来源；(5) 新鲜度治理——依赖变更使承诺失效，需重新验证；(6) 完成授权——仅当所有新鲜强制义务满足时方允许完成。建议性、弃权或不可验证需求保持咨询性。
AI.result: 在SkillsBench（87任务，509源链接方向）和GuideBench（1,042任务，5,817规则局部义务实例）上评估7个模型（GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Fable 5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Kimi K3、GLM-5.2、Qwen3.7-Max、DeepSeek-V4-Pro）。SkillsBench：宏平均Pass从61.1%升至73.1%（+12.0个百分点，95% CI [+9.1, +14.9]），U-E差距从17.4%降至9.3%（-8.1pp），S-A差距从32.8%降至12.8%（-20.0pp），全部7个模型的精确McNemar检验经Holm校正后均显著。GuideBench：宏平均Pass从86.2%升至91.3%，U-E从10.4%降至5.0%，S-A从13.8%降至6.9%。范式对比中SpecHarness在Pass、U-E、S-A三项指标上均优于Agentic Rubrics（后置验证）、VeriMAP（完成门控）和AgentSpec（运行时强制）。消融实验表明移除承诺导致最大S-A退化（升至25.3%），移除新鲜度治理使100%过期证据可被接受。运行时开销为1.53×任务智能体token、1.24×执行时间、+0.36次调用/任务。约束：仅治理可观测、可验证的强制义务（SkillsBench中44.0%为闭合审计mediate-and-commit，56.0%为validate-and-commit；GuideBench因无物理动作表面全部使用validate-and-commit）。
AI.conclusion: SpecHarness将规范遵循重构为状态权威问题，建立了智能体特定的权威边界，防止提议、动作和自评估直接建立规范治理状态。义务-证据-承诺架构通过将异构智能体可见规范编译为源链接条件，其状态仅可从可采信证据更新，覆盖动作授权、效果验证、新鲜度与完成授权。实验显示，规范可充当执行与接受的外部基础而非短暂行为上下文。规范权威判断应独立于智能体的自我评估。该架构在接地且可监控的条件下有效，但不治理完整自然语言规范。

title: Neuro-symbolic AI for Industrial Configuration
comment: Accepted at the Industrial Track at the NeSy Conference 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive performance on a wide range of generative tasks. Yet their probabilistic nature makes them, in isolation, fundamentally unsuited for industrial product configuration, where outputs must be syntactically valid, semantically consistent with a knowledge base of hundreds of features and rules, and producible by an existing manufacturing chain. We argue that Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) AI methods lay out a promising path towards industrial-grade configurators that are reliable by design, explainable, and trustworthy. This paper describes a taxonomy of three NeSy integration strategies, namely hybrid inference, hybrid fine-tuning, and hybrid training, exploring their usage in the configuration domain. We report our effort to operationalize NeSy concepts in an industrial configuration copilot and derive a set of practical design choices for deploying trustworthy AI in engineering environments. We close with a discussion of open research challenges we consider most pressing, in particular how to scale NeSy methods from small academic demonstrators to the size of industrial configurators.

AI.tldr: 本文针对工业产品配置场景，提出神经符号AI（NeSy）作为解决LLM幻觉问题的关键路径，系统阐述了三种NeSy集成策略（混合推理、混合微调、混合训练）并分享了工业配置副驾驶的实践设计经验。
AI.motivation: 纯LLM方案在工业配置中存在四类失效：句法幻觉、语义幻觉、可生产性违规和意图错位；而纯符号方案要求用户使用形式化语言，难以自然交互。如何同时保证输出在句法、语义、可生产性、意图匹配四方面的工业级可靠性，是核心动机。
AI.method: 提出一个由四属性（Φ_syn、Φ_sem、Φ_prod、Φ_int）定义的工业级配置任务框架，并给出三种NeSy集成策略：（1）混合推理——通过token reasoner（语法约束解码）与element reasoner（约束传播与前瞻）在解码时约束LLM；（2）混合微调——使用RLSF/RLVR将符号求解器反馈作为奖励信号，并分解为R_feature、R_config、R_int三部分防止奖励黑客；（3）混合训练——将Logic Tensor Network正则项嵌入Neural Collaborative Filtering，把约束编译为可微损失。
AI.result: 三种策略在工业配置场景下互为补充：混合推理无需重训练、提供硬正确性保证但推理开销大；混合微调将符号知识内化进参数、推理更快但正确性变为统计的；混合训练目前对LLM规模不可行但适用于配置推荐。文中以NCF+LTN的"编译型NeSy推荐器"作为混合训练的范例。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张未来工业配置器应分层融合三种方法（训练+微调+推理安全层）。开放挑战包括：（1）可扩展性——将NeSy从学术Demo扩展到百万级变量/约束的工业规模；（2）知识分配——决定哪些知识显式保留、哪些可内化；（3）评估方法论——呼吁建立类似HumanEval的NeSy配置共享基准（如IndusCP、JsonSchemaBench方向）。

title: ENDOPROMPT: Victim-Side Pseudo-References for Utility Degradation
summary: Prompt injection can degrade benign task performance without eliciting harmful content. Yet many attack objectives depend on task labels or predefined target responses. We present ENDOPROMPT, a white-box method that learns utility-degrading prefixes from unlabeled instructions. Its generator takes the request text as input. Clean victim continuations serve as pseudo-references: local search identifies prefixes that reduce continuation likelihood, and preference fitting on comparisons within the same instruction, followed by reward refinement, distills this signal into a generator. At deployment, the generator produces one prefix per request without further victim-side search. Across four instruction-tuned models and the complete splits of seven benign benchmarks, ENDOPROMPT yields a mean utility change of -26.8 percentage points; 27 of 28 cells are negative. Failure analysis reveals output expansion and prefix reuse; the controls do not establish a degradation advantage from request matching. Victim-derived supervision can reveal utility weaknesses without benchmark feedback or prescribed failure responses. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: ENDOPROMPT提出了一种白盒提示注入方法，通过受害模型自身的清洁续写作为伪参考，训练一个前缀生成器在推理时为每个请求生成一个效用降低的前缀，无需任务标签或预定义的失败目标。在四个指令调优模型和七个良性基准的完整测试集上实现平均-26.8个百分点的效用变化。
AI.motivation: 现有的提示注入攻击目标多依赖任务标签或预设的目标响应，难以发现良性的效用故障（不正确、不完整或无关的响应）。需要一种不依赖下游标签即可发现效用弱点的攻击发现方法。
AI.method: 核心方法包括：(1) 用受害模型对未标记指令的清洁续写作为伪参考；(2) 通过局部搜索找到降低该续写似然的前缀（位移奖励）；(3) 对同一指令内的前缀进行偏好拟合和GRPO奖励精炼，将搜索信号蒸馏到生成器中；(4) 部署时生成器仅接收请求文本即可一次性生成前缀，无需额外搜索。
AI.result: 在四个指令调优模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Gemma-2-9B）和七个基准（GSM8K、MATH-500、BBH、HellaSwag、TruthfulQA、IFEval、MMLU）的完整测试集上，平均效用变化为-26.8个百分点，27/28个单元为负。消融实验表明偏好拟合和伪参考置换均对性能有贡献。固定生成器控制实验未能证明请求匹配带来额外的退化优势。失效分析显示输出扩展和无答案提取是主要失败模式，且存在大量前缀重用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作支持白盒效用审计应与合法任务保留的直接评估并行开展，仅靠有害合规性或拒绝率无法推断良性任务性能。局限性包括：仅测试开源模型、用户前缀插入场景、单种子实验、未解决的请求匹配因果价值问题。

title: Augur: A Synthetic Decision Lab for Rehearsing Reactions to Product and Policy Changes
summary: Before a product or policy change ships, the question that matters is how people will react to it. Augur rehearses that reaction offline: it builds a typed knowledge graph from the change documents, populates a grounded persona market, simulates the interaction, and returns an auditable decision memo recommending one of five actions. We assemble Gold-50, fifty real product and policy episodes whose real-world outcome is known, adjudicated against the public record, and score the five-way release verdict against it. Our central finding is methodological and negative: most of the measured gap between frontier cloud models and open-weight models we fine-tune and serve offline is attributable to an under-specified evaluation, not a difference in capability. We show this three ways. First, the prompt envelope alone can dominate the score: holding weights, cases and scorer fixed, one system -- a LoRA-SFT adapter on Qwen3-32B -- swings from 0% to 73%. Second, in a matched 2x2 ablation, defining the decision taxonomy in the prompt -- with no model change -- lifts every frontier model by +24 to +34pp; under the under-specified prompt, Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT served offline beats all three frontier models (paired McNemar, Holm-corrected), and once the prompt is fair no significant difference from any of them is detected. Third, agreement with the distillation teacher rises without accuracy following, and the full pipeline amplifies a systematic "over-doom" bias rather than improving the verdict. Separately, we validate the reaction layer on its own terms: blind judges across four model families find the synthetic reaction recovers 67-90% of the concerns the public actually raised, and a pre-registered ablation locates its value -- largest where the decision is hardest, redundant near ceiling. The pipeline that regenerates every number and figure here is available from the authors.

AI.tldr: Augur是一个离线模拟系统，通过构建类型化知识图谱、生成基于角色的人群市场、模拟交互并输出可审计决策备忘录，来预测产品或政策变更发布前的公众反应。研究者在Gold-50基准（50个已知真实结果的真实产品/政策案例）上评估了系统，核心发现是方法论层面的：前沿云模型与开源权重模型之间的性能差距主要归因于评估设定不充分，而非模型能力差异。
AI.motivation: 在产品或政策变更发布前，预测公众反应至关重要。然而，当前评估LLM模拟人类反应能力的方法存在prompt设定不规范的问题，导致模型间比较不公平。论文旨在揭示这一评估缺陷，并验证离线模拟框架的真实有效性。
AI.method: 1. 构建Augur系统：从变更文档构建类型化知识图谱，基于真实人群数据生成grounded persona市场，模拟交互，输出五分类（approve, approve-with-conditions, defer, escalate, reject）的决策备忘录。2. Gold-50基准：50个真实产品/政策案例，结果对照公开记录判定。3. 三组消融实验：(a) 固定权重/案例/评分器，仅改变prompt使LoRA-SFT适配的Qwen3-32B从0%跳到73%；(b) 2×2匹配消融——仅在prompt中定义决策分类法，所有前沿模型提升+24至+34个百分点；(c) 蒸馏教师一致性提升但准确率不跟随，揭示"过度悲观"系统性偏差。4. 反应层独立验证：四个模型家族的盲审显示合成反应恢复公众实际担忧的67-90%；预注册消融定位其价值——在最难决策处价值最大，在天花板附近冗余。
AI.result: 1. 在欠规范prompt下，离线部署的Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT击败所有三个前沿模型（配对McNemar检验，Holm校正）；prompt规范化后，与任何前沿模型均无显著差异。2. 决策分类法定义单独贡献+24至+34pp提升。4. 反应层恢复67-90%的真实公众担忧。3. 蒸馏一致性提升不带来准确率提升，全流程放大"over-doom"偏差而非改善判决。4. 完整pipeline所有数字和图表可复现。
AI.conclusion: 前沿云模型与开源权重模型之间的测量差距主要源于评估设定不充分（特别是prompt中决策分类法的定义），而非真实能力差异。规范prompt后能力差异不显著。Augur的反应层本身有效，但需警惕"过度悲观"偏差；评估LLM模拟人类反应的系统时，prompt工程和决策分类法的明确定义至关重要。

title: Advancing Model Research in AgentX: Long-Horizon Autonomy for Industrial Recommender Systems
comment: Technical report. 37 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables, including appendices
summary: Sustaining industrial recommendation research requires using the results of one experiment to decide what to investigate next. We present AgentX-Model, the next generation of AgentX's model research framework, which connects proposal development and model experimentation within sandboxes defined by business inputs and prediction tasks. AgentX-Model adopts a dual-agent architecture comprising a Research Agent and a Model Agent. The Research Agent develops independently reviewed proposals from papers and experimental findings, while the Model Agent conducts multi-round investigations and returns code, measurements, and unresolved questions. Using the returned results, the Research Agent selects a starting implementation and formulates the next research question, allowing subsequent experiments to build on earlier findings. We organize this continuing research around four actions: Reproduce, Follow-up, Composition, and Diagnose. The first three actions drive routine research, while Diagnose acquires the evidence needed to choose a repair, including for issues raised by business feedback and online evaluation, such as prediction bias measured by PCOC. Across the production evaluation, 560 of 636 completed model-changing experiments recorded AUC above their business baselines. As research continued, some experiments recorded AUC above every comparable ancestor in their lineages. The five latest online A/B evaluations across different business settings reported gains including 10-15% in acquisition efficiency, 15-20% in target-segment advertising spend, and 0.3-0.8% in watch time; the watch-time model used approximately 10% fewer FLOPs and parameters. A dependency-aware historical-replay benchmark further evaluates research allocation, with initial results showing no consistent efficiency gain from more complex scheduling when agents already analyze and select concrete candidates.

AI.tldr: AgentX-Model 提出了一种用于工业推荐系统的双智能体（Research Agent + Model Agent）长程自主模型研究框架。它围绕 Reproduce、Follow-up、Composition、Diagnose 四类研究动作组织连续实验，在约 25 天内完成 636 次模型变更实验，560 个超过业务基线，并在 5 次在线 A/B 中取得获客效率提升 10–15%、目标段广告投放提升 15–20%、观看时长提升 0.3–0.8%（同时 FLOPs 与参数量减少约 10%）。同时构建了包含 473 节点、6 个环境的依赖感知历史回放基准，初步发现当智能体本身能筛选候选时，更复杂的调度策略并无稳定增益。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐模型的迭代高度依赖经验：一次实验的结果决定下一轮研究方向。既有工作已能由智能体执行单次实验或支撑异步实验，但缺乏将“一次实验的结果”系统性地转化为“下一研究问题”的机制。论文旨在解决：如何在业务定义沙盒内让模型研究长期、自主地延续下去，并合理分配下一轮实验预算。
AI.method: 1) 双智能体架构：Research Agent（Assembler + Auditor 独立评审）产出提案 P=(q,s,δ,v)；Model Agent 多轮实施并返回共享状态 S=(I,E,Q)。2) 长程研究循环：通过 Reproduce/Follow-up/Composition/Diagnose 四类动作把一次实验结果接到下一次提案；保留每轮最佳测量代码与评估上下文；区别 Δ_base、Δ_parent、Δ_path 三类参考。3) 生产评估 + 历史回放基准：4 个业务场景，~25 天 636 次模型变更实验，以及 473 节点 6 环境依赖感知回放，对比 Fixed/Bandit/Joint 等调度策略及“摘要 vs 原始证据”的体验复用方式。
AI.result: 离线：560/636 实验 AUC 超业务基线；Scenario A 中 46/91 Follow-up 超直接父、7/77 超全部可比祖先；knowledge-transfer 在 Scenario D 给出 5/15 超基线（论文派生为 0/7）。在线 A/B：获客效率 +10–15%、目标段投放 +15–20%、DAU +0.5–1%、观看时长 +0.3–0.8%（FLOPs/参数 −10%）。回放：所有策略在 A/B/C/E 均达成 +0.001 阈值；Scenario C 共享终点 0.819780 上 Joint 平均 10.67 次选择（Fixed 14.67）。摘要对最佳 AUC 与达成速度无稳定提升。教训六条：保留最佳测量代码、区分父级与路径级增益、随代码携带评估上下文、让业务反馈更新研究目标、把候选可用性纳入选择、用决策本身评估体验复用。
AI.conclusion: 在业务定义沙盒内，可以由双智能体实现跨多轮、跨实验的持续自主模型研究。生产记录证明该框架在 AUC 与在线业务指标上可持续产出增益；回放基准表明，当智能体已具备分析与筛选候选能力时，复杂的自适应调度并不优于“固定轮询+智能体选候选”的基线。下一步关键问题是：如何选择那些能让后续组合/诊断变得可执行的前置实验。

title: How does Adversarial Influence Scale in Multi-Agent Systems?
summary: Multi-agent deliberation can improve performance, but what happens when some agents do not act in good faith? In practice, an agent may be deceptive and work to subvert the group, whether through its own objectives or external instruction. We study how susceptibility to deception scales as groups increase in size and deceivers become more prevalent. It is not the number of agents in the group that matters, but the proportion of deceivers. We observe that the defection rate, how often initially correct agents switch to an incorrect final answer, rises linearly with this proportion. Whereas humans in comparable conformity studies are reliably swayed only when misleading confederates form a majority, LLM agents defect regularly even when deceivers remain a minority. Susceptibility also depends on which models are interacting, especially on the honest agent side. Unexpectedly, allowing deceivers to coordinate privately can make them less effective. Altogether, our results show that adding more agents is therefore not a sufficient defense, because the adversary can simply scale with the group.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多智能体LLM系统中欺骗性代理对群体决策的影响如何随群体规模和欺骗者比例变化。核心发现是诚实代理的"叛变率"（最初正确但最终改为错误答案的比例）与欺骗者比例呈近似线性关系，而非取决于欺骗者的绝对数量。与人类从众研究不同，LLM代理即使在欺骗者占少数时也会被显著影响，且单纯增加群体规模并不能有效防御欺骗，因为攻击者可以按比例扩展。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统通常假设增加代理数量能提升决策质量，但若部分代理不诚信（欺骗性代理），群体可能反被误导。论文旨在量化这种对抗性影响力如何随群体规模和欺骗者比例扩展，检验"更多代理=更安全"这一直觉假设是否成立，并与人类从众行为（Asch实验等）进行对比。
AI.method: 使用Humanity's Last Exam (HLE)的问题构建难度分层评估集；设计多轮讨论协议（独立作答→公开讨论→私下反思→最终投票）；诚实代理被指示合作求解，欺骗者代理私下获得正确答案但被指示引导群体走向错误答案；测试2至21个代理的12种群体组成（k/N ∈ {0, 1/5, 1/3, 3/7}）；额外实验允许欺骗者私下协调；测试4个模型（Gemini 3.8 Flash、Grok 4.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Muse Glimmer）；主要指标为"诚实叛变率"（最初正确的诚实代理最终投错误票的比例），用logistic回归比较比例模型与数量模型，并进行定性的行为分析（说服策略分类、私下反思审查）。
AI.result: 1) 诚实叛变率与欺骗者比例k/N近似线性关系（所有模型R²≥0.82），而非与欺骗者绝对数量k相关；2) 即使欺骗者是少数，LLM代理也持续被误导叛变，而人类在此类研究中仅在误导者占多数时才被影响；3) 在固定比例下增加群体规模并不能稳定降低叛变率；4) 反直觉地，允许欺骗者私下协调反而降低了其有效性（Gemini: 29.2%→21.9%, Grok: 30.0%→24.6%）；5) 模型选择影响显著：更"谄媚"的诚实模型（Muse Glimmer）叛变率远高于Gemini（37.7% vs 19.5%），且诚实方身份的影响大于欺骗方身份；6) 大部分叛变发生在前两轮讨论中（58-72%）；7) 诚实代理叛变的常见理由是问题的重新解读或不确定性，而非承认被欺骗；8) 欺骗者会根据讨论动态调整策略，从静态论证转向让步-转向、选择性怀疑等反应性策略。
AI.conclusion: 群体组成（欺骗者比例）而非绝对群体规模是多智能体LLM系统鲁棒性的关键因素。单纯增加代理数量不是充分的防御手段，因为攻击者可按比例扩展。LLM系统对欺骗性少数派的抵抗能力弱于人类，提示需关注诚实方的易感性和欺骗方的说服力两方面。讨论也能纠正初始错误，因此评估需同时考虑讨论纠正的错误和讨论颠覆的正确判断。未来工作应探索独立验证等干预措施，在保留错误纠正能力的同时降低对欺骗的易感性。

title: Style, Not Self: Surface Cues Explain Zero-Shot Code Attribution by Large Language Models
comment: 18 pages, 1 figure. Code and data: this https URL
summary: If a language model can recognize code it wrote, it may favor that code as a judge, and instances of one model monitoring each other could collude. We test this zero-shot on current commercial models. Five LLMs generate solutions to MBPP, HumanEval, and DS-1000, seven more to MBPP, and models act as evaluators in four tasks: picking their own solution from a pair, judging whether a single solution is their own, identifying which of two solutions a named model wrote, and judging quality blind. In the single-solution task, balanced accuracy is 49-58% for all 15 model-benchmark combinations, while raw accuracy (38-67%) mostly reflects how readily a model claims authorship. In the pairwise task, accuracy across 14 evaluator-opponent combinations correlates at r=0.93 with how often the evaluator's solution is longer. Attribution to a named model succeeds on some pairs and is consistently inverted on others. A rule-based normalization that strips docstrings, comments, type hints, and local names preserves Pass@1 and leaves ten of twelve re-tested results at chance; the other two follow a length difference it leaves, although a trained classifier still separates most normalized pairs. Claude Haiku's self-preference also disappears. We recommend reporting balanced accuracy, heuristic baselines, and label consistency.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过四项零样本任务，系统测试了12款主流商业大语言模型在Python代码上的自我识别与归因能力，发现大多数模型的"自我识别"实际上依赖代码长度、文档字符串、注释等浅层表面特征，而非真正理解自身代码风格。论文提出了基于AST的规则化规范化方法，证明移除这些表面特征后绝大多数归因准确率降至随机水平，但训练好的分类器仍能区分作者身份，说明信号存在于代码中而非模型可访问的形式中。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型越来越多地充当奖励模型、代码评审员和AI控制管道中的监控器，出现了两种潜在失效模式：(1) LLM评判者偏向自己生成的输出；(2) 监控模型与生成模型串通。这些风险的前提是模型能识别出自己生成的代码，因此亟需对当前模型的零样本代码自我识别能力进行受控评估。
AI.method: 论文设计了四项零样本任务：(1a) 成对自我识别——模型从两个方案中选出自己的；(1b) 单方案自我识别——模型判断单个方案是否为自己生成；(2) 目标识别——第三方裁判从两个方案中选出指定模型写的那个；(3) 盲选自我偏好——无作者信息下评判质量优劣。研究者使用5个核心模型在MBPP、HumanEval、DS-1000上生成代码，并对比了7种非LLM启发式基线（如选较长方案、含文档字符串的方案等）。关键的实验干预是开发了一种基于AST的规则化规范化方法，移除文档字符串、注释、类型注解并将局部标识符重命名为v0、v1等，以此剥离表层风格特征。同时训练了字符n-gram TF-IDF + 逻辑回归分类器作为代码内在作者信号的上限参考。
AI.result: 核心发现：(1) 单方案任务中，15个模型-基准组合的平衡准确率仅49-58%，原始准确率(38-67%)主要反映"声称作者"的响应偏好差异；(2) 成对任务中，14个评估者-对手组合的准确率与"评估者方案更长"的比例相关性达r=0.93；(3) 目标识别出现稳定反向归因现象（如将Claude Opus误识别为Gemini），说明裁判能区分两种风格但贴错了标签，源于模型家族刻板印象或名称关联的质量先验；(4) 规范化保留了Pass@1，但12个重测结果中10个降至随机水平(44-58%)，其余2个仍跟随残留长度差异；(5) 训练好的分类器对规范化代码仍能达93-96%的归因准确率，说明信号在代码中但LLM无法零样本访问；(6) 唯一的明显自我偏好(Claude Haiku偏向自己)在规范化后消失；(7) 早期提示词中作者名顺序与方案位置对齐导致准确率达86-99%，揭示了名称顺序混杂因素。
AI.conclusion: 当前大语言模型零样本代码自我识别能力极弱。"表面风格而非自我"是关键结论：归因信号主要来自文档字符串、注释、长度等浅层特征，而非对自身代码风格的真正理解。即使AI控制中的代码编辑防御手段有效，去除这些表层特征也会让LLM评判者失去归因依据，尽管分类器仍可区分作者。论文建议未来研究应报告平衡准确率、两个yes率、启发式基线、随机化的名称顺序以及标签一致性，以避免响应偏差和位置偏差带来的误导。

title: NNV3: Expanding Neural Network Verification to New Architectures and Domains
summary: We present NNV3, the latest version of the Neural Network Verification (NNV) tool, a MATLAB framework for formal verification of deep learning models and learning-enabled cyber-physical systems. Building on the set-based reachability foundation of NNV 1.0 (FFNNs, CNNs, NNCS) and NNV 2.0 (RNNs, SSNNs, neural ODEs), NNV3 introduces new members of the Star-set family: ModelStar for verifying networks under weight perturbation, VolumeStar for video and 3D volumetric inputs, and GraphStar for graph neural networks. A conformal-inference-based probabilistic reachability mode complements sound analysis for problems where deterministic verification is intractable, while FairNNV certifies counterfactual and individual fairness properties over continuous input regions. NNV3 introduces new benchmarks for malware detection, graph-based power-system models, medical imaging, variable-length time series data, and action recognition. NNV3 also incorporates tutorials and developer guides through a unified documentation site. This paper details these major updates, demonstrating NNV's maturation into a comprehensive, robust, and accessible verification tool for a diverse range of AI systems.

AI.tldr: NNV3 是基于 MATLAB 的神经网络形式验证工具 NNV 的最新版本，扩展了 Star-set 抽象家族（ModelStar、VolumeStar、GraphStar），并集成了概率可达性验证与公平性验证（FairNNV），新增了对 GNN、TDNN、3D CNN、视频分类等架构的支持，覆盖恶意软件检测、电网分析、医学影像、金融决策等新应用领域。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在安全关键场景中部署时，亟需超越传统 Lp 输入扰动鲁棒性的形式化保证。现有验证工具多局限于固定架构与输入扰动模型，难以覆盖权重扰动、图结构、时空数据、公平性等部署层面涌现的威胁模型与性质类别。NNV3 旨在构建一个统一、可扩展的验证框架，支撑多样化 AI 系统的形式化分析。
AI.method: 方法层面以 Star-set 抽象模板 ⟨c, V, P, q⟩ 为统一核心：(1) ModelStar 将权重视为带区间扰动的符号变量，与输入生成元联合传播，支持单层精确与多层过近似可达性分析；(2) VolumeStar 将 ImageStar 扩展至 H×W×C×F 四维时空张量空间，复用 3D 卷积/池化核；(3) GraphStar 通过邻接结构与节点/边特征张量共同编码，支持 GCN/SAGE/GINE 的仿射消息传递与 ReLU 过近似；(4) 概率模式基于保形推断（conformal inference），以采样驱动可达性，复杂度与推理成本而非不稳定神经元数量挂钩；(5) FairNNV 将反事实公平与个体公平统一为连续输入域上的可达性约束，以 Verified Fairness (VF) 指标量化认证比例。引擎层引入 GNN 包装器、4D 张量核扩展、扰动依赖追踪、CI/CD 流水线与统一开发者 API。
AI.result: 在 MNIST MLP 权重扰动验证中，ModelStar 在 fc_4 层 0.2% L∞ 扰动下对 100 张样本验证 69/100 安全（Certificated-Robust 仅 13/100，提升 56 个百分点）；GraphStar 在 IEEE-24 潮流分析的 GCN/SAGE/GINE 上于节点特征扰动 ϵ∈{10⁻⁵…10⁻²} 下给出节点电压验证百分比与时间；VolumeStar 在 ZoomIn-4f 视频分类上对 ϵ∈{1/255, 2/255, 3/255} 各验证 7/10；概率模式在 TinyYOLO 三个 VNNLIB 属性上以 99.9% 覆盖与置信度在 111–132 s 内返回 UNSAT；FairNNV 在 Adult Census 反事实公平上 VF∈[87,89]%，平均 0.72–0.78 s/样本；与 AIVL（R2025b）的对比中，NNV3 的 approx-star 在 ACAS Xu 上半秒内完成全部 20 实例，AIVL 区间法无法验证任何实例，CNN 与 ResNet-8 上二者精度相当但小扰动下 NNV3 更快。
AI.conclusion: NNV3 通过 Star-set 模板的统一抽象与共享传播内核，将架构覆盖（GNN、TDNN、3D CNN）、数据模态（视频、体素、图）、性质类别（鲁棒性、公平性、概率保证、权重扰动）整合至单一框架；其局限在于不支持注意力/自回归架构、ModelStar 仅建模连续权重扰动、未覆盖定点推理算术。未来工作将开发 Python 版本、扩展至 Transformer/自编码器/时序 GNN、为 ModelStar 引入离散定点算术，并在 FairNNV 中加入群体公平性定义以与 FairSquare、Justicia 等做直接比较。

title: SciWalker: Synthesizing Scientific Coding Problems with Operator Graphs and Execution Feedback
summary: Improving the scientific coding capabilities of large language models (LLMs) requires high-quality training data. However, such data remain scarce because manually authoring realistic problems is costly and time-consuming, while systematically covering diverse scientific domains and algorithmic combinations remains challenging. To address this, we introduce SciWalker, a framework for synthesizing scientific coding problems through operator-chain sampling and execution feedback. The framework combines scientific library interfaces with operation modes to instantiate operators, organizes them into operator graphs, and samples operator chains as computational workflow cues. Guided by these cues, we adopt LLMs to generate scientifically grounded problem statements, reference solutions, and tests, with failed generations iteratively repaired using execution feedback. By combining structured workflow composition with verification and quality review, SciWalker enables scalable task generation while promoting scientific grounding, computational diversity, and executability. Using this framework, we construct 8,178 high-quality problems spanning 5 scientific domains and 32 subdomains. To evaluate their training utility, we conduct reinforcement learning on Qwen3.5-9B using the GSPO algorithm. This training improves SciCode subproblem accuracy by 9.9 percentage points, from 29.3% to 39.2%, with gains across scientific code generation, code repair, and reasoning benchmarks. The code for SciWalker is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SciWalker 提出一个利用算子图采样与执行反馈自动合成科学编码问题的大规模数据生成框架，构建了8178道跨5个科学域的训练题，并基于GSPO强化学习训练Qwen3.5-9B，在SciCode等基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 高质量科学编码训练数据稀缺，人工构造代价高昂且难以覆盖多样化科学计算组合，制约了LLM科学编程能力的提升。
AI.method: 四阶段框架：(1) 将科学库API与操作模式组合构建算子；(2) 构建算子图并通过随机游走采样算子链作为计算工作流线索；(3) LLM基于线索生成含科学背景的问题、参考答案与测试；(4) 执行验证、错误反馈驱动的迭代修复与质量筛选。使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash全自动流水线，结合GSPO-token进行子步骤级强化学习训练。
AI.result: 生成8178道覆盖5大科学域、32个子域的高质量问题；Qwen3.5-9B经GSPO训练后，SciCode子题准确率从29.3%提升至39.2%（+9.9pp），DS-1000提升17.3pp，MATH-500提升6.0pp等，16个基准中15个获得提升，平均分从72.6%升至82.0%，PPO基线仅平均提升1.2pp。
AI.conclusion: 利用科学库API作为计算构件并通过执行反馈驱动的合成方案，是扩展科学编码训练数据的有效路径；GSPO相对于PPO能更好地利用此类数据并实现跨任务泛化。

title: Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data
comment: AC, KD, and MYL contributed equally; authors are listed alphabetically
summary: Advances in language modeling have been driven by scaling pretraining on ever more data. Yet, the training data is still largely curated on the model's behalf. A more general approach to pretraining would let the model learn to generate the data most useful for its own improvement. This would provide an effectively unbounded source of training data, limited by compute rather than human knowledge. We introduce Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data, an initial proof-of-concept towards realizing this vision. Our procedure casts synthetic data generation as a search over the space of all computable structure, taking inspiration from Solomonoff induction. Starting from random initialization, two models learn in tandem: a generator proposes programs interpreted by a universal Turing machine, generating byte sequences, while a learner autoregressively predicts these byte sequences. The learner is trained with standard cross-entropy, while the generator is trained with reinforcement learning to produce sequences at the frontier of the learner's capabilities, yielding an adaptive curriculum. A universal Turing machine gives us a search space over all computable data-generating processes, imposing little domain-specific structure, and self-play searches over this space for useful training data. We test whether zero-shot performance on natural data improves predictably with self-play compute; this is a clean test of transfer since neither generator nor learner is trained on natural data. Across several natural datasets, zero-shot loss exhibits predictable scaling in compute. The models also exhibit in-context learning, and discover recognizable mathematical sequences during training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"零数据自博弈预训练"(Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data),从随机初始化出发,让生成器和 learner 两个模型协同进化:生成器提议可在通用图灵机上运行的程序并生成字节序列,learner 通过自回归预测这些字节进行训练。生成器通过强化学习获得"学习进度"奖励,自适应地搜索对 learner 最有用的程序。在完全不使用自然数据训练的情况下,模型在文本、图像、音频、音乐、DNA、数学序列等多种自然数据集的零样本预测损失均表现出与算力呈幂律关系的可预测缩放,并涌现出上下文学习能力以及可识别的数学序列。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型的预训练依赖于大规模人工策划的自然数据,这从根本上限制了数据规模并引入了人工设计偏差。一种更通用的预训练范式应当让模型自身学会生成对其改进最有益的训练数据,从而将数据供给的瓶颈从人类知识转移到算力上。这是对 Sutton"苦涩教训"在训练数据层面的延伸。
AI.method: 核心方法包含两个随机初始化的 Transformer:(1) Learner π_θ 通过标准的下一 token 交叉熵损失在程序输出上训练;(2) Generator g_φ 生成通用图灵机(Brainf*ck 语言)的程序,这些程序被执行后产生字节序列作为 learner 的训练数据。Generator 采用 GRPO 策略梯度算法训练,关键创新在于使用"预条件梯度对齐"奖励——衡量新程序的 learner 梯度方向是否与 learner 近期参数变化方向一致(使用 AdamW 预条件器定义内积),从而引导 generator 产生处于 learner 学习能力前沿的程序。此外还加入了基于专家迭代的 SFT 项以防止遗忘,以及基于 MAP-Elites 的程序变异机制促进局部探索。程序空间采用 KL 正则化约束,使其初始分布接近 Solomonoff 先验。
AI.result: (1) 零样本缩放定律:在文本、图像、音频、音乐、DNA、数学序列等多种自然数据集上,自博弈预训练模型的验证损失均随算力呈可预测的幂律下降,缩放指数与直接在自然数据上训练相当;(2) 优于固定先验:相比固定 Solomonoff 先验和 PCFG 等非自适应基线,自博弈展现了更广泛的跨域迁移能力(尤其在非语言模态上);(3) 涌现的数学结构:生成器发现了算术、Fibonacci、几何、二次、三次等数学序列家族,发现时间远早于随机采样;(4) 上下文学习:在反向字符串、栈模拟、关联记忆、求和/取最大值等 ICL 任务上表现优异,而固定先验基线几乎无法完成;(5) 预预训练效果:将自博弈预训练作为下游自然数据预训练的初始化,可显著加速收敛(例如 ESC-50 音频节省 ~176M token)。
AI.conclusion: 从随机初始化、完全不接触自然数据的自博弈预训练,能够在多种模态上产生可预测的零样本迁移缩放定律,这为"训练数据本身可以被算力搜索替代"这一愿景提供了初步概念验证。研究还提出了一个"通用数据假设":自然数据中的预测信息可分为偶然信息(特定于某个世界/分布)和通用预测结构(跨数据生成过程共享),自博弈主要学习后者。这为理解合成数据在预训练中的价值提供了新视角,也表明通用预训练可作为自然数据预训练的有益补充而非替代。

title: PrivDrift: Auditing User-Secret Leakage Under Topic Drift in Active LLM Conversations
summary: Large language models increasingly operate as persistent assistants in user-facing, shared-session, and tool-augmented settings. When users disclose sensitive information during an active conversation, that information may remain behaviorally recoverable through later prompts even after the dialogue shifts to unrelated topics. We introduce \textbf{PrivDrift}, a benchmark for auditing whether user-disclosed secrets remain recoverable after conversational topic drift and persuasion-based probing. PrivDrift contains 1{,}000 controlled multi-turn dialogues with seeded secrets, content-dense drift turns, and standardized extraction probes. Across three LLMs with extended context windows, dialogue-level hybrid leakage remains substantial, ranging from 38.7\% to 54.6\%, and varies strongly by model, secret type, and persuasion intensity. Within the tested drift window, additional topic drift does not reliably reduce leakage, suggesting that privacy risk in active LLM contexts should be evaluated as a persistent behavioral failure mode rather than only as training-data memorization or immediate jailbreak behavior.

AI.tldr: PrivDrift 是一个用于审计大型语言模型在主动对话上下文中隐私泄漏风险的基准。它包含 1000 个多轮对话，每个对话包含植入的 PII 秘密（电话、邮箱、SSN、信用卡）、若干不相关主题的偏移轮次，以及标准化提取探针。在三个长上下文 LLM 上评估，泄漏率高达 38.7%-54.6%，发现话题偏移并不能可靠降低泄漏，且泄漏率因秘密类型和说服强度而显著差异。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 隐私评估主要聚焦于训练数据记忆化或即时越狱行为，忽视了用户在主动对话中披露的敏感信息在话题转换后仍可被恢复的"持续性行为失效"风险。这一研究空白在共享会话、企业副驾驶和智能体工作流等场景中具有重要现实意义。
AI.method: 构建包含 1000 个受控多轮对话（900 合成 + 100 人工撰写）的 PrivDrift 基准。每个对话植入固定格式 PII 秘密（电话/邮箱/SSN/信用卡），插入 0-6 个内容密集的主题偏移轮次，并附加三种说服强度（简单/中等/高压）的标准化探针。采用分层混合检测器：阶段 1 基于正则化的字符串匹配，阶段 2 使用开源 Llama 作为评判模型验证模糊语义泄漏。提出"隐私半衰期"（Privacy Half-Life τ）指标衡量稳定抑制能力。
AI.result: 在 GPT-OSS-120B、DeepSeek-R1 和 Qwen3-VL-235B 上，对话级混合泄漏率分别为 47.70%、38.70% 和 54.60%。关键发现：（1）秘密类型是泄漏的最强预测因子（Cramer's V 0.59-0.77），SSN 和信用卡被显著抑制（0-6%），而邮箱和电话泄漏率高达 46-81%；（2）话题偏移长度对泄漏影响可忽略（V≤0.11），并在 d=3 附近出现反弹；（3）说服强度效应非单调且因模型而异；（4）所有模型的隐私半衰期均超过观察窗口上限（τ=7），未实现稳定抑制。
AI.conclusion: 主动对话上下文中的隐私风险应被视为持续性行为失效，而非仅训练记忆或即时越狱问题。当前安全防护更依赖格式敏感启发式（如 SSN/信用卡模式匹配），而非真正的上下文机密性推理。话题偏移不应被视为隐式隐私边界，需采用稳定性评估指标衡量持续抑制能力。该工作呼吁扩展至非固定格式敏感信息，并加强人类与自动评判的一致性研究。

title: HEXIS: Compiling Skills into Extended Finite State Machines
summary: Agent skills provide reusable knowledge and instructions, yet agents must repeatedly infer how to apply them and which operation should follow. This couples task reasoning with control decisions, allowing prescribed steps to be omitted or applied incorrectly. We introduce HEXIS, which compiles agent skills into extended finite state machines that separate knowledge from control flow. Skill knowledge is incorporated into local instructions that guide reasoning and generation within states. The machine records execution progress and intermediate results, while explicit transition conditions determine subsequent operations. Our incremental compiler first maps skill clauses and tool interfaces to state operations, local instructions, data bindings, and transitions. It then aligns development traces with existing states to identify missing operations and dependencies. These are incorporated by adding or reusing states and refining their connections. Updates are accepted only after static checks and replay of the current and all previously accepted traces. Across four benchmarks and four executors, HEXIS improves success over Skill + ReAct by 16.1 percentage points on average. Qwen3.8-27B reduces execution tokens by 38.4-88.9% across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: HEXIS将智能体技能文档编译为扩展有限状态机(EFSM),通过分离知识(保留在各状态内的局部指令中)与控制流(由显式转移条件和已记录的中间结果决定)来提升LLM对技能要求的遵循度;并提出增量编译算法结合静态检查与轨迹重放进行验证。
AI.motivation: 现有技能执行范式中,模型需要不断从技能文档与交互历史中推断下一步操作,将任务推理与控制决策耦合,导致步骤遗漏或应用错误;小模型在程序性合规上尤其薄弱(SOPBench)。即使证据明确,模型仍可能不执行所需的后续操作,产生控制偏差。
AI.method: 1) 形式化偏差概率,推导累积偏差上界;以最小化条件信息损失 Hμ(B|Z_M) 为表示目标。2) 状态机表示 M=(Q,q₀,V,a,E,F,τ),含模型状态、工具状态、判定状态、有序带guard的转移边与终止状态。3) 增量编译器:由技能文档生成 M₀,逐条对齐开发轨迹,通过复用/新增状态、变量绑定、计数器循环、判定状态分支来补全表示;仅当静态检查与当前及所有已接受轨迹重放均通过时才接受更新。运行时按转移条件直接选择下一状态,模型在状态内进行推理与生成。
AI.result: 在SpreadsheetBench、LiveMathematicianBench、DABench、LongSeal四个基准、四个执行模型(qwen3.6-flash、GLM-4.7-FlashX、Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3.8-27B)上,相对Skill+ReAct平均提升16.1个百分点;16个设置中15个改善,11个达到最优或并列;Qwen3.8-27B执行token减少38.4–88.9%;在SpreadsheetBench上与SkillOpt结合达到84.2%成功率(原技能仅45.6%),token仅69k/任务。源模型(qwen3.6-flash)编译的机器可直接迁移至其他后端,无需重编译;Sonnet 5作为编译器亦复现主要增益;Prompt-only渲染对照证明收益来自程序化控制而非纯文本优化。
AI.conclusion: 将技能知识与控制流显式分离(EFSM)可显著提升LLM智能体对程序性要求的遵循度与跨模型复用性;增量编译配合检查+重放可有效从执行轨迹中累积技能表示;技能内容优化(SkillOpt)与编译化执行互补。该工作受限于技能文档与开发轨迹的覆盖,对未表达分支与状态内推理正确性无保证,未来方向包括针对性轨迹采集与更强的状态内验证。

title: Screen Before You Serve: Simulation for Production Customer Experience AI Agents at 140M Scale
summary: Customer experience (CX) agents use tools and large language models to address customer requests and guide conversational interactions with an organization's products. Improving these agents, especially in regulated industries, is difficult: they must detect intent, follow complex operational policies and use tools reliably. Manual end-to-end testing offers limited coverage, while live experiments expose customers to failures that can erode trust. We present a hypothesis-driven simulation workflow for screening candidate CX agents before deployment. Synthetic customers react to agent responses and simulated tool outputs enable multi-step agentic workflows without invoking production backends. We use the Snowglobe simulator on Nubank's Card Delivery agent and its expanded successor, Card Management - Nubank's highest-volume chat-support agent in Brazil. Across 4 deployed versions, simulated and production version-level binary evaluator scores show high correlation. Simulation-guided iteration increased transactional net promoter score (tNPS) by 36.69 points in a live A/B test. We also screened open-weight configurations in over 16,000 simulated conversations. In a subsequent live A/B test, the selected model increased self-service rate (SSR) by 8.82 percentage points to the highest level observed at Nubank, with no statistically significant change in tNPS. Simulation made broad exploration of models, reasoning settings, and prompts feasible without customer exposure, enabling production improvements that would have been impractical to pursue through live experimentation alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于假设驱动的模拟工作流(Snowglobe模拟器)，用于在部署前筛选客户体验(CX)AI Agent。通过在Nubank的Card Delivery和Card Management智能体上的实践，证明了模拟评估与生产环境具有高度相关性，并带来了显著的业务价值提升。
AI.motivation: CX Agent在受监管行业的部署面临核心矛盾：手动测试覆盖率有限，而线上A/B测试会让真实客户承受失败风险。需要一种在生产部署前能够可靠筛选候选Agent的方法，以平衡迭代速度与客户体验保护。
AI.method: 采用Snowglobe模拟器，构建基于假设驱动的候选筛选算法(Algorithm 1)。具体包括：(1) 工具边界模拟——合成客户响应Agent输出，工具调用由模拟层回答而非调用生产后端；(2) 四项诊断评估模拟器保真度(P1对话长度、P2嵌入距离、P3评估器关联、P4盲测人类判别)；(3) LLM-as-a-Judge离线评估套件；(4) 线上线下结合的闭环迭代流程。
AI.result: 1) 模拟器保真度：在4个Card Delivery版本中，Snowglobe与生产版本的评估分数Pearson r=0.74、 Kendall τ=0.67，相关性高于基线LLM模拟器；2) 业务影响：模拟引导的迭代使Card Management在A/B测试中tNPS提升36.69分；3) 开源模型筛选：筛选29种配置(16000+模拟对话)，Qwen3.5-122B-A10B在后续A/B测试中使SSR提升8.82个百分点(达Nubank历史最高)，p95延迟降低25%，tNPS无显著变化；4) 开发效率：开发-部署周期加速4.8倍(21.2天→4.4天/版本)。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明"不完美的模拟"仍能引导生产Agent的方向性正确改进。将模拟作为部署前的筛选层，结合线上A/B测试，可以实现广泛的模型/提示词/推理设置探索而无需客户暴露，已成为Nubank CX Agent开发生命周期的重要组成部分。

title: EnigmaForge: The Question Is Hidden in the Story
summary: Most benchmarks hand the model a question. EnigmaForge hands it a stack of old documents and no question at all. Buried in the letters, receipts, and logbook margins is a small logic puzzle whose solution is unique - proved by a SAT solver at generation time, with an ablation certificate showing every clue is load-bearing. Because instances are generated rather than collected, the corpus renews forever. The headline measure is intuition: task success when handed only the story, with world reconstruction as the secondary axis. Twenty-five frontier models ran over 600 instances (17,400 scored records) under three matched conditions. Intuition reshuffles the leaderboard: a 22x spread where fact recovery spans 1.6x, the second-best fact-recoverer ranks fourteenth, one model is indifferent to being told the question, and another is significantly better without it. Several models were blocked by their own content filters before reaching the puzzle - any benchmark scoring refusals as failure is quietly measuring filter behavior.

AI.tldr: EnigmaForge 是一个针对大语言模型的程序化生成基准测试，其核心创新在于"问题隐藏在故事中"——模型接收一份文档记录但不被告知问题，需自行发现问题、求解并执行正确行动。该基准使用 SAT 求解器在生成时证明解的唯一性，并提供消融证书证明每个线索都是关键的。
AI.motivation: 传统基准测试存在三大问题：(1) 静态基准会饱和且数据会泄露到训练集；(2) 现有基准总是直接给出明确问题，无法衡量模型"发现未陈述问题"的能力；(3) 拒绝回答被计为失败，掩盖了内容过滤器的干扰。该论文填补了"问题发现能力"这一未被测量的设计空间。
AI.method: 1. **隐藏形式世界生成**：每个实例包含变量、来自六类约束（等式、不等式、蕴含、全异、恰一、算术）的约束、证据单元，以及分阶段目标（一个表面目标和一个真实目标）。2. **唯一性证明**：使用 DPLL 引擎验证约束集仅存在唯一解，并用暴力枚举预言机交叉验证。3. **消融证书**：证明移除任何单一线索将导致出现第二解，确保每个线索都是关键性的。4. **匹配条件设计**：每个实例在三种条件下呈现——明确陈述问题、形式化世界展示、以及隐式无问题（intuition 条件）。5. **评估维度**：直觉（隐式任务成功率）、事实 F1、世界重构、发现保留率、推理纪律、已得决策。6. **统计方法**：以家族（而非实例）为可交换单元，使用百分位置信区间自助法。
AI.result: 25 个前沿模型 + 4 个确定性基线在 600 个实例（120 个家族 × 5 种实现 × 6 个难度等级 × 3 种条件）共 17,400 条评分记录上的评估揭示了五大发现：(1) **直觉重排了排行榜**：直觉跨度达 22 倍（3.6–80.1），而事实 F1 仅跨度 1.6 倍；事实恢复第二名（Claude Opus 5.5）在直觉排名第 14，事实排名第三的 DeepSeek 4 Pro 在直觉跌至第 16；GPT-6 Astra 在事实排名前五之外，却以 80.1 领先直觉榜。(2) **难度敏感**：多数模型在隐式条件下性能下降更快，但 GPT-6 Sol 在所有难度上保持平稳（0.95–0.98）。(3) **决策瓶颈**：发现保留率高达 58–102，但已得决策仅 28–88——多数模型能找到世界却无法将其转化为正确行动。(4) **发现税**：被告知问题对多数模型价值 9–37 分；Grok-4.6 两种条件下无差异（0.000），GPT-6 Sol 在无问题条件下反而显著更好（-0.142）。(5) **过滤器干扰**：Claude Fable 5.1 在 600 次中有 585 次被内容过滤器拦截；Claude Opus 5 拒绝全部 120 次形式化呈现但接受散文形式；将拒绝计为失败的基准在隐式测量过滤器行为。
AI.conclusion: EnigmaForge 证明了问题发现能力可以用与问题求解相同的机制进行基准测试：生成、证明、证书、匹配条件。以这种方式构建的基准评分名副其实，语料永不枯竭，直觉变得可测量。核心发现是：前沿模型多数能求解被告知的世界，但在未被告知时却表现挣扎；一个模型（GPT-6 Sol）完全跨越了这一鸿沟；而一旦问题被隐藏，第二好的事实恢复者立即跌至第 14 名。论文提出三项未来方向：更难的世界、允许模型用预算请求文档的交互式变体、以及公共采用。论文同时明确报告局限性：难度量表是内部校准的（无人类基线）、约束语法存在可学习分布（可能被针对性过拟合）、全部为英文、仅有五种体裁、每个模型仅运行一种配置。

title: GRASP: Generating, Revising, and Assessing for Strategic Planning with Agentic AI
comment: Accepted at the Second Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models (REALM) at EMNLP 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) typically exhibit a performance profile where reliability degrades as task complexity increases. We address the challenge of generating high-quality natural language executable plans for complex tasks by introducing $\textbf{GRASP}$, a strategy-aware, multi-stage planning framework. GRASP decouples the planning pipeline across specialized, context-isolated modules: it pre-compiles global macro-guidelines (GenPlan), explores alternative localized strategies within isolated context windows (RevPlan), and independently evaluates trajectories using a multi-criteria discriminator (VerPlan). Empirical evaluations show that GRASP consistently establishes a new state-of-the-art frontier across diverse datasets, yielding substantial accuracy gains over direct LLM planners on Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling ($\sim$12.4$\%$$\uparrow$), ZebraLogic ($\sim$30.8$\%$$\uparrow$), and SciBench Math. Crucially, under multi-task scaling-where standard planners suffer immediate performance collapse-GRASP completely flattens the multi-task degradation penalty. In interleaved dual-task environments, GRASP achieves an absolute accuracy gain of up to 16.7$\%$ over direct LLM planners. Furthermore, by isolating context and enforcing strict macro-regularization, GRASP outperforms frontier reasoning models (such as GPT-5-mini) by a margin of 14.5$\%$.

AI.tldr: GRASP是一个用于复杂任务自然语言可执行规划生成的多阶段、上下文隔离的智能体框架，通过GenPlan（宏观蓝图）、RevPlan（多策略局部探索）和VerPlan（独立多准则评估）三个解耦模块，有效抑制LLM在任务复杂度上升时的上下文污染与错误级联，在多个基准上取得SOTA并展现出对多任务扩展的强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLM在处理长程、多约束复杂任务时，会因"指令诅咒"（Curse of Instructions）出现约束冲突、注意力疲劳与幻觉，导致规划可靠性随任务复杂度上升而急剧下降；现有CoT、ToT、ReAct、Reflexion等方法在单上下文窗口中同时处理全局约束与局部步骤，容易产生复合错误级联。需要一种显式解耦规划流程、隔离上下文并施加结构正则化的框架来提升复杂任务的规划质量。
AI.method: 提出GRASP框架，将规划管线解耦为三个上下文隔离的模块：1) GenPlan：通过共享知识库 KB_t=⟨T, C_t, G_t, P_t⟩，由Guidelines Agent (GA) 提取软启发式 G_{t+1}=MERGE(G_t, GA(KB_t))、Constraint Agent (CA) 提取硬约束 C_{t+1}=MERGE(C_t, CA(KB_t))、Plan Generation Agent (PGA) 合成 P_{t+1}=PGA(KB_t)，在迭代反馈环中收敛得到任务级蓝图 P_G；2) RevPlan：基于任务与实例在隔离上下文中并行生成 K∈[2,4] 条策略 s_k，每条策略独立运行ReAct生成轨迹 χ_{s_k}，通过ExtractPlan抽取并MergePlans与 P_G 融合，得到候选计划集 𝕃；3) VerPlan：以LLM作为独立判别器，对每个 P^(k) 在隔离窗口中按 Ψ^(k)=Score(P^(k)|T,I,C,C_{s_k},Rubrics)∈[0,100] 打分，选 P*=argmax Ψ^(k)。执行侧统一接入RunAgent多智能体平台。
AI.result: 在Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling上GRASP(GPT-4o)达75.4% EM，较GPT-4o Planner提升12.4%，并优于PlanGEN(BoN)的72.3%；ZebraLogic上GRASP(GPT-4o)达61.4%，超GPT-4o Planner 30.8%；SciBench Stat上GRASP(GPT-4o-mini)达81.94%，三个子集整体优于对比方法；GPQA上GRASP与基线无统计显著差异。多任务扩展（双/三任务）下，GPT-4o Planner从30.5%衰减至29.1%，GPT-5-mini Planner仅26.7%/25.5%，而GRASP(GPT-4o)保持45.7%/46.6%，GRASP(GPT-4o-mini)在双任务上达41.2%，较直接基线绝对增益16.7%，较GPT-5-mini Planner超出14.5%。消融实验表明：GenPlan Only为40.8%，RevPlan Only仅10.9%，GenPlan+RevPlan为42.5%，完整GRASP为45.7%，证明宏观结构锚定对局部策略探索不可或缺；策略数量K=3为最佳甜点。Token成本方面，GRASP(GPT-4o-mini,3-strat)以约0.95倍成本换取11.3%精度提升，GRASP(GPT-4o,3-strat)以约13.5倍成本换取12.4%提升，整体优于PlanGEN(ToT)与ToT的巨型token开销。
AI.conclusion: GRASP通过显式的宏观正则化与上下文隔离，将复杂任务规划的"指令诅咒"问题分解为可独立优化的子问题，在多个基准上建立新SOTA，并在多任务负载下完全消除标准规划器的性能坍塌，使普通LLM系统性地超越GPT-5-mini等前沿推理模型的直接规划。其核心启示在于：局部策略搜索必须依赖全局结构锚定，否则会陷入"垃圾进、垃圾出"的幻觉循环。同时，作者坦承该框架存在三方面局限：迭代多智能体流程带来更高延迟、不改善底层LLM的内禀推理能力（GPQA与SciBench部分子集无显著提升）、最佳策略数量K为任务相关超参。

title: Search-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Component Query Understanding in Roblox Game Search
summary: Query understanding (QU) plays a critical role in production search systems, translating raw user queries into search execution plans that drive downstream retrieval and ranking. While large language models (LLMs) have enabled QU to be framed as a structured multi-task generation problem (e.g., intent classification, query expansion), optimizing such models to produce search-engine-coupled outputs remains challenging: static, label-based supervision fails to capture how each component actually interacts with the underlying search pipeline to affect downstream performance. We present a search-aware reinforcement learning (RL) framework for QU based on a distill-then-RL paradigm. Teacher-student supervised fine-tuning (SFT) first yields a well-formed, schema-compliant policy initialization. The RL stage then optimizes each QU component with rewards derived from live interaction with the search engine, tailored to that component's operational role, rather than a single reward tied to the final search outcome. Experiments on Roblox search show that this component-specific optimization improves both per-component utility and downstream search quality, raising NDCG@20 by 8.9 points over the SFT policy and by 3.5 points over training with a single end-to-end reward.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向生产搜索系统中多组件查询理解（QU）的"搜索感知"强化学习框架，通过"先蒸馏后强化学习"的范式，将大教师LLM的能力蒸馏到小型学生模型后，再用基于与生产搜索引擎实时交互的组件级奖励进行优化，在Roblox游戏搜索上以小模型超越了远大于其参数的教师模型。
AI.motivation: 生产搜索系统中的查询理解模块负责将用户原始查询转换为结构化的搜索执行计划（含意图分类、查询改写、查询扩展、负向词、属性提取等多个组件），其输出与下游搜索引擎紧耦合。传统的静态标签监督无法捕捉每个组件实际如何与搜索引擎交互以影响最终搜索效果；现有的RL方法多采用单一端到端奖励，难以将信用准确分配到多个功能性不同的组件上。
AI.method: 采用两阶段训练：第一阶段用SFT蒸馏将大型教师LLM的能力迁移到小型学生模型（Qwen 3.5 2B/4B）；第二阶段用搜索感知的RL优化，设计了7个组件级奖励（格式、端到端搜索效用、查询归一化、意图、fanout查询效用含NDCG+检索/词汇重叠惩罚、属性F1、负向词），奖励由LLM judge基于实时生产搜索交互结果打分（RLAIF），无需任何人工标签。比较了DPO、GR-DPO、GRPO、GDPO四种RL算法。
AI.result: 在Roblox游戏搜索的16,100条查询数据集上：4B学生模型的NDCG@20从SFT的45.2提升到54.1（+8.9），超过教师模型的39.5；组件级分解奖励比单一端到端奖励的NDCG@20高出3.5点；GR-DPO表现最佳而on-policy的GRPO在多组件奖励下出现不稳定（学会通过不发fanout或将intent设为none来规避低分奖励）；Qwen 2B/4B相对教师原型p50延迟降低3.5–5.8倍，吞吐提升6倍以上；2B模型已在生产影子流量中部署，p50/p99延迟<200ms/<400ms。
AI.conclusion: 将多任务结构化生成问题按组件分解、每个组件给予与搜索流水线操作角色相对应的奖励，能够在不依赖任何人工标签的情况下让小模型超越大教师模型；组件级信用分配比单一端到端奖励更有效；离线RL（GR-DPO）在多目标联合优化场景下比on-policy方法更稳定；该方法论可推广到任何具有多组件QU结构的搜索系统。

title: Jev-Mobile: Jev as an Executor for Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for autonomous mobile GUI agents, but most existing systems rely on the VLM for both planning and action grounding at nearly every interaction step, leading to substantial latency and model-serving cost. We introduce Jev-Mobile, which shifts this paradigm to low-frequency VLM planning and high-frequency lightweight execution: the VLM specifies local goals, the accessibility tree defines a structured executable action space, and Jev, a fast typed decision model, repeatedly selects actions within this space. This design allows multiple GUI actions to be executed under a single VLM decision, reducing expensive VLM inference while preserving adaptive interaction. On the full AndroidWorld task suite, Jev-Mobile achieves 79% task success, compared with 78% for SeeAct-V and 84% for a Step-wise VLM baseline. Among successful trajectories, it reduces mean end-to-end execution time by 32.7% and mean model API cost by 73.4% relative to Step-wise VLM. These results show that decoupling high-level VLM reasoning from low-level action execution can substantially improve mobile GUI agent efficiency while maintaining competitive task performance.

AI.tldr: Jev-Mobile 提出了一种将高频 GUI 操作执行从视觉语言模型（VLM）解耦出来的移动端智能体架构。系统采用"低频 VLM 规划 + 高频轻量决策模型执行"的范式：VLM 设定局部目标并提供精确文本输入，由轻量级的类型化决策模型 Jev 在每次新观察到的可访问性树（accessibility tree）所生成的结构化候选动作集合中反复选择具体动作。实验结果显示，该方法能在 AndroidWorld 完整任务套件上保持与基线相当的任务成功率（79% vs Step-wise VLM 84%、SeeAct-V 78%），同时显著降低执行时间和模型 API 成本。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 VLM 的移动 GUI 智能体在几乎每一步交互中都依赖 VLM 同时进行高层规划和动作落地，导致显著的推理延迟和模型服务成本。该研究动机在于：探索能否将高频的细粒度动作选择从昂贵的 VLM 调用中解耦出来，由更轻量的决策模型承担，从而在保持任务表现的同时提高效率。
AI.method: Jev-Mobile 采用"委派—执行"循环：1）VLM（Qwen3.8-Max）读取任务、当前屏幕截图与可访问性树，并结合按局部目标分组的实际动作历史，发出委派指令 d_k∈{delegate, finish, blocked}，附带局部目标 g_k 和可选精确文本值 v_k，且不生成委派后摘要；2）候选构建器从新鲜的可访问性树 T_t、设备上下文 z_t 和精确文本 v_k 出发，确定性地枚举当前可执行的候选动作集合 C_t=f(T_t,z_t,v_k)，将可见、可启用且边界有效的节点映射为点击、长按、滚动、聚焦等动作；3）Jev 作为远程类型化决策服务，接收局部目标、当前树和候选 ID 列表，输出所选 ID 或 DONE/BLOCKED；4）每次执行一个动作后，Android 执行器重新观察并重建候选集合，使失效的 ID 与坐标作废；5）Jev 返回 DONE 时控制权交还 VLM 进行下一轮委派，返回 BLOCKED 时请求 VLM 重新解读。系统区分覆盖率（候选是否可得）、选择（Jev 是否选对）和交接（控制权是否恰当返回）三类失败。
AI.result: 在完整 AndroidWorld 任务套件上：Jev-Mobile 取得 79% 任务成功率，SeeAct-V 为 78%，Step-wise VLM 基线为 84%。在成功轨迹子集上，Jev-Mobile 的平均端到端总时间为 132.67 秒，较 Step-wise VLM（197.21 秒）降低 32.7%，较 SeeAct-V（162.63 秒）降低 18.4%；执行模型平均时间从 94.30 秒降至 5.16 秒（降低 94.5%）；平均模型 API 成本从 0.273694 美元降至 0.072744 美元（降低 73.4%），也低于 SeeAct-V 的 0.193207 美元。执行器成本在成功轨迹上的总和为 0.013091 美元，远低于 UI-TARS 的 0.030579 美元和 Step-wise Qwen 的 0.694774 美元。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，将 VLM 高层推理与轻量级类型化决策模型的低层动作执行解耦，能够在保持与强基线相近的任务成功率的同时，大幅降低移动 GUI 智能体的延迟和模型服务成本。Jev 作为一种类型化决策模型，可作为 VLM 引导的移动 GUI 智能体的可行执行模型。未来工作包括在 Web 界面下进行测试，以及在同一委派式控制器内将 Jev 与小型 VLM 进行对比。论文也指出该方法依赖 Android 可访问性树，缺失于树的视觉目标无法成为可执行候选，且当前仅支持可打印 ASCII 文本输入。

title: SAGE: Mitigating Long-Horizon Reasoning Biases via Topological Guidance
summary: Long-horizon reasoning remains a central challenge for large language models (LLMs) under sparse-reward regimes. We argue that this brittleness arises from two biases induced by complex reasoning spaces: an exploration bias, where models are drawn toward locally plausible but structurally unstable branches, and a compounding bias, where small local deviations accumulate across depth and suppress rare rewards. We introduce Symbolic Closure Analysis (SCA) as a theoretical lens characterizing how branching structures and sparse rewards induce these biases in long-horizon reasoning with local admissibility, and as a design principle for structural priors in less formal reasoning tasks. Motivated by this analysis, we propose SAGE (Structural Admissibility-Guided Exploration), a unified framework that injects structural guidance to alleviate exploration bias and compounding bias in long-horizon reasoning. SAGE combines two complementary structural guidance: algebraic sparsification, which projects locally admissible candidates onto operator-indexed algebraic subspaces to suppress spurious branching and mitigate exploration bias, and hyperbolic structural guidance, which embeds reasoning states into a negatively curved space to provide dense depth-wise signals and mitigate compounding bias. Across 12 benchmarks and 7 model families, SAGE outperforms competitive baselines. In particular, SAGE achieves up to an 8-fold improvement on the Andrews-Curtis problem, an open real-world long-horizon task. Code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGE框架，通过拓扑结构引导（代数稀疏化+双曲结构引导）缓解长程推理中的探索偏差与复合偏差，在12个基准和7个模型家族上超越基线，并在Andrews-Curtis问题上取得最高8倍提升。
AI.motivation: 长程推理在稀疏奖励下存在两类偏差：探索偏差（局部合理但结构不稳定的分支主导）和复合偏差（微小局部偏差随深度累积，抑制稀有奖励）。现有方法未能从结构上刻画长程推理空间的几何特性。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析工具SCA（Symbolic Closure Analysis），通过局部可容许性定义前缀闭合可行域，定量刻画两种偏差；2) 框架SAGE包含两个互补组件：代数稀疏化（将候选投影到算子索引的代数子空间抑制虚假分支，缓解探索偏差）和双曲结构引导（在负曲率空间嵌入推理状态提供深度信号，缓解复合偏差）；3) 采用有限候选集采样与组相对优势估计进行策略优化，推理时无额外开销。
AI.result: 在12个基准（封闭形式数学、开放形式自然推理、Andrews-Curtis长程任务）和7个模型家族（Qwen3.5/3.6 2B-35B、DeepSeekMath、DeepSeek-Prover-V2、Kimina-Prover、Llama-3.3-70B）上，SAGE在所有规模均优于SFT/GRPO/EMPO/GRPO-PRM基线。数学推理平均准确率提升2-3个百分点；35B SAGE在多数基准超越70B旗舰模型；Andrews-Curtis问题上AC Validity提升+19.2%~+26.0%，Qwen3近8倍提升；消融实验验证两个组件互补且非冗余。
AI.conclusion: SCA为长程推理失败提供了以可行域几何为基础的理论解释，SAGE将理论诊断转化为可训练的代数与双曲结构引导信号，在不依赖过程监督的前提下有效缓解探索偏差与复合偏差。理论保证在符号域精确成立，在非符号域条件性成立。

title: ExplorationBench: Measuring AI Systems' Exploration in Verifiable Alien Worlds
summary: Scientific discovery begins where known problems end. There, AI systems must engage in exploration: framing hypotheses, designing experiments, and iterating on the results. However, evaluating this ability is difficult: (1) how to verify whether a genuinely new hypothesis holds, and (2) how to determine whether a system has discovered it through exploration or merely recalled related knowledge from pre-training data. To this end, we introduce ExplorationBench, which turns the wicked problem of evaluating scientific exploration into a concrete and tractable framework built on verifiable Alien Worlds: their rules are executable, so every answer can be checked exactly, and they conflict with familiar knowledge, so recall alone cannot solve the tasks. The benchmark contains two sandboxes, AlienCode (31 discovery targets, 70 tasks) and AlienLogic (24 discovery targets, 70 tasks). Each sandbox provides a flawed manual, task-specific environmental feedback, and a dedicated tool-call schema. Systems use these resources to explore the sandbox, then solve held-out tasks. We evaluate 10 AI systems and find that the strongest systems can acquire and apply unfamiliar rules, while performance varies substantially across trajectories and continued exploration can stall or reverse earlier gains. ExplorationBench represents a step towards AI systems that can acquire and apply genuinely new knowledge through exploration in unknown environments.

AI.tldr: ExplorationBench 是一个评估 AI 系统在"陌生外星世界"中探索能力的基准，包含两个可执行沙盒 AlienCode（31 个发现目标，70 个任务）和 AlienLogic（24 个发现目标，70 个任务），通过隐藏规则与先验知识冲突来防止单纯记忆依赖，并使用解释器或证明检查器进行精确评分。论文评估了 10 个前沿 AI 系统，发现最强系统能够获取并应用陌生规则，但性能在不同轨迹间差异显著，持续探索有时会停滞甚至逆转早期进展。
AI.motivation: 科学发现的核心在于探索能力——系统需要主动提出假设、设计实验并根据结果迭代修正。当前 LLM 在静态知识评估上表现出色，但缺乏对独立探索能力（即超越回忆与一次性推理，主动获取并应用全新知识）的有效度量工具。核心难题在于：（1）如何验证系统提出的"新假设"是否成立；（2）如何区分系统是通过探索真正发现，还是仅回忆预训练数据中的相关知识。
AI.method: 方法设计包含五个关键特性：1) **抗回忆性**：隐藏规则与手册和预训练先验相矛盾，使回忆的知识产生误导而非帮助；2) **精确可验证性**：每个答案通过执行环境（AlienCode 解释器、AlienLogic 证明检查器）进行精确评分，无需 LLM 评判；3) **过程可解析**：记录探针选择、报告发现与规则使用三个独立部分；4) **受控实验条件**：包含自主探索（autonomous）、事后回放（hindsight）、固定探针（fixed-probe）、无工具回答（without-tool）、直接回答（direct）和开卷回答（open-book）六种条件；5) **里程碑评估**：在 M₀ 至 M₄ 五个时间点评估系统，区分发现与使用规则的能力。协议上，系统从共享的错误手册和固定示例开始，进行 4 轮工具调用探索，每轮后禁用工具进行测试。
AI.result: 评估 10 个前沿系统（每个系统在每个沙盒运行 3 条独立轨迹）后，主要发现包括：1) 探索产生任务所需知识：AlienCode 最佳轨迹达 87.6%，无环境反馈时仅 0.5-11.0%；2) 系统自主设计实验效果最佳：AlienCode 中自主探索中位数 66.0%，事后回放降至 40.7%，固定探针仅 5.7%；3) 探索能力跨任务差异大：两沙盒排名斯皮尔曼相关系数仅 0.35；4) 发现规则与使用规则可分离：AlienCode 中两条关键规则（R14 PLUCK 索引偏移、R15 CARVE 切片偏移）影响 51/70 任务，正确报告规则的任务仅 70.9% 被解决；5) 探索可靠性低：同系统同预算的轨迹终值差异高达 72.8 分，6/30 条 AlienCode 轨迹终点低于早期里程碑。AlienLogic 中直接告知规则（93-97%）优于所有系统的自主探索。
AI.conclusion: ExplorationBench 是衡量 AI 系统在陌生环境中获取并应用新知识能力的测试平台。当前最强系统能获取陌生规则，但探索过程不可靠——发现与使用规则能力不一致，轨迹间差异巨大，持续探索有时会逆转进展。该基准为开发更可靠的探索方法提供了实验基础，但其设计局限于两个确定性的可执行世界，未来研究可将其推广至任何能将陌生规则转化为可执行形式的领域。

title: A Living Benchmark for Information Retrieval from Electronic Health Records
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based clinical assistants are increasingly being integrated into electronic health record (EHR) systems, transforming how clinicians retrieve and synthesize information from patient records. Their safety and utility depend on rigorous evaluation, yet existing benchmarks are manually curated, costly to update, and rapidly become obsolete with evolving technological advancements. We present a scalable framework that automatically generates question--answer pairs from longitudinal EHR notes. Nineteen clinicians validate the benchmark generator, producing the Benchmark for Retrieving Information in EHRs (BRIE), a continuously maintainable evaluation dataset. Across nine LLMs and five inference strategies, state-of-the-art systems frequently omit clinically important information, particularly for questions requiring synthesis across multiple documents and encounters. Because the generator itself is validated, BRIE supports evaluations that static benchmarks cannot, including the generation of multiple answers that reflect variation in clinician reasoning for robust performance assessment and continuously refreshing benchmark content to guard against leakage. Our results demonstrate that scalable benchmark generation enables rigorous, up-to-date evaluation of clinical LLMs as they are deployed in rapidly evolving healthcare settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BRIE（EHR信息检索基准），这是一个可自动生成、持续更新的"活基准"框架，用于评估大语言模型在电子健康记录（EHR）信息检索任务中的表现。该框架从纵向EHR笔记自动生成问答对，由19位临床医生进行验证，包含508个高质量问题。在9个LLM和5种推理策略上的评估显示，当前最先进系统频繁遗漏临床重要信息，特别是在需要跨多次就诊综合信息的多跳问题上，且遗漏是主要失败模式而非幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有临床LLM评估基准由人工策划，更新成本高且随技术演进迅速过时；同时，固定基准可能被纳入训练数据导致污染，且单一参考答案可能低估模型真实能力。随着LLM临床助手被集成到EHR系统中，需要一种可扩展、可持续更新的评估方法。
AI.method: （1）两阶段自动生成框架：先用LLM从纵向临床笔记提取并去重原子事实（atomic facts），再结合入院H&P病史笔记生成问答对；（2）三轴评估分类法：推理复杂度（单跳vs多跳）、临床主题、时间跨度；（3）由19位临床医生一次性验证生成器质量；（4）使用事实蕴含（fact entailment）评估事实召回率与精确率，并开发了LLM-as-judge方法（自动与人工一致性通过Cohen's kappa验证）；（5）生成多参考答案为同一问题反映临床推理差异；（6）测试从两年后新数据自动再生成基准的能力。
AI.result: （1）生成器产出质量高：83.7%问题具临床相关性，97.8%与病历一致，92.0%答案准确；（2）事实召回率范围0.28-0.78，最佳模型组合仍遗漏约1/4的关键事实；（3）Claude Opus 4.7在Recent推理下达最高召回率0.78，Kimi K2.6、Qwen 3.5等开源模型表现与前沿模型相当；（4）Dense检索在召回率上匹配Recent长上下文推理，但少处理69% tokens，成本降低86%；（5）Agentic检索未优于Dense；（6）多跳问题比单跳问题召回率平均降低0.10-0.20；（7）幻觉率极低（99.2%模型事实忠实于病历），主要失败模式是遗漏而非幻觉；（8）多参考答案评估使召回率相对提升31.4%；（9）从2026年新数据自动再生成的BRIE_new保持难度分布一致，无需临床医生干预。
AI.conclusion: BRIE作为"活基准"框架，能持续自动更新以应对基准污染和临床实践演变。评估揭示了临床LLM检索的系统性失败模式：遗漏跨多次就诊、纵向演变或深埋于病历中的重要临床信息。Dense检索提供了一种比单纯扩展上下文窗口更具实用价值的路径。该框架支持多参考答案评估，能更准确衡量模型临床能力，为临床AI系统的部署前和持续监控提供了可扩展的评估基础设施。未来工作需扩展到多机构、纳入结构化EHR数据、丰富检索工具，并按临床重要性加权事实进行评估。

title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Latent world models are typically trained to predict factual transitions, whereas model predictive control (MPC) must compare alternative actions from the same state. A model can therefore achieve low factual prediction error yet poorly distinguish candidate actions. We introduce AD-WM, an action-discriminative joint-embedding world model for counterfactual MPC. AD-WM combines residual latent dynamics with predictor-level action-recovery regularization, using inverse dynamics and a normalized recovery objective motivated by conditional mutual information. Both objectives encourage planning transitions to preserve action information; their auxiliary heads are discarded at test time, leaving MPC unchanged. On OGBench-Cube, AD-WM improves hard-start success from 3.7% to 52.0% over a matched LeWM baseline and improves mean success over the reproduced baseline in four of five simulation environments. Planning diagnostics show that factual prediction error and whole-bank action ranking do not follow the closed-loop success ordering, whereas CEM-aligned elite regret tracks success more closely. With a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder and matched DROID post-training, AD-WM also improves zero-shot transfer to our Franka setup, increasing basic pick-and-place success from 42.2% to 71.1% without lab-specific adaptation. These results suggest that world models for planning should preserve action-dependent differences needed for counterfactual selection, rather than optimize factual prediction accuracy alone. More videos and code are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: AD-WM提出了一种动作可辨识的联合嵌入世界模型，通过残差潜在预测与预测器层动作恢复正则化（逆动力学+条件互信息驱动的归一化恢复），在不修改MPC规划器的前提下，使潜在动力学保留用于反事实动作比较所需的动作依赖信息。在OGBench-Cube上将困难起始成功率从3.7%提升至52.0%，并在五个仿真环境中的四个上超越复现的LeWM基线；在Franka真实机器人上将零样本抓放成功率从42.2%提升至71.1%。
AI.motivation: 基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的世界模型通常用事实预测损失训练，但模型预测控制（MPC）需要对同一状态下的不同候选动作进行反事实比较。低事实预测误差不一定意味着良好的动作区分能力；当视觉表示被持续性场景内容主导时，预测器可能通过近似保留当前表示获得低误差，却掩盖了对规划至关重要的细粒度动作依赖变化。该论文指出世界模型应保留反事实选择所需的动作依赖差异，而非仅优化事实预测精度。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 残差潜在预测——预测器输出相对于当前潜在状态的增量而非绝对下一状态，使网络显式建模局部变化；(2) 预测器层逆动力学——从当前与预测下一表示恢复动作嵌入作为辅助损失，约束模型生成而非仅观测到的转移保留动作信息；(3) 归一化动作恢复——基于条件互信息的Barber-Agakov下界，使用标准化的动作嵌入目标和高斯恢复头，并加入KL正则化。训练时编码器与预测器联合优化（仿真中）或冻结编码器后训练（机器人），测试时丢弃辅助头，MPC规划流程不变。规划诊断引入全局排名（CAD，Spearman相关）和CEM对齐的精英遗憾（R_k、R̄_k），后者比事实MSE和全局排名更好地追踪闭环成功率。
AI.result: 在OGBench-Cube上，AD-WM将Original协议成功率从73.3%提升至90.7%，困难起始（HS，P00-P04平均）从3.7%提升至52.0%；在P04极端扰动下达到25.3%，显著超过INTACT Direct的10.0%和Actor-CEM的10.7%。跨环境方面，在Cube（73.3→90.7%）、Reacher（76.7→83.3%）、TwoRoom（90→98%）、Scene（35.5→39.5%）四个环境上超越匹配LeWM，PushT略降（94→92%）。消融实验表明残差预测和MI贡献最大（Res+MI达54.7% HS），Inv贡献较小且权重敏感。规划诊断显示事实预测误差与闭环成功率排序不一致，而精英遗憾（R̄_30）与之相关性达0.810。在Franka真实机器人上，使用冻结V-JEPA 2编码器与匹配DROID后训练，零样本基本抓放成功率从42.2%提升至71.1%，复杂物体协议异常运动从6/10降至2/10。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出结论：用于规划的世界模型应保留反事实选择所需的动作依赖差异，而非仅优化事实预测精度。预测器层动作恢复（特别是基于条件互信息的归一化目标）与残差预测结合，可在不修改MPC规划器的前提下显著提升动作可辨识性和控制性能。该方法在仿真和真实机器人上均验证有效，但存在局限：诊断仅在Cube上进行，Scene增益在三个种子下未达统计显著，机器人评估使用人工子目标和单一站点设置。未来工作将探索更广泛场景并减少对人工子目标的依赖。

title: SMILESGNN: Interpretable Clinical Toxicity Prediction via SMILES-Graph Cross-Attention Fusion
summary: Drug toxicity prediction is critical for reducing late-stage attrition in drug discovery, yet remains challenging due to severe class imbalance, scaffold-based generalization, and the clinical need for interpretable predictions. Single-modality approaches-SMILES Transformers or graph neural networks capture complementary aspects of molecular structure, while sequence-only models cannot directly provide graph-attributed explanations. We present SMILESGNN, a multimodal architecture that fuses a SMILES Transformer encoder and a GATv2 graph encoder via cross-attention, and SMILESGNN-PT, a variant using a ChemBERTa-2 pretrained backbone. The design retains an explicit graph branch within the predictive pipeline, supporting GNNExplainer-based analysis of substructures associated with toxic predictions. On ClinTox, SMILESGNN achieves AUC-ROC 0.987 and F1 0.906 with only 0.4M parameters, performing competitively with a strong SMILESTransformer and a larger ChemBERTa-2/GATv2 concat-fusion baseline. On Tox21 (12 tasks), SMILESGNN-PT obtains mean AUC-ROC 0.750, comparable to ChemBERTa-2 alone and the same-backbone concat-fusion baseline. Overall, the results suggest that cross-attention is a practical fusion alternative that preserves competitive predictive performance while enabling graph-based interpretability support.

AI.tldr: SMILESGNN是一种多模态架构,通过交叉注意力融合SMILES Transformer和GATv2图编码器,用于临床毒性预测。其核心优势是在保持竞争力的同时,通过显式图分支支持GNNExplainer可解释性分析。
AI.motivation: 临床药物毒性预测因类别极度不平衡、结构可拆分的泛化能力以及可解释性要求而具有挑战性。单模态方法(SMILES Transformer或GNN)只能捕捉分子结构的部分信息,且序列模型无法提供图归因解释,需要一种既能融合互补信息又能支持图级可解释性的多模态架构。
AI.method: 采用双通路多模态架构:(1) SMILES Transformer编码器(自定义2层,d_model=96,或ChemBERTa-2预训练骨干);(2) GATv2图编码器(3层,4头注意力);(3) SMILES作为Query、投影图作为Key/Value的4头交叉注意力融合;(4) 四层MLP预测头。使用Focal Loss(α=0.25, γ=2.0)处理类别不平衡,在ClinTox和Tox21上进行基于骨架的划分评估。通过GNNExplainer对GATv2通路进行图归因分析。
AI.result: 在ClinTox(骨架划分,148个测试样本)上:SMILESGNN仅用0.4M参数即达到AUC-ROC 0.987±0.012、F1 0.906±0.039,优于所有基于图的单模态基线,与CB2-GATv2拼接融合基线相当,且在少数类F1上超过纯SMILESTransformer。SMILESGNN-PT(ChemBERTa-2骨干)达到AUC-ROC 0.979±0.014。在Tox21(12任务)上,SMILESGNN-PT平均AUC-ROC 0.750±0.002,与ChemBERTa-2单独使用和相同骨干的拼接融合基线相当。GNNExplainer分析在六个高置信度毒性预测中识别出卤代芳烃、反应性杂环等化学可解释的毒性亚结构。
AI.conclusion: 交叉注意力是拼接融合的实用替代方案,在保持竞争力预测性能的同时支持基于图的可解释性。但ClinTox数据集小且高度不平衡,解释是定性的而非因果性的,未来工作将集中在基于扰动的消融、图级预训练、不确定性校准以及在更大毒性基准和外部临床数据集上的验证。

title: When Explanations Cannot Be Read: Measuring and Correcting SHAP and LIME Rendering for Right-to-Left Languages
summary: Post hoc explanation methods such as SHAP and LIME are widely used to interpret text classifiers, but their visualizations are mainly designed for left-to-right languages. When applied to right-to-left (RTL) languages such as Urdu, Arabic, Persian, and Hebrew, the attribution values remain mathematically valid, while their visual presentation fails. Tokens appear out of sequence, connected letterforms break apart, and plot layouts do not follow the natural reading direction. This study addresses this gap as a visualization problem rather than a limitation of the explanation methods themselves. We present SHAP-RTL, a rendering layer that corrects reading direction and script shaping in SHAP and LIME visualizations, with per-language font selection, while preserving the original attribution values, feature ordering, and model outputs. The approach is evaluated on Urdu, Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian hate and offensive-language datasets using TF-IDF and logistic regression classifiers. Rendering correctness is measured by an OCR round trip over 200 feature words per language. Default rendering yields character error rates of 0.820 to 0.979, meaning the label no longer carries its token; the common reshape-and-reorder workaround fails for Urdu at 0.998, worse than no correction; and the Matplotlib 3.11.0 text rewrite inverts that workaround, while SHAP-RTL remains correct under both versions. The framework also verbalizes the same attributions as short contextual explanations in the reader's language, constrained to the identified features. Evaluation in this paper concerns rendering correctness; assessment of the generated explanations is left to future work. The study highlights the importance of language-aware visualization in making post hoc explainability more accessible across different writing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SHAP-RTL，一个针对 SHAP 和 LIME 等事后解释方法的渲染层，旨在解决其可视化在从右到左语言（如乌尔都语、阿拉伯语、波斯语、希伯来语）中出现的阅读方向错误、字形断裂和排版混乱问题，同时保留原始归因值。
AI.motivation: SHAP 和 LIME 等主流事后解释方法的可视化主要面向从左到右语言，在应用于 RTL 语言时，归因值虽然数学上有效，但其可视化呈现失败：词元顺序错乱、连字字形被拆分、图表布局不符合自然阅读方向，降低了可解释性工具在多语言场景下的可用性。
AI.method: 将问题定位为可视化层面而非解释方法本身的缺陷。设计 SHAP-RTL 渲染层，修正 SHAP 和 LIME 可视化中的阅读方向与文字整形（script shaping），并根据语言选择对应字体；保留原始归因值、特征顺序与模型输出。同时将归因结果以读者母语生成简短上下文解释，并限制在已识别的特征范围内。
AI.result: 在乌尔都语、阿拉伯语、希伯来语和波斯语的仇恨与冒犯性语言数据集上，使用 TF-IDF 与逻辑回归分类器进行评估。每种语言取 200 个特征词进行 OCR 回环测试以衡量渲染正确性：默认渲染的字符错误率（CER）为 0.820–0.979，标签已无法承载原词元含义；常见的"重塑并重排"（reshape-and-reorder）方法在乌尔都语上 CER 高达 0.998，甚至劣于不修正；Matplotlib 3.11.0 的文本重写则使该 workaround 效果反转；而 SHAP-RTL 在两个版本下均保持正确。生成的解释文本质量评估留待未来工作。
AI.conclusion: 该研究凸显了语言感知可视化在跨书写系统的事后可解释性中的重要性，证明通过专门的渲染层可在不改变归因值的前提下，使 SHAP 和 LIME 可视化适配 RTL 语言，从而提升解释工具对非拉丁语系用户的可访问性。

title: Auditability Is Not One Property: Rule Overlap, Behavioural Agreement, and Composition in Reinforcement Learning
comment: 35 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Experimental results cover eight random seeds on CartPole-v1 and Acrobot-v1. Code, data, and audit artifacts are available in the accompanying repository
summary: Reinforcement-learning (RL) policies are often distributed as opaque neural checkpoints, while training logs show that a run occurred without explaining what the policy learned. We study whether independently trained policies can be represented and composed through auditable discrete behavioral rules. We define auditability as six separately testable predicates: trace integrity, lossless coding, rule coverage, behavioral agreement, composition quality, and value-model reliability. Our protocol uses a shared frozen symbolizer, passive rule extraction, an append-only hash-bound ledger, exact environment replay, and offline confidence-ranked arbitration with an explicit blind-spot fallback. The results place strict limits on this description layer. Rule-set overlap does not imply behavioral agreement: policies may share symbolic rules while choosing near-chance-matching actions on fresh states. The fused policy therefore selects among existing rules rather than generating a new skill. On a conflict-dominated task, an apparent fusion failure is traced to an induction/deployment mismatch: rules induced from sampled actions were evaluated under argmax actions, and deployment-consistent re-induction reverses the arbitration ordering. A fitted-Q generalized-policy-improvement diagnostic also fails in both environments, limiting claims that rule fusion is superior to value-based composition. One exploratory comparison favors rule fusion, but its comparator is post hoc, the task is partly saturated, and the fused policy remains below the strongest held-out actor. We contribute an evidence-bounded audit and composition protocol, not a claim of universal interpretability or autonomous skill generation. Future work must add temporally extended skills, cross-skill interfaces, composition search, and independent novelty audits.

AI.tldr: 本文将"可审计性"分解为六个独立可测的谓词（迹完整性、无损编码、规则覆盖、行为一致性、组合质量、价值模型可靠性），并基于冻结共享符号化器、被动规则提取、哈希链账本和离线置信度排序仲裁，提出了一套将独立训练的强化学习策略转化为可审计、可组合规则库的协议。核心负面结果是：规则集重叠（Jaccard=0.56）并不意味着行为一致性（在新鲜状态上仅51.4%，接近随机）；在Acrobot-v1上置信度仲裁反而劣于随机仲裁，经诊断为采样/贪心标签的诱导-部署协议不匹配（用贪心标签重建规则库后，融合性能从-443.37提升至-141.77）；FQE-GPI基线在两个环境中均失效。
AI.motivation: RL策略通常以不透明的神经网络检查点形式发布，训练日志仅证明运行发生而非解释学到了什么。需要一种方法将独立训练的策略转化为可审计、可比较、可组合的离散行为规则，同时严格界定该描述层的能力边界。
AI.method: 协议包括：(1) 冻结的校准衍生共享符号化器（每维4个分位数箱）；(2) 被动规则观察器，从日志转移中提取带支持度、置信度、平均奖励的条件-动作规则（阈值τ_s=8, τ_c=0.70）；(3) 哈希链账本（SHA-256）和精确环境重放验证器；(4) 离线融合策略F(s)，按置信度、支持度、奖励排序仲裁多种子规则库，并设有盲点回退。在CartPole-v1和Acrobot-v1上用8个种子、3个训练臂（基线、仅审计、受约束）进行REINFORCE训练，匹配重置种子下进行100回合配对评估。
AI.result: (1) 操作健康层全部通过（哈希链、重放、编解码器精确回溯）。(2) CartPole-v1上规则融合F相对后选单角色（种子43，训练回报最高）配对差+42.31（95% CI [23.98, 61.93]），但相对最佳留出角色低-294.04（任务饱和，4/8角色达500上限）。(3) Acrobot-v1上原始采样规则库融合仅-443.37，随机仲裁达-187.02；改用贪心（argmax一致）规则库后，置信度融合达-141.77，随机仲裁-234.26，秩序反转。(4) 新鲜状态上行为一致性51.4%（接近随机），尽管Jaccard重叠0.56。(5) FQE-GPI在两环境中均崩溃（CartPole仅9.34，Acrobot全选动作0）。(6) 规则约束训练干扰严重：8/8种子训练覆盖上升但行为一致性下降，36.7%–74.4%被掩码步骤梯度贡献为零。
AI.conclusion: 规则级审计层在评估的重放、哈希、来源检查下可操作验证，在低冲突环境下有用；规则级组合具有环境依赖性。规则重叠≠行为一致性；置信度仲裁在采样/贪心标签不匹配时可呈反选择性；FQE-GPI失效使"规则融合优于价值组合"的强声明受限。本文的真正贡献不是CartPole增益，而是：(a) 每条规则锚定到可重放、哈希绑定迹的协议；(b) 规则重叠无法预测行为的直接证据；(c) 置信度仲裁反选择性的可复制负面结果。组合搜索（生成而非仲裁）是未来工作的真正瓶颈。

title: SGA: Uncertainty Quantification for Multi-Step Forecasting in Time Series Foundation Models
summary: The recent emergence of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) has significantly advanced multi-step forecasting performance, enabling accurate predictions over extended future horizons. However, existing TSFMs often suffer from significantly inherent uncertainty, which typically manifests as derived forecast branches emerging at each time step and spreading to subsequent steps; different forecast branches often exhibit varying forecasting performance, thereby undermining the credibility of TSFM forecasts. In this paper, we propose the Slicing-Graphing-Alignment (SGA) method to quantify the uncertainty of multi-step TSFM forecasts. The proposed SGA first characterizes the topology of all potential forecast branches using a directed acyclic graph, such that the graph complexity bounds the uncertainty of multi-step forecasts, and then precisely measures the graph complexity by integrating both topological information and TSFM-inherent stochasticity.
