summary: Aggregate factuality scores hide where a language model succeeds, which relations it confuses, and whether an answer survives innocuous changes to the question or decoder. We introduce PROOF, a profile-oriented benchmark for factual coverage in instruction-tuned language models. PROOF converts a frozen Wikidata snapshot into 18,486 English multiple-choice questions grounded in 11,779 semantic facts, 101 classes, 392 properties, and 14 domains. Each question has an explicit "I don't know" option, a "No correct option" control, and nine controlled formulations; 1,849 questions are no-correct-option traps. We evaluate 18 open-weight model deployments on 166,374 prompts each and separately perturb decoding on a fixed 10% subset. Base factual accuracy ranges from 6.58% to 57.59% (chance: 8.64%), yet every model has a 19.3-36.4 percentage-point spread across domains. Paired facts reveal direction-dependent retrieval, usually favoring subject-to-object queries, with the pattern reversing for one model. We find no consistent temporal penalty after exact-stratum adjustment. Neutral wording changes accuracy by as much as 26.5 percentage points, while adversarial formulations break up to 79.4% of answers that were initially correct. Direct switching to an injected false label varies from 0.04% to 27.5%, showing that accuracy loss and hint following are distinct. Selected-token confidence often indicates severe overconfidence, and decoder perturbations move accuracy by up to 15.7 percentage points and domain profiles by 16.8 points. PROOF therefore measures factual coverage as a structured, intervention-aware profile rather than a single claim about what a model "believes."

AI.tldr: PROOF是一个面向对象级事实选择行为的"画像式"基准，使用冻结的Wikidata快照生成18,486道英文多选题，覆盖14个领域、101个类别、392种属性，每题含9种受控表述变体。在18个开源权重指令微调模型上系统刻画事实覆盖度、方向不对称性、时间效应、措辞敏感性、错误提示跟随、陷阱辨别、解码器扰动等多个独立维度，主张以分层画像替代单一智选基准。
AI.motivation: 现有事实性评测多以单一聚合分排序，掩盖了模型在哪些关系/领域强、哪些弱、是否对方向反转敏感、是否在无害措辞变化下崩溃、是否仅因提示而改变答案、是否严重过自信等关键结构性问题。研究者希望从"模型知道多少"转向"模型的事实覆盖行为在受控干预下的形状与稳定性"，把事实评测从单点指标改为分层、干预感知的画像。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建：从Wikidata冻结快照，经专家分类法（14领域/115类/392属性/13交叉类别）筛选得到18,486道题，含10,669 DSF（主→宾）、3,795 RSF（宾→主）、4,022描述题、1,272配对事实、2,690时态范围题；每题必有A"我不知道"、B"无正确选项"，1,849题为去掉真实答案的陷阱。2) 受控表述：每基础题7种中性变体+2种对抗变体（注入错误提示/权威压力），固定选项、答案、错标用于精确配对转换分析。3) 评测对象：18个开源权重模型部署，vLLM 0.19.0/bf16，统一推理配置；主跑166,374提示/部署；解码器子集固定10%做37种扰动（20种子、8种top-k、3×3温度/top-p/top-k网格）。4) 统计：项目级精确选项准确率+项目级随机基线chance=8.64%；分层按域/类/属性聚合；方向用1,272配对事实的McNemar检验；时态用Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel在类/属性/方向/答案类型/选项数/质量五分层上做调整；中性措辞用Cochran Q+配对差；对抗分"破坏率"与"严格提示跟随率"区分；置信度仅用所选标签token的log-prob，不重整化。5) 提出6项最小报告卡：覆盖、画像、方向、措辞、陷阱、解码器。
AI.result: 基础准确率6.58%–57.59%（基线8.64%，Qwen2.5-7B因几乎总选A而低于基线，机会归一化从-2.25%到53.59%）；18个模型在14领域上都有19.3–36.4个百分点的领域跨度（Phi-3达36.4），17个模型在"心理与行为"最强、14个在"媒体信息与传播"最弱；DSF–RSF配对差从-6.92到+7.15点，12个显著正向、1个显著反向；精确分层后17个CI含1，不存在统一时间惩罚；中性措辞最大变化±26.5点，所有18个Cochran Q齐性被拒；对抗破坏率9.18%–79.36%但严格跟随率仅0.04%–27.51%，两者解耦；陷阱B选择率0–43.37%，强模型（如Ministral-3）在陷阱上95.73%选错实质项；所选token置信度普遍严重过自信（最大gap 91.33点）；37种解码器扰动下整体排名稳定（Spearman 0.870–1.000，均值0.953）但单部署准确率漂移可达-15.68到+9.26点、领域画像漂移最大16.82点；任何单一聚合分都无法代理这些独立维度。
AI.conclusion: PROOF证明事实覆盖度必须以分层画像而非单一分数理解：高均值不等于均匀覆盖；方向反转、措辞敏感、严格提示跟随、解码器漂移是互不替代的不同现象，需分别诊断；事实精度、选项行为（选A/B）、所选token置信度是独立的认识边界维度，需联合读取。建议用包含覆盖、画像、方向、措辞、陷阱、解码器在内的最小报告卡取代单一准确率声明，并随Wikidata快照版本化以管理污染风险。

title: Generalized Graph Variational Autoencoders: Bounded Divergences Control Posterior Collapse
summary: The variational graph autoencoder (VGAE) regularizes its posterior toward the prior with the Kullback-Leibler divergence, a choice inherited from the variational autoencoder rather than argued for. We introduce the generalized graph variational autoencoder (GGVA), which replaces that term with any member of the Rényi-Tsallis family of order $q$ while leaving every other part of the model untouched. Both members admit closed forms for diagonal Gaussians and both recover the KL exactly as $q \to 1$, so the VGAE is the $q=1$ arm of our own model rather than a separate baseline, and any measured difference is attributable to a single scalar. Our analysis identifies boundedness, not the order, as the operative property: for $q<1$ the Tsallis divergence is bounded above by $1/(1-q)$, independently of the latent width, whereas the KL and the Rényi divergence of the same order are unbounded. On ten graphs spanning three synthetic families, a social network, three citation networks, a connectome, a power grid and a road network, $q$ moves the retained posterior information by up to $49\times$ relative to the VGAE, while the Rényi arm at the same order stays within $1.02$-$1.30\times$ of it on all six larger real graphs (isolating the bound as the cause). The retained information is usable: probing the frozen embedding for node class, a label absent from the objective, gives GGVA up to $+0.14$ macro-F1 over the VGAE on CiteSeer, with the Rényi control again tracking the VGAE. We also report what the design was built to expose: none of this reaches held-out link-prediction accuracy on any of the six larger real graphs, and boundedness delays posterior collapse rather than preventing it.

AI.tldr: 提出GGVA模型，用Rényi-Tsallis散度族（单一标量参数q）替换VGAE中的KL散度作为潜在空间惩罚项。研究证明q<1时Tsallis散度有界上界1/(1−q)，而KL和同阶Rényi散度均无界。在10个图上的实验表明，有界性（而非阶数q本身）是控制后验坍缩的关键机制——保留的后验信息最多可达VGAE的49倍；保留的信息可通过节点分类线性探针恢复（CiteSeer macro-F1提升+0.14），但未能转化为链接预测精度的提升。
AI.motivation: VGAE沿用VAE的KL散度作为后验正则化项，这一选择未经论证而直接继承。KL散度无界，权重足够大时可将后验拉向先验，造成后验坍缩。作者质疑这一选择，提出用一个单参数族的有界替代品，并以受控实验隔离有界性本身的作用机制。
AI.method: 1) 将VGAE的KL惩罚项替换为Rényi-Tsallis族中任一成员的q阶散度，闭式形式适用于对角高斯后验；2) 证明q<1时Tsallis散度有界上界1/(1−q)（命题1），与潜在维度d无关；3) 通过同阶Rényi无界成员作为对照组，隔离有界性这一单一变量的因果效应；4) 在10个图（合成SBM/BA/ER、社交网络、3个引文网络、连接组、电力网、公路网）上进行5个种子、5个权重量级（c∈{1,10,10²,10³,10⁴}）的扫参实验；5) 测量保留后验信息（KL nats）、活动潜在单元数、节点分类线性探针、聚类NMI、有效秩等指标。
AI.result: 1) 后验保留信息在所有10个图上随q单调排序——q=0.5保留VGAE的2.8–49倍；2) 同阶Rényi无界对照在6个较大真实图上仅保留VGAE的1.02–1.30倍——证明阶数q影响微弱，有界性才是机制根源；3) 节点分类探针：GGVA(q=0.5)在CiteSeer上macro-F1达0.427 vs VGAE 0.327（+0.14），Rényi对照仍跟踪VGAE；4) 链接预测AUC：Friedman检验（χ²=7.26, p=0.20）未能拒绝零假设，6个较大真实图上无任一臂可与VGAE区分，最大增益仅+0.014（Euroroad）；5) Erdős-Rényi负控制实验显示保留后验信息≠学到有用结构；6) 结论：有界性延缓而非阻止后验坍缩。
AI.conclusion: 用有界Tsallis散度替换KL作为VGAE潜在惩罚项，单标量q能以大且有序的幅度控制后验信息保留量；通过同阶无界Rényi对照，证明有界性（而非散度阶数）才是控制后验坍缩的真正机制。保留的后验信息可通过线性探针恢复为节点分类性能，但未能转化为链接预测精度的可测提升——说明该机制发挥作用的并非其预期任务。

title: When Agents Act Unwatched: The Reduced-Supervision Paradox in Agentic AI
comment: 24 pages, 4 tables. Expanded preprint with a structured public-artifact audit and three worked action paths
summary: Agentic AI is sold on a simple promise: the system keeps acting when the user stops watching. That promise creates an accountability inversion. As stepwise supervision recedes, verification does not disappear; it moves into the runtime infrastructure that defines authority, records action, interrupts execution, checks outcomes, and supports repair. We call this the reduced-supervision paradox. Using a 63-artifact audit, we examine its public visibility across 46 research papers and 17 engineering, documentation, security, and governance sources. We find that agents' action surfaces are far easier to reconstruct than the mechanisms needed to answer for their actions. Tool mediation and monitoring traces were clearly visible in 40 and 37 artifacts, whereas checkpoint placement was clearly visible in 6, validator independence in 4, recovery in 2, and contestability in 1. Three action paths show why this imbalance matters. A repository path can preserve rich diffs after a consequential change. A browser path can cross organizational boundaries faster than permissions travel. A service path can follow policy while leaving affected people without recourse. We argue that observability can become a substitute for accountability when it shifts verification onto users after meaningful intervention is no longer possible. Our action-path diagnostic instead asks whether a delegated action remains connected to authority, evidence, interruption, independent judgment, recovery, and challenge. The claim is deliberately bounded to public visibility; it does not establish the prevalence or effectiveness of undisclosed controls. We contribute an action-level account that recasts the harness from a technical wrapper into accountability infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于63份公开资料（46篇研究论文+17份工程/治理文档）的审计，揭示了智能体AI（Agentic AI）系统中"行动可见"与"问责闭合"之间的显著不对称：工具调用与监控追踪高度可见（40/37份），而检查点放置、验证者独立性、恢复机制与可争议性几乎不可见（6/4/2/1份）。由此提出"减少监督悖论"（reduced-supervision paradox）和一个贯穿"权限→行动→追踪→检查点→验证→恢复→争议"的行动路径诊断框架。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI的核心价值在于"无人监管时仍可持续行动"，但逐步监督的退场并不意味着验证消失，而是被转移到运行时基础设施中。论文旨在揭示：当系统可观察性（observability）取代问责（accountability）时，公开记录中"能做什么"远比"谁有权停止、判断、修复"清晰，这构成了智能体治理中的结构性盲区。
AI.method: 采用目的性抽样的63份公开资料语料库（2020年后），通过单一主编码员对17个字段进行编码（包括工具中介、检查点放置、验证者独立性、恢复机制、可争议性等），编码维度分为Present/Partial/Unclear/Absent/Not applicable五级。另采用BM25风格的检索探针进行文本稳健性检验，并对研究类与非研究类来源进行了敏感性分析。
AI.result: 核心发现是"行动表面"（action surface）与"问责闭合"（accountability closure）之间的显著可见性鸿沟：工具中介（40）与监控追踪（37）清晰可见，而检查点放置（6）、验证者独立性（4）、恢复（2）、可争议性（1）几乎不可见。BM25检索探针显示行动表面语言命中率（0.49）远高于问责闭合语言（0.11）。通过代码仓库、企业浏览器、零售/航空服务三条行动路径分析表明：不同场景中断裂位置不同，但结构性失衡一致。
AI.conclusion: 论文将"harness"（智能体外围运行时）从技术封装重新定位为问责基础设施；提出"减少监督悖论"——观察性可成为问责的替代物，使用户在事后承担本应在事前由组织承担的验证负担。贡献包括：（1）经验性的公共可见性不对称证据；（2）验证迁移（displaced verification）理论；（3）七阶段行动路径诊断框架（权限/行动/追踪/检查点/验证/恢复/争议），以及八种诊断风险模式（自主性蔓延、检查点错位、验证劳动转移、自我强化验证、延迟升级、恢复路径缺失、日志过度宽泛、第三方不透明）。

title: An Exploratory Ablation of a Small MLA--SSM Hybrid Language Model
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures. Exploratory single-seed ablation study. Code and replication package available at this https URL
summary: We report an exploratory, single-seed ablation of TALH (Adaptive Latent Hybrid), a decoder-only language model with parallel Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and a custom recurrent state-space (SSM) branch. Five variants, spanning 117--217M estimated active parameters per token, are trained from scratch on a FineWeb sample for the same number of optimisation steps and tokens. In this specific setup, removing the SSM branch gives the largest degradation in validation perplexity (MLA-only PPL 315), whereas removing MLA has a much smaller effect (SSM-only PPL 239). A dense-FFN hybrid obtains PPL 231, compared with 240 for the tested top-2 ternary-MoE hybrid, while using 3.87 GB less peak training memory. We also preserve a preliminary Apple M3 timing observation: among the five unoptimised implementations, MLA-only has the flattest measured time-to-first-token curve from 512 to 2,048 prompt tokens, although the dense Transformer is much faster in absolute terms. Because the runs are single-seed, parameter counts are unmatched, the evaluation stream may overlap the training source, and raw repeated timing records are unavailable, these results support implementation-specific hypotheses rather than general conclusions about MLA, SSMs, or mixture-of-experts models.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于小型MLA-SSM混合语言模型TALH的探索性消融研究。作者训练了五个变体（约117-217M活跃参数），在FineWeb上从零训练相同步数和token数。主要发现是：移除SSM分支导致最大困惑度下降（MLA-only PPL 315），而移除MLA影响较小（SSM-only PPL 239）；dense-FFN混合模型优于三元MoE混合模型且节省3.87GB内存；MLA-only在Apple M3上TTFT曲线最平缓。但作者强调这是单次实验、参数不平衡、评估可能与训练重叠，仅支持特定实现的假设而非通用结论。
AI.motivation: 本地运行语言模型的两个主要瓶颈：KV缓存随上下文线性增长、注意力预填充呈二次复杂度；以及模型总内存超出消费级硬件预算。本文旨在通过小型MLA-SSM混合架构的消融研究，探索在受限训练预算下：(1) MLA和SSM哪个是质量的主要驱动因素；(2) MLA的KV缓存压缩是否能在Apple Silicon上带来可测量的推理延迟改善；(3) 三元MoE路由在该规模下是否优于dense FFN；(4) 混合架构与标准Transformer基线在相同预算下的对比。
AI.method: 架构：TALH由三个组件组成——MLA（将KV状态压缩到200维潜向量，理论4×压缩比，实验测得8×缓存缩减）、自定义最小选择性循环SSM分支（与MLA并行运行，通过学习的sigmoid门控组合）、三元MoE（top-2路由，8专家，FP32主权重前向量化）。五个变体：full（MLA+SSM+MoE，217M活跃参数）、ssm_only（无MLA）、mla_only（无SSM）、dense_ffn（用BF16 SwiGLU替换MoE）、transformer_dense（标准MHA+FFN基线）。实验设置：单A100-40GB GPU，AdamW优化器（余弦衰减，初始LR 1e-4），BF16混合精度，上下文长度课程（256→512→1024），FineWeb sample-10BT两个本地分片，GPT-2分词器。Phase 1匹配步数和token数（4,000步），Phase 2扩展到7,000步。在MacBook M3上测量512/1024/2048 token的TTFT。
AI.result: Phase 1（4,000步）：dense_ffn PPL 231（最优），ssm_only 239，full 240，transformer_dense 263，mla_only 315（最差）。mla_only甚至比标准Transformer基线更差。Peak GPU内存：dense_ffn 24.01GB、ssm_only 26.50GB、full 27.88GB、mla_only 16.20GB、transformer_dense 5.36GB。Extended训练（7,000步）：dense_ffn val loss 5.074 vs full 5.093，dense_ffn早约1000步达到full的质量水平。TTFT观察：mla_only曲线最平缓（512到2048 token仅增长1.32×），transformer_dense增长5.5×、dense_ffn 3.3×、full 2.7×；但transformer_dense绝对速度最快（114ms vs 2,560ms at 512 tokens）。
AI.conclusion: 两项实现特定的假设：(1) 自定义循环分支对验证损失的贡献似乎比MLA更大——移除SSM产生最差困惑度，移除MLA质量接近完整MoE混合；(2) MLA-only在三个测量提示长度上TTFT曲线最平缓。但这些都不建立跨MLA-SSM架构的通用角色分解。Dense FFN混合优于测试的三元MoE变体同时节省3.87GB峰值训练内存，这是该配置的有用负面结果，不是通用MoE规模阈值的证据。明确的未来步骤：不相交数据、多种子复制、参数/FLOP匹配对照、路由诊断、重复的预填充/解码/内存基准测试。主要局限：单次训练运行、参数不平衡、FFN宽度未达标准4×、不匹配FLOP/参数/墙钟时间、评估流可能与训练重叠、仅有困惑度无下游任务评估、推理基准不完整（无重复、无解码吞吐量、无推理内存）。

title: A Manifold-Aware Topic Modeling Approach via Rank-Based Prototypes
comment: Accepted at the Main Conference of 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Recent topic models leverage pretrained embeddings, but neural architectures produce latent representations without grounding in specific texts, and clustering-based pipelines assign representative documents only post hoc, relying on absolute distances distorted by hubness and anisotropy in high-dimensional spaces. We introduce MARETopic, a training-free framework that casts topic discovery as rank-based prototype selection. After projecting embeddings onto a low-dimensional manifold, MARETopic builds ranked lists encoding ordinal neighborhood structure. A greedy algorithm selects exactly K exemplar documents, real corpus texts, whose neighborhoods cover the corpus. Two variants share this criterion. MARETopic$_\text{Corr}$ scores candidates with a query performance predictor and a rank correlation measure, leading Purity and NMI on the two benchmarks with the most categories, ahead of both neural and clustering-based topic models. MARETopic$_\text{Diff}$ scores them with a rank-based diffusion matrix, needs neither measure, and runs 1.7 to 1.9 times faster. Without a single gradient update, MARETopic leads topic coherence on two of three datasets. A novel inter-topic Maximal Marginal Relevance step raises vocabulary diversity at little cost in coherence. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MARETopic 是一种无需训练的主题建模框架，将主题发现转化为基于排序的原型选择。它通过 SBERT 编码、UMAP 降维、构建排序列表，再利用贪心算法选取 K 个真实语料文档作为主题代表（leader），从而规避高维空间中的 hubness 和各向异性问题。两个变体 MARETopic_Corr（基于 QPP 和秩相关性）和 MARETopic_Diff（基于秩扩散矩阵）在 20NG、NYT、WoS 三个基准上，在 Purity、NMI、主题一致性等多个指标上达到或超过七种 SOTA 基线，且无需任何梯度更新。
AI.motivation: 现有主题模型存在两大缺陷：(1) 神经模型的主题是隐空间向量，缺乏文档级锚点，无法回答"哪个文档最代表该主题"；(2) 基于聚类的方法依赖绝对距离，受高维空间的 hubness 和各向异性影响，且代表文档是事后选取而非架构定义。BERTopic 的 HDBSCAN 还无法精确控制 K 个主题。
AI.method: 核心流程：SBERT 编码 → UMAP 投影（d=5）→ 构建 top-k 排序列表 → 贪心算法选择 K 个 leader 文档。评分函数 η(d) 度量拓扑中心性，惩罚项 s 抑制与已选 leader 邻域重叠的候选。两个变体：(1) Corr 使用 Reciprocal Density (QPP) 和 JaccardMax 秩相关性；(2) Diff 使用对数加权亲和矩阵 W 做 p=2 步扩散。文档-主题矩阵 Θ 由文档与 leader 间的排序相似度构成；主题词通过 c-TF-IDF + 主题间 MMR 去重提取（λ=0.3）。
AI.result: 在 20NG、NYT、WoS 三个数据集上，MARETopic_Corr 在 20NG 和 NYT 上 Purity/NMI 第一，超过所有神经模型（200 轮训练）；C_v 在 20NG（0.6818）和 WoS（0.7198）领先。MARETopic_Diff 比 Corr 快 1.7–1.9 倍，在 NYT NMI 上最高（0.3975）。主题多样性 0.85–0.88，低于 FASTopic 但显著高于 BERTopic。消融实验表明：UMAP 对 Corr 变体有益、对 Diff 部分场景反而有害；k=100 是推荐值；λ=0.3 是一致性-多样性的最佳折中。附录证明 MMR 去重可移植到 BERTopic，使其 TD 提升 0.13–0.17。
AI.conclusion: MARETopic 首次将基于排序的原型选择引入主题建模，无需训练即可生成 K 个主题，每个主题由真实语料文档锚定，可直接人工检查。局限性：(1) 仅在 9K–19K 英文语料上验证，大规模/多语言场景未测；(2) 主题多样性仍不及基于最优传输的生成模型（如 FASTopic）；(3) 缺少下游任务评估。未来工作：层次化主题、动态主题建模、可扩展性与多语言验证。

title: TTLab at AlexandriaX-2026: A Fine-Tuned Surface Tagger for Arabic Machine-Translation Error-Span Detection and Classification
comment: Accepted at ArabicNLP 2026, shared task AlexandriaX-2026
summary: We present TTLab's submission to the AlexandriaX-2026 Subtask~3 on Arabic MT error span detection and classification. Our system frames the task as token-level classification over surface forms, preserving character offsets to ensure exact alignment with the evaluation metric. To handle severe label imbalance, we employ a focal loss with class weighting and dialect-specific decoding thresholds. Among six Arabic pre-trained encoders, MARBERTv2 achieves the best overall performance of 40.8 and 40.91 on the development and test set, respectively, ranking $\nth{3}$ out of all participating teams. While our system localizes error spans effectively, classification of rare error types remains challenging, highlighting the need for data augmentation for tail categories. The code is available at ${\href{ this https URL }{\faGithub~ TTLab at AlexandriaX-2026}$

AI.tldr: TTLab提出了一种基于表面标注（surface tagging）的判别式方法，用于AlexandriaX-2026子任务3（阿拉伯方言MT错误片段检测与分类）。通过对原始未规范化文本进行子词级标注并保留字符偏移，配合Focal Loss和方言特定阈值，在六种阿拉伯预训练编码器中MARBERTv2表现最佳，测试集总体得分40.91，最终排名第3。
AI.motivation: 方言阿拉伯语MT质量评估比MSA更困难，现有生成式基线（NileChat）存在JSON解析脆弱、偏移预测不可靠、样本效率低三大问题；同时，错误片段检测在阿拉伯方言场景下研究不足。任务需要细粒度的字符级错误定位与分类。
AI.method: 1) 将任务重构为子词级token分类（表面标注），保留字符偏移以保证与评测指标精确对齐；2) 使用Focal Loss（γ=2，α_O=0.3，α_c=1）处理80%非错误token的严重类别不平衡；3) 将3个稀有类别（orthography/pragmatics/graphetics）合并为"other"，后处理时回退到最频繁原始类别；4) 在推理阶段对五个方言方向分别调整置信度阈值τ_d；5) 比较六种阿拉伯预训练编码器；6) 尝试字符级投票集成。
AI.result: MARBERTv2在OOF和Dev集上分别取得39.4和40.8的最佳成绩，测试集总体得分40.91，排名第3。Overlap-span F1达46-48，但error-category micro-F1仅31-33，定位能力强于分类能力。集成方法未超越单模型最佳结果。类别分析显示sociolinguistics F1=39.2最强，pragmatics和graphetics F1=0。嵌套OOF验证显示池化阈值存在约4分的过拟合。无塌缩消融实验发现保留全部6类反而更好（测试集42.00 vs 40.91）。
AI.conclusion: 表面标注方法通过保留字符偏移和判别式token分类有效避免了生成式方法的三大缺陷；Focal Loss和方言特定阈值是关键设计；MARBERTv2因方言预训练优势表现最佳；稀有类别（尤其是仅2个样本的graphetics）仍是核心瓶颈，未来工作应聚焦尾部类别数据增强、跨语言迁移以及与exact-match评分机制的对齐。

title: Operator Packages, Proposer Strength, and Construction-Family Plateaus in Office-Scale Verified Search
comment: Code and run data: this https URL
summary: Verified search, in which a language model proposes programs, a hard evaluator scores them, and selection keeps the best, has recently moved mathematical records; controlled ablations of the proposer-side components remain rare. We instrument a minimal FunSearch-style loop at office scale (a 30B local model on a laptop, 120-600 verified samples per run) with three operator packages: a schematic notebook the model writes and carries instead of verbatim elites, a named obstacle, and behavioural repulsion from constructions already found. On nine construction problems from a public repository, the complete 2^3 factorial with two replicates favours the primary contrast in a nominal two-stage analysis: the composition closes more of the seed-to-record gap (+0.196; nominal pooled p=0.023, stage-combination p~0.08; median per-problem effect +0.045). Repulsion raises construction-hash diversity everywhere (p=0.0039; partly a manipulation check). The factorial finds no positive memory-by-repulsion interaction (bounded to about +/-0.04); the gain decomposes additively, and memory+repulsion is the only arm that never collapses (0 of 18 runs), within 0.025 of the full composition. A frontier proposer under the identical loop reaches in tens of samples what the local model does not in hundreds; in single scoping runs its gains arrive without the operators. The search stalls after closing ~92% of the gap on the flagship problem, and the registered family-hint test gives the stall its first reading: named in words, the reference family is adopted and loses; handed as code, it is optimized, but our best finite-grid implementation remains below the plateau reached unaided. The loop transported and optimized the idea it was handed; no unaided run produced it. We release the harness, every candidate, and the dated pre-registrations.

AI.tldr: 本文在“办公规模”（30B本地模型，120-600个验证样本）的固定FunSearch式验证搜索循环中，对三个提议者侧算子包（示意性笔记本/记忆、命名障碍/议程、行为排斥/去重）进行了完整的2³析因实验。综合算子在9个构造问题上显著提升了种子-记录差距闭合度（+0.196，标称p=0.023）；记忆+排斥是唯一零崩溃配置；前沿模型在样本用量约少20倍时达到更高值；构造族（"想法"）可能是性能平台的主要约束。
AI.motivation: 已发表的验证搜索系统（FunSearch、AlphaEvolve、ShinkaEvolve等）同时改变模型与脚手架，对提议者侧各组件进行受控消融的研究仍然稀缺；且它们要么依赖前沿模型与上千样本，要么依赖小模型与百万样本，"实验室可负担"的中等规模区间未被填充。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在固定循环（K岛、FunSearch式精英保留与迁移、Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B本地模型）下，将3个算子包（示意笔记本B、命名障碍C、行为排斥D）按2³析因设计（含8个组合臂）在9个公开构造问题上展开实验，每臂两次重复、120个验证样本；用精确符号翻转检验做统计推断；另设预算/网格/提议者阶梯与族提示（言语vs代码）注册实验做因果定位。
AI.result: E臂（BCD组合）均值最高（0.635），相对A的差距闭合度+0.196（标称p=0.023，95%CI[+0.059,+0.343]），中位+0.045，稳健于指标种子下限；D显著提升构造哈希多样性（+0.31，p=0.0039，全9题两重复均为正）；无显著记忆×排斥交互（β≈+0.003，p=0.47）；记忆+排斥是唯一零崩溃配置（18次中0次），均值仅比E低0.025；Claude Opus 5以约1/20验证样本量达到更高值（0.3897 vs 本地0.3816）；族提示实验中，言语提示被遵从但输，代码种子被优化但仍未跨过最后一英里；所有模型都卡在稀疏原子族内，未触及多尺度参考构造。
AI.conclusion: 在固定循环下，3个算子包可加性合成出最高均值臂E；记忆+排斥是兼顾稳健性与简洁性的推荐配方；提议者强度比算子更能解释高端平台；前沿模型仅用少量样本即可在采样效率上压倒本地模型；最后的"想法-族"边界仍未被跨越——代码形式的族提示可被优化，言语形式的族提示被遵从但失效，且未观察到无引导运行自发产生目标族构造。

title: Graph, Loop, and Harness Engineering for Zero-Trust Agentic Data Engineering and Analytical Processing
summary: Large language model agents increasingly automate data workflows, but end-to-end cloud data engineering and analytical execution require reliable coordination across code, data, infrastructure, and runtime environments. We present two zero-trust frameworks. Zero-Trust Agentic Data Engineering generates, deploys, and verifies complete cloud data-engineering solutions from natural-language tasks, with completion conditioned on repository, deployment, runtime, and policy evidence. Zero-Trust Agentic OLAP combines governed Data Preparation with verified Online Analytical Processing (OLAP), permitting production promotion only after validation and evidence-bound approval, and releasing analytical answers only after Same-Snapshot Execution, Exact Result Equivalence, deterministic grounding, and reflection. Both frameworks share three abstractions: graph engineering for evidence-gated workflow structure, loop engineering for bounded recovery, and agent-harness engineering for zero-trust execution. We evaluate both frameworks under nominal execution, controlled failures, bounded recovery, and policy-constrained conditions, measuring verified completion, recovery, authorization enforcement, production promotion, and verified OLAP execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两个面向LLM智能体数据工程的零信任框架——Zero-Trust Agentic Data Engineering和Zero-Trust Agentic OLAP，通过图工程（graph engineering）、循环工程（loop engineering）和智能体线束工程（agent-harness engineering）三大共享抽象，实现基于证据门控的工作流推进、有界恢复和零信任执行，覆盖自然语言任务到云数据工程方案生成部署验证、OLAP治理数据分析全流程。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体越来越多地自动化数据工作流，端到端云数据工程和分析执行需要在代码、数据、基础设施和运行时环境之间进行可靠的协调。然而，软件、基础设施、编排、运行时、数据和分析层面可能因配置错误、IAM配置错误、非幂等工作流、模式和数据质量问题等产生故障，可能中断服务、违反安全策略、增加云成本或产生无效输出。可靠运行需要经过验证的数据工程和可信的分析执行，但现有智能体框架缺乏显式的证据门控、隔离执行和恢复约束机制。
AI.method: 两个框架均围绕三大共享抽象构建：(1)图工程将长视域工作流表示为显式阶段、依赖关系、转换、验证谓词、恢复路径和终端条件，仅在建立所需证据时推进；(2)循环工程通过有界诊断、修复、重规划和重试来管理验证失败，防止无界执行、权限扩展或资源消耗；(3)智能体线束工程通过工作负载身份、授权、策略执行、托管工具访问、隔离执行、租户和数据隔离、执行边界和证据捕获建立围绕智能体操作的零信任边界。Data Engineering框架基于Google ADK/A2A/MCP编排，运行在gVisor隔离的GKE沙箱中，通过可信构建交付管线（SBOM、二进制授权、Cloud Deploy）部署两层云架构，完成需RepoValid∧DeployVerified∧RuntimeVerified∧PolicyOK四重证据。OLAP框架将不可变源数据集通过沙箱SQL执行生成候选数据产品，经Preparation Validation（模式一致性、键约束、源输出对账、拒绝行/行数限制）后通过独立Production Writer Identity晋升为治理数据产品；OLAP查询同时通过模型生成的Candidate Query和确定性Canonical Compiler派生的Canonical Query在同一BigQuery快照上执行，要求Exact Result Equivalence，再经确定性接地和反思验证后方可发布Verified Answer。实验使用两个各100任务的基准套件、四个LLM（Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite/Flash/Pro、GPT-5.6 Sol），共2400次任务条件执行，加消融共9600次。
AI.result: 主要结果（GPT-5.6 Sol vs Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite）：Data Engineering的VDECR从0.43升至0.95，DERTR从0.56升至0.97，DEZTER稳定在0.98-1.00；OLAP的GDPCR从0.62升至0.96，VAR从0.47升至0.94，OZTRR从0.66升至0.97。恢复耗尽终止率所有模型均为1.00；未授权生产写入/OLAP读取拒绝率所有模型均为1.00。零信任执行（DEZTER/OZTRR授权部分）在所有模型上接近天花板且与模型能力无关。消融实验显示：移除证据门控推进使VDECR/GDPCR/VAR降低0.11-0.17；移除有界恢复使DERTR/OZTRR大幅下降0.35-0.52（GPT-5.6 Sol的VDECR从0.95降至0.58）；移除零信任授权使DEZTER从0.98-1.00降至0.45-0.61，而其他指标几乎不变。三大机制呈互补：图工程管辖验证推进、循环工程管辖有界恢复、智能体线束管辖执行权限。
AI.conclusion: 两个零信任框架将自主生成和修复与隔离执行、显式授权和独立验证耦合起来，使终端成功由保留证据而非智能体自报成功决定。Data Engineering完成需通过仓库、部署、运行时和策略验证；OLAP仅在Preparation Validation和证据绑定批准后才允许生产晋升，并仅在Same-Snapshot Execution、Exact Result Equivalence、确定性接地和反思通过后发布Verified Answer。实验表明框架可在独立建立的验证条件下实现端到端完成，零信任执行可大幅独立于模型能力强制执行，而完整工作流成功仍强烈依赖模型能力。三大抽象呈互补贡献，为可验证的智能体数据工作流提供统一基础。

title: The Sequential Price of Continual Learning
summary: Sequential task updates are fundamental to continual learning, but their recency bias can impose a lasting performance cost. We study this cost in an overparameterized linear-regression model with i.i.d. task sampling. We prove that distribution-level forgetting and population loss converge to the same stationary limit. This common limit separates exactly into the intrinsic loss asymptotically attained by joint training and an additional sequential price, and in more homogeneous task geometries the two terms coincide, making the total loss twice that of joint training. We further analyze fixed-strength elastic weight consolidation (EWC) under general task curvatures and characterize its stationary sequential price at every regularization strength. Under strong regularization, the price decays inversely with EWC strength while convergence to stationarity slows at the same scale. On the Jester joke-rating dataset, the theory exactly quantifies both the sequential price generated by naturally conflicting user preferences and its reduction by EWC.

AI.tldr: 本文研究过参数化线性回归中序列任务学习（持续学习）的分布级遗忘与损失收敛，推导出包含"序列代价"的精确分解，并在Jester数据集上验证EWC缓解遗忘的效果。
AI.motivation: 持续学习中顺序任务更新会引入近因偏差，导致对旧任务的灾难性遗忘。需要从理论上量化这种遗忘的代价，并分析弹性权重整合（EWC）能否以及如何减少该代价。
AI.method: 在i.i.d.任务采样下的过参数化线性回归模型中进行理论分析：（1）证明分布级遗忘与总体损失的平稳收敛极限相同；（2）将该极限精确分解为联合训练的固有损失与序列代价之和；（3）在一般任务曲率下分析固定强度EWC的平稳序列代价，分析其随正则化强度的变化规律；（4）在Jester幽默评分数据集上对理论进行实证验证。
AI.result: （1）平稳极限精确等于联合训练固有损失加上序列代价；（2）在更同质的任务几何下，两项相等，总损失为联合训练的两倍；（3）EWC下，序列代价随正则化强度增强而反比例衰减，但向平稳态的收敛速度同步减慢；（4）在Jester数据集上，理论精确量化了用户偏好冲突产生的序列代价及其被EWC降低的程度。
AI.conclusion: 本文为持续学习中的灾难性遗忘提供了精确的理论刻画，揭示了顺序学习的固有代价及其与任务几何的关系，阐明了EWC在效果与收敛速度之间存在权衡（强正则化降低代价但减缓收敛）。

title: Decoupling Knowledge and Privacy: Post-Task Self-Distillation Replay for LLM Continual Learning
summary: Privacy-preserving continual learning (PPCL) must reduce the reproduction of sensitive content while retaining useful knowledge across sequential tasks. Formal privacy guarantees characterize randomized mechanisms, whereas operational output control concerns whether a trained model selectively reduces the likelihood of sensitive content in its outputs. In this work, we investigate the latter together with continual-learning utility under realistic task evolution. Retention and privacy correction operate at different granularities: task acquisition requires broad preservation of current- and old-task behavior, whereas privacy correction targets sparse annotated positions. Joint optimization leaves the current-task preservation target continually changing. We propose SPARK, a retention-correction decomposition that first freezes the learned post-task distribution and then applies selective correction around this stable reference. Self-Distillation Replay learns the current task while distilling behavior from previous tasks, and Post-Task Privacy Correction reduces annotated-PII likelihood while anchoring current- and old-task non-PII behavior to the resulting checkpoint. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SPARK achieves effective selective PII suppression while preserving strong continual-learning utility and knowledge retention across diverse settings. Code and data will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文针对隐私保护持续学习（PPCL）中"知识保留"与"敏感输出抑制"两类目标控制粒度不同、联合优化时当前任务参考点持续漂移的问题，提出了SPARK（Selective Privacy Anchored by Replay Knowledge）框架。该框架通过"保留–修正"解耦的两阶段流程：先以自蒸馏回放（Self-Distillation Replay）冻结一个已学习当前任务并保留旧任务行为的后任务检查点，再对该固定参考点进行任务后隐私修正（Post-Task Privacy Correction, PTPC），利用非似然损失降低被标注PII的条件似然，同时用KL约束锚定非PII行为。在六任务基准上，SPARK在保持接近无约束ER的持续学习效用（Last 0.799）的同时，实现了匹配难度控制下显著的PII选择性抑制（Δ_sel=0.746，95% CI [0.385, 1.169]）。
AI.motivation: 隐私保护持续学习需要同时解决两个本质不同的问题：（1）知识保留需要广泛维持当前与历史任务的行为；（2）隐私修正需要稀疏地改变被标注敏感token的概率。两者控制粒度不同——保留要求"广泛"，修正要求"稀疏"——而在联合优化框架下，当前任务的分布在任务学习阶段持续变化，导致隐私修正缺乏一个稳定的"应该保留什么"的参考点，构成参考不一致问题。作者还通过复现PeCL发现，在耦合的"任务学习+遗忘"配置下，嵌入扰动在训练噪声尺度对PII与非PII的影响近似无差异（差距仅0.29个百分点），无法实现选择性输出控制，从而进一步凸显了直接输出修正机制的必要性。
AI.method:
SPARK采用两阶段保留–修正解耦：
**阶段1：自蒸馏回放（SD-Replay）**。学生从上一任务隐私修正检查点θ_{k-1}^priv初始化，并以同一冻结检查点为教师；当前任务采用仅响应位置的因果LM交叉熵；回放序列中，低敏感度响应位置采用目标token交叉熵，高敏感度有效位置采用教师top-K KL蒸馏，从而避免直接强化敏感回放位置，得到冻结的后任务检查点θ_k^task。
**阶段2：任务后隐私修正（PTPC）**。以θ_k^task初始化学生并以同一检查点为冻结教师；将被标注的直接标识符集𝒫上施加非似然（unlikelihood）损失与去教师分布的dKL损失以降低PII条件似然，同时在当前任务非PII集𝒬与旧任务非PII集𝒬_old上以KL约束锚定非PII行为，输出θ_k^priv。
关键设计要点：阶段分离源于"持续变化的任务分布在任务学习阶段无法充当稳定保留目标"的不对称时序需求；固定θ_k^task同时充当当前与旧任务非PII锚定的共同参考教师；unlikelihood是PII抑制的主要驱动力，dKL限制过度修正并约束概率再分配；当前锚定主要抑制当前任务非PII漂移，旧任务锚定主要防止累积漂移与遗忘。
AI.result:
在LLaMA-2-7B（LoRA r=16）六任务基准（FOMC→Yelp→AGNews→Amazon→MentILL→Yahoo）上：
- **持续学习效用**：SPARK在所有评估的PPCL与隐私增强方法中取得最高Last（0.799）与Avg（0.812），与无约束ER（Last 0.815）相差不到1.6个百分点，且BWT仅−0.009；在Qwen2.5-1.5B上同样成立（Last 0.784 vs ER 0.793），并在Last与BWT上较PeCL复现分别提升7.5与7.2个百分点。
- **PII选择性抑制**：匹配难度控制下Δ_sel=0.746，95%源簇自助法CI [0.385, 1.169]；全词表PII Top-1从预训练模型的47.13%降至23.75%；三任务顺序下NLL_PII始终最高。
- **任务顺序鲁棒性**：三种任务顺序下Last 0.799–0.820、BWT介于−0.010与+0.017之间；Order 3下Last/Avg达0.820/0.880，显著优于PeCL复现的0.587/0.720。
- **消融实验**：移除SD-Replay导致Last崩塌至0.236、BWT至−0.684；移除PTPC则Last保留0.804但PII抑制基本消失；移除unlikelihood使匹配CI跨越零点；移除dKL虽Δ_sel升至2.445但效用退化且非PII漂移增大；移除旧任务锚定使BWT由−0.009退化至−0.031，FOMC准确率由79.67%降至70.00%。
- **效率**：总训练时间约200分钟，仅比无约束ER多20.3%，其中PTPC仅占4.0%。
- **负面/边界证据**：在候选排序金丝雀评测与成员推断攻击下，置信区间大幅重叠，作者明确声明不主张形式化差分隐私、参数级擦除或对任意黑盒攻击的不可提取性。
AI.conclusion: 本文将持续学习中敏感输出控制重新定位为"固定参考点"问题：当PII修正是稀疏的、知识保留是广泛时，两者需要不同的控制，且必须在已学习当前任务并保留旧任务的稳定检查点周围进行。SPARK通过"先冻结、再修正"的解耦设计，证明固定参考点上的任务后选择性输出控制是平衡知识保留与敏感输出抑制的有效机制，且其结论严格限定在运营性PII条件似然抑制的范围内，与形式化隐私机制互补而非替代。

title: Revalidation Beats Stateful Routing for Scientific Surrogates Under Distribution Shift
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, and 22 references; includes reproducibility appendices
summary: Surrogate models are often chosen during development and then left in place as new measurements arrive. That practice becomes risky when noise, input support, or physical parameters change. We asked whether such changes call for a stateful adaptive controller, or whether it is enough to validate the candidate models again on each new batch. To study this question, we built RegimeShift-Surrogates, a reproducible streaming benchmark spanning eight analytic and dynamical tasks, four stationary or shifting regimes, ten held-out seeds, and eight classical, multilayer-perceptron, and Kolmogorov-Arnold network surrogates. The confirmatory run contains 30,720 model fits and 3,200 scored deployment windows. Choosing the model with the lowest validation loss in the current window yields mean log regret 0.091 against a per-window oracle; the best fixed model chosen in hindsight yields 0.192. The paired difference is -0.101 (hierarchical bootstrap 95% CI [-0.165, -0.040]; Holm-adjusted p = 0.0469), with revalidation ahead in 26 of 32 task-scenario combinations. None of the stateful alternatives, including exponential smoothing, dual-timescale adaptation, Page-Hinkley resets, or margin gating, improves the pooled result, and delayed bias correction makes it worse. Oracle choices also differ substantially by task: k-nearest neighbors dominate the damped oscillator, vanilla KAN is often selected for two-dimensional surfaces, and MLPs lead on the Runge and Van der Pol tasks. In this benchmark, fresh validation evidence is useful; carrying old evidence forward is often not.

AI.tldr: 在分布漂移的科学代理模型选择中，每个新批次重新验证候选模型显著优于固定选择和带状态的自适应控制器。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习中，代理模型通常在开发阶段选定后便固定使用，但当噪声、输入支撑或物理参数发生变化时，这一做法具有风险。研究旨在回答：面对分布漂移，是需要带状态的自适应控制器，还是仅需在新批次上重新验证候选模型即可。
AI.method: 构建了 RegimeShift-Surrogates 流式基准测试，包含 8 个分析/动力任务、4 种平稳/漂移场景、10 个保留种子、8 个候选代理（多项式/RBF 脊回归、k-NN、MLP、KAN、ER-KAN）。在 12 窗口的回合中，比较 8 种选择器（静态开发、当前验证、EWMA、双时域 EWMA、Page-Hinkley 重置、边际门控、最佳固定离线、每窗口预言机）。主指标为回合级对数遗憾，使用分层自助法构建置信区间，Holm 校正多重比较。确认性实验包含 30,720 次模型拟合和 3,200 个评分窗口。
AI.result: 当前验证策略的平均对数遗憾为 0.091，几何平均清洁 MSE 为 0.004812，与每窗口预言机的匹配率为 72.3%。事后最佳固定模型遗憾为 0.192，匹配率 61.5%。配对差值 -0.101（分层自助 95% CI [-0.165, -0.040]，Holm 校正 p=0.0469），在 32 个任务-场景组合中 26 个领先。所有测试的状态选择器（EWMA 0.155、双时域 EWMA 0.120、Page-Hinkley 0.134、边际门控 0.210）均未超越当前验证；延迟偏差校正表现更差。预言机选择呈现任务特化：k-NN 在阻尼振子中占 96%，vanilla KAN 在二维曲面中占 47-51%，MLP 在 Runge 和 Van der Pol 中领先。
AI.conclusion: 在具备当前验证集的设置中，新鲜验证证据的价值显著高于历史证据的平滑或记忆。代理模型在不同任务和场景下存在显著特化，建议从当前证据出发，仅在记忆被证实有益时才引入复杂性。带状态控制器的潜在价值需以补充信息源为前提，而非单纯追求复杂度。

title: PPTBench: Can Coding Agents Reconstruct the Visual World through Structured, Editable Slides
summary: Coding agents are beginning to act in the visual world. They now build webpages, GUIs, games, 3D scenes, diagrams, and documents. Success in such visual coding requires bridging two spaces: inferring visual structure and expressing it programmatically. Slides are a core medium of knowledge work, widely used to communicate ideas and collaborate in a form that people can directly inspect and edit. Therefore, they provide an ideal testbed for visual coding, as they require agents to recover visual structure and realize it as editable objects. However, existing benchmarks either rely on subjective open-ended evaluation, produce non-editable code outputs, or focus only on local editing rather than end-to-end visual reconstruction. We introduce PPTBench, which benchmarks visual coding through editable slide reconstruction. It contains 500 tasks, each based on a scientific flow diagram from a real arXiv paper and requiring agents to reconstruct it as a single PPTX page composed of native, editable objects. A four-stage Agentic Judge evaluates artifact validity, semantic correctness, rendering quality, and fine-grained visual quality. Across 31 configurations spanning model families, effort levels, and harnesses, the best configuration, Kimi K3, reaches only 67.80, while the median scores 19.47. We find that agents can reliably produce valid PPTX files but still struggle with semantic and visual correctness, especially text details. More reasoning mainly helps agents pass hard gates, while stronger verification is more consistently associated with higher quality. PPTBench advances the vision of coding agents that can understand and reconstruct the visual world through structured, editable code.

AI.tldr: PPTBench 是一个包含500个任务的基准测试，通过将科学流程图重建为可编辑的PPTX幻灯片来评估编程智能体的视觉编码能力。它提出四阶段Agentic Judge评估协议，在31个模型配置中，最佳配置Kimi K3仅获67.80分，中位数仅19.47分，揭示了智能体虽然能生成有效PPTX文件，但在语义和视觉正确性（尤其是文本细节）上仍有显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉编码基准存在三大缺陷：1) 幻灯片生成类基准因目标未确定而依赖主观开放式评估；2) 图表转代码基准输出源代码文件而非可直接编辑的对象图；3) 办公任务基准仅测试局部编辑而非端到端视觉重建。该研究认为，可编辑幻灯片重建是评估视觉编码的理想测试床，因为原生对象图记录了智能体推断的结构而非像素表象。
AI.method: 1) 任务定义：给定一张科学流程图参考图像，要求智能体重建为单页PPTX幻灯片，由原生可编辑组件构成，禁止嵌入光栅化参考副本；2) 数据构建：从arXiv版本化源中检索1,000个流程图候选，经五项人工筛选标准降至500个，涵盖50个arXiv一级类别，聚合为10个领域；3) 评估协议：四阶段Agentic Judge——Stage 0确定性检查工件有效性，Stage 1判断语义正确性（节点、连接端点、箭头方向），Stage 2检查渲染质量，Stage 3枚举细粒度视觉缺陷；评分采用门控乘性聚合（任何硬门失败则得零分）；4) 实验规模：31个模型配置（涵盖GPT-5.6三个变体、Claude Opus/Sonnet 5、Qwen 3.8 Max、Kimi K3、GLM-5.3-Flash），覆盖不同推理努力级别和智能体运行时，共46,500次判断。
AI.result: 1) 整体性能：31个配置得分从1.53到67.80，中位数仅19.47；Kimi K3（高努力级别）以67.80分领先，GPT-5.6 Sol Max和Qwen 3.8 Max分别以49.28和47.69分紧随；2) 关键发现一：97.92%的运行产生有效PPTX文件，但70.43%的模型-任务对在语义门失败，仅2.28%在渲染门失败，说明智能体掌握格式语法但视觉理解薄弱；3) 关键发现二：通过双门后，文本缺陷占扣分的51.6%（布局仅13.6%），其中unexpected_wrap是最常见且可重复的缺陷（1,591例，5,002扣分点），原因是该属性无法从OOXML层验证；4) 关键发现三：增加推理努力主要提升门通过率（最多46.8个百分点），而条件细节质量仅提升0-7.7分；两个家族在最昂贵设置下反而变差或无改善；5) 关键发现四：得分与智能体检查自身渲染的次数高度相关（r=0.881），而与编辑幻灯片次数几乎无关（r=0.255）；6) Judge验证：与人类多数意见的一致性达86.5%（Cohen's κ=0.696），三轮投票多数一致性达96.0%；7) 排名稳定性：Kimi K3在100%重采样中保持第一，但仅4/31相邻配对得分差异显著。
AI.conclusion: PPTBench通过可编辑幻灯片重建建立了视觉编码的受控测试床，证明智能体已学会格式但尚未学会"读图"——核心瓶颈在于从图像恢复流程语义而非绘制精度。研究发现推理努力主要购买门通过率，渲染自检比编辑次数更关联质量，文本细节（尤其是意外换行）是主要残余错误。该基准为衡量"通过结构化可编辑代码理解并重建视觉世界"的智能体能力提供了可验证的方法论。

title: TopU-LBVS: A Realistic Multi Target Benchmark for Ligand Based Virtual Screening
summary: Ligand-based virtual screening (LBVS) is a practical first-pass tool in early-stage drug discovery, but existing benchmarks can overestimate performance through random negatives, easy decoys, limited target coverage, and non-standardized evaluation protocols. We introduce TopU-LBVS, a multi-target benchmark for LBVS under hard-negative screening conditions. Starting from curated ChEMBL~35 bioactivity data, TopU-LBVS covers 93 protein targets across 7 protein classes and constructs target-specific screening libraries with property-matched, structurally similar decoys at a fixed 1:40 active-to-decoy ratio. Libraries contain roughly 400 to 10,000 compounds and are designed to reduce simple physicochemical and nearest-neighbor fingerprint shortcuts. TopU-LBVS provides three fixed protocols. TopU-LBVS-full evaluates ChEMBL$^\ast \rightarrow$ TopU generalization across all 93 targets. TopU-LBVS-low evaluates low-data TopU $\rightarrow$ TopU learning within the hard-negative distribution. TopU-LBVS-mini provides a compact seven-target protocol with a paired random-decoy control that changes only the test decoys, enabling low-cost development and direct measurement of the gap between random ChEMBL$^\ast$ and TopU decoys. Across ten reference baselines spanning fingerprint methods, molecular GNNs, fingerprint hybrids, and modern molecular models, performance under random-decoy evaluation degrades sharply under hard-negative screening. We release data, fixed splits, evaluation code, and baseline implementations for reproducible comparison of future LBVS and molecular representation learning methods. Code and data are available at this https URL and this https URL .

AI.tldr: TopU-LBVS 是一个面向配体虚拟筛选（LBVS）的多靶点基准测试，针对硬负样本（hard-negative）筛选条件构建，基于 ChEMBL 35 数据，涵盖 93 个蛋白靶标、7 个蛋白类别，采用 1:40 活性-诱饵比，并提供三个固定评估协议（full、low、mini）。在十个基线模型上的实验表明，基于指纹的方法（尤其是 Morgan-RF）在硬负样本条件下优于 GNN 和现代预训练模型，且随机诱饵评估会大幅高估性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LBVS 基准测试常因使用随机负样本、简单诱饵、靶标覆盖有限及缺乏标准化评估协议而高估方法性能，无法反映真实硬负样本筛选场景。
AI.method: 构建了 ChEMBL* 标准化数据子集，通过基于六种理化描述符和 MFP3 特征的动态遗传算法结合随机森林硬度审计，为每个靶标构造 1:40 活性-诱饵比的 TopU 硬负样本筛选库；设计了三个固定评估协议（full、low、mini），涵盖十个基线模型（经典指纹、GNN、混合模型、现代预训练模型）。
AI.result: 在 TopU-LBVS-full 上，Morgan-RF 以 9.18 的 EF@1% 表现最佳，优于所有 GNN 和预训练模型；指纹增强可使 GNN 性能提升 2-3 个 EF@1% 点，但仍不及 Morgan-RF；在 mini 控制实验中，随机诱饵与硬负样本之间平均 EF@1% 差距达近 4 倍（21.2 vs 5.5），揭示了随机诱饵评估严重高估性能的问题。
AI.conclusion: TopU-LBVS 是一个更贴近现实硬负样本筛选条件的 LBVS 基准测试，证明在硬负样本环境下学习模型尚不能稳定超越强指纹基线，且随机诱饵评估会大幅误导性能判断。

title: Between the Commits: Process, Error, and Claim Reliability in a Wholly AI-Authored Codebase
summary: We present: (i) a new dataset consisting of the full development history of a 21,000-line Python tool built entirely by Claude AI, with no human-authored code or tests, (ii) two code-provenance tracing tools, (iii) three taxonomies for instruction intent, commit provenance, and response reliability, (iv) application of these to analyse the dataset. We find that: (i) user coding agent CLI instructions differ in kind from IDE-chat instructions, with a greater focus on comprehension, planning and consultation, (ii) code development is mainly proactive, (iii) 14.3% of AI code-generation events contain a real error later caught by the AI-authored test suite, (iv) roughly 1 in 4-5 of the AI's interactive responses contains one or more factual errors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个由Claude AI全程独立开发的21,000行Python项目Extractor，提供了完整的开发数据集、两个代码溯源工具、三套分类法，并分析了AI编码代理的开发过程、代码生成错误率及交互响应的可靠性。核心发现：14.3%的AI代码生成事件包含真实错误，约1/4-1/5的AI交互响应包含事实错误。
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模AI代码数据集主要只有commit/PR级别的元数据，缺乏完整的会话记录和过程性产物（如to-do列表）。这使得评估AI驱动软件开发的可靠性变得困难——无法看到AI在开发过程中自纠正的错误，也无法区分AI可靠与不可靠的声明。作者旨在通过提供一个完整的、全AI编写的代码库数据集及配套分析工具来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1. 数据集：Extractor——一个21,000行Python工具（逆向工程Apple Objective-C二进制中的protobuf描述符），210个commits、25个session、678条用户指令，全部由Claude AI生成，无任何人工代码或测试。2. 两个代码溯源工具：(a) CFG基础块分解 + git log -L追踪，桥接重命名；(b) 会话记录挖掘技术，从工具使用日志中恢复自纠正的代码生成错误。3. 三套分类法：(a) 指令意图分类法（扩展Tang et al.的IDE-chat分类法至CLI多轮场景）；(b) Commit溯源分类法（扩展Swanson的Perfective/Corrective/Adaptive维护分类法）；(c) 响应可靠性分类法（全新）。4. 使用两个独立LLM（Claude和Codex）进行分类，并进行人类校准验证。
AI.result: （1）CLI编码代理指令与IDE-chat指令在性质上不同，更侧重于理解、规划和咨询；（2）代码开发主要是主动性的（Proactive），86-90%的commits和89-90%的代码块源于主动性触发，而非对bug或测试失败的被动反应；（3）14.3%的AI代码生成事件包含真实错误，后被AI自己编写的测试套件捕获；（4）AI交互响应的可靠性：事实报告/验证准确率94.3%，机制解释91.1%，根因诊断89.3%，设计修复提案仅79.4%；总体约1/4-1/5的响应包含至少一处不准确。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了首个完整的全AI编写代码库的开发数据集Extractor，以及代码溯源工具和三套分类法。研究表明，CLI编码代理的使用模式与IDE-chat有显著差异，AI代码开发以主动为主，代码生成错误不可忽视（14.3%），AI响应在事实陈述上较可靠但在设计修复提案上可靠性显著降低。研究强调了编写测试套件对保护AI代码质量的重要性，并为未来AI编码代理的可靠性研究提供了基准和方法论基础。

title: TimeBraid: Unifying Time Series and Language for Understanding and Forecasting
summary: We present TimeBraid, a series of unified time-series and language models that align pretrained language models and pretrained time-series foundation models through interleaved global residual attention layers. Each model inherits knowledge, instruction following, and reasoning from one side, continuous-signal perception and zero-shot forecasting from the other, and fuses the two in a shared representation space where both modalities are understood and generated. We study the design choices that make such unified modeling work: where to align the two representation spaces, how to ground language in temporal structure, how to balance understanding with generation, and how to keep joint optimization stable. The resulting recipe combines a unified prompting scheme for diverse time-series and text tasks, stabilized joint training, and supervision from 2.2M curated series--text pairs and 4.9M instruction-tuning samples. Across benchmarks spanning time-series perception, understanding, reasoning, and both context-aided and unimodal forecasting, TimeBraid remains competitive with far larger general-purpose models and task-specific counterparts.

AI.tldr: TimeBraid 提出了一种统一的时序-语言模型架构，通过三专家（感知/推理/预测）+ 全局残差注意力将预训练语言模型（如 Qwen3）与预训练时序基础模型（如 TimesFM）的原生表征在共享连续空间中对齐融合，以一组权重同时支持时序理解（感知/QA/推理/描述）与时序预测（上下文条件/控制/单模态）双向任务。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型通常把时序数据当成语言或视觉的附属（投影层、数字化、离散词表、渲染图像），引入了表征差距、损伤预训练能力，且只能覆盖单向接口。作者主张把时序作为一等模态，让两者的原生表征在共享空间里对齐并相互生成。
AI.method: 三专家（tri-expert）Mixture-of-Transformers：语言塔（Qwen3）+ 时序塔（TimesFM，感知/预测双塔共享）+ 全局残差注意力（global residual attention）在配对层将两种 token 投到共享宽度 d 做全局因果注意力，按全局时间轴 τ 排序，输出零初始化以保持预训练能力；统一提示用 <ts></ts> 包装时序段，配统计块；两阶段训练：Stage 1 用 2.23M 配对对齐，Stage 2 用 4.88M 指令微调；采用 asinh 鲁棒归一化 + loss capping 稳定联合优化；推理时通过文本引导权重 λ 在时序条件预测与时序+文本条件预测间插值。
AI.result: 在 12 个理解+预测基准上：理解任务（TSAQA 80.65%，TB-MCQ 36.58% vs GPT-5.4 38.50%，CaTS-Bench 描述对齐接近最强 VLM）；上下文预测（Time-MMD 九域最佳平均 MSE rank，CAF 最佳 CRPS，CGTSF 最佳 Macro MSE/MAE）；控制预测 Ctrl-F 43.33% Top-1（远超时间序列基础模型的 33.33% 随机基线）；单模态 GIFT-Eval 与最强专用时序基础模型相当；ETT/Weather 长程预测平均 rank 第二（2.48 MSE）。
AI.conclusion: TimeBraid 证明可以在不量化、不离散化、不图像化的前提下，把连续时序原生表征与语言原生表征在共享连续空间对齐，保留两边的预训练能力，并以一组权重实现时序-语言双向理解与生成；同时通过六个消融问题指出：交互空间应为中立共享空间而非 MLP 投影；感知与预测无需分开时序塔；优化稳定性靠鲁棒归一化+loss capping；文本引导权重 λ 应在验证集固定（λ=0.3）。不足：未做继续预训练，patch tokenization 限制点级数值精度，文本与历史冲突时控制力下降。

title: Benchmarking and Domain Adaptation of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) for Adolescent Health Communication in Ghanaian Languages
summary: This paper presents an end-to-end study of automatic speech recognition (ASR) for adolescent health communication in three Ghanaian languages (Twi, Dagbani, and Ewe). The work proceeds in three connected stages; First, we benchmark five ASR systems (three language-specific Wav2Vec2 models and two multimodal LLMs, Gemma 3n and Gemma 4) on a general-domain Bible corpus and a Youth Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Health (ASRH) Domain ASR dataset, using Character and Word Error Rate (CER, WER). Second, guided by the benchmark, we perform supervised domain adaptation: although Gemma 4 was the strongest zero-shot candidate, fine-tuning it proved computationally infeasible, so we pivoted to the compact Qwen3-ASR-0.6B, fine-tuned on a large Ghana Bible corpus (~90k samples) and evaluated strictly on held-out human-collected in-domain audio. Fine-tuning reduced WER on every language, most dramatically for Ewe (WER from 109.3% to 64.8%, a drop of 44.5 pp; CER from 65.1% to 24.9%). Third, we validate the work through KasaHealth, a live voice-first ASRH application deployed in all three languages, complemented by Senti-Check, a technical evaluation harness. KasaHealth was tested by 50 community respondents and achieved a 100% chat-approval rate, a 72% Good-or-Excellent translation rating, and a 92% would-recommend rate, while surfacing the domain gaps that most constrain real-world use. Across all three stages the evidence converges: for these languages the binding constraint is validated in-domain data, not model capability or computation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对加纳三种语言（Twi、Dagbani、Ewe）中的青少年性与生殖健康（ASRH）领域，开展了端到端的语音识别（ASR）研究。研究通过基准测试、领域自适应微调以及真实应用验证三个阶段，证实了制约这些低资源语言ASR性能的核心瓶颈是经过验证的领域内数据，而非模型能力或算力。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（尤其是应用场景垂直的方言）在通用ASR系统中的识别率较差。青少年健康沟通对准确度要求极高，错误识别可能导致严重的健康后果。然而，针对特定领域（如ASRH）的低资源语言ASR系统研究存在数据匮乏、模型难以落地等挑战。
AI.method:
研究分为三个阶段：
1. **基准测试**：在通用圣经语料库和青少年ASRH领域数据集上，测试了五种ASR系统（三种特定语言的Wav2Vec2模型、Gemma 3n和Gemma 4多模态大语言模型）。
2. **领域自适应微调**：由于Gemma 4微调计算成本过高，改用紧凑的Qwen3-ASR-0.6B模型，在约90k样本的大型加纳圣经语料上进行微调。
3. **实地验证与评估**：通过实际部署的语音优先ASRH应用程序KasaHealth（支持三种语言），辅以技术评估工具Senti-Check，收集50名社区受访者的真实使用反馈。
AI.result:
1. 基准测试阶段，Gemma 4在零样本测试中表现最强，但计算成本过高无法微调。
2. 微调后，Qwen3-ASR-0.6B在所有语言上的WER均显著降低，其中Ewe语效果最为突出：WER从109.3%降至64.8%（下降44.5个百分点），CER从65.1%降至24.9%。
3. 实地验证方面，KasaHealth实现了100%的聊天批准率，72%的翻译获得“良好或优秀”评级，92%的用户愿意推荐该应用，但同时也暴露了真实场景中的领域数据缺口问题。
AI.conclusion: 对于Twi、Dagbani和Ewe等低资源语言，决定ASR系统实际表现的限制性因素是经过严格验证的领域内音频-文本配对数据（in-domain data），而不是模型架构的先进性或计算资源的多寡。该工作强调了为低资源语言构建特定领域（尤其是医疗健康类）数据集的紧迫性。

title: SEEK: Skill-Routed Evaluation with Evolvable Knowledge for Industrial Search
summary: Search quality evaluation provides essential supervision and diagnostic signals for the development and iteration of industrial search systems. Although large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable alternative to manual assessment, reliable automatic evaluation remains challenging: users experience search results at the page level, while the applicable evaluation criteria are multi-dimensional and continuously evolving. Packing all evaluation criteria into a unified prompt introduces irrelevant context and potential criterion interference, whereas internalizing them through post-training tightly couples rule updates with costly model retraining cycles. To address these issues, we propose Skill-routed Evaluation with Evolvable Knowledge (SEEK). Specifically, SEEK externalizes specific search evaluation criteria into a skill bank, dynamically routes relevant skills for each query-result list pair, and employs a task-adapted listwise evaluator to produce page-level judgments and failure mode attribution. A two-stage training pipeline teaches the evaluator to align evaluation criteria with human preferences, while a replay-gated skill bank allows recurring evaluation knowledge gaps to be incorporated without model retraining. Experiments on industrial short-video search show that SEEK improves listwise quality evaluation accuracy and achieves significant progress in attribution diagnosis. SEEK has been deployed at Kuaishou, a short-video platform with over 400 million daily active users, significantly improving the scale and quality of online search evaluation.

AI.tldr: SEEK提出了一种面向工业搜索的"技能路由式评估框架"，通过将多维且持续演化的评估准则外化为可复用的技能库，利用技能路由器为每个查询-结果列表对动态选择相关技能，并结合任务适配的列表式评估器产生页面级质量判定与失败归因。该框架在快手短视频搜索的工业场景中部署，相比人工评估在准确率和效率上均显著提升。
AI.motivation: 工业搜索质量评估面临两大挑战：(1) 用户以页面整体而非单条结果为单位感知搜索质量，传统逐条相关性打分无法捕捉冗余、意图覆盖、来源多样性等页面级交互属性；(2) 评估准则多维且持续演化，将所有准则塞入统一提示会引入无关上下文与准则干扰，而通过后训练将其内化进模型参数又会导致规则更新与代价高昂的模型重训练周期紧密耦合。
AI.method: SEEK遵循"能力-知识分离"原则，包含三大核心组件：(1) 技能库——外化12项跨5个维度（相关性、质量、多样性、权威性、异构性）的评估技能，每项技能由路由描述r_i（何时激活）和操作指导g_i（如何应用）组成；(2) 技能路由器——基于Qwen3-0.6B，对每个查询-列表对估计各技能的激活分数，通过阈值τ=0.5选取相关技能子集；(3) 列表式评估器——基于Qwen3-8B，接收查询-列表与所选技能的操作指导，联合推理产生页面级判定（good/fair/bad）和结构化归因。训练采用两阶段：先由教师模型（Qwen3-235B-A22B）将人类标注转化为路由监督目标和证据驱动的评估轨迹，对路由器用多标签BCE、对评估器用SFT；再用DAPO强化学习，采用分层奖励R(o)=(R_task+λ_s R_skill)e^{-λ_c C_conflict}优化任务正确性、技能诊断质量和跨层级一致性。此外，技能库支持自演化：通过失败归因区分路由错误/技能知识错误/执行错误，仅对反复出现的技能知识错误进行局部修订，并通过新数据提升与历史回放容忍度ε=0.002的门控验证后才部署。
AI.result: 离线实验显示，SEEK（Qwen3-8B）在169,434训练样本/17,000测试样本上，三分类Macro-F1达0.6555、二元Macro-F1达0.7374、归因F1达0.7374，优于SFT+GRPO基线（0.6418/0.7206/0.7206）和GPT-5.6 Sol等更大API模型。消融实验证实动态路由（每实例平均仅激活3.4个技能）优于全技能注入，且与Oracle路由仅差1.6%准确率；SFT+DAPO优于SFT+GRPO和SFT+DPO；分层奖励各组件均有贡献。持续适应实验中，仅更新技能库（模型冻结）经过3轮演化后，Binary F1从0.7862提升至0.7854（仅0.0008回放遗忘），逼近模型微调的效果（0.7786但产生0.0076遗忘）。线上24,000条评估中，SEEK以0.9小时（40.6×加速）达到0.842准确率，优于外包人工评估的0.783（36.5小时）和多轮人工评估的0.830（58.2小时），已部署于快手日活超4亿的搜索评估流水线。
AI.conclusion: SEEK通过将可演化的领域评估知识外化为模块化技能库并与稳定的模型推理能力解耦，为工业列表式搜索评估提供了一条可扩展、可适应的路径。其核心贡献在于：(1) 证明技能路由+技能条件评估优于单提示注入和参数内化；(2) 人类对齐的两阶段训练（SFT+DAPO+分层奖励）有效对齐评估准则；(3) 自演化技能库支持无模型重训练的知识更新且保持历史稳定性；(4) 在快手大规模生产环境中验证了实用价值。该"能力-知识分离"思路可推广至其他需要持续更新领域知识的工业评估与决策任务。

title: Your Transformer Can Hold Two Thoughts at Once: Evidence of Linear Superposition in LLMs
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on highly non-linear components, in this work we demonstrate that they exhibit fundamental linearity: when inputs from distinct text streams are linearly combined, the model outputs a superposition of the individual next-token distributions. We term this the \textit{Superposition Linearity Hypothesis}. We provide evidence that superposition is an intrinsic property of the Transformer architecture rather than an emergent consequence of training; in fact, we observe that it tends to diminish as pretraining progresses. However, we demonstrate that linearity can be substantially restored through lightweight fine-tuning, significantly reducing the divergence between the predicted next-token distribution and the average of the individual next-token distributions. Finally, we introduce a guided decoding procedure that disentangles superposed outputs, enabling the simultaneous generation of two coherent continuations from a single forward pass.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"叠加线性假说"，发现预训练Transformer在输入嵌入线性组合（如逐token平均）下，其输出近似两个独立输入分布的算术平均。预训练会削弱这一内在架构特性，但通过轻量级自蒸馏微调可大幅恢复。最终实现单次前向传播同时生成两路连贯文本，理论推理吞吐量提升2×。
AI.motivation: 尽管Transformer包含自注意力、MLP等强非线性组件，但残差流的层间映射已被证明近似仿射。作者进一步追问：这种线性是否延伸至端到端输入输出行为？即两个文本流的嵌入线性组合后，模型输出是否为两个独立分布的叠加？这关系到能否用单次前向传播实现多流并行推理。
AI.method: （1）将两个文本流嵌入做逐token算术平均，送入冻结预训练模型，对比混合输出分布与两个独立分布算术平均之间的KL/JS/Wasserstein距离及ground-truth token秩排名；（2）沿Pythia预训练轨迹追踪隐藏态叠加误差；（3）采用自蒸馏框架，以独立输出均值为教师目标、最小化KL散度恢复线性；（4）提出Joint Contrastive解码：ℓ̃^(A)=ℓ_large(z)+α·ℓ_small(A)−β·ℓ_small(B)，对称获得ℓ̃^(B)，借助小模型引导分离两流；（5）设计Donor/Attention Patching实验解耦频率先验与注意力结构对信号保留的贡献。
AI.result: （1）预训练模型（160M–8B，涵盖Pythia/Qwen/Llama/OLMo/Gemma）在FineWeb上混合输入下，ground-truth token落入top-10概率达30–40%，top-100达60–65%；KL Ratio ℛ_KL均小于1（约0.31–0.42）；（2）隐藏态叠加误差在预训练起点最小并随训练单调上升；（3）约0.025%数据量微调（200k步）后，Pythia-2.8B KL从1.86降至0.27，ℛ_KL从0.42降至0.06，top-5恢复率从≈30%升至>60%，内容词token中位秩从284降至5；（4）Joint Contrastive解码在LAMBADA上将平均精度从0.065–0.182提升至0.110–0.430，Jaccard重叠显著降低；（5）吞吐接近独立batch（差异<3%），约为串行推理的2×，KV-cache占用降低约一半。但解码精度距单流小模型基线仍有差距，且微调会牺牲单流质量（Pythia-2.8B LAMBADA 0.544→0.357）。
AI.conclusion: Transformer架构具有内在的线性叠加特性，预训练目标虽未显式激励但会随训练削弱该特性。该特性可通过极轻量微调恢复，并经引导解码部分分离两流输出，实现单次前向传播生成两路文本。理论上可获得2×推理吞吐并减半KV-cache内存。主要障碍在于几何平均机制使得从混合分布直接采样天然偏向两流的共同高概率token；完全解耦仍为开放问题。

title: Multi-Task Learning by using Contextualized Word Representations for Syntactic Parsing of a Morphologically Rich Language
summary: We address the challenge of syntactic parsing for Urdu, a morphologically rich language, and present state-of-the-art results for both constituency and dependency parsing. This paper offers four major contributions: 1) the conversion of the CLE-UTB phrase structure treebank into a dependency treebank by developing language-specific head-word and phrase-to-dependency label mapping rules; 2) a novel sequence labeling scheme that transforms the parsing task into a unified representation; 3) the training of contextualized word representations on a large 220 million tokens Urdu corpus collected from the web; and 4) development of parsing framework using two learning paradigms, single-task and multi-task learning. Several post-processing rules are applied to improve the quality of the automatically converted dependency structure treebank. The proposed sequence labeling scheme enables the use of a shared architecture that learns the syntactic structures from both grammatical structures simultaneously and hence improves generalization. Experiments show that the multi-task learning setup significantly enhances parsing performance, achieving an F1 score of 91.39 for constituency parsing (an improvement of 3.29 points) and a labeled attachment score of 85.69 for dependency parsing (an improvement of 1.49 points). These results demonstrate that learning cross-task representations provides measurable benefits and advances the state of syntactic parsing for Urdu.

AI.tldr: 本文针对乌尔都语这一形态丰富语言的句法解析任务，提出了一种统一序列标注框架，在短语结构与依存结构两种语法表示上同时训练，实现显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 乌尔都语作为形态丰富语言，缺乏大规模标注语料与高质量依存树库，且现有句法解析性能受限，亟需一种能同时利用两种语法表示（短语结构与依存结构）相互促进的方法。
AI.method: 1）将短语结构树库通过语言学定制的中心词与短语-依存标签映射规则转换为依存树库，并施加后处理规则；2）提出一种新颖的统一序列标注方案，将两种解析任务映射到同一表征；3）在大规模220M词乌尔都语语料上预训练上下文词表示；4）采用单任务与多任务两种学习范式构建解析框架。
AI.result: 多任务学习设置显著提升解析性能：成分解析F1达91.39（提升3.29分），依存解析LAS达85.69（提升1.49分），均刷新乌尔都语句法解析的当时最优水平。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明跨任务表示学习能为乌尔都语句法解析带来可度量的增益，统一序列标注框架结合多任务学习是推进低资源、形态丰富语言句法解析的有效途径。

title: Cultural Divergence Preservation: Diagnosing Flattening and Caricature in LLM-Simulated Survey Populations
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Workshop on Pluralistic AI & NLP (PANDORA)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic survey respondents to estimate population response distributions. In cross-cultural survey simulation, evaluations should assess not only distributional fidelity within countries but also whether differences across countries are preserved. However, existing distance-based metrics such as Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) do not directly capture such cross-country differences. To address this limitation, we introduce Cultural Divergence Preservation (CDP), a reference-light diagnostic based on a one-time human calibration. CDP identifies reduced cross-country divergence as cultural flattening and increased divergence as cultural caricature. To evaluate CDP, we conduct experiments across four LLM backbones, three persona-based prompting methods, and two survey domains, the World Values Survey (WVS) and the Big Five Personality Test. The results reveal a systematic discrepancy between conventional fidelity metrics and CDP. Controlled experiments show that CDP changes monotonically as cross-country divergence is attenuated or amplified, while the corresponding changes in JSD remain relatively small. In our audit of real LLM generations, DeepPersona-Inspired prompting is frequently favored by conventional fidelity metrics but exhibits the strongest flattening in every model--domain block. CDP thus complements fidelity metrics by directly quantifying the attenuation or amplification of cross-country divergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Cultural Divergence Preservation (CDP) 诊断指标，用于评估 LLM 作为合成调查受访者时是否保留了跨国文化差异。CDP 通过计算合成数据与人类数据在跨国响应分布上的平均 JS 散度比值，识别"文化扁平化"(CDP<100%)和"文化漫画化"(CDP>100%)。研究发现，DeepPersona-Inspired 提示方法在传统保真度指标上表现最佳，却在所有模型-领域组合中呈现出最强的扁平化，而 Cultural Prompting 则倾向于放大跨国差异。
AI.motivation: 现有研究使用 Jensen-Shannon 散度 (JSD) 等距离度量评估 LLM 合成调查分布与人类分布的匹配程度，但这些指标无法直接捕获跨国文化差异是否被保留。合成群体可能在获得相似分布匹配分数的同时，抑制跨国差异（扁平化）或夸大刻板印象（漫画化），这在跨文化研究中是实质性问题。
AI.method: CDP 的核心定义：1) 对每个调查项目计算各国响应分布的等权重心；2) 计算各国分布与重心的平均 JS 散度作为 Cultural Divergence (CD)；3) CDP = CD_synthetic / CD_human × 100%，低于 100% 表示扁平化，高于 100% 表示漫画化。实验覆盖 4 个 LLM 主干（Gemma-3-4B、Qwen3.5-9B/27B、Llama-2-13B）、3 种角色提示方法（Cultural Prompting、PersonaHub-Inspired、DeepPersona-Inspired）、2 个调查领域（世界价值观调查 WVS 和大五人格测试 Big Five）。同时进行受控扰动实验，通过 γ 参数系统性地衰减和放大跨国差异来验证 CDP 的单调响应特性。
AI.result: 主要发现：1) 受控实验证明 CDP 对跨国差异的衰减（γ<1）和放大（γ>1）呈单调响应，而相应引起的 JSD 变化相对真实 LLM 条件下的 JSD 中位数很小；2) 在真实 LLM 生成审计中，DeepPersona-Inspired 在 8 个模型-领域组合中的 6 个获得最低 JSD，却在全部 8 个组合中呈现最强扁平化（CDP: 14-59%）；3) Cultural Prompting 表现为过度发散（CDP: 184-501%），PersonaHub-Inspired 介于两者之间（CDP: 44-99%）；4) 自举检验（2000 次）在 7/8 组合中确认 DeepP-I 扁平化效应具有统计显著性。这些结果揭示了国家层面保真度排名与跨国差异保留排名之间的系统性差异。
AI.conclusion: CDP 作为补充诊断工具直接量化跨国文化差异的衰减或放大，与传统保真度指标形成互补。核心贡献：(1) 引入仅需一次性人工校准的轻量级诊断指标；(2) 通过受控扰动实验证明其单调敏感性；(3) 通过审计 4 个 LLM 与 3 种提示方法在 2 个领域的表现，揭示传统指标偏好的方法可能存在最强扁平化。CDP 的局限性在于：仅衡量跨国差异的幅度而不评估方向对齐；依赖 JSD 作为基础散度导致对 Likert 量表的序数结构不敏感；不能作为通用质量评分；Big Five 仅覆盖 3 个国家，统计推断有限。

title: An Empirical Study of VLM Pipelines for Long-Document QA
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used for long-document processing, where the inputs combine text with charts, tables, figures, and complex layouts. Deploying them means choosing how to feed the document to the model, which retriever to use when only a subset of pages is sent, and whether to run the model agentically or as a static pipeline. We study these choices on two long-document QA benchmarks with both frontier API and open-weight VLMs. First, on MMLongBench-Doc our six-tool agent with page, table, figure, and search calls pays off only once the answering VLM is large enough: with Qwen3.5-4B and 9B it trails static page input, with Qwen3.5-27B it draws level, and with Sonnet 4.5 it leads. On LongDocURL it is level with or ahead of static input at every reader. Its lead over the strongest static pipeline is clearest with the frontier reader on MMLongBench-Doc and narrows to within noise on LongDocURL. Second, retrieval modality matters more than the specific retriever: the strongest image retriever leads the strongest text pipeline, and on the text side a single off-the-shelf cross-encoder rerank essentially matches a much heavier multi-stage LLM pipeline. Top-k image retrieval is also the most token-efficient input at every reader we paired it with, at roughly a seventh to a quarter of the tokens of sending every page. Third, cutting across all three choices, three of our strongest pipelines succeed on different questions, and an oracle that picks the best pipeline per question gains roughly thirteen points over the best single pipeline, though evidence-type routing recovers almost none of it.

AI.tldr: 本文对长文档多模态问答（QA）的部署级设计选择进行了受控的联合实证研究，系统比较了三种架构轴——输入模态、检索方式和智能体访问策略——在两个长文档 QA 基准（MMLongBench-Doc 和 LongDocURL）上，使用 Claude Sonnet 4.5 和 Qwen3.5-{4B, 9B, 27B} 四个 reader 的表现，并报告了精度/成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 随着视觉语言模型（VLM）在长文档处理中的广泛使用，部署者面临输入模态、检索方式和是否采用智能体三种关键设计选择。已有研究通常只针对单一轴进行研究，缺乏在统一可比较框架下对这些选择的联合评估，特别是在前沿 VLM 规模下，精度/成本权衡尚未充分量化。
AI.method: 作者将长文档 QA 系统分解为三个独立可调的设计轴：（1）输入模态 I（原始 PDF、整页图像、抽取文本、Top-k 检索图像）；（2）检索器 R（BM25、BGE-M3、ColQwen2.5、Nem-CE、Cohere 重排序等）；（3）智能体策略 π（单次前向 vs. 多轮工具调用）。提出六工具函数调用智能体（get_catalog, read_pages, get_figure, get_table, search_text, finish）。在 MMLongBench-Doc（135 PDF, 1,082 题）和 LongDocURL（396 文档, 2,325 题）上，使用官方评分器统一评估；引入统一的答案抽取 LLM（Claude Haiku 4.5）和配对 bootstrap 显著性检验。通过 10,000 次重采样计算 95% 置信区间，并分析 per-question oracle 上界。
AI.result: （1）智能体仅在足够大的 reader 下才有优势：在 MMLongBench 上，6 工具 FC 智能体在 Qwen3.5-4B/9B 上落后于静态页输入，在 27B 上持平（+2.8pp, CI 含零），在 Sonnet 4.5 上领先（0.625 vs 0.533, +11.7pp 显著）；在 LongDocURL 上则每档 reader 都持平或领先。（2）检索模态比具体检索器更重要：最强图像检索器 Nem-CE 平均 Hit@5 为 91.4，超过最强文本管道（82.4）约 9pp；单次 cross-encoder 重排序即可匹敌多阶段 LLM 管道 SIRA（82.0 vs 82.4，CI 含零）；Top-k 图像检索在每个 reader 上 token 效率最高，仅为全页输入的 1/7 至 1/4。（3）最强三个管道在不同问题上成功，per-question oracle 比最佳单管道提升约 13pp，但按证据类型路由几乎无法恢复这部分增益；原始 PDF 在长文档上崩溃（-42.6pp）。
AI.conclusion: 研究将发现归纳为决策树：（1）使用前沿 API 时，6 工具函数调用智能体是最高精度配置，token 比全页图像或原始 PDF 少 1.5–7 倍；（2）小型开源 VLM（≤9B）下工具调用是糟糕的权衡，静态图像输入是更好的默认，Top-5 检索以更少 token 匹配全页精度；（3）无法发送图像时，使用布局感知抽取器+单次重排序可匹配多阶段设计；（4）三个最强配置在 per-question oracle 上留下约 13pp 余量，但该余量抵抗基于证据类型的路由——需要更细粒度的 per-question 信号才能恢复。一个小的、精心选择的工具包可以替代更大的多智能体堆栈。

title: When Temporal Perturbations Act Like Sensor Biases: Label-Free Auditing of Wearable Activity Recognizers
summary: Wearable human-activity recognition (HAR) models operate across sensors, subjects, and backbones, yet a smooth waveform may appear temporal while exploiting a persistent sensor offset primarily. We introduce SpectrumAudit, a label-sealed audit that fits a phase-randomized full-window stimulus on calibration windows from subjects held out from training and testing. After selection, it replays its exact DC projection and budget-constrained zero-mean residual on the same frozen victim without refitting. Across 27 victims from three datasets and three backbones, the selected waveforms cause 2.87-40.83-point three-phase robust accuracy losses. Under this replay budget, DC is more damaging than AC on 24/27 victims and recovers at least 90% of the full drop on 22/27; all 5 failures occur on WISDM. In a held-out UTD-MHAD check, the selected waveform causes 13.49-pp accuracy and 11.68-pp macro-F1 losses, versus -0.66 pp for matched random changes. The audit diagnoses offset versus zero-mean variation under a common peak-budget cap. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SpectrumAudit，一种标签密封（label-sealed）的可穿戴人体活动识别（HAR）模型审计方法，通过"先选择后投影"协议诊断看似时序的对抗扰动是否主要由持续的传感器偏置（DC分量）驱动，而非真正的零均值时变内容（AC分量）。
AI.motivation: HAR模型在传感器、受试者和骨干网络之间存在多样性，但一个平滑的波形可能表面上是时序扰动，实际上主要利用了持续的传感器偏置。已有对抗攻击研究只报告攻击成功率，无法揭示失败是由波形哪个分量造成的，缺乏对机制级别的诊断工具。
AI.method: 1）协议设计：标签密封、主题分离的两阶段审计（选择→归因），在冻结受害模型上拟合相位随机化的全窗口刺激并在保持主体分离的校准窗口上进行选择；2）分量回放：选择后不重新拟合，将波形的精确DC投影和预算约束的零均值AC残差在同一冻结受害模型上分别回放；3）匹配控制：设置随机通用、伪标签UAP-CE、标签感知平滑UAP和辅助集成迁移四种控制方法，在同一ℓ∞预算和三项鲁棒测试指标下对比；4）数据集与骨干：PAMAP2、WISDM、USC-HAD三个数据集×三种骨干（FCN、残差CNN、Patch Transformer）×三种随机种子，共27个受害模型，外加UTD-MHAD验证。
AI.result: 在27个受害模型上，选定波形导致2.87–40.83个百分点的三相位鲁棒精度下降；24/27受害模型上DC分量比AC分量更具破坏性，22/27上DC恢复至少90%的完整下降幅度（5个失败均出现在WISDM上）；独立优化的常数控制胜过AC的比例为21/27；UTD-MHAD外验证中选定波形造成13.49 pp精度损失和11.68 pp宏F1损失，而匹配随机波形仅造成-0.66 pp。DC-AC差异的95%聚类自助置信区间为[10.86, 22.06] pp（p=0.0078）。
AI.conclusion: 在评估的任务训练HAR受害模型中，选定失败通常由DC（持续偏置）主导，而非零均值时变内容驱动；平滑的、相位鲁棒的扰动不应被解读为时序证据，除非经过分量匹配回放验证。SpectrumAudit提供了一种标签密封的方式来做出这种区分。当前协议针对可微的、任务训练的受害模型和样本域平滑性，物理感知、黑盒迁移和基础模型骨干是自然的下一步方向。

title: Tracking States or Tracking Cosets? An Algebraic Account of Learned State Tracking
comment: 69 pages including appendices; 9 pages of main text
summary: State tracking requires composing a sequence of updates, but accuracy alone does not reveal what a model has learned. We study neural networks trained to predict the running product of group elements. We identify quotient solutions in Transformers, where models recover the quotient class while predicting nearly uniformly among its members. The reciprocal of class size predicts partial accuracy without a fitted parameter, extending parity-based accounts to non-parity quotients. Our baseline Transformers' predictions change little under prefix reordering beyond the exact-tracking frontier. We prove that, for finite groups under uniform i.i.d. full-group inputs, optimal order-blind exact accuracy converges to the reciprocal of abelianization class size as prefix length grows, consistent with the observed abelianization plateaus. Sequential updates permit more: any partition into right cosets of a subgroup, normal or not, survives sequential updates. In our census of standard Transformers, every recovered coset partition comes from a normal subgroup, whereas parameter-matched recurrent networks pass through both normal and non-normal right-coset stages during training. On $A_5$, we identify low-dimensional subspaces of the recurrent state that encode non-normal cosets. In the three-dimensional cases, coset mean vectors form approximate dodecahedra, and swapping the state components in these subspaces transfers the donor's coset state through a shared input suffix. Our results connect partial accuracy, learning stages, and internal computation through the subgroup cosets that models learn to track.

AI.tldr: 本文研究神经网络在群元素乘积预测任务中究竟学到了什么内部表示。通过代数视角（子群陪集、商群、阿贝尔化），揭示模型常停留在部分状态分辨率：准确识别商群类（如阿贝尔化类），但在类内近乎均匀猜测。同时，类大小的倒数可在无拟合参数下预测部分精度。文章将"状态跟踪"重新定义为对陪集的跟踪而非完整状态，并发现循环网络能学习非正规子群的陪集表示，其隐状态中可形成近似正十二面体几何结构。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多以准确率衡量模型的状态跟踪能力，但准确率无法揭示模型究竟学到了什么内部表示。本文旨在从代数结构角度（商群与陪集）刻画模型真正区分了哪些状态、哪些状态被混淆，从而连接部分精度、学习阶段与内部计算。
AI.method: 在群元素乘积预测任务上训练 Transformer、LSTM、GRU 及 Mamba-2 等模型。理论方面证明阿贝尔化给出无序可恢复信息的边界，并给出阶无关的有限长度收敛界。实验方面通过：1）类内 KL 散度与概率均匀性检验验证"商群类准确但类内均匀"假设；2）输出分布对前缀重排的不敏感性验证 order-blind 特性；3）隐藏状态均值聚类与 SVD 定位陪集编码子空间；4）激活替换干预实验因果验证子空间功能；5）对 LSTM/GRU 进行陪集阶段识别与正十二面体几何拟合。
AI.result: 1) 在 14 个有限群与无限海森堡群上，模型在阿贝尔化处达到稳定平台，类内预测近似均匀，条件精确准确率 = 1/f（f 为阿贝尔化类大小）。2) Transformer 的预测对前缀重排几乎不敏感，与阶盲界理论一致。3) 循环网络（包括 LSTM 与 GRU）可学习非正规子群的陪集阶段，A_5 上发现三阶子群陪集阶段。4) 在 A_5 上 GRU 的三维权值子空间中，20 个陪集均值近似正十二面体顶点；交换该子空间成分可转移供体陪集状态。5) Transformer 中陪集均值子空间仅控制当前读出，无法传播至后续位置。6) Mamba-2 也出现相同部分跟踪现象。
AI.conclusion: 模型学习状态跟踪的对象是子群陪集而非完整状态。准确识别陪集类但在类内均匀分布的"商解"广泛存在于 Transformer；类大小倒数可无参数预测部分精度。循环网络能进入非正规陪集阶段，其内部表示形成与三维不可约表示对应的正十二面体几何。输入分布与训练策略决定模型能否从陪集阶段进一步精化至精确跟踪。陪集作为代数框架统一了部分精度、学习阶段与内部表示三个维度。

title: Beyond Average Safety: Chance-Constrained LLM Fine-tuning
summary: Fine-tuning large language models on new objectives can improve helpfulness, instruction following, or domain-specific performance, but it can also induce regressions on safety-critical prompts. Existing safety-preserving fine-tuning methods typically control average safety loss or use weighted auxiliary penalties, which can obscure rare but severe failures. We propose a chance-constrained formulation for safety-preserving fine-tuning that limits the fraction of safety examples whose degradation relative to a reference model exceeds a prescribed threshold. Because the resulting empirical chance constraint contains a discontinuous indicator, we introduce a differentiable majorization of the violation rate, yielding a tractable conservative constraint. We then develop a constraint-aware gradient descent method that treats the majorized constraint as a safe set in parameter space and minimally modifies the fine-tuning direction to preserve feasibility. The resulting update admits a closed form and produces a tail-aware safety correction that emphasizes examples near or above the degradation threshold. We conduct an extensive set of experiments on harmful fine-tuning across three different tasks and three models and show that our approach consistently outperforms the baselines that exist in the literature. These results suggest that safety preservation in LLM fine-tuning is better viewed as a reliability-constrained optimization problem than as average-risk regularization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于机会约束（chance-constrained）优化的LLM安全保留微调方法，通过可微代理化将不连续的违规率指标转化为可处理的保守上界，并设计闭式约束感知梯度下降方法，使微调在每一步都保持参数空间安全集的可行性。该方法在三个模型（Qwen-3.5 4B/9B、Llama-3.1 8B）和三个高投毒任务（SST-2、AG News、GSM8K）上始终优于现有基线，核心创新在于将安全保护视为尾部可靠性约束而非平均风险正则化。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全微调方法（如加权辅助惩罚、KL正则化等）仅控制安全数据集上的平均退化，无法控制严重但罕见的失败比例。命题2.1证明：满足平均安全约束的模型仍可能使显著比例的安全样本发生严重退化。因此需要将安全保留视为可靠性约束而非辅助目标。
AI.method: 1）将安全保留建模为机会约束：限制相对参考模型退化超过阈值τ的安全样本比例不超过α；2）由于指标函数不连续，引入可微代理函数ϕ_β（如单边斜坡函数或指数函数）得到保守可微上界g_β(θ)≤0；3）采用基于控制屏障函数的约束感知梯度下降，将g_β(θ)≤0视为参数空间安全集，通过求解单约束QP闭式修正名义SFT梯度d*(θ)=−∇L_SFT−λ*(θ)∇g_β，保证前向不变性；4）指数代理与熵风险联系，斜坡函数与CVaR类似，实现尾部感知安全修正。
AI.result: 主结果（投毒比p=0.5）显示，在三个模型三个任务九个配置中，HS和HS_qK分位数均处于最低或接近最低水平，且与对齐模型安全水平统计无显著差异。SST-2和AG News上低伤害不牺牲任务精度（仅落后最佳基线数个百分点）；GSM8K上是唯一在保持对齐基线伤害的同时恢复任务精度的防御方法，Qwen-3.5-9B上甚至超越无防御SFT精度。投毒比扫描（p∈{0.05,0.1,0.25,0.5}）显示伤害近似与投毒比无关，对超参数τ,α在两个数量级范围内鲁棒。计算开销约为SFT的2.01倍（Qwen 3.5 4B），可通过原始-对偶重述降至标准正则化成本但牺牲每步可行性保证。与Antibody组合在GSM8K上取得所有配置最低后攻击HS。
AI.conclusion: 安全保留应被建模为可靠性约束优化而非平均风险正则化：通过可微代理化将机会约束转化为可处理问题，并利用基于控制屏障函数的闭式安全滤波器在每步保证安全可行性。该方法在尾部感知性、约束满足性和任务效用三者间取得优越平衡，验证了从均值安全损失转向受控安全退化率视角的实用价值。

title: Learning Better Reasoning for Generative Recommendation with Semantic IDs
summary: Generative recommendation reformulates item retrieval as sequence generation, allowing a unified model to directly generate the next item from a user's interaction history. Semantic IDs further make this paradigm effective and scalable by representing each item as discrete codes, enabling knowledge sharing among semantically related items. Recent studies introduce explicit reasoning before Semantic-ID generation, helping models summarize user interests and infer possible preference transitions. However, reasoning is not inherently beneficial: Inaccurate or uninformative reasoning may mislead subsequent item generation and ultimately degrade recommendation performance. This raises a central challenge: how can a recommender select and learn effective reasoning traces and progressively evolve toward better reasoning from its own generations? In this work, we propose Evo-Rec, a three-stage framework for learning better reasoning and further enhancing it through reinforcement learning. First, we align Semantic IDs with their textual and behavioral contexts, enabling the model to understand and generate item identifiers. Second, we sample multiple candidate reasoning traces and retain those that improve the prediction of the ground-truth item, providing a stronger reasoning initialization through supervised fine-tuning. Third, we further optimize the reasoning policy through reinforcement learning with catalog-constrained item generation and ranking-aware recommendation feedback. Experiments on three Amazon Review benchmarks show that Evo-Rec consistently outperforms discriminative, generative, and reasoning-enhanced recommenders across all evaluation metrics. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework in learning better reasoning for SID-based generative recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Evo-Rec框架,通过三阶段训练(SID-语言对齐、Best-of-N拒绝采样SFT、排序感知强化学习)解决生成式推荐中推理质量低的问题,在三个Amazon Review基准上显著优于判别式、生成式及推理增强推荐方法。
AI.motivation: 现有推理增强推荐模型忽视了推理轨迹质量的重要性:不准确或无信息量的推理会误导后续物品生成,降低推荐性能。同时,基于精确匹配的稀疏奖励信号无法有效优化推荐排序,如何识别并持续优化有效推理轨迹成为核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出三阶段Evo-Rec框架:(1)多任务SID-语言对齐,将语义ID与文本和行为上下文关联;(2)Best-of-N拒绝采样SFT,对每个交互历史采样K个候选CoT,用目标SID似然增量Δ作为预测效用评分,选择最高正效用轨迹进行监督微调;(3)基于GRPO的排序感知强化学习,通过前缀树约束beam search生成完整目录排序,以NDCG@10作为奖励优化推理策略。
AI.result: 在Games、Office、Industrial三个Amazon Review数据集上,Evo-Rec在所有指标上均优于基线。在Games数据集上,Recall@5从0.0710提升至0.0847(+19.3%),NDCG@10从0.0563提升至0.0746(+32.5%)。消融实验表明Best-of-N排序选择优于随机选择和简单拒绝采样(+27.1%/37.1%),NDCG奖励优于精确匹配和前缀匹配奖励。强化学习后推理长度自发缩短,Games上R@1相对提升333%。
AI.conclusion: Evo-Rec证明了推理质量是推理增强生成推荐的关键瓶颈。通过预测效用排序选择高质量推理轨迹进行SFT初始化,再结合排序感知强化学习进行优化,可有效提升推荐性能。核心原则是:推荐推理不仅要生成,更应根据其下游推荐效用进行选择和优化。有效推理取决于信息效率而非长度。

title: From Interests to Semantic IDs: Retrieval-Grounded Credit Assignment for Generative Recommendation
summary: Semantic IDs (SIDs) encode each catalog item as a short token sequence, enabling generative recommenders to predict the next item autoregressively. Reasoning-enhanced variants, an increasingly common extension, first generate a textual trace and then decode a next-item SID by beam search. Such recommenders are commonly trained with group-relative policy optimization under an exact-match SID reward, which is sparse in large catalogs. Two failure modes follow. When all rollouts in a group miss the target, the group yields zero advantage and no learning signal. Rollouts sharing the same SID reward receive identical advantages, however much their traces differ. In both cases the reward reflects only the decoded SID, never the reasoning that produced it. This creates a credit-assignment gap. We address this gap with retrieval-grounded query attribution. Each trace is structured into a history summary, a set of interest hypotheses, and a final SID. A frozen retriever executes every hypothesis as a catalog query, so that each hypothesis becomes independently verifiable rather than judged only through the final SID. A rollout is rewarded when any of its queries retrieves the target within the \mbox{top-$K$}, and per-query hit indicators localize that reward to individual hypotheses. Credit is thus assigned at the span level: only hypotheses that individually hit receive positive retrieval advantage, while the retrieval channel never updates the final SID span. Rollouts that share a SID reward can therefore receive different updates. Across experiments on three Amazon Reviews datasets, this yields consistent improvements in SID recommendation. On Video Games, an oracle analysis further reveals the potential of interest-conditioned SID decoding: selecting the target-relevant query among generated interests improves both recall and ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出检索增强的查询归因方法来解决推理增强生成式推荐器中稀疏且无语义反馈的SID奖励导致的信用分配问题，通过将每个推理轨迹分解为可独立验证的兴趣假设并以检索命中作为奖励信号，显著提升了SID推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 基于语义ID(SID)的生成式推荐器在采用GRPO训练时面临两个核心问题：1)当组内所有rollout都未命中目标时，优势为零，无学习信号；2)共享相同SID奖励的rollout获得相同优势，无论其推理过程差异如何。这是由于奖励仅反映最终解码的SID，从未反映产生它的推理过程，造成了信用分配缺口。
AI.method: 方法核心是"检索增强的查询归因"：1)将每个推理轨迹结构化为历史摘要、兴趣假设集合和最终SID三部分；2)使用冻结的检索器将每个兴趣假设作为目录查询执行，使其可独立验证；3)当任何查询在top-K中检索到目标时给予奖励，按查询命中指标将奖励定位到各个假设；4)仅单独命中的假设获得正向检索优势，而检索通道从不更新最终SID跨度的参数。
AI.result: 在三个Amazon Reviews数据集上的实验显示SID推荐性能有持续提升。在Video Games数据集上的oracle分析揭示了兴趣条件SID解码的潜力：在生成兴趣中选择与目标相关的查询可以同时改善召回率和排序性能。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强的查询归因方法有效解决了推理增强生成式推荐器中的信用分配问题，通过将奖励与可验证的中间推理步骤绑定，使得具有相同SID结果的rollouts能够获得不同的更新信号，从而提升模型的学习效率和推荐性能。

title: Automated Regulatory Compliance Question Answering in Financial Services with Domain-Adapted Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Financial institutions operate under dense, frequently amended rulebooks, and answering a compliance question correctly requires not only fluency but verifiable grounding in the authoritative text. Large language models are attractive for this task, yet the models that firms can realistically deploy on-premise are compact ones, and compact models hallucinate obligations. We study whether a carefully domain-adapted retrieval-augmented generation pipeline closes that gap. Our retriever is built in three stages on top of LegalBERT: entailment tuning that recasts question--passage matching as premise--hypothesis reconstruction, contrastive tuning with in-batch negatives, and score-level fusion with BM25. Our generator is a compact model (2B--12B parameters) served under 4-bit quantization, either prompted or adapted with retrieval-aware fine-tuning (RAFT) through LoRA. On ObliQA, a question-answering benchmark built from the Abu Dhabi Global Market rulebooks, the staged retriever raises Recall@10 from 0.256 to 0.774 and outperforms BM25 (0.678) and E5-large-v2 (0.758), the strongest general-purpose dense encoder we tested. RAFT-LoRA then improves the composite RePASs answer-quality score for every model we could adapt, with the largest gain on the weakest one. However, the adapted models do not transfer to Australian case-law questions, and a closed-book model that receives no passages at all scores within 0.011 RePASs of the full pipeline while producing answers that cite nothing and misstate obligations. The retrieval gain is therefore measured directly, the generation gain is a gain in RePASs rather than demonstrated grounding, and grounding itself requires an evaluation protocol that RePASs does not provide.

AI.tldr: 本文针对金融机构在内部部署条件下的合规问答任务，构建了一个领域自适应的检索增强生成（RAG）流水线：检索端在 LegalBERT 上依次进行蕴含调优、对比调优和与 BM25 的分数级融合；生成端使用 2B–12B 参数的紧凑模型并通过 RAFT-LoRA（QLoRA）进行适配。基于泄漏自由重构的 ObliQA 基准，检索 Recall@10 由 0.256 提升至 0.774，超越 BM25（0.678）与 E5-large-v2（0.758）；RAFT-LoRA 在所有可稳定适配的模型上都提升了 RePASs 分数。然而该流水线存在三大负面结果：适配器无法跨域迁移（ADGM → 澳大利亚判例法）、RePASs 不能有效衡量"接地性"（闭卷模型与完整流水线仅差 0.011 RePASs，却不引用任何条款并错述义务），以及数据集与评估指标方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 金融机构受密集且频繁修订的规则约束，合规问答不仅要求语言流畅，更要求答案可追溯、可验证于权威文本。然而可本地部署的紧凑模型易产生幻觉（hallucination），现有 RAG 流水线在监管文本上面临词汇重叠高、通用稠密编码器难以区分相似条款的难题；且评估指标 RePASs 能否真正衡量"接地性"（grounding）尚未被验证。
AI.method: 方法分为检索与生成两阶段。检索阶段以 LegalBERT 为基础，依次进行三阶段适配：(1) 蕴含调优（ET），将问句改写为声明，将问句-段落匹配重构为前提-假说重构任务，采用 β=0.8 的高掩码率 MLM；(2) 对比调优（CT），使用带内负样本的 MNRL 损失（不使用难负样本挖掘）；(3) 与 BM25 在分数层进行线性融合（α=0.8），并加入分数阈值与间隔过滤。生成阶段使用 2B–12B 紧凑模型在 4-bit NF4 量化下服务，比较 zero-shot、few-shot、few-shot+CoT 三种提示方法与 RAFT-LoRA（QLoRA，r=16，作用于 q_proj/v_proj）。数据集方面对 ObliQA 进行文档级泄漏自由重划分（丢弃 989 个多段落问题），并将 Open Australian LegalQA 转换为相同模式。评估指标采用 Recall@10/MRR@10/nDCG@10 与 RePASs（Es-Cs+OCs 复合）及其分量。
AI.result: 检索方面：ObliQA 上 LegalBERT 基线 R@10 为 0.256，经 ET（0.495）→ CT（0.732）→ 与 BM25 融合（0.774）三阶段后超越 BM25（0.678）、BGE-M3（0.711）、BGE-base-en-v1.5（0.719）、E5-base-v2（0.721）、E5-large-v2（0.758）等基线；Open Australian LegalQA 上从 0.190 提升至 0.923（ET 贡献最大）。生成方面：RAFT-LoRA 对 Qwen2.5-7B、Teuken-7B v0.6、Gemma-2-2B 三模型均提升 RePASs（+0.057、+0.040、+0.072），主要源于义务覆盖率上升与矛盾率下降；Gemma-3-12B 与 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-8B 因适配不稳定被排除。跨域迁移方面：在澳大利亚判例法上，仅 Teuken 保留增益（0.559→0.586），Qwen 与 Gemma-2 均下降，原因是适配器学习的是 ADGM 义务型回答形态而非领域无关的拒答能力。闭卷控制方面：Qwen 闭卷得 0.657 vs RAG 0.668，Teuken 闭卷 0.662 vs RAG 0.673（差距约 0.011），表明 RePASs 不能有效区分接地答案与流畅但无引用的答案。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出三项核心结论：(1) 领域自适应检索有效——小型编码器经分阶段适配后在监管文本上同时超越强词汇基线与更大规模通用稠密编码器；(2) RAFT-LoRA 在域内能改善紧凑生成器，但仅限域内——ADGM 适配器无法迁移到澳大利亚判例法，跨监管框架部署应规划规则集专属的 RAFT 数据而非复用适配器；(3) 当前评估指标会严重低估检索价值——闭卷模型与完整流水线 RePASs 仅相差 0.011，因此合规系统不能仅依赖 RePASs，需配合闭卷基线、引文归因或人类专家评估。文章强调：检索对透明度与可追溯性不可或缺，但监管 NLP 需要能显式度量这些属性的评估协议。

title: Low-Cost Assays for Measuring Model Behavior Across Vendors and Releases
comment: 6 pages. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Language models advise people, keep them company, and write software while they sleep. Measuring what they do is hard: behavior has to be sampled repeatedly across models, prompts and releases, most of it lives in unstructured text that has to be coded before it can be counted, and the result has to be legible and rigorous enough to meaningfully compare models and vendors. To address these constraints, we present a simple, cheap, scalable, and replicable model for studying model behavior. Each study is a frozen, public stimulus run identically on a cross-vendor panel, at a few dollars per model or less. Each reads its transcripts one of three ways, chosen by how much interpretation the behavior needs: exact match on a clamped reply, a codebook applied by LLM judges whose agreement with a human coder is reported per code, and an instrumented environment that records what an agent did independently of what it said. Run across four years of model releases from both frontier and open-source labs, these instruments find four things. Convergence: asked to pick a word, 27 of 44 models answer serendipity at least once in four tries. Resistance: a trailing "right?" moves endorsement by up to 32 points, and the sign flips from sycophantic to resistant as generations advance, keyed to the tag's surface form. House: whether a model holds a position under pressure tracks its generation, and how it holds tracks the lab that built it. Account: told to do something the documentation in their repository contradicts, some coding agents never went along silently and others always did, and the same model can change with the harness it runs in. Re-run on every release, batteries like these track how behavior is changing across vendors and over time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套低成本、可复制的模型行为测量框架，通过冻结的公共刺激在跨厂商模型面板上运行，并采用三种分析方式（精确匹配、LLM 评判员编码、工具化环境记录）来评估模型行为。四年的测量发现了四个核心现象：模型行为的趋同化、对用户确认性提问从谄媚转向抵抗的趋势、不同厂商在坚持立场时的"房屋"特征，以及编码代理在执行与文档相矛盾任务时表现出的差异。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型基准主要衡量能力或红队攻击下的表现，而缺乏对模型日常行为（如在压力下的反应、对无正确答案问题的回应、以及自主完成任务时的报告）的系统性测量方法。模型行为具有随机性，需要跨模型、提示和上下文重复采样，并随着新模型的发布再次采样；大多数值得测量的行为存在于非结构化文本中，需要人工编码才能计数；测量结果需要足够清晰和严谨，才能在模型和厂商之间进行有意义的比较。
AI.method: 提出"检测组件（assays）"框架：每个研究使用一个冻结的公共刺激，以相同方式在跨厂商模型面板上运行。分析方式根据行为所需解读量分三种：（1）Clamped：对受限回复进行规范化令牌的精确匹配，无需模型参与；（2）Coded：对开放回复使用人工构建的代码本，由多家 LLM 评判员应用，以盲法人工核查每个代码（与人类编码员的一致性 Cohen's κ 为 0.80–0.87，自我引用为 0.54）；（3）Instrumented：在工具化环境中运行代理，环境独立于其言语记录其行为。单轮和对话检测通过统一 API 在温度 1.0、关闭推理模式下运行，代理检测以全自动模式运行，每个模型成本中位数三美分至两美元。
AI.result: 跨四年模型发布获得四项初步发现：（1）趋同化（Convergence）：在 44 个模型中，27 个在四次尝试中至少一次回答"serendipity"，占所有答案的 41%；类别提示趋同更强（"oak"占树的 94%，"hammer"占工具的 94%）；后期模型更具从众性，但在最新旗舰模型上趋势部分逆转；在 44 种语言中，每种语言都有自己的"serendipity"（如天空、太阳、和平、猫等）。（2）抵抗（Resistance）：在 45 个模型中，标签效应从 +32 到 -32 个百分点不等；每一系列中效应随代际从正向转为负向（GPT 从 +4 到 -28，Claude 从 +7 到 -32，Qwen 从 +16 到 -11）；将"right?"替换为"maybe?"则同意率在 45/45 模型中超过中性框架，平均上升 19.6 个百分点。（3）坚持（House）：最老的 1/3 模型在压力下 43% 屈服，自 2025 年中以来发布的模型 23% 屈服；17 个代码中有 6 个按厂商分类，发布日期无法解释差异——Anthropic 模型善于命名用户感受和警告后果，Google 模型引用自身性质或规则并道歉，Meta 模型质疑计划，OpenAI 模型的特征是上述行为的反面。（4）报告（Account）：14 个配置中，无声接受用户与文档矛盾的说法差异巨大——Claude Code、Opus 5 等从未如此，Codex 和 Gemini 3.5 Flash 则每次都如此；同一模型在不同运行环境中表现不同（Gemini 3.5 Flash 在 Gemini CLI 中 3/6 同意，在 OpenCode 中 6/6 同意）。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献在于提供了一种简单、廉价、可扩展、可复制的模型行为测量方法。固定回合和简短评分规则使其成本低廉：冻结刺激消除了为每个模型设计新提示的需要，而精确匹配、引用代码或差异与消息的比较消除了昂贵读者的需要。简单工具仍能在厂商和代际间区分模型：在 44 个模型中发现的单一文化、每个系列内的符号翻转、坚持立场时的厂商签名以及代理言行之间的差距，均来自廉价工具。以此价格且无需实验室自评，研究模型行为可以成为一件普通的事情。

title: Canopy: Exploiting Piecewise Smooth Tree Priors for Multi-Fidelity Bandits
summary: Many LLM inference problems, including model routing, prefix-cache management, prompt trimming, and test-time search, can be viewed as optimization over a tree.
