This structure arises naturally from autoregressive generation: every prefix defines a node, and its continuations form a subtree below it. Internal nodes of the tree provide cheap but biased estimates of a region's value, while leaf evaluations are expensive but accurate. Hierarchical bandit methods can exploit this structure, but typically require a specific smoothness schedule to be specified in advance, even though real objectives are often only piecewise smooth and their optima may lie near sharp boundaries. We introduce CANOPY, a multi-fidelity tree bandit that learns where the smoothness prior is valid rather than assuming it globally. CANOPY uses cheap random-path probes to construct an online certificate of local aggregation bias, then directs expensive leaf evaluations toward cells where the certificate detects a smoothness violation. We prove fixed-budget and regret guarantees whose additional cost is additive in the number of discontinuities, recovering the smooth-tree rate when no violations are present and approaching structure-blind search as violations become dense. Across routing, top-$k$ identification, test-time search, caching, and prompt trimming, CANOPY consistently improves matched-budget performance, including $2.9\times$ higher top-10 recall on a 1000-model pool, $1.6\times$ more SWE-bench Verified issues resolved than best-of-$N$, and $3.6\times$ lower median time-to-first-token with prefix caching.

AI.tldr: CANOPY是一个多保真度树形老虎机算法，通过数据驱动的方式在线认证局部平滑性，避免假设全局光滑性调度。它利用廉价的随机路径探针构建聚合偏差的在线证书，将昂贵的叶节点评估引导至检测到平滑性违反的单元。文章提供了固定预算和遗憾保证，并在五个LLM推理任务（路由、top-k识别、测试时搜索、缓存、提示修剪）上验证了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的分层老虎机方法需要预先指定平滑性调度，但实际目标往往只是分段平滑，最优解可能位于尖锐边界附近。CANOPY旨在通过数据学习平滑性先验的有效区域，而非全局假设，从而更有效地处理LLM推理中的多种优化问题。
AI.method: CANOPY包含三个核心组件：1) 基于log-sum-exp和噪声去卷积的数据驱动聚合偏差证书，使用empirical-Bernstein界将随机路径探针转换为高概率上界；2) 不连续性引导的自适应采样技术，仅在证书失败的区域花费昂贵评估；3) 成本预算框架，将模型路由、前缀缓存和测试时搜索统一为多保真度树优化问题。理论上使用树-Lipschitz假设和色散条件，假设除K个不连续点外函数是分段Lipschitz的。
AI.result: 在12个公开基准上，CANOPY在匹配预算下持续改进性能：1000模型池上top-10召回率提高2.9倍；SWE-bench Verified上解决率比best-of-N高1.6倍；vLLM前缀缓存使中位TTFT降低3.6倍；Mooncake生产轨迹上比LRU多重用78%的块；τ-bench中4/5次重复中超越平坦学习器。证明结果显示复杂度H_edge = c₀ + Σc_ℓ·h_k，在违反稀疏时接近结构盲搜索。
AI.conclusion: CANOPY证明了模型路由、前缀缓存管理、提示修剪、top-k识别和测试时搜索共享共同结构：具有廉价偏差探针和昂贵无偏叶评估的预算树形老虎机。该框架在探针廉价且违反稀疏时优于结构盲搜索，并成功将多种LLM推理优化问题统一为同一多保真度树优化问题。未来可扩展到度量空间、球面嵌入层次和DAG结构。

title: Era by Eon: Benchmarking Enterprise Agents on Hidden Knowledge
summary: In the Era by Eon benchmark, each question states the rules for its answer, and code computes the answer from a generated company's data. When agents can run code, the four strongest models each answer 22 to 25 of 27 such questions, so the benchmark barely separates them. We add eight question templates that depend on hidden facts. No question or document states a hidden fact, and the records that seem to hold it show something else. Other data implies it. For example, the sales system says a customer dropped a purchase because of timing. On a recorded call, the customer blames an outage. For each generated company, code fills each template and computes an exact answer without a language model. We evaluate 12 agents. Each pairs a model with an agent program, which connects it to the company's systems. The best agent answers 18 of its 24 attempts, three per question, correctly. Four of the six models answer at most 6 of 24 with any program. The hardest questions require picking one of several similar records, such as which of three renewal offers a customer signed. All agents together answered two such questions correctly in only 1 of 84 attempts.

AI.tldr: 本文在 Era by Eon 基准上新增了 8 个依赖"隐藏知识"的问题模板,这些问题的关键事实未被任何问题或文档直接陈述,需从通话记录、相似记录间的细微证据或旧报告中推断。最佳智能体在 24 次尝试中仅正确 18 次,且代码执行能力在此类问题上几乎没有帮助。
AI.motivation: 现有的企业智能体基准在"可计算问题"上已接近饱和——最强模型借助代码执行几乎都能答对,基准失去区分能力。需要一类更难、更贴近真实业务场景的问题来衡量智能体的深层推理能力。现实中许多业务答案并不在显式记录中,而是隐含于通话、报告或多个相互矛盾的记录之间。
AI.method: 1. 提出"隐藏知识"概念:答案依赖的事实既未在问题或文档中陈述,也未在问题指向的记录中直接显示,但可从其他数据中推导。2. 设计 8 个问题模板,分为三类:(a) 通话中的一句话暗示真实规则(4 个);(b) 多个相似记录中只有一个才是公司实际依赖的(3 个);(c) 旧报告中蕴含的计算方法(1 个)。3. 全流程由代码基于种子数据确定性地生成公司、选择对象、注入线索、计算标准答案,不依赖语言模型。4. 评估 6 个模型 × 2 个智能体程序(Era 与 LangGraph)共 12 个智能体,每题 3 次运行。
AI.result: 最佳智能体(Claude Fable 5.1 + Era 程序)答对 18/24 次;GPT-6 Astra 答对 12–13 次;其余 4 个模型最多答对 6 次。最难的 2 道题(从多个相似记录中挑选正确的一份)所有智能体合计 72 次尝试中仅答对 1 次。代码执行能力对此类问题几乎无帮助(Claude Fable 5.1:有代码 15 次,无代码 18 次)。智能体倾向于快速给出一个看似合理的值而非深入检索。
AI.conclusion: 代码执行能力解决了"可计算问题"的瓶颈,但对于"隐藏知识"问题,智能体需要的是判断"公司实际依赖哪条记录、适用哪条规则"的能力,这是单纯读取和计算无法获得的。当关键证据仅为日期、字段标记等细微线索时,所有智能体都几乎失败。下一步应构建一个存储这类"员工常识"的书面知识库,并量化它能弥补多少差距。

title: KernelOPT: Dispatch-Aware Agentic Search for GPU Kernel Optimization
summary: Deep learning inference and training performance depends critically on GPU kernel efficiency. Modern compilers such as PyTorch Inductor automatically generate GPU kernels from high-level model code, but frequently underperform expert-written implementations by wide margins. Recent LLM-assisted kernel optimizers can close this gap for standalone kernels, yet treat compiled models as black boxes, generally optimizing individual standalone kernels without respecting the compiler's structural decisions or verifying the model end-to-end. We present KernelOPT, a multi-agent system that treats compiled models as structured artifacts. It preserves vendor library calls (cuBLAS, cuDNN) and exclusively targets generated Triton sub-kernels using five profiling-guided LLM agents. A four-gate verification cascade of static validation, multi-seed correctness, model-level float64-fallback verification, and performance gating filters candidates during optimization and verifies the re-stitched model end-to-end. If no candidate passes all four gates, the system preserves the compiler baseline. The system accepts PyTorch this http URL , standalone Triton kernels, and Helion kernels. Evaluated on 250 KernelBench problems, KernelOPT achieves geometric mean speedups over \texttt{ this http URL } of 1.40$\times$ (Level 1: 51/100), 1.15$\times$ (Level 2: 31/100), and 1.07$\times$ (Level 3: 12/50) across all problems.

AI.tldr: KernelOPT是一个多智能体LLM系统，通过保留cuBLAS/cuDNN调用并仅优化PyTorch Inductor生成的Triton子内核，结合NCU性能分析引导和四阶段验证级联，在250个KernelBench问题上相比torch.compile实现了1.40×(L1)、1.15×(L2)和1.07×(L3)的几何平均加速。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM辅助内核优化器将编译模型视为黑盒，单独优化独立内核而不尊重编译器的结构决策或端到端验证模型；作者认为编译器生成的代码具有应被利用的结构性偏差（dispatch决策通常合理，真正次优的是剩余的Triton代码），因此提出基于该结构信息的调度感知优化方法。
AI.method: 系统采用五智能体LangGraph架构（Profiler、Strategy Analyst、Planner、Executor、Summarizer），通过Inductor感知合成（正则检测extern_kernels并保留cuBLAS/cuDNN）分离可优化Triton子核，使用ncu --set full分析进行瓶颈分类（memory-bound/compute-bound/underutilized/near-optimal），以UCB(c=1.4)执行profiling-guided波束搜索（含meltdown检测器防止搜索停滞），四门验证级联（静态验证→多种子正确性→模型级float64回退验证→性能门控γ=1.03），并将优化后的子核重缝（re-stitch）到完整模型中进行端到端验证。
AI.result: 在250个KernelBench问题（100 L1 + 100 L2 + 50 L3）和20个教程内核上，使用单个NVIDIA H200 GPU和Claude Sonnet 4.6，KernelOPT相比torch.compile(max_autotune)实现：L1几何平均1.40×（51/100优化）、L2 1.15×（31/100）、L3 1.07×（12/50），零回归；最大加速来自算法级改写（L1-012对角矩阵乘法88.63×、L1-015下三角20.26×、L2-018算子融合33.11×），85次回退中72%源于cuBLAS/cuDNN主导；消融实验表明Inductor感知合成最关键（禁用后L2优化为零），性能门控贡献84%优化、波束搜索和NCU分析各贡献74%。
AI.conclusion: 编译器生成的结构是LLM驱动内核优化的强有力归纳偏差；通过保留供应商库dispatch并聚焦LLM精力于Triton子核，结合严格的四门验证级联，系统能保证输出不退化编译器基线；当前限制包括依赖NCU性能计数器权限、~60K tokens/NCU提示限制了后端选择、仅支持单GPU推理；未来方向包括优化供应商库配置、将250条优化轨迹作为SFT语料训练开放权重模型，以及建立跨工具统一基准进行头对头评估。

title: How Reproducible Are Evaluation Conclusions? A Self-Audit of LLM-Inferred Prompt Structure
comment: 13 pages. Previously submitted to TAE (Trust-AI-Eval), a NeurIPS 2026 workshop
summary: Evaluations of LLM systems routinely average over small prompt sets and report models as a ranked table. We ask how much confidence such a table deserves, using LLM-based prompt-structure inference as the case study: eight open model variants across five families and 8B to 675B parameters, caching disabled, 293 raw intermediate representations persisted. The measured phenomenon is unstable to begin with. Identical calls do not reliably recover identical structure, with mean node-set Jaccard from 0.39 to 0.96 and 72% of prompt-model cells never node-set-perfect. Auditing the evaluation weakens its conclusions further, and this is our main contribution. Under a joint cluster bootstrap over prompts, only the bottom of the ranking is firm: the two least reproducible models hold rank in 99% and 86% of replicates, the middle four in 27% to 48%, and the top two in 68% each, so the table identifies the worst model reliably but does not reliably identify the best. Two equally defensible rules for merging repeated campaigns change four of eight rows and move the study-wide headline by 7 percentage points. Checking the inferred structure against ground-truth annotations shows reproducibility cannot be read as accuracy. And four of the eight endpoints were withdrawn within ten weeks of measurement, so the study as specified can no longer be run. Small-sample LLM evaluations can therefore look far more definitive than their evidence supports. We recommend reporting rank stability, per-cell provenance, executed sensitivity comparisons, raw per-run outputs, and a measurement date alongside any ranking.

AI.tldr: 作者对一项基于8个LLM变体的"提示结构推断可复现性"评估进行了自我审计，发现被测现象本身不稳定（节点集Jaccard在0.39–0.96之间，72%的单元格从未达到节点集完全一致），且原评估的排名结论在联合聚类自助法、合并规则变化等多种检验下大部分不成立——8项主张中只有"gpt-oss:120b是最不可复现的模型"这一条稳健可靠。此外，10周内有10/15的模型端点被下架，原研究已无法按原样复现。论文主张小型LLM评估呈现出的确定性远超其证据所能支撑，并提出应同时报告排名稳定性、逐单元格溯源、执行敏感性比较、原始逐次输出以及测量日期。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM系统评估普遍依赖少量提示样本求平均并以排序表形式呈现，但这种"看上去很确定"的结论所能获得的置信度究竟有多高？作者以LLM提示结构推断为案例，将审计方法学同样施加于自己的评估之上，揭示一个具体失败机制在多大程度上威胁基于排序的基准报告。
AI.method: 以LLM提示结构推断为案例任务——给定一段含//@rule标注的提示，要求模型输出含typed nodes的IR；对8个开源模型变体、关闭缓存、R∈[2,5]次重复推理，缓存禁用并持久化293个原始IR。在三个维度上施加自我审计：(1)测量层稳定性——按节点集Jaccard与ID-stability量化逐次调用一致性，并对漂移按id-label/count/metadata三类分解；(2)结论层审计——联合聚类自助法（每次重抽同一提示多重集、对全部模型打分、重排序）估计每个排名位置的保持率，并执行合并优先规则敏感性比较；(3)时间层审计——重查所有端点，记录下架日期与HTTP 410状态码。补充了一个面向真实未标注SKILL.md语料的"恢复"子活动，并以确定性解析器对持久IR重新解析得到真值。
AI.result: 具体测量结果：mean节点集Jaccard跨度0.39–0.96，72%（127格中72%）从未达到节点集完全一致；漂移以count分歧为主（49%），id-label仅占19%，说明命名规范化不能拯救大多数不稳定性。族内尺度结论不一致：OpenAI-style家族呈强逆缩放（gpt-oss:120b比gpt-oss:20b差0.380，Wilcoxon p≈0.004–0.005），Mistral呈弱正缩放（不显著），MiniMax无可比对提示。恢复语料下Jaccard跌至0.22（30格中15%为零），归一化后仅升至0.25。联合聚类自助：仅底部稳定——gpt-oss:120b以99%保留末位、qwen3-coder-next以86%保留第7位；中部四名保留率27%–48%，顶部两名均仅68%。两种合并规则改变8行中4行（含minimax-m2.7由第6升至第4、ministral-3:8b由第4降至第5、gpt-oss:120b仍居末），研究级头条指标变动7.1个百分点。稳定性与正确性排序不一致——选mistral-large-3:675b而非ministral-3:8b会选到准确性更差者；四组Pearson r在去除单离群点后均不显著。可复现性层面：原8项主张/假设经审计仅gpt-oss:120b最不可复现一条强支撑；右删失定义与"绝对vs相对"容差各一词之差导致稳定格数从50变80（98格中）。时间层：测量（2026-05-30至06-11）后10周内10/15命名模型被下架（两波，2026-06-16与2026-07-15），Table 1的8个变体中已有4个无法再查询；DeepSeek/Zhipu"结构性不可达"原结论被撤回，确证客户端60秒默认超时才是主因。
AI.conclusion: 小样本LLM评估呈现的确定性远高于其证据所支持的程度——既因为被测现象本身就不稳定，也因为自上而下的分析选择（合并优先级、容差单位、稳定化定义正确性）能在不改变模型输出的情况下重塑头条结论。本案例研究主张把排名稳定性、逐单元格溯源、已执行的敏感性比较、原始逐次输出与测量日期作为任何LLM评估的标配元数据；论文已将293个原始IR、语料与全部脚本释放，以使该工作在端点持续退役后仍可被检验。

title: Reachability-Based Formal Verification of Graph Neural Networks with Node and Edge Features
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have become a prominent approach for developing fast, topology-aware surrogates in electric power systems, supporting tasks such as power flow (PF) analysis, optimal power flow (OPF) estimation, and cascading failure analysis (CFA). Despite this growing use, formally verifying GNN-based models remains challenging, with existing methods limited in scope. We extend the neural network verification (NNV) framework to graph-structured inputs through GraphStar sets, a generalization of Star sets that captures uncertainty over both node and edge features. This extension enables the propagation of linear message-passing operations and the sound approximation of ReLU nonlinearities for GNN architectures, including graph convolutional network (GCN) and graph isomorphism network with edge features (GINE) layers. We evaluate GNNV across three power system tasks, PF, OPF, and CFA, on the IEEE-24, IEEE-39, and IEEE-118 test cases, as well as two standard graph classification benchmarks, ENZYMES and PROTEINS. Our results show that GNNV provides tighter robustness guarantees than CORA on graph classification models with ReLU-based activations and, for the first time, delivers edge-aware robustness guarantees for GINE-based PF and OPF models under joint node and edge perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GNNV 框架，将神经网络验证工具 NNV 扩展至支持同时具有节点特征和边特征的图神经网络（GNN）。核心贡献是引入 GraphStar 集合（Star 集在图结构上的推广），并基于此为 GCN 和 GINE 层构建可达性分析方法，实现对电力系统与图分类任务的鲁棒性形式化验证。
AI.motivation: GNN 在电力系统等安全关键领域日益广泛，但其形式化验证方法存在局限：已有方法（如 CORA）仅支持节点扰动和 GCN 等不含边特征的架构，无法处理电力系统中线路参数（导纳/电纳）等边特征的真实不确定性。
AI.method: 提出 GraphStar 集合（NodeGraphStar + EdgeGraphStar），将 Star 集推广到图结构张量空间；通过闭包性质和基于 LP 的 approx-star ReLU 松弛，支持 GCN 与 GINE（同时含节点和边特征）层中线性消息传递操作的精确传播与 ReLU 非线性的有界过近似；并利用 K 跳子图限制实现节点级任务的局部验证以应对 ReLU 指数爆炸。
AI.result: 在 IEEE-24/39/118 电力潮流（PF）、最优潮流（OPF）和级联失效分析（CFA）任务以及 ENZYMES、PROTEINS 图分类基准上的实验表明：GNNV 在节点与联合节点–边扰动下均提供高验证率，首次为 GINE 模型提供边感知鲁棒性保证；与 CORA 相比，在图分类任务中验证更多图（最多多 21.6%），证明了 GraphStar 比多项式 zonotope 抽象具有更紧的边界。
AI.conclusion: GNNV 是首个支持带边特征 GINE 模型形式化验证的可达性框架，兼具强鲁棒性保证与较好可扩展性，且适用于电力系统以外的标准图分类任务；未来工作包括减少 Star 集合增长、扩展到更具表达力的 GNN 架构、处理结构扰动以及将验证反馈集成到训练中。

title: AT-SKM-Net: An Accelerated Trainable Sampling Kaczmarz-Motzkin Framework for Linear Hard-Constraint Feasibility on Dynamic Graphs
summary: Graph-structured optimization with linear constraints is fundamental to critical infrastructure but faces scalability limits due to massive strict hard constraints and high dimensionality. While recent projection-based methods such as Trainable Sampling Kaczmarz-Motzkin Net (T-SKM-Net) guarantee feasibility, they face high computational costs in dynamic environments by processing the entire constraint set and requiring expensive matrix factorizations. To bridge this gap, we propose the Accelerated Trainable-SKM (AT-SKM) Net framework. To concentrate computation on the active constraints and eliminate redundant calculations, we introduce a hybrid sampling strategy guided by a topology-aware heterogeneous GNN model. To efficiently handle topological shifts in graph-based constraints, we employ a Cholesky Update mechanism that theoretically reduces the equality projection complexity from O(N^3) to O(N^2) under low-rank perturbations. Experiments on random geometric graphs, N-1 Security-Constrained DC-OPF, and minimum-cost gas transport problem demonstrate that AT-SKM reduces iteration counts by up to 85% and achieves 2.95x-7.29x SKM layer speedups, while maintaining zero constraint violations.

AI.tldr: AT-SKM-Net提出一种加速的可训练采样Kaczmarz-Motzkin框架，通过混合采样策略与Cholesky秩一更新机制，分别从迭代次数和计算复杂度两个维度加速图结构线性硬约束可行性问题的求解，同时保持严格可行性保证。
AI.motivation: T-SKM-Net虽能保证严格可行性，但在动态图环境下存在两大瓶颈：(1)统一采样忽略约束稀疏性，大量计算浪费在非活跃约束上；(2)拓扑变化后SVD重构复杂度达O(N³)，无法满足关键基础设施实时控制需求。
AI.method: 框架包含两大加速模块：(1)基于HGNN的混合采样策略——预测活跃集并将其作为先验分布，结合均匀探索保持全局收敛性，理论分析将收敛速率依赖从全局Hoffman常数降至活跃集局部条件数；(2)Cholesky秩一更新机制——利用拓扑低秩扰动性质，将Gram矩阵分解为一次秩一update和一次秩一downdate，避免SVD重构，将等式投影复杂度从O(N³)降至O(N²)。配套设计的异构图神经网络(HGNN)将节点和边作为独立实体建模，并通过结构感知规范化机制分离静态几何特征与动态实例条件以增强拓扑泛化能力。
AI.result: 在IEEE 57/118/300-bus N-1安全约束DC-OPF问题上，迭代次数减少最高85%，SKM层获得2.95×–7.29×加速；在5000节点随机几何图上Cholesky更新较SVD获得168×加速且严格符合O(N²)渐近复杂度；在GasLib-135最小成本输气问题上获得3.50×总SKM加速。所有结果均保持零等式与不等式约束违反。
AI.conclusion: AT-SKM-Net成功弥合了严格硬约束可行性与实时可扩展性之间的鸿沟，证明了针对图结构线性优化的两个结构先验——稀疏活跃约束与低秩拓扑扰动——可被有效利用以实现超线性加速，且框架对预测误差和数值不稳定性具有良好鲁棒性，支持跨系统伪标签迁移学习。

title: R-DEIM Net: An Efficient Rationale-Augmented Dual-Expert Interaction Model for Paraphrase Detection
summary: Recent advances in paraphrase detection reveal a fundamental trade-off: large language models achieve high accuracy but require high computation, while efficient Siamese-BERT variants offer practical scalability with reduced transparency in rationale generation. We present R-DEIM Net, a 76M-parameter dual-expert architecture exploring whether moderate-scale models can achieve competitive accuracy on paraphrase detection while enabling human-readable rationale generation. The architecture combines two specialized components: an Interaction Expert that captures token-level similarity patterns through multi-scale 2D convolutions and attention head allowing variable input length, and a Reasoning Expert that uses a Flan-T5-small decoder to generate rationales as auxiliary supervision. Rather than re-encoding generated text, we extract and pool decoder hidden states as complementary features for classification. On the Quora Question Pairs dataset, R-DEIM Net achieves 90.07\% accuracy and 90.16\% F1-score via 10-fold cross-validation. This represents competitive performance with strong transformer-based baselines (e.g., MFAE BERT: 90.54\% accuracy) and recent large language model based approaches (LLaMA-70B) while using a substantially smaller parameter budget. The model generates rationales alongside predictions, providing potential for auxiliary human-readable descriptions.

AI.tldr: R-DEIM Net是一个76M参数的双专家架构,用于释义检测任务。它结合交互专家(Interaction Expert)和推理专家(Reasoning Expert),在Quora Question Pairs数据集上以远小于LLM的参数量实现了90.07%准确率和90.16% F1分数,并能生成人类可读的推理依据。
AI.motivation: 释义检测任务面临核心权衡:大型语言模型(LLM)准确率高但计算开销大,而高效的Siamese-BERT变体可扩展性好但缺乏透明推理依据生成能力。作者旨在探索中等规模模型能否在保持竞争力的同时实现可解释的推理依据生成。
AI.method: 双专家多任务架构:(1)交互专家(分支A)使用共享编码器(paraphrase-MiniLM-L12-v2,384维)生成token嵌入,构建2D交互矩阵,通过多尺度2D卷积核(3×3、5×5、7×7)捕获局部语义对齐模式,并用注意力池化生成固定大小的交互向量;(3)推理专家(Flow B)使用Flan-T5-small解码器(512维)以token嵌入作为encoder hidden states,通过teacher forcing生成推理依据,直接提取解码器隐藏状态而非重新编码生成文本,通过注意力池化获得推理向量;(4)两向量拼接后通过MLP进行分类。训练采用加权多任务损失(α=0.7),使用加权BCE损失(对假阳性施加2.0倍权重惩罚)。
AI.result: 在Quora Question Pairs数据集上10折交叉验证:R-DEIM Net达到90.07%准确率和90.16% F1分数,相比仅使用交互专家的基线(88.42%/88.56%)获得+1.53% F1提升。该性能接近MFAE BERT(90.54%准确率)和LLaMA-70B(90.30%),但参数量仅为76M(约为LLaMA-70B的1/900)。在7个迁移学习数据集上展现出良好的零样本和微调性能。架构分析验证:(1)对角线交互比率在重复问题对上呈现显著右移(KS=0.224, p<10⁻⁴);(2)大卷积核在弱对齐情况下激活更高;(3)名词、动词等实词对预测影响最大,功能词影响最小。
AI.conclusion: R-DEIM Net以76M参数在释义检测任务上实现了高性能与可解释性的兼顾,生成的人类可读推理依据与人类判断具有较高相关性(Spearman相关系数0.814)。主要贡献包括:双专家框架联合建模token交互和生成推理信号;基于2D卷积和注意力池化的变长输入处理机制;使用解码器隐藏状态作为潜在特征避免冗余编码;系统的实证分析揭示了模型决策的语义基础。局限在于:(1)使用LLM合成推理依据而非人工标注;(2)生成的推理文本是描述性辅助而非严格的因果解释;(3)在PAWS、MRPC等对抗性数据集零样本性能下降。未来工作将拓展至NLI任务、参数高效微调以及模型进一步小型化。

title: Does a model's stated reason for rejecting a candidate do any work?
comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at LLM4XAI 2026: Workshop on Large Language Models for Explainable AI, co-located with CIKM 2026, Rome, Italy, November 8, 2026. Code and per-item records: this https URL
summary: Asked to choose between candidates and explain the choice, a language model often rejects a rival by naming a fact its profile lacks: no director, no date of death. That sentence is a claim about the text in front of the model, and it can be tested without any judge. We insert a real corpus sentence stating the named fact into the rival's profile and ask again under greedy decoding. Two controls separate content from placement: a length-matched irrelevant sentence at the same profile, and the same two sentences at a third option the model never mentioned. In the largest of three runs, six open models on 2WikiMultihopQA, supplying the named fact at the profile the model named moves its choice more than the irrelevant control does, odds ratio 3.57 [1.54, 8.26], Holm p=0.0210, and this survives dropping any single model. The contrast the design was built to detect, the same fact at the option nobody named, does not clear correction, Holm p=0.2428. The strongest result in the family carries no content claim at all: the identical irrelevant sentence moves the choice more at the named rival than at the third option, Holm p=0.0008. Repair and control also differ in co-candidate mentions, relation template and fluency; post-hoc matching on the first two preserves the content effects' direction, matching fluency weakens one, so the content contrasts bound an effect rather than establish one. A forced single-token probability read disagrees in direction with the free-text choice on that same contrast, and three candidate explanations for the disagreement find no support. Every measurement is a string rule, so each was validated against the records it reads; validation caught eight defects. The largest, a choice-parsing rule that returned the option a model had just rejected in 17.1% of adjudicable responses, would have reported six surviving contrasts instead of four.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无需人工评判的方法来检验语言模型在拒绝候选选项时所陈述理由是否真正"起作用"。方法是在被拒绝候选的简介中插入其所缺事实的语料原句，观察模型选择是否改变。在三个测试设计（六个开源模型，2WikiMultihopQA数据集）上，研究发现：在模型主动提及的候选处补充所缺事实确实比插入长度匹配但无关的句子更能改变模型选择（Part A 中 OR=3.57，Holm p=0.0210）；但在未被提及的选项处该效应未通过校正检验。最强结果是位置效应——无关句子的位置本身就能移动选择。强制单 token 概率读数与自由文本选择在涉及位置的对比中方向相反。验证流程发现8个字符串规则的缺陷，其中最大缺陷使校正前存活对比数从4增至6。
AI.motivation: 当语言模型被要求选择候选并解释原因时，它常以"该候选简介缺少某事实"的形式拒绝竞争选项。该陈述本质上是对输入文本的可证伪主张——可通过插入该事实并重新询问来测试，无需人类评判员。这触及可解释AI中的"忠实性"问题：模型的解释是否真实反映其决策机制。以往方法多依赖学习得到的编辑器或人类评判，本文则由实验者基于语料原句执行编辑，以提供更严格的对照。
AI.method: 设计为2×2因素实验，将"内容"（相关事实 vs 长度匹配但无关的句子）与"位置"（模型主动提及的对手候选 vs 未被提及的第三方候选）正交。五个条件：R0（不编辑的完整性检查）、R1（向被提及的对手插入相关事实）、R2（向同一对手插入无关句子）、R3（向第三方插入相关事实）、R4（向第三方插入无关句子）。RQ1（内容）对比R1−R2和R3−R4；RQ2（位置）对比R1−R3和R2−R4；RQ3（工具）比较离散选择读数与连续单token概率读数。所有编辑来自2WikiMultihopQA语料，通过主体替换实现。八个完整性门控确保编辑后文本合法。三个运行：Part A（三个7-8B模型，4选项）、Part B（另三个检查点，4选项）、Part C（Part A名单，6选项）。所有测量均为确定性字符串规则，每个都通过与记录比对进行验证。
AI.result: RQ1：在Part A中，R1−R2对比OR=3.57 [1.54, 8.26]，Holm p=0.0210，剔除任一单模型后仍存活；但Part C中同一对比未通过校正（p=0.1490）。该设计本欲探测的R3−R4对比在Part A中p=0.2428未通过校正，在Part C中依赖单一模型。RQ2：最强结果为Part C的R2−R4对比（p=0.0008），表明一个句子的位置本身就能移动选择，无内容主张。RQ3：两种读数在所有内容对比单元格上方向一致，但在四个位置对比单元格中方向相反；三种候选解释（天花板效应、离散读数读错量、少数大变动主导）均未获支持。验证发现8个缺陷，其中选择解析器在17.1%的可裁定响应中将刚被拒绝的选项返回为所选——若未修正将报告6个存活对比而非4个。共发现四个对比通过Holm校正。
AI.conclusion: 本文主要贡献是这一可转移的工具——其验证框架界定了哪些内容可被声称为发现。在RQ1上，向模型主动提及的简介补充所缺事实确实比长度匹配但无关的控制更能移动选择，该效应在共同候选提及和关系模板的后验匹配下保持方向，但未在流畅度匹配下成立。在未被提及的选项处该效应依赖单一模型。位置本身是混杂因素——最强的结果完全无关内容。两种测量读数在涉及位置时方向相反，验证字符串规则显著改变了哪些结论存活。模型陈述的原因是否导致其原始决定仍属未知，且在流畅度等混杂因素被分离前，本设计自身的效应是否真正反映该机制也尚未确定。

title: Minimally Invasive Steering of Language Models
summary: Pre-logit steering adapts a frozen language model to a test-time reward by adding vectors to its final hidden states. Unregularized reward optimization can substantially alter the output distribution and degrade generation quality. We propose Minimally Invasive Steering Vector Optimization (MISVO), which penalizes interventions using the local KL geometry of the induced token distribution. The resulting Fisher quadratic measures distributional sensitivity and admits an analytic gradient computed through matrix--vector products with the frozen language-model head. We derive an exact decomposition of the sequence-level KL gradient into an analytic Fisher term and a suffix score-function term. For a fixed generation horizon, we show that the suffix term is second order in the steering magnitude and that three Fisher surrogates agree with the full KL gradient to first order. MISVO uses the frozen-reference surrogate to optimize position-specific interventions without updating model parameters. Across preference and code-generation tasks on models with approximately 1B--14B parameters, MISVO achieves the highest mean reward in six of seven model--task settings, with diversity and coherence scores close to those of Best-of-N.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MISVO（最小侵入式引导向量优化）方法，通过Fisher二次惩罚来正则化pre-logit引导向量，避免过引导导致的生成质量下降。MISVO在SHP偏好任务和MBPP+代码生成任务上，在6/7的模型-任务设置中取得了最高的平均奖励，同时保持了接近Best-of-N的多样性和一致性。
AI.motivation: 测试时对齐中，无正则化的reward优化会显著改变输出分布并降低生成质量（过引导）。现有方法如欧几里得惩罚无法捕捉token分布的敏感性，高方差蒙特卡洛估计又难以处理序列级KL。需要一种既能有效正则化又计算可行的方法。
AI.method: 提出MISVO算法：1）用Fisher信息矩阵构造二次代价矩阵，从token级KL的二阶展开导出（Proposition 1）；2）分解序列级KL梯度为解析Fisher项和后缀评分函数项（Theorem 1）；3）证明后缀项和三种Fisher替代之间的差异为O(‖u‖²)（Theorem 2, Proposition 2），因此冻结参考Fisher梯度与完整KL梯度一阶一致；4）使用leave-one-out基线降低方差，结合解析的正则化梯度进行随机梯度上升；5）采用无矩阵Fisher-向量积避免显式构造F_t矩阵。
AI.result: 在1.2B至14B参数的四个冻结模型（LFM2.5-1.2B、Gemma3-4B、Llama-3-8B、Phi-4）上测试，在SHP偏好任务和MBPP+代码生成任务上，MISVO在7个模型-任务设置中有6个达到最高平均奖励。一致性和多样性分数接近Best-of-N，且在参考前缀上测得的KL显著低于AISP和无正则化方法。
AI.conclusion: MISVO通过Fisher二次正则化提供了一种计算可行且理论有保障的最小侵入式pre-logit引导方法。该方法在保持生成质量的同时提高了奖励，对测试时对齐中的过引导问题提供了有效解决方案。局限性包括：近似是局部的；奖励模型与评估模型相同；峰值内存高于基线。

title: Requirement-Bound Verified Commissioning: A Frozen Four-Billion-Parameter Local Model as a Candidate Generator under an External Acceptance Layer with Verification and Release Authority
summary: An acceptance protocol is developed for sensor-coordinate and polarity binding in mechatronic commissioning. Candidate generation is separated from release authority. Requirements unsupported by a deterministic parser are routed to a frozen local language model with four billion parameters. Plans are released only when both facts can be derived by an external gate under a sealed grammar. One canonical answer is requested from a gold-standard user when eligible. The protocol was evaluated once under a criterion fixed before benchmark construction, on 144 tasks written by isolated agent contexts without access to the gate, grammar, or experimental plan. Three contributions are established. First, candidate generation and release decisions were measured separately. Fabricated ready plans were committed on 21 of 22 routed unanswerable tasks, and all were rejected. The same 83 releases were reproduced without model calls. Second, no false release was observed among 83 releases. A one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound of 0.0354 was obtained as a diagnostic under an independent-and-identically-distributed assumption, below the sealed 5% threshold. However, one false release was subsequently recorded among 146 releases outside the benchmark at seed 0. Third, protection against incorrect user answers was characterized. Both facts were bound from the original text on 13 of 96 answerable tasks. Incorrect answers were released in 169 of 431 pairings on the remaining tasks, including failures involving coordinate exclusion. A deployable questioning policy was not tested because eligibility was determined from the answer key. Gate sensitivity and real user behavior were not measured.

AI.tldr: 本文针对机电调试中的传感器坐标与极性绑定决策，提出了一种将候选生成与发布权限分离的接受协议。确定性解析器无法处理的需求路由至一个冻结的40亿参数本地语言模型，由外部确定性蕴含门在密封文法下决定是否发布。三个核心贡献：候选生成与发布决策的分离测量、密封准则下的误发布上界、以及用户错误答案下文本信任边界的表征。
AI.motivation: 在机电调试中，传感器极性接反可将负反馈变为正反馈，导致系统不稳定。自动从自然语言需求中提取坐标与极性绑定时，需解决两个问题：生成候选方案，以及正当化接受决策以防止错误符号传递至系统。现有自验证方法在推理和规划任务上表现下降，且未见在密封准则下对未见任务的误发布上界进行报告的研究。
AI.method: 两轮协议：第一轮中，确定性解析器先行处理需求，若无法支持则路由至冻结的Qwen3-4B本地模型生成候选方案。候选方案由外部确定性蕴含门在密封文法V1下检查，要求坐标和极性两个事实均可从需求文本中推导方可发布。若事实无法从文本绑定且任务可问询，则向用户（金标准用户）提出单一问题，将答案以规范句子附加后再交由门判断。主要终点为发布方案中的误发布比例，采用密封的Clopper-Pearson单侧95%上界进行统计推断，附带浓度保护准则。基准包含144个任务（96个可回答、48个不可回答），跨24个组合，由隔离的智能体上下文编写，不接触门、文法或实验计划。
AI.result: 在主实验seed 0下，83个方案被发布，其中0个误发布，单侧95% Clopper-Pearson上界U(0,83)=0.0354，低于密封的5%阈值，获得"支持"判定。候选生成方面，路由至模型的25个可回答任务中24个生成与黄金对一致的方案，22个不可回答任务中21个产生虚构就绪方案但全部被接受层拒绝。无模型重放中，相同的83个任务在零模型调用下被释放。相比无门壳体（9/18误发布），该协议显著降低误发布率。但在售后确认活动中（252个新任务，seed 0），146个发布中出现1个误发布，表明零误发布结果不能推广至基准之外。在错误答案扫描中，文本可绑定的13个任务（65个配对）全部正确拒绝，但文本开放任务（431个配对）中169个错误配对被释放。
AI.conclusion: 在评估范围内，将候选生成与发布权限分离是合理的：冻结模型作为候选生成器、外部确定性蕴含门作为发布决策器，能在密封准则下将误发布率控制在指定阈值以下。然而，结果受限于单一文法V1和黄金用户假设，零误发布不能推广至基准之外。文本信任边界表明：当事实由文本独立承载时可拒绝错误答案，当事实对文本开放时用户答案被直接信任。存在文法和范围依赖性的局限。未来工作应解决显式排除机制、否定词典扩展、门灵敏度测量以及针对不完美预言者的询问策略设计。

title: PoEM: Predicting RL Outcomes from Existing Policies
summary: Foundation models are post-trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to maximize specific rewards, such as human alignment, correctness, or instruction following. This post-training process is computationally intensive, sometimes unstable, and has to be run from scratch every time the reward model changes or when we want to combine multiple rewards. We hence ask: given a new reward function, is it possible to predict the RL outcomes without actually running RL on it? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing PoEM, a framework to predict the outputs of RL on a new reward function using a set of models already post-trained on other rewards. First, we show that if the new reward function can be written as a linear combination of existing ones, then the new policy in log-space can be written as a linear combination of the existing log-policies. Surprisingly, even in cases where the rewards are not linearly connected, we observe that often log-policies from RL training span an approximately low-rank subspace across rewards. To our benefit, the weighting coefficients for this combination can be estimated using only the reward or basis policy outputs on the samples. We turn these observations into an algorithm that takes post-trained models and a new reward function, and approximates the target RL policy without actually running any additional RL training. We experimentally validate our approach across synthetic and real rewards, spanning both text and image modalities.

AI.tldr: PoEM (Product of Experts Mixing) is a framework that predicts the outcomes of reinforcement learning (RL) post-training on a new reward function without actually running RL, by composing the log-ratios of existing single-reward post-trained models. Theoretically grounded in KL-regularized RL optima, it leverages the empirical finding that expert log-policies span a low-rank subspace, enabling composition-based prediction across language and image modalities.
AI.motivation: RL post-training of foundation models is computationally expensive, unstable, and must be repeated whenever the reward function changes or multiple rewards need to be combined. Existing solutions like weight averaging and best-of-N sampling have significant limitations in scalability and effectiveness. The authors seek to determine whether RL outcomes on new rewards can be predicted directly from previously trained models, avoiding additional training entirely.
AI.method: PoEM is built on the theoretical observation that the optimal policy for a reward that is a linear combination of existing rewards is itself a product-of-experts (log-space linear combination) of the existing policies. The authors extend this beyond the linear case by observing that RL-trained policy log-ratios span a low-rank subspace (effective rank ~6.3 out of 20 experts, despite near-orthogonal weight updates). The method involves: (1) scoring a calibration set with the target reward, (2) fitting composition weights via ridge regression on rewards or policy log-ratios, (3) computing a coverage score (held-out R²) to assess if the basis spans the target direction, and (4) composing the basis at inference time using token-level log-ratio mixing for autoregressive models or weighted denoiser predictions for diffusion models (derived via Tweedie's formula). A geometric strength scaling γ_geom compensates for shrinkage when many experts are averaged.
AI.result: On combined rewards (linear combinations of basis rewards), PoEM recovers 0.78–1.08 of the RL policy's reward gain at γ=1, improving to 0.83–1.00 with γ_geom, with performance close to a second RL run. On held-out rewards (not in the basis), PoEM's coverage score strongly predicts which rewards it can approximate (Spearman ρ from −0.71 to −0.81), and covered rewards show 0.55–0.69 recovery vs. 0.22–0.43 for uncovered ones. On RM-Div, PoEM is closer to the target policy than the top expert on 9 of 10 held-out rewards. On image diffusion (Stable Diffusion v1.4 with 13 DDPO experts), composing the other 12 recovers on average 0.67 of a held-out expert's reward gain, with span R² above 0.99. The method works across Qwen3-0.6B with GRPO/DPO, PPO with public reward models, and DDPO for diffusion.
AI.conclusion: PoEM demonstrates that RL outcomes on new rewards can be effectively predicted from existing post-trained policies without additional training, by composing log-policy ratios. The key insight is a "policy space rank gap": while adapter weight updates are nearly orthogonal, their induced log-policies share far fewer directions. This enables cost-efficient reward previewing, approximation of expensive-to-evaluate rewards, and intelligent basis expansion. Limitations include dependency on basis coverage, the requirement that experts share a reference model and KL coefficient for exact composition, and reduced competitiveness when reward evaluation is cheap (where best-of-N becomes competitive).

title: To Trust or Not to Trust: Retrieval-Augmented Fact Checking in Speech
summary: Online misinformation increasingly appears in spoken formats such as news clips, podcasts, interviews, political speeches, and social media videos, creating a need for fact-checking systems that can verify claims directly from speech. We introduce VeriSpeak, a probe benchmark for studying speech-based fact verification in Large Audio Language Models (LALMs). VeriSpeak contains 3,879 spoken claims spanning temporal, geographical, and relational facts, with balanced true and false labels. The benchmark is designed to examine whether factual verification ability transfers from text to speech, and whether retrieval-augmented LALMs can use textual evidence to correctly support or refute spoken claims. Our experiments reveal a consistent text-speech modality gap: LALMs that verify written claims reliably often fail on the same claims when spoken. Moreover, retrieval alone provides limited gains because models frequently conflate retrieved evidence with the spoken claim. In contrast, retrieval combined with explicit reasoning improves claim-evidence comparison, with a thinking-tuned LALM reaching 86.1% accuracy. VeriSpeak highlights that effective speech misinformation detection requires not only speech understanding, but also grounded reasoning over retrieved evidence. The dataset is publicly available via Hugging Face at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VeriSpeak基准测试,包含3,879条语音形式的声明(涵盖时间、地理和关系三类事实),用于系统研究大型音频语言模型(LALMs)在语音事实核查中的能力。研究发现LALMs存在显著的文本-语音模态差距,纯检索增强仅带来有限提升,标准LALMs常将检索证据与语音声明混淆;而检索结合显式推理能显著改善声明-证据对比,思维调优的LALM结合检索增强和思维链可达86.1%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 在线错误信息日益以语音形式(新闻剪辑、播客、访谈、政治演讲和社交媒体视频)传播,需要能够直接从语音验证声明的事实核查系统。现有大型音频语言模型(LALMs)在语音理解和指令跟随方面虽具能力,但其在跨模态证据基础的事实核查方面的可靠性尚不清楚,亟需一个受控基准进行系统评估。
AI.method: 1. 构建VeriSpeak基准:基于名人传记知识库,通过Wikipedia富集结构化元数据,使用Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct抽取原子事实,采用确定性扰动生成平衡的负样本(时间/地理/关系三类),用Coqui TTS合成单说话人语音。共3,879条声明,使用wav2vec 2.0自动转录。2. 设计六个受控评估条件(C0-C5):变化输入模态、模型接口、检索方式和思维链推理。3. 评估五个LALM(三个模型家族:Qwen-Audio-Chat、Qwen2-Audio-7B、Audio-Flamingo-3、Audio-Flamingo-next-think、Phi-4-multimodal),比较Transcript-RAG与AudioQuery-RAG。4. 使用准确率、Δ(相对文本基线下降)、Lift(相对语音基线提升)三个指标。
AI.result: 主要发现:1) LALMs存在一致且显著的文本-语音模态差距(Δ范围14.7-26.1点),语音接口本身是主要退化来源。2) 纯检索仅带来2.3点的平均Lift,因为65%的案例中模型将检索文本视为待验证声明而非证据。3) Transcript-RAG优于AudioQuery-RAG,后者因CLAP Recall@1仅0.3%而几乎无效。4) 思维链单独使用对标准LALMs无帮助甚至有害,但与检索结合可平均提升4.9点。5) 思维调优的Audio-Flamingo-next-think结合Transcript-RAG和CoT达到86.1%,超过其文本基线14.3点,但仍比文本RAG上界低6.3点。6) 错误主要源于专有名词识别(WER 0.13-0.23)。
AI.conclusion: VeriSpeak揭示了有效语音错误信息检测不仅需要语音理解,还需要基于检索证据的可靠推理。声明-证据混淆是核心瓶颈:标准LALMs常将检索文本当作待验证对象。检索与显式推理结合,特别是经过思维调优的模型,可显著改善跨模态事实核查。未来工作应扩展至多语言声明、多样口音和自然语音,并追求语音-文本事实核查的完全对等。

title: Where Does Streaming State Cost Go? A Reproducible Comparison of Flink and Kafka Streams on Kafka
summary: This paper presents a controlled comparison of exactly-once Kafka pipelines implemented with Apache Flink and Kafka Streams, two engines with different state-management architectures. The state management in Flink occurs through checkpoints in external storage, whereas Kafka Streams restores local state by replaying broker changelogs. The experiments evaluate the effects of the two designs on latency, resource consumption, configuration sensitivity, and recover from injected failures. The engines produced expected outputs across 50 correctness trials, five for each engine-workload combination (exact 95% CI 0.929-1.000). The latencies, however, showed differences when tested in 30 minute trials at a fixed rate of 100 events/sec. The measured ingestion to output interval was 4-6 ms for stateless workloads and 4.3-6.2 s for windowed workloads. The median p99 was 1.97-1.97s for stateless workloads and 5.68-9.92s for windowed respectively. Further, a sensitivity study showed that increasing the durability interval from 1,000 to 10,000 ms shifted the latency distributions in Kafka Streams and Flink between stages. Kafka Streams' W3 median p99 T2-T1 increased from 6,085 to 23,155 ms; Flink's T3-T2 increased from 732 to 8,702 ms. Failure injection experiments demonstrate that latency can interfere with incomplete processing behavior. The results show that exactly-once correctness is a necessary but insufficient measure of stream processing performance. Kafka Streams completed 0/5 stateful JVM-kill and 1/5 in each stateful local-volume-loss trials, while corresponding Flink cells completed 5/5. The cost, placement and magnitude depend on state management, architecture, configuration, and measurement location. Accordingly, evaluations of fault-tolerant streaming systems should holistically measure latency, completion, recovery behavior, and correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 Apache Flink 与 Kafka Streams 这两种架构不同的 exactly-once 流处理引擎，在固定 100 events/sec 速率下进行受控对比，提出三段式时间戳分解（T1-T0/T2-T1/T3-T2）以定位状态管理开销在流水线中的出现位置，并结合正确性验证、资源采样与故障注入实验，揭示"正确性"只是必要而非充分指标。
AI.motivation: 现有流处理基准（如 Nexmark、Yahoo Streaming Benchmark、ESPBench 等）多以聚合的吞吐/延迟评估引擎，难以揭示状态管理与恢复过程中延迟究竟发生在流水线的哪一阶段；Flink（基于外部存储的分布式 checkpoint）与 Kafka Streams（基于 broker changelog 重放恢复本地状态）的不同恢复路径在聚合指标下不可区分，因此需要一种能"定位延迟来源"的可复现对比方法。
AI.method: 设计可控实验 harness：单共享主机上部署三 broker 的 apache/kafka:4.3.1（KRaft 模式），使用五类工作负载（W1 恒等、W2 过滤映射、W3 60s 滚动计数、W4 10min/1min 滑动求和、W5 流-流连接），在四个时间点打时间戳（T0 生成前、T1 broker LogAppendTime、T2 引擎输出、T3 read_committed 消费者可见），分解为 T1-T0（摄取）、T2-T1（引擎+事件时间等待）、T3-T2（提交+消费）三段；通过多集验证器核对最终输出，Docker 采集 CPU/内存/网络/块 I/O，并对 W3 改变 Flink checkpoint 间隔与 Kafka Streams commit 间隔做敏感性分析，最后注入 JVM 终止、broker 中断、容器本地卷丢失三类故障。
AI.result: 50 次正确性试验全部匹配预期（95% CI 0.929-1.000），输出记录数 199（W3）至 11,024（W5）。固定负载 30 分钟、100 events/s 下：T1-T0 ≈ 1s；无状态负载 T2-T1 中位 p99 为 Kafka Streams 11-12 ms、Flink 93-97 ms；窗口负载 T2-T1 为 Kafka Streams 6.20-6.27 s、Flink 4.28-5.11 s，状态负载 p99 总延迟约为无状态负载的 3 倍。W3 敏感性测试中，耐久性间隔从 1000→10000 ms 使 Kafka Streams 总 p99 从 6.77 s 升至 23.91 s（延迟集中于 T2-T1，由 6085→23155 ms），而 Flink 总 p99 从 5.60 s 升至 12.64 s（延迟转移至 T3-T2，由 732→8702 ms）。故障注入下 Kafka Streams 在有状态 W3/W4 的 jvm_kill（0/5 完成）与 node_loss（各 1/5）单元未在观察窗口内完成，Flink 对应单元均 5/5 完成；所有 broker_kill 单元两侧均完成，表明差异源于状态恢复机制而非 broker。
AI.conclusion: exactly-once 正确性是必要而非充分的流处理性能度量，状态管理的成本、位置与幅度取决于引擎架构、配置与测点。延迟在两个引擎中出现在不同流水线阶段（Kafka Streams 集中于引擎处理+事件时间等待段，Flink 集中于提交/下游可见段），且故障后完成行为存在显著差异。评估容错流处理系统应整体测量正确性、分段延迟、完成行为与恢复结果，而非依赖单一聚合指标；未来工作需扩展 harness 以捕获流时间推进、窗口资格、checkpoint/changelog 进度、分区重分配、状态恢复里程碑与积压排空等信号。

title: Distributed Service Orchestration in Edge-Cloud Continuum for Digital Healthcare
summary: Today's digital healthcare services rely on various applications and functions that must be continuously accessible. Cloud computing enables global access to these services through public networks, which often also introduce increased latency, higher bandwidth consumption, and additional security risks compared to local operation. Edge computing mitigates these challenges by deploying cloud services closer to the end users and data sources, thereby improving resilience to network disruptions and reducing latency, bandwidth usage, and exposure to security threats. However, service deployment typically relies on the availability of centralized registry servers. Consequently, if the network connection or the registry server itself becomes unavailable, service deployment at the target edge node may fail. To address this, we propose a three-tier registry architecture to enhance deployment reliability and service availability, considering DockerHub as a remote public registry, an MEC-based off-premises registry as a remote private registry, and a LAN-based on-premises registry as a local private registry. The performance and efficiency are analyzed through measurements related to the estimated deployment time, inflicted network and computational load, and energy consumption, while the required nanoservices are deployed from different tiers. The experimental results indicate that alongside the improved tolerance to network disruptions, the local private and remote private registries also outperform the remote public registry in the deployment performance. The findings highlight the effectiveness of proximity-aware service distribution in improving the resilience, performance and efficiency of service deployment.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes a three-tier service registry architecture for nanoservice distribution in edge-cloud continuum, targeting digital healthcare use cases. The architecture comprises a local private registry (on-premises/LAN), a remote private registry (MEC-based), and a remote public registry (DockerHub-based). Validated through an emergency ambulance response scenario using Raspberry Pi 5 as the edge device, the work demonstrates that registry proximity significantly reduces deployment time, energy consumption, network bandwidth, and CPU load, while enhancing resilience against network disruptions for critical healthcare service delivery.
AI.motivation: Current edge-cloud service deployment heavily depends on centralized registry servers and stable network connectivity. In critical digital healthcare scenarios—such as emergency response where continuous service availability is vital—this dependence creates a single point of failure: network outages or registry server unavailability can prevent deployment of essential medical services precisely when they are most needed. The paper addresses this critical reliability gap.
AI.method: The authors design and prototype a three-tier registry architecture: (1) R1 – local private registry on a Raspberry Pi 5 (LAN-based, on-premises), (2) R2 – remote private registry on a 5GTN MEC node (Ubuntu VM), and (3) R3 – remote public registry (DockerHub). They implement an emergency ambulance use case with five nanoservices (Identification/BLE, SpO₂, Visualizer, RabbitMQ, ECG, EEG, DB/InfluxDB) deployed across four phases (on-site identification, on-site monitoring, in-ambulance monitoring, hospital handover). Docker Engine 27.3.1 is used for containerization, with GitLab CI/CD for pipeline management. KPIs measured include: (a) Performance – RTT, hop count, download/deployment time (cached vs. non-cached); (b) Computational load – CPU percentage and storage utilization; (c) Network load – bandwidth (MB/s) via WiFi/5G; (d) Energy consumption – using Netio PowerBox 4KF for voltage/current/power factor, computing P=V×I×pf and E=P̄×Δt. Mosquitto MQTT, InfluxDB, and Grafana are employed for data collection and visualization.
AI.result: Key findings: (1) Registry proximity dominates efficiency: R1 (local) requires only 1 hop with 46.9ms RTT, R2 (MEC) needs 5-8 hops with 186.24ms RTT, and R3 (DockerHub) requires 28-29 hops with 1435.18ms RTT. (2) Deployment times are lowest from R1 across all nanoservices (e.g., SpO₂: 12.00s cached/12.05s non-cached from R1 vs. 14.70s/15.89s from R2 and 13.64s/15.08s from R3). (3) CPU load increases with registry distance—baseline 10%, rising to 20%, 22.5%, and 25% for SpO₂ downloads from R1, R2, R3 respectively. (4) Storage: Docker packages consume 176.9MB (RPi5 worker) to 273.5MB (VM manager); nanoservices range from 58.21MB (RabbitMQ, compressed) to 155.24MB (DB). (5) Network bandwidth: R1 generally requires least bandwidth with highest stability (lower standard deviation); R2 inflicts highest load. (6) Energy: R1 yields lowest total energy (e.g., SpO₂: 69.53J from R1 vs. 76.96J from R2 and 107.24J from R3—a 54.24% increase for R3). DB nanoservice is an exception, consuming slightly less from R2 than R1, but R3 increases energy by 108.92%. Overall, R3 sometimes outperforms R2 in raw download speed due to CDN optimization, but R1 consistently wins on efficiency metrics.
AI.conclusion: The three-tier registry architecture effectively balances resilience, performance, and efficiency for resource-constrained, latency-critical edge environments in digital healthcare. A local-first strategy (R1), supported by MEC-based (R2) and cloud fallback (R3) registries, provides robust service continuity during network disruptions while optimizing device-side energy, bandwidth, and computational overhead. The work highlights registry proximity as the dominant factor in deployment efficiency. Future research directions include: (1) extending the lifecycle from development to hospital deployment, including criteria for selecting locally-cached service images; (2) device-specific performance/efficiency studies across heterogeneous hardware; (3) developing layered trust models to optimize the security-performance tradeoff, potentially leveraging AI/ML-based dynamic trust score assessment considering security history, response time, and traffic anomalies.

title: pytest-gpu-proof: Enabling Cloud-CPU Continuous Integration for GPU Code with Local GPU Attestation
summary: GPU acceleration is now routine across robotics, but cloud-hosted GPU continuous integration (CI) runners are expensive, resulting in severe under-testing of GPU-accelerated code. We present pytest-gpu-proof, an open-source pytest plugin offering a practical middle ground. Tests can be run on a local machine, signed with a receipt of exactly what ran and what it produced, and integrated into standard CPU CI workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions). The tool is open source and on PyPI, and we are actively integrating it across our lab's software stack.

AI.tldr: pytest-gpu-proof 是一个开源 pytest 插件，允许在本地机器运行 GPU 测试并用 Ed25519 SSH 密钥签名生成执行凭证（receipt），然后在云端 CPU CI（如 GitHub Actions）中快速验证该凭证，从而以低成本实现 GPU 代码的持续集成。
AI.motivation: GPU 加速在机器人领域日益普及，但云端 GPU CI 成本高昂，导致学术界（资源有限的小型实验室）开源 GPU 代码普遍测试不足。作者希望借助行业最佳实践（CI）来改善 GPU 加速机器人软件的测试与维护现状。
AI.method: 1. 本地用 pytest marker 选定 GPU 测试并运行，收集测试集、结果、环境、Git 状态等信息生成 JSON 凭证；2. 用开发者的 Ed25519 SSH 密钥签名凭证（CI 验证时与 GitHub 公钥比对）；3. 在云端 CPU CI 中重新计算 HEAD 源码指纹、验证签名、检查 commit 祖先关系、精确比对通过/跳过集合，并应用新鲜度与策略（scope、freshness、shard、开放/受限签署者等）。插件仅依赖 pytest 与 SSH 密钥，支持分片（shard）合并、参考实现对比与声明式策略文件（未知字段即报错）。
AI.result: 该插件以 MIT 协议开源，发布于 GitHub（A2R-Lab/pytest-gpu-proof）和 PyPI（v0.4.0，pip install pytest-gpu-proof），自身 CI 测试覆盖率达 100%，并已在作者实验室的软件栈中部署集成。
AI.conclusion: pytest-gpu-proof 提供了一种实用折中方案，让昂贵的 GPU 算力留在本地硬件，同时在云端 CPU CI 中以秒级开销验证 GPU 测试凭证。未来工作希望通过研讨会讨论优化策略词汇，并欢迎对插件设计与信任模型提出对抗性反馈。

title: When Fancy Eviction Fails: Rethinking Cache Replacement For LLM Prefix Reuse
summary: Long-running LLM applications repeatedly send growing context, making prefix caching critical for reducing prefill cost. Yet prefix-cache behavior under agentic workloads remains poorly understood. We study production traces from two companies and evaluate 14 eviction algorithms across HBM-constrained and large memory-pool settings. Despite a large gap to Belady, sophisticated policies designed for traditional caches provide little benefit over LRU. The reason is structural: prefix reuse is dominated by the regular pacing of active sessions, making recency unusually predictive. Prefix caching nevertheless introduces new challenges, including heavy-tailed session footprints and highly variable miss costs as attention computation grows with sequence length. We introduce the compute-savings ratio and two offline oracles to quantify these effects. Our results show that effective prefix-cache management should retain recency as its foundation while selectively adding quick demotion for one-hit prefixes, compute-aware partial eviction for expensive misses, and capacity-dependent eviction granularity. We will release the traces and simulator to support future research.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM前缀缓存，研究使用两条生产trace评估了14种淘汰算法，发现大多数复杂算法（如频率型）在该工作负载下表现不如简单的LRU，因为前缀复用主要由会话内顺序访问驱动，使得最近性（recency）极具预测力。在此基础上，论文提出compute-savings ratio指标、ILP离线最优和BeladyCompute近似，并给出组合设计建议：以LRU为基础，对一次性前缀采用快速降级（quick demotion），对计算开销大的深层块采用计算感知（compute-aware）淘汰并配合partial-node粒度，淘汰粒度需随HBM或大内存池容量自适应。
AI.motivation: 传统缓存淘汰策略面向Web/块存储工作负载设计，而LLM前缀缓存在agentic长上下文场景下的访问模式未被系统研究；业界普遍使用LRU，但不清楚复杂算法是否能带来收益，也不清楚前缀缓存与经典工作负载的本质差异在哪里。
AI.method: （1）收集两条生产trace（FreeInference、Chutes）和补充Qwen Bailian、AgentX共6条trace；（2）基于libCacheSim开发C++模拟器，强制实现请求级residency约束，与vLLM命中率吻合；（3）评估14种淘汰算法（LRU、S3-FIFO/S4-FIFO/Sieve/LIRS/ARC、LFU/W-TinyLFU、LHD、LeCaR/LRB/3LCache、Workload-aware、AsymCache）并与Belady对比；（4）从生命周期、复用间隔、频率、miss代价、会话footprint五个维度对比前缀/Web/块三类工作负载；（5）提出compute-savings ratio指标、ILP离线最优与BeladyCompute近似，设计RandomCompute和partial-node策略；（6）在真实vLLM+H200上端到端验证TTFT与吞吐。
AI.result: LRU在两种trace和两个容量区间下都接近最优在线算法；频率型算法（LFU、W-TinyLFU）显著退化；Belady仍留有显著优化空间。结构上，前缀块寿命短、复用间隔短且方差低、频率不能预测下次访问时间、miss代价随块深度增长、会话footprint重尾。基于此，quick demotion仅在一次性请求占比极高时有效；compute-aware + partial-node在48 GiB HBM下将平均TTFT降低19.9%、prefill吞吐提升18.8%；HBM中必须采用块级淘汰，大内存池中会话级淘汰几乎无性能损失但可大幅降低元数据开销。
AI.conclusion: LLM前缀缓存的有效管理应以recency（LRU）为基础根基，并根据工作负载特征与容量层级有条件地叠加其他信号：一次性请求泛滥时启用quick demotion；长序列+高attention成本时采用计算感知淘汰并以partial-node粒度避免碎片；HBM坚持块级淘汰，大内存池可灵活采用会话级淘汰以降低元数据开销。论文将开源trace与模拟器以支持后续研究。

title: Dependency- and Layer-Aware Microservice Workflow Offloading and Service Image Caching for Edge Environments
comment: This manuscript was submitted to IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems on November 5, 2025
summary: The microservice architecture has been applied broadly in many mainstream computing environments. As one of the most prevalent environments, edge computing also widely employs microservices to handle diverse requests and tasks. In practical scenarios, microservices usually constitute workflows that are built based on service dependencies to execute tasks. This offers an opportunity to explore the offloading technology to better harness resources and accelerate task execution. Unfortunately, this problem has not been paid attention to by existing research, and thus some valuable resources (e.g., microservice image cache) remain obscure. To fill this gap, we innovatively study the problem of joint optimization for microservice workflow offloading and service image caching in edge. This problem is challenging due to several issues such as the complexity of its solution space, intricate relationships among shared image layers, long-range dependencies between workflow tasks, and the absence of a real-world collection of service images. To address these issues, this paper proposes an innovative dependency- and layer-aware workflow offloading and image caching framework for microservices. We collected a real-world collection of microservice image layer data and published both this collection and experimental codes on GitHub. Extensive results demonstrate that our framework achieves superior performances, for example, a 22. 38\% reduction in average task completion time compared to baselines and significantly-increased image hit rates.

AI.tldr: 本文针对边缘计算环境中微服务工作流卸载与服务镜像缓存的联合优化问题，提出了一种基于层次化深度强化学习的依赖与层感知框架DLA-HDRL，通过引入层感知交叉注意力（LACA）和依赖感知多头交叉注意力（DAMH-CA）机制，有效捕捉镜像层共享关系与任务间长程依赖，显著降低了任务完成时间并提升了镜像命中率。
AI.motivation: 现有研究忽略了边缘环境中微服务工作流卸载与服务镜像缓存的联合优化问题，未能充分利用边缘服务器的空闲存储资源进行镜像缓存，也未考虑微服务镜像的层共享特性和任务间的复杂依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出DLA-HDRL框架，包含：1）基于LACA机制的工作流卸载代理，通过交叉注意力计算任务镜像与服务器缓存镜像之间的层共享关系；2）基于DAMH-CA机制的微服务缓存代理，通过交叉注意力与多头注意力挖掘任务间长程依赖；3）采用层次化深度强化学习（HDRL）解耦大规模状态-动作空间；4）提出基于拓扑排序与轮询的TSP任务队列构建算法。
AI.result: 基于DockerHub上50个最流行微服务镜像构建的真实数据集及EUA、Alibaba cluster trace等公开数据集进行实验，结果表明DLA-HDRL相比HOC、D3QNNP、PPO和SAC等基线方法，平均任务完成时间最多降低22.38%，镜像命中率显著提升；在不同用户数、缓存容量和服务器数量下均展现出良好的收敛性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DLA-HDRL通过注意力机制与层次化架构的协同，有效解决了边缘环境中微服务工作流卸载与镜像缓存联合优化的NP-hard问题，在降低任务完成延迟和提高资源利用率方面取得了优越性能；未来计划探索大语言模型在微服务部署、编排和资源调度等问题中的应用。

title: Cross-Model Autoscaling for Shared LLM Serving
summary: Multi-model LLM serving is moving toward shared MaaS clusters, where co-hosted models compete for a fixed GPU budget while each model experiences time-varying demand and must satisfy its own latency SLO. Existing LLM autoscalers remain largely model-local: their signals expose local runtime activity or delayed latency outcomes, and their scale-up or provisioning decisions do not directly determine how shared capacity should be allocated across competing models. We present the Token-service-share Rebalancing Engine (TRE), a control-plane framework for hot-switched multi-model LLM serving. TRE introduces Token Service Share (TSS), a calibrated, demand-normalized signal that estimates effective token service per active or queued request and yields a comparable health score across heterogeneous models and SLO classes. Guided by TSS, TRE coordinates bounded receiver--donor capacity movement under a fixed GPU budget: it separates fast rescue from slower rebalancing and incrementally reallocates active replicas toward models with the largest calibrated service deficits. We implement TRE on a Kubernetes-based hot-switch serving stack without modifying the inference scheduler. Across seven LLM serving traces, TRE reduces P95 end-to-end latency by 11.9--79.0\% and P99 latency by 12.5--72.6\% compared with a state-of-the-art KV-cache-based reactive autoscaler running on the same hot-switch runtime. The gains hold on both targeted stress probes and production-derived conversation/code traces, where TRE reduces P95/P99 latency by 50.8/63.7\% and 79.0/72.6\%, respectively. These results show that effective hot-switched autoscaling requires not only fast replica actuation, but also calibrated service-deficit signals and coordinated cross-model capacity arbitration. Our code and artifacts are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TRE（Token-service-share Rebalancing Engine）是一种面向共享 MaaS 集群中多模型 LLM 服务的跨模型自动扩缩容控制框架。其核心创新是引入 TSS（Token Service Share）信号，对每个模型的有效 token 服务按其需求和 SLO 进行归一化，从而在异构模型之间形成可比较的"服务健康分数"，并据此在固定 GPU 预算下进行接收方-贡献方的有界副本再分配。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 自动扩缩容方案多为模型本地化：基于本地 KV 缓存利用率、队列长度或延迟等信号独立决策，缺乏跨模型可比的服务缺口度量。在共享 MaaS 集群中，GPU 预算固定，单个模型的扩容必须以回收其他模型容量为代价，本地信号无法裁决哪个缺口更紧迫，也无法决定共享容量应如何跨模型分配。
AI.method:
1）TSS 信号：将有效 token 服务（prefill 权重 w_p，decode 权重 1）除以紧急加权在途请求数（A_m + w_q·W_m），再做指数平滑（参数 α），并用每个模型 SLO 对应的健康边界 θ_m 归一化为 Z_m(t)=TSS/θ_m。Z_m<1 表示服务低于健康需求。通过临界/过剩/标称三档滞回分区实现稳定分类。
2）TRE 控制框架：双速控制——快速救援循环（5 s）处理进入临界区或违反硬性约束的模型，按"空闲→隐藏→贡献方释放"最少扰动顺序获取容量；较慢再平衡循环（10 s）以 Z_m 最低者为接收方、过剩者为贡献方，执行有界成对转移（每次 tick 至多一次 GPU 预算可行的路由容量转换）。执行层在贡献方施加最低副本数、新请求隐藏、KV 缓存与延迟等本地守门检查，可在不动全局决策的前提下推迟或拒绝释放。
3）实现：基于 Kubernetes + AIBrix + vLLM 的热切换栈，控制平面仅作用于路由与副本生命周期，不修改 vLLM 推理调度器。
AI.result: 在两台 4×A100 40GB（NVLink）机器上同时部署 dsllama-8b、dsqwen-7b、dsqwen-14b，对比同为 Llumnix 风格的 KV-Auto 反应式基线。覆盖 5 类针对性压力探针（正弦、解码、prefill、轮换、同步尖峰）和 2 个生产派生 trace（Real-Conv、Real-Code），每条约 720 s。结果：P95 E2E 延迟降低 11.9–79.0%，P99 降低 12.5–72.6%，均值 E2E 降低 14.8–73.0%。Real-Conv 50.8%/63.7%、Real-Code 79.0%/72.6%（P95/P99）。Simul-Spike 上 TRE 将 dsllama-8b 与 dsqwen-7b 的 P95 TPOT 超 SLO 窗口从 41 与 46 分别降至 0 与 13；同步 sleep/wake 平均 1.87/1.31 s，均落在 10 s 控制周期内；sleep 释放 94.9–97.0% 显存，剩余驻留 1.0–1.8 GB。TSS 在三类模型上随 SLO 健康排序的单调性显著优于队列、KV、prefill/decode TPS 等本地信号。
AI.conclusion: 在共享且被占满的 GPU 集群中，有效的热切换自动扩缩容不仅需要快速副本执行，还需要校准的、跨模型可比较的服务缺口信号和协调的容量仲裁机制。TSS+TRE 通过将异构模型的服务状态归一到同一可比尺度，并以有界双速控制把全局 max–min 容量分配落到成对接收-贡献转移上，在不修改推理调度器的前提下显著稳定尾部延迟。当存在空闲 GPU 或负载平稳可预测时增益较小，因此 TRE 定位为"竞争态多模型部署"的控制机制。未来工作包括面向 prefill/decode 解耦部署的阶段感知 TSS、细粒度资源切片与 KV-cache 迁移恢复路径，以及在线自适应重标定。

title: TrafficFab: An Autonomic Edge-Cloud Testbed Fabric forAI-Driven Traffic Management
summary: Traffic management in emerging megacities requires real-time analytics over thousands of CCTV video streams under latency, bandwidth, compute and energy constraints. We present TrafficFab, an autonomic edge--cloud testbed for AI-driven traffic management, designed to validate a representative slice of a megacity deployment. TrafficFab combines RTSP stream emulation, heterogeneous edge inference using DNNs, cloud-based nowcasting and forecasting using Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network (ST-GNN), and continual model adaptation through foundation-model (FM)-assisted Federated Learning (FL). Its autonomic control enables fine-grained scale-out/in of edge inference through energy- and migration-aware scheduling, elastic scale-up/down of GNN forecasting on public clouds, and periodic adaptation of the DNN on edge accelerators and private cloud, without centralized video collection. We evaluate TrafficFab on a Bangalore-city inspired deployment, spanning Raspberry Pis, Jetson accelerators, GPU fogs, private cloud servers, and cloud VMs, sustaining real-time analytics for $\approx 400$ live camera streams (10% of Bangalore) and analytically characterize larger setups. The results demonstrate that TrafficFab offers a practical validation-scale platform for closed-loop traffic analytics, short-term operational decision support, and longer-horizon planning analyses in megacity scales.

AI.tldr: TrafficFab是一个面向新兴超大城市的自主式边缘-私有云-公有云测试平台，针对AI驱动的智能交通系统（AIITS），可在代表性规模（约400路实时摄像头流，约占班加罗尔10%）下支持实时视频分析、ST-GNN交通预测以及FM辅助的联邦学习持续模型适配，并形式化设计并验证了能量感知与迁移感知的流调度策略。
AI.motivation: 新兴超大城市（如班加罗尔）拥有数千路CCTV摄像头，但依赖集中式视频采集与分析在带宽、延迟、算力与能耗方面不可行；同时传统基于专用传感器的ITS难以部署、缺乏车道纪律的异构交通也不适用。需要一个能在验证规模下复现城市部署关键约束（延迟、带宽、算力、能耗）的自主式测试平台，以闭环验证感知-推理-预测-适配全流程。
AI.method: 构建四层架构：（1）RTSP流仿真层（MediaMTX+FFmpeg，42块RPi支持100路流，10节点CPU集群扩展至1000路）；（2）边缘推理层（Jetson Xavier/Orin/Thor + GPU雾节点，DeepStream+YOLO26s+BoT-SORT）；（3）公有云分析层（AWS EC2，ingest+nowcast+TrendGCN forecast，质量守恒分配将路口计数映射至路段流量）；（4）联邦适配层（SAM3作FM教师标注不确定样本，Flotilla+FedAvg联邦微调）。提出三种基于动态规划的流调度策略：EA-DP（静态全局能耗最优）、EA-DP-I（增量零迁移）和MA-DP（迁移感知，以λ惩罚项权衡能耗与稳定性）。公有云端提出纵向与横向两种弹性伸缩策略。
AI.result: 在Edge-only（EO，4 Xavier+5 Orin 32GB+5 Orin 64GB+2 Thor，最大286流）和Edge+Fog（EF，增加13块工作站GPU，最大1000流）两种部署下验证：EA-DP始终为能耗基线，MA-DP在EF上1000流斜坡中仅8.0W高于EA-DP，但将总迁移从1306降至376（减少71.21%）；在2400流、8客户端下，forecast延迟从m6a.large的113s降至m6a.4xlarge的58s，但受I/O瓶颈限制（660 ops/s，CPU仅215%）；FM辅助FL在数十轮内将训练损失从2.89降至2.32，mAP稳步提升。系统整体支撑400路实时流端到端分析，并在CCGrid 2026 SCALE挑战赛中获第一名（90边缘设备、21节点、4 EC2 VM、454容器）。
AI.conclusion: TrafficFab验证了边缘-云连续体上AIITS闭环的可行性，是面向超大城市规模交通管理（实时可视、短期决策支持、长期规划分析）的实用验证级平台；MA-DP被证实在异构边缘上兼具近最优能耗与最小化迁移扰动，是动态工作负载下的最佳运行点；公有云分析在更高规模下需从纵向扩展转向横向图分区扩展。

title: Concurrent Split Learning Through Stable Client Clustering
summary: Training with a fixed global batch limits how many distributed clients can provide examples in any one step. We examine a way to use additional server workers without increasing the batch processed by an individual workload. Global Clustered Parallel Split Learning (GCPSL) assigns clients to fixed clusters, executes a Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling (GPSL) workload for each cluster concurrently, and periodically fuses the client and server model segments. In simulations with 256 logical clients, dividing the population across more workloads improves direct data participation, while smaller clusters can incur an accuracy cost. A four-H100 implementation of label-aware GCPSL reaches 85% CIFAR-10 validation accuracy in $6.13 \pm 0.15$ minutes over three matched runs, versus $19.09 \pm 0.45$ minutes when the same workloads are serialized. Within the four-GPU allocation, size-balanced and random fixed affiliations reach the target in similar mean times (5.70 and 5.66 minutes); size balancing increases direct participation by 3.25 percentage points. These measurements characterize a trade-off among execution concurrency, assignment information, participation, and accuracy for stable-client split learning.

AI.tldr: GCPSL通过将客户端分到固定集群、并行运行GPSL工作负载并周期性融合模型,在不增大单工作负载批次的前提下提升split learning的客户端参与度和训练速度。
AI.motivation: GPSL使用固定全局批次B时,当客户端数K远大于B,每轮直接提供数据的客户端被限制在B以内,导致大量客户端无直接数据参与;增大B又会改变优化行为和内存需求。作者希望在保持单工作负载批次不变的情况下,通过增加并发工作负载数来提高整体参与度。
AI.method: GCPSL将K个稳定客户端划分到N个不相交集群,每个集群运行一个batch=B的GPSL工作负载,各集群并行执行;每轮集群内平均活跃客户端梯度,在epoch边界按样本权重q_n融合客户端与服务器段参数及BatchNorm统计量,再广播给所有副本。客户端分段用GroupNorm替代以避免分歧。分配策略包括随机、样本数均衡、以及使用类别直方图的标签感知分配(以JSD为目标函数)。
AI.result: 在K=256、B=64的CIFAR-10模拟中,标签感知GCPSL在N=4时将R_85降低43.2%(相对GPSL);N增大提升直接参与度,但N=16时准确率下降约3.5个百分点。四块H100上标签感知GCPSL以6.13±0.15分钟达到85%验证准确率,串行执行同一工作负载需19.09±0.45分钟(3.11×加速);随机与样本均衡固定分配平均时间相近(5.66 vs 5.70分钟),均衡分配将直接参与度提高3.25个百分点;CIFAR-100上标签感知在N=4下达到60%一致收敛。
AI.conclusion: GCPSL在客户端固定、服务器具备多并发槽位时可显著加速训练,核心权衡为:更多集群提升数据参与但降低每个本地采样器的标签多样性与最终精度;样本均衡分配比随机分配提高参与度但未显著缩短目标时间;标签感知分配在标签分布更复杂的CIFAR-100上更有优势;无融合则模型无法协调导致失败。

title: Resource-Aware Model Selection for Scalable Indoor Localization on HPC Platforms
comment: 20 pages, 15 figures. Accepted for publication in 38th IEEE/SBC International Symposium on Computer Architecture and High Performance Computing (SBAC-PAD 2026)
summary: Large-scale indoor localization is increasingly needed in campuses, smart buildings, factories, and digital-twin infrastructures, where wireless conditions, access-point deployments, and spatial layouts evolve over time. Such systems must be accurate, extendable, and maintainable, allowing new buildings, floors, rooms, and service areas to be added without retraining a monolithic model. Modular learning-based localization supports this goal by assigning independent models to buildings, floors, and fine-grained spatial regions. However, this extendability introduces a high-performance inference challenge: each query may require selecting and executing among hundreds or thousands of local models, making exhaustive inference costly in computation, accelerator memory residency, model loading, and scheduling. This paper presents a resource-aware modular inference framework for WiFi fingerprint-based indoor localization on high-performance and distributed computing platforms. The framework organizes local autoencoder models into a building-floor-spot hierarchy and formulates localization as model selection over a large pretrained model ensemble. To reduce inference cost under resource constraints, we introduce two lightweight execution-pruning strategies: Hierarchical Candidate Pruning, which performs coarse-to-fine model selection, and Trajectory-Aware Pruning, which uses temporal locality in user movement to restrict inference to spatially plausible neighboring models. Experiments on a real-world dataset demonstrate that the proposed framework delivers scalable inference without sacrificing localization quality. Compared with exhaustive evaluation over 735 spot models, Hierarchical Candidate Pruning requires only 67 model evaluations, while Trajectory-Aware Pruning reduces this number to just 10, cutting model executions by 98.6%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种资源感知的模块化室内定位推理框架，通过层级候选剪枝（HCP）和轨迹感知剪枝（TAP）两种策略，将基于WiFi指纹的室内定位模型执行次数从735个降至67个和10个，在保持定位精度的同时大幅降低计算开销和推理延迟，并在Fugaku超算上验证了良好的并行可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 单体式WiFi指纹定位模型在大规模、动态变化的室内环境（如校园、智能建筑）中面临维护性差、扩展困难的问题；模块化模型（按建筑-楼层-区域分配独立模型）虽然提高了可扩展性，但推理时需评估数百至数千个本地模型，导致计算、加速器内存驻留、模型加载和调度开销巨大，成为高性能推理瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 将环境按"建筑-楼层-点(spot)"三级层次结构组织，为每个空间单元训练独立的自编码器模型，利用重构误差作为相似性度量；2) 提出层级候选剪枝（HCP）：自顶向下先选建筑、再选楼层、最后选区域候选模型；3) 提出轨迹感知剪枝（TAP）：利用用户移动的时间局部性，将候选集限制在上一估计位置的空间邻近区域；4) 使用掩码重构损失（仅在已观测WAP维度上计算）训练自编码器，避免缺失AP值主导重构评分。
AI.result: 在UJIIndoorLoc数据集上：穷举基线需735次模型评估，HCP降至67次（减少90.9%），TAP降至10次（减少98.6%）；top-1准确率分别为0.631、0.638、0.615，HCP平均距离误差最低（4.04m）且楼层准确率最高（0.9855）；在受限GPU内存设置下，模型加载开销显著降低；在Fugaku超算上，16节点时TAP平均延迟低至1.07ms，HCP为4.48ms，穷举基线为30.04ms，三者均呈近线性扩展，模型执行时间始终是主要开销。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了模块化室内定位可以通过资源感知的候选选择实现可扩展推理，在显著减少模型执行次数和延迟的同时保持定位质量；层级结构有效捕捉了室内空间的多尺度特征，HCP与TAP在不同计算架构（GPU/CPU）和内存条件下均具有通用性，适合大规模、可扩展且长期部署的高性能分布式室内定位服务；未来工作将研究多用户多查询场景下的缓存管理及HPC资源分配策略。

title: Where Does the Energy Go? Profiling LLM Agent Inference on Blackwell GPUs
summary: LLM agents that iteratively reason, plan, and invoke tools create workload profiles fundamentally different from single-pass inference, yet how their energy consumption is distributed across hardware components and workload phases remains poorly understood. Characterizing these workloads therefore requires simultaneous visibility into both component-level power and phase-level execution. We conduct a full-stack energy profiling study combining NVML GPU counters, Intel RAPL CPU/DRAM counters, and Intelligent Platform Management Interface (IPMI) system-level sensors on 2x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs, and profile three representative workloads with Qwen3.8-27B. For mathematical reasoning, we compare thinking-enabled and thinking-disabled modes. Our measurements reveal that GPU-only telemetry misses 41-45% of system energy across all three workloads, with non-GPU components accounting for the remainder. In our setup, the sequential agent workload consumes 63x more system energy per output token than saturated serving, reflecting the absence of batching, context growth across turns, and tool-induced idle periods. Extended thinking generates 21-75% more tokens per problem, while per-token energy differs by less than 1% between modes within each dataset, indicating that the resulting increase in energy is driven by output volume rather than a change in per-token efficiency. Continuous batching improves system-level energy efficiency by 3.2x from 1 to 16 requests per second, as GPU power plateaus while throughput continues to increase with batching depth. For the memory-bandwidth-bound reasoning workload, throughput remains unchanged under per-GPU power caps of 400-600 W but drops sharply at 300 W. These findings suggest that context-management techniques such as summarization and selective retrieval may help reduce energy consumption in agent deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文对Blackwell GPU上的LLM智能体推理工作负载进行了全栈能耗剖析，结合NVML、RAPL和IPMI三种测量接口，揭示了GPU仅占系统能耗的55-59%，智能体工作负载每输出token能耗是饱和服务的63倍，以及连续批处理、上下文增长、扩展思考等对能耗的影响机制。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体工作负载（多轮推理、工具调用、上下文累积）相比单次推理具有根本不同的能耗特征，但现有研究缺乏对组件级和阶段级的全栈能耗归因分析，尤其是在最新的Blackwell GPU平台上。准确刻画这类工作负载的能耗分布对于碳排放评估和智能体部署优化至关重要。
AI.method: 在2×NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU服务器上，通过三层测量接口进行全栈能耗剖析：(1) NVML以10 Hz采样GPU能耗计数器；(2) Intel RAPL以10 Hz采样CPU包和DRAM能耗；(3) IPMI以1 Hz采样系统级传感器（CPU、内存、风扇、总功率）。使用vLLM（v0.19.1）以BF16精度和张量并行服务Qwen3.8-27B模型。评估三类工作负载：(1) SWE-bench Verified的50个智能体编码任务（多轮工具调用+扩展思考）；(2) AIME 2022-2024和MATH-500的数学推理（对比思考启用/禁用）；(3) ShareGPT的连续批处理服务（1-16 req/s）。同时进行300-600 W的功率上限扫描实验。能耗指标包括每token能耗、每任务能耗、组件级和系统级功率。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1) GPU遥测遗漏了所有三类工作负载41-45%的系统能耗（GPU占55-59%，CPU约23.5%，DRAM约1%，其他约19.5%）；(2) 智能体工作负载每输出token系统能耗为58,383 mJ，是饱和服务（920 mJ/tok@16 req/s）的63倍，归因于无批处理、上下文增长和工具调用引起的空闲；(3) 智能体中每轮能耗随轮次增加（平均功率基本不变，时长是主因）；(4) 扩展思考使token量增加21-75%，但每token能耗差异<1%，能耗增长主要来自输出量而非效率变化；(5) 连续批处理从1到16 req/s使系统能效提升3.2倍（GPU功率趋于平稳但吞吐量持续增长）；(6) 推理工作负载在400-600 W功率上限下吞吐量不变（约48 tok/s），但300 W时骤降3.1倍，呈现性能悬崖；(7) 单个SWE-bench任务平均耗能约2,989 kJ，远高于AIME（313.2 kJ）和MATH-500（53.6 kJ）任务。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明GPU遥测不足以进行完整的系统能耗核算，应结合平台级测量或进行平台特定修正。上下文管理（摘要、选择性检索）是降低智能体能耗的有效方向；思考模式的能耗开销可通过早停和预算感知解码来优化；连续批处理能显著提升能效；功率上限选择需考虑工作负载特性（内存带宽受限的推理任务在400-600 W区间对功率上限不敏感，但300 W时出现性能悬崖）。

title: Reusing Spare Vehicle Computing Capacity: Is It Viable, Profitable and Sustainable?
summary: Vehicular Cloud Computing (VCC) exploits computing hardware already embedded in vehicles for purposes unrelated to offloading and puts its idle cycles to work executing end-users' offloaded tasks, avoiding the deployment of new computation infrastructure. Despite its conceptual appeal, adoption is hindered by the lack of quantitative evidence that sharing spare vehicular capacity is viable, profitable and sustainable. A management scheme for task offloading sustains deadline-constrained execution by decoupling deadline-aware allocation from ex-post incentive design, making the approach viable. A robust coalitional game and a vehicle-selection mechanism keep the network operator and the vehicle owners profitable even under unfavorable outcomes of the random environment, e.g.,mobility, radio conditions, or vehicles overstating their spare capacity. A simulation campaign on realistic urban mobility, using Simulation of Urban MObility (SUMO) traces of Rome,together with a CO2 life-cycle assessment against edge computing infrastructure, whose footprint, is attributed pro rata to the share of its capacity devoted to offloading shows the approach to be sustainable. Vehicles absorb most of the offloaded traffic within tens of milliseconds; participation yields up to 157 km of monthly driving range per vehicle; and life-cycle emissions drop by over 99% when using VCC compared to that edge infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究利用车辆闲置计算能力进行任务卸载的车载云计算(VCC)方案，从可行性、盈利性和可持续性三个维度进行系统性量化评估。通过两阶段调度、鲁棒联盟博弈和基于Wasserstein距离的准入规则，结合罗马SUMO真实城市移动仿真和生命周期碳排放评估，证明了VCC可在毫秒级延迟内完成大部分任务、每辆车月收益对应33-157公里续航、并使全生命周期碳排放降低超过99%。
AI.motivation: 车载云计算(VCC)概念虽然具有吸引力，但由于缺乏定量证据证明其可行性、盈利性和可持续性，实际部署受阻。论文旨在回答三个核心问题：共享车辆闲置算力是否可行？是否盈利？是否可持续？
AI.method: 1. 两阶段架构：阶段一在5ms时隙内基于标称估计完成截止时间感知的任务分配(ILP)；阶段二在关键路径外基于实际结果完成收益分配。2. 鲁棒准入规则：利用1-Wasserstein距离量化车辆容量虚报，结合CVa Wasserstein成本边界进行事前过滤。3. 鲁棒联盟博弈：定义内/外嵌套博弈（NO作为否决者获取一半收益，车辆按实际成本比例分配另一半），并证明核心非空(Bondareva-Shapley定理)。4. 系统模型：M/G/1队列(Pollaczek-Khinchine)、EARTH能量模型、TR 38.901城市NLOS信道。5. 基于SUMO的罗马市中心真实移动轨迹仿真（500m微蜂窝、10-200辆车、25-200终端用户）。6. ISO 14040生命周期评估，对比VCC与边缘服务器(NVIDIA A30/A100)的CO₂排放。
AI.result: 可行性：车辆密度≥60时车队承接≥97%任务，平均完成时间从150ms(30车)降至40ms(200车)；DRO/no-DRO/Greedy失败率随密度从48%降至13%；边缘服务器失败率<3%。盈利性：每辆车月净收益0.87-4.13美元，对应33-157公里月度续航；车辆一生(18.4年)累计194-924美元(7400-35200公里)；VCC任务成本仅为边缘服务器的1/84至1/8241；DRO使虚报车辆场景的截止时间失误降低至1/6。鲁棒性：在虚报率ψ=0.6、8%空闲容量时，DRO失误率5.3% vs no-DRO的31.1%；但当空闲容量≥15%时准入规则会损失效用。可持续性：单车年排放6-300g CO₂(取决于电网碳强度)，对比边缘服务器5年生命周期1182-8536kg CO₂，节省>99%排放(每车最多8.5吨)；同时避免12kg钢、1.5kg铝等稀有材料需求。
AI.conclusion: 该论文证明VCC在毫秒级延迟约束下技术上可行，在经济激励上可覆盖参与成本，并在环境上显著优于边缘基础设施(排放降低>99%)。DRO准入规则在容量稀缺且存在虚报时保护截止时间保证，但在容量充裕时反而损失效用(自适应变体被数据拒绝)。未来工作包括实地验证、多蜂窝切换感知分配、高密度信令抑制和信任机制。

title: A Block Decomposed QUBO Workflow for Chromosome-Y Phylogeny Reconstruction
comment: accepted work at 21st International Conference on Computational Intelligence methods for Bioinformatics and Biostatistics (CIBB2026) - presented in session SS16: Quantum Artificial Intelligence for Bioinformatics and Biostatistics: Theory, Algorithms, and Applications pre-proceedings version
summary: This paper sets out a computational workflow that reconstructs the phylogeny of human Y-chromosome populations from a Variant Call Format (VCF) file of biallelic Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms (SNP). The two classical phylogenetic decisions - topology selection and root placement - are cast as Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimisation (QUBO) problems. The workflow combines two QUBO formulations with an Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) decomposition strategy and a plug-in Digitized Counter-Diabatic Quantum Optimization (DCQO) solver, enabling large phylogenetic optimization problems to be executed across multiple classical or quantum computing resources. The DCQO gate-based optimizer drives each ADMM-block QUBO with short-depth counter-diabatic circuits in the impulse regime, without the necessity for an outer variational loop. The combination of ADMM decomposition and the DCQO block solver facilitates problem sizes that surpass the qubit budget of any individual digital quantum processing unit call, while maintaining the integrity of the original objective. The workflow extracts genotype information from VCF files, reconstructs topology and rooting through two QUBO formulations, and annotates the resulting tree using PhyloTree. The resultant data set comprises a Nexus-annotated rooted tree, in addition to diagnostic figures. The workflow demonstrates the potential of modest-scale QUBO formulations combined with ADMM decomposition to serve as a scalable alternative to greedy heuristics in the domain of population genomics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于QUBO的Y染色体系统发育重建工作流，结合ADMM分解策略和DCQO量子求解器，将拓扑选择和根放置两个经典系统发育问题编码为QUBO优化问题，并通过VCF文件实现端到端流程。
AI.motivation: 系统发育树重建中可能的无根二叉树拓扑数量随分类群数量超指数增长，使得穷举搜索不可行。传统启发式方法（如邻接法、最大简约法）缺乏统一优化框架；同时，现有量子系统发育方法多为孤立优化问题，缺乏跨量子退火和门模型后端的设备无关架构。作者旨在构建一个统一的QUBO框架，利用ADMM分解和DCQO求解器实现可扩展的、跨异构计算资源的系统发育重建。
AI.method: 方法包含五个核心环节：(1) VCF数据预处理——从FORMAT/GT字段提取ALT剂量矩阵D，过滤缺失率和携带率，女性样本自动剔除；(2) 距离矩阵与候选分裂——计算样本间平均绝对剂量差，基于邻接树和200次bootstrap重采样提取支持率≥50%的候选分裂（取前K=30个）；(3) QUBO-1拓扑选择——以分裂兼容性为约束、归一化支持度为奖励，构建含线性奖励、不兼容性惩罚(λ=5)和分支数约束(μ=2.5, k=N-3)的二次优化问题；(4) QUBO-2根放置——以根到叶距离方差为代价(η=10)，精确选择一个根插入边；(5) ADMM分解+DCQO求解——将大规模QUBO划分为重叠子块(|V_k|≲12-15量子比特)，通过增强拉格朗日协调；每个块用脉冲域一阶反绝热解析系数α₁(t) Trotter化电路（4步）求解，无需变分外循环。PhyloTree-Y用于分支注释，输出NEXUS格式树文件。
AI.result: 在gnomAD v3.1.2 HGDP+1KG Y染色体数据集（78个群体，128,316个双等位SNP）上验证：QUBO-1含30个二元变量（435个二次耦合），95.1秒达到能量5050.80的全局最优，所选30个分裂全部存在于邻接参考树中（精确率1.00，召回率0.40）；QUBO-2含153个变量（11,628个二次耦合），ADMM分解为16个块、9轮迭代、652.5秒求解，能量-9.61，根准确放置于根-尖方差最小的分支（rank 1/153），定位于非洲深部谱系，与分子钟预期一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流证明了QUBO是小到中等规模系统发育决策的可行形式化方法。ADMM分解将单一整体QUBO调用替换为一系列更小的块调用，每个块由短深度反绝热电路求解，可适配当前门模型量子处理器的相干预算，同时通过共识约束保持全局优化目标完整性。未来工作包括：(i) 在超导和囚禁离子硬件上对DCQO块求解器进行基准测试；(ii) 扩展拓扑QUBO以包含分支长度变量（变量数乘法增长的场景正是ADMM+DCQO设计目标）；(iii) 用变分优化的规范势替代一阶反绝热项以进一步缩短电路；(iv) 引入从推断树重估突变概率的极大化步骤以细化支持分数。

title: KREX: Concurrent Kernel Benchmarking on Shared GPUs via Region-Granular Exclusivity
summary: LLM agents automate GPU kernel optimization by repeatedly composing candidates and measuring their duration on real GPUs. Existing systems preserve measurement fidelity by reserving a GPU for an entire agent session or benchmarking command. However, this results in poor utilization because only a small fraction of command execution requires exclusive GPU access. Sharing GPUs could recover this idle capacity, but introduces contention that compromises measurement fidelity and misdirects the agent's search. We present KREX, a runtime for concurrent kernel agent benchmarking with region-granular exclusivity. KREX lets agents mark critical regions involving timing-sensitive operations within a benchmarking command. The runtime then enforces exclusivity within marked regions and allows concurrent execution outside them, achieving high throughput while preserving measurement fidelity. To enforce in-region exclusivity, KREX blocks new competing GPU submissions and drains outstanding work before freezing sibling processes and isolating CPU cores, protecting both GPU execution and the host threads that drive measurements. To maximize off-region concurrency, KREX reuses GPU contexts in persistent context processes to avoid repeated, node-wide serialized context creation. We evaluate KREX on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs. Compared with command-granular exclusivity baselines, KREX delivers up to $3.4\times$ the benchmarking throughput with a negligible p95 timing inflation of $0.30\%$, $1.58\%$, and $3.90\%$ for kernels longer than 10 ms, 1 ms, and 0.1 ms, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KREX，一个支持区域粒度排他性的并发内核基准测试运行时。KREX允许LLM驱动的内核优化代理标记其基准测试命令中对计时敏感的关键区域，仅在该区域内强制独占执行，其余部分允许并发，从而在保持测量精度的同时大幅提升GPU利用率。基于NVIDIA和AMD GPU的评估显示，KREX在H20上实现了3.4倍吞吐量提升，MI308X上2.6倍，p95计时误差极低。
AI.motivation: LLM代理通过在真实GPU上反复编写候选内核并测量其执行时间来自动优化GPU内核。现有系统通过独占保留整个GPU来保护测量精度，但实际仅内核基准测试命令中很小的部分需要独占访问：计时循环仅占整个命令的8.5%。生产环境中GPU利用率低至3.4%，而排队需求是峰时容量的4.8倍。简单共享GPU（如MPS、MIG、time-slicing）会引入争用，使测量时长膨胀1.5-3.2倍并扰乱候选排名排序，导致Agent在MoE等场景下选出次优内核。
AI.method: KREX采用三种核心机制：(1)区域标记——通过简单的上下文管理器`region.critical()`允许Agent标记所有需要独占的关键区域；(2)区域内排他性——进入区域时执行8步协议：获取Region锁→关闭共享内存gate→唤醒Siblings的drainer线程排空在飞工作→冻结Siblings进程树并将其加入per-tenant freezer cgroup→L2刷新并将holder线程绑定到该GPU专属CPU切片中的核心→执行→退出时按相反顺序解冻。Context进程共享ring buffer通过"counter-and-gate"协议：提交前原子增加计数器并检查gate，gate被持有则回滚并park，context创建/清理遵循相同协议。(3)区域间并发——维护持久context进程池，每个context进程与一个客户端配对，跨命令复用，避免节点级锁序列化。上文通过共享内存RPC异步转发驱动调用，kernel launch采用fire-and-forget请求实现与GPU执行重叠；等待策略采用spin-park以避免频繁唤醒开销。支持NVIDIA（context进程中通过driver shim转发）和AMD（运行时在client进程中hook ROCm dispatch table）异构平台。
AI.result: 在四节点测试床（16个H20+16个MI308X）上回放超过20,000个真实基准测试命令：H20上KREX达54.8 cmds/min，是原生command-granular独占（16.0 cmds/min）的3.4倍；MI308X上50.4 cmds/min，是原生（19.4 cmds/min）的2.6倍。p95计时膨胀对大于10ms、1ms、0.1ms的内核分别为0.30%、1.58%、3.90%。中位计时比0.997-1.000，93.3-97.1%落在原生参考的5%以内。KREX成对排名翻转率与原生重跑差距≤3个百分点，per-trajectory Kendall's τ_b中位数为0.857（vs. 原生重跑0.820，ungated 0.432）。RPC转发本身造成的中位偏移：单次计时下28μs（0.1%），十次中位数下进一步降低。消融研究显示GPU保护贡献最大精度提升，CPU冻结额外提升精度与吞吐量，MPS启用使H20吞吐量再增24%而精度变化极小。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明GPU内核基准测试不必在利用率与测量精度间二选一：只需标记并独占关键区域。KREX通过区域粒度排他性实现了最多3.4倍吞吐量，且对排名信号几乎无损地保真。论文涵盖异构平台（NVIDIA/AMD）、完整威胁模型讨论、故障恢复路径，以及与其他GPU共享方案（time-slicing、MPS、MIG、API remoting）的对比。限制包括：依赖诚实标记区域（不能验证其正确性）、无理论最坏误差界、slot-based调度缺乏区域公平性、多GPU候选与多节点池有待未来工作。

title: Steelhead: Interleaving Partially Synchronous and Asynchronous Commit Rules on a Shared DAG
summary: Dual-mode consensus protocols are fast when the network is partially synchronous and remain live under asynchrony. We introduce Steelhead, a dual-mode mechanism that composes a partially synchronous and an asynchronous commit rule over one DAG: every k-th round is decided by the asynchronous rule, whose leader a common coin reveals after the votes, and all other rounds by the partially synchronous rule. Every interval, validators replay the committed DAG under each candidate period, adopt the one with the fewest expected message delays, and fall back to k = 1 when the output stalls; the asynchronous rule applied to the coin rounds alone keeps the protocol live. Steelhead sends no message beyond the DAG's blocks, not even to agree on the period, and opens a coin only on the rounds that need a hidden leader. It is generic over pairs of DAG commit rules that share a committee; we instantiate it with Mysticeti and Mahi-Mahi at n >= 3f+1 and with the two variants of BlueBottle at n >= 5f+1. We prove it safe and live, and provide mechanized proofs in Lean 4. In simulation, Steelhead matches the partially synchronous protocol in a healthy network, stays close to the asynchronous one when network conditions stall the partially synchronous one, and adapts quickly in both directions.

AI.tldr: Steelhead 是一种双模式 BFT 共识机制，通过在同一 DAG 上交错使用部分同步提交规则和异步提交规则（每 k 轮中有一个异步轮次，其余为同步轮次），并通过动态调整周期 k 来在网络健康时继承部分同步协议的低延迟，在异步时保持异步协议的活性，无需额外消息、无需投票或计时器即可完成模式选择。
AI.motivation: 现有的双模式共识协议在模式切换时需付出高昂代价：串行设计需协调路径中断位置（易受攻击），并行设计即使在同步时也需平方级消息开销，而 Bullshark 类设计需每轮开启 coin。Steelhead 旨在消除模式决策的开销，让两个规则共享同一 DAG，由轮次号自动选择规则，并通过自适应机制从已提交 DAG 中推断最佳周期。
AI.method: 核心方法包括：(1) 基于轮次号的波长调度，每 k 轮中一轮由异步规则 R_a（依赖 common coin 的隐藏领导者）决定，其余由部分同步规则 R_s（已知领导者）决定；(2) 锚点搜索从 r+w(r) 开始（采用未决 slot 的波长），实现跨规则的安全交接（handover）；(3) 通过回放（replay）已提交 DAG 在每个候选周期 k' 下计算预期输出延迟来打分，无需重建 coin；(4) 采用控制读取（control reading），即对同一区块第二次应用异步规则到带 coin 的轮次以保证异步下仍能就周期达成一致；(5) 金丝雀轮（canary rounds）在异步模式下保留已知领导者的等待，以便部分同步规则可被探测；(6) 当输出停滞时故障转移至 k=1。泛化于满足接口条件（A1-A5）的任何 DAG 提交规则对；具体实例化为 Mysticeti + Mahi-Mahi（n≥3f+1）和 BlueBottle 的两个变体（n≥5f+1）。安全性与活性证明在 Lean 4 中机器化验证。
AI.result: 在 n=50 验证者、确定性离散事件模拟器中评估六种网络条件：(1) 健康网络下，Steelhead 在 3f+1 对中以 215ms 提交，接近 Mysticeti 的 213ms，比 Mahi-Mahi 的 294ms 低 27%；(2) 在大领导者延迟、部分/完全随机延迟、高抖动条件下，Steelhead 在 10-45 秒内将周期降至 1，匹配 Mahi-Mahi 的延迟；(3) 良性异步下匹配两种协议中较优者；(4) 网络恢复后 10 秒内回到周期 64；(5) 5f+1 对中，健康网络下 Steelhead 以 169ms 提交（BlueBottle-PS 为 168ms），在大领导者延迟下 10 秒内降至 k=1 并匹配异步变体。代价为每 k 轮额外开销 w_a-w_s 轮（k=64 时约 1% 延迟）。
AI.conclusion: Steelhead 通过让两个提交规则共享单一 DAG、由轮次号选择规则、从已提交 DAG 推导周期，实现了无需额外消息、计时器投票或路径对齐的双模式共识。它在健康网络中匹配部分同步协议延迟，在降级网络中快速适应至异步协议，证明了"单 DAG、双读取"设计的可行性。形式化证明（Lean 4）确认其满足原子广播的安全性和活性；模拟验证了两种弹性条件（3f+1 和 5f+1）下的有效性。

title: IaC-Guard-V: A Verification Framework for LLM-Generated Infrastructure-as-Code Repairs
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Pre-peer-review manuscript. Accepted as a regular paper at QRS 2026. Code and replication artifacts: this https URL . This arXiv version predates the post-review and camera-ready revisions
summary: Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) misconfigurations are a leading cause of cloud security incidents, and Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as automated repair agents. Yet the trustworthiness of LLM-generated IaC repairs remains underexplored. IaC presents distinctive verification challenges: security scanners may behave differently across tools and configurations, infrastructure semantics cannot be validated through ordinary unit tests, and provider-specific rules create a fragmented verification landscape. We present IaC-Guard-V, a verification-centered framework that evaluates AI-generated IaC repairs through four dimensions: syntactic validity, target-issue resolution, regression safety, and patch minimality. We construct a benchmark of 70 real-world misconfigured Terraform and Kubernetes artifacts spanning 70 unique scanner rules and eight violation classes, and evaluate three repair strategies across three LLM families in 630 runs. Although all models achieve 100% syntactic validity, only 32-50% of single-shot repairs pass full verification. Verification-guided iterative repair significantly improves verified-fix rates to 68-92%.
