An open-source model with verification-guided repair outperforms the strongest commercial model without verification at one-twelfth the cost per verified fix. Kubernetes repairs reach near-perfect rates for commercial models but require verification-guided iteration for the open-source model. Structured prompting consistently reduces Terraform repair quality, challenging common assumptions about constrained LLM output. The benchmark and artifacts are released for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 IaC-Guard-V，一个面向 LLM 生成 IaC 修复的验证框架，定义四个验证维度（语法有效性 V1、目标问题解决 V2、回归安全性 V3、补丁最小性 V4），并构建了包含 70 个真实 Terraform/Kubernetes 误配置样本的基准测试，在 630 次实验运行中评估了三种 LLM 与三种修复策略。核心发现是：所有模型虽均达 100% 语法有效率，但仅 32-50% 的单次修复通过完整验证；采用验证引导的迭代修复后，验证通过率显著提升至 68-92%；开源模型配合验证机制以每修复 1/12 的成本超越未带验证的最强商业模型。
AI.motivation: LLM 越来越多地被用作 IaC 误配置的自动修复工具，但生成补丁的可信度（trustworthiness）研究不足。IaC 缺乏可执行的单元测试，安全扫描器在不同工具间结果不一致，且云供应商特定语义高度碎片化，使得传统通用代码的 detect-repair-verify（DRV）流程无法直接迁移。语法正确性本身是修复质量的极差代理指标——论文用一个示例说明 LLM 可能产生语法正确但修错了属性的"假修复"。
AI.method: 框架定义三个二元验证门 V1（语法有效，由 Checkov 解析器判定）、V2（目标规则解决，重新运行 Checkov 确认目标规则 ID 不再出现）、V3（无回归，对比修复前后失败规则集），及一个信息性指标 V4（补丁最小性，通过 unified diff 计算变更行数比）。提出 verified-fix rate（VFR）作为核心指标，需同时通过 V1-V3。评估三种修复策略：(1) plain prompting（仅给通用指令）、(2) structured prompting（附带 Checkov 规则 ID、描述、受影响资源等结构化上下文，要求返回 JSON）、(3) verification-guided iterative repair（首次使用结构化 prompt，验证失败后附详细反馈重试，最多 2 次重试）。基准测试从 Checkov v3.2.517 测试套件中分层采样 50 个 Terraform（覆盖 50 个唯一 AWS 规则）+ 20 个 Kubernetes（覆盖 20 个唯一规则）项目，跨 8 个违规类。模型为 Claude Opus 4.6、Sonnet 4.6、Llama 4 Maverick 17B，全部经 AWS Bedrock 调用，temperature=0。共 70×3×3=630 次实验运行。统计方法：1000 次重采样的 bootstrap 95% CI、Cochran's Q 检验、Bonferroni 校正的 McNemar 精确检验、Cliff's δ 效应量。
AI.result: RQ1（Terraform 修复效果）：所有模型在所有方法下均达 100% V1，但单次修复仅 32-50% 通过全部验证。verify-loop 显著优于基线：Opus VFR 92%（84-98%）、Maverick 70%（56-82%）、Sonnet 68%（54-80%）。McNemar 检验在 Bonferroni 校正下 vs structured 对所有模型显著（p<0.001）。反直觉发现：structured prompting 一致劣于 plain prompting（32-42% vs 44-50%），且在 4-10% 案例中引入回归。RQ2（违规类差异）：verify-loop VFR 从 47%（不安全默认值）到 97%（缺失加密）不等；公开暴露类获益最大（17%→94%）。RQ3（跨技术泛化）：Kubernetes 上两个商业模型在所有方法下均达 100% VFR；Maverick 在 plain 下仅 45%，verify-loop 提升至 100%；此技术间效应反转——structured 对 K8s 反而帮助 Maverick（45%→95%）。RQ4（成本效益）：Maverick+verify-loop 以 $0.002/修复达 78.6% VFR；Opus 不带验证以 $0.029/修复仅达 61.4%——前者便宜约 12 倍。RQ4b（补丁最小性）：structured 产生最小补丁（中位 diff 比 0.067-0.086）；Maverick plain 产生最大补丁（0.478），但 verify-loop 缩小至 0.144。失败分析：50 项中 30 项被全部三个模型修复，4 项无一修复，16 项模型依赖；7 项仅 Opus 能修复，无项仅 Sonnet 或 Maverick 独修，表明能力决定上限、验证决定接近上限的程度。收敛性：verify-loop 多数修复发生在第 1-2 次尝试，第 3 次仅增加约 2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: IaC-Guard-V 证明语法有效性是修复正确性的极差代理指标，验证引导的迭代修复可将 VFR 从 32-50% 提升至 68-92%，且开源模型配合验证机制能以每修复约 1/12 的成本超越无验证的最强商业模型——验证基础设施投资回报高于模型升级。研究还揭示结构化提示在 Terraform 上一致降低修复质量（因 JSON 转义错误与多资源文件中的局部聚焦问题），但在结构更简单的 Kubernetes 上效果反转。实践建议：(1) 商业模型+Kubernetes 可直接用 plain+事后验证；(2) Terraform 或开源模型必须使用验证引导迭代修复；(3) 两次重试是性价比甜点。未来工作包括多扫描器共识验证、人工评估修复意图保持、扩展至 CloudFormation/Pulumi/Ansible 及生产代码库来源样本。

title: Pretraining and adapting a language model on a dependency-free stack: GPT-2 124M from random weights, reproduced against llm.c, and a clinical adapter for Qwen3-0.6B
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Weights: this https URL Licence: Apache-2.0. Weights, a config and an evaluation curve only; no framework source is released and none is needed to use them
summary: Almost every language model in service was trained by one family of software. That concentration makes a question hard to settle: how much of what is known about training a language model describes language models, and how much describes that software? Settling it needs a second implementation able to carry a model through a whole lifecycle rather than reproduce one operator. We report such a lifecycle. Using numbat, a machine-learning stack written in Zig with no third-party runtime dependencies, we pretrain a 124.4 M-parameter GPT-2 from random initialisation over 9.91 B tokens of web text, then adapt a separate small model to clinical question answering. A reference implementation runs on identical hardware at both stages, and a sidecar with authority to halt a run supervises each. Agreement is close. Held-out cross-entropy finishes at 3.2588 against a published 3.29, and HellaSwag at 0.3053 against 0.299; across 8 paired evaluations it sits below a same-machine reference at every point, by 0.0608 on average. Re-running that reference on different hardware moves it 0.0035, which bounds how much of any gap is method rather than framework. Throughput does not pay for agreement: measured in one session at a production configuration, numbat reaches 43,374 tokens per second against PyTorch's 41,202, scaling 2.769x over three cards. Clinical adaptation ends at 2.1899 held-out loss against 2.1941. Neither model is a medical device, and neither is validated for clinical use.

title: Change-Provenant Supervision: Governing Learned Artifacts Under Policy Change
summary: A recorded dependency graph cannot certify that it contains no omitted edge. For learned artifacts, graph-scoped invalidation therefore cannot by itself justify admission after authority changes, especially when output testing misses a provenance-stale derivation. We separate recorded lineage, which proposes impact scope and a dependency explanation, from independent current-contract revalidation of every retained target, which supplies soundness relative to the declared contract. We evaluate this design in two evidence layers. Four Qwen3-14B LoRA packages bind 1.028 GB of adapter bytes to training and authority records. Stale and full-fresh adapters trained on mutually exclusive versioned supervision emitted identical plans on all 80 tested authority-neutral inputs. Byte-derived reconstruction and a sealed current-contract ledger nevertheless refused the stale and naive-append packages and admitted full-fresh and lineage-selective packages. In a controlled harness with six role-separated amendments, transitive lineage recovered all 40 semantically invalidated amendment-target pairs while nominating 56 impact candidates, compared with 120 under document-wide invalidation. All 56 had a declared path to an amended clause, although 16 remained content-valid. Omitting one load-bearing edge per amendment reduced semantic recall to 34/40 while independent revalidation refused all six affected packages. The results establish properties of a controlled governance mechanism, not an enterprise invalidation rate, unlearning result, operationally optimal workflow, or measured total-cost reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究学习制品（learned artifacts）在机构权限变更后如何被治理、拒绝或重建，提出将记录型谱系（lineage）与独立当前契约重验证（current-contract revalidation）分离的双机制架构，并通过四个真实Qwen3-14B LoRA包和六个角色分离的合成修正进行验证。
AI.motivation: 学习制品（如LoRA适配器）是对其训练记录的"不透明替代品"。当权限（authority）发生变更时，仅靠输出行为测试无法区分监督来源已过期的制品与当前合规的制品；而记录型依赖图（lineage graph）因可能遗漏边（edge）而无法自我证明完备性，因此图驱动的失效判定本身不能作为接纳依据。核心问题是：在权限变更后，如何独立、可验证地判断一个已部署的学习制品是否仍可被接纳。
AI.method: 采用两层证据：(1) 真实适配器层——对四个Qwen3-14B LoRA包（stale、naive-append、full-fresh、lineage-selective）进行字节级重构与凭证核对，应用独立封存的目标级契约决策；(2) 受控机制层——在六个角色分离的合成修正下，比较surface heuristic、direct reference、document-wide、transitive lineage、missing-edge、spurious-edge等失效方法相对于语义替换oracle的精确率/召回率，并加入单边缺失压力测试与托管（custody）良性/受损包测试。架构上将lineage限定为"预重验证的影响范围建议与因果解释"，将契约重验证作为最终安全边界。
AI.result: 真实适配器层：stale与full-fresh在80个权限中性输入上输出完全一致，但字节派生重构与封存契约账本正确拒绝stale与naive-append，接纳full-fresh与lineage-selective。受控层：transitive lineage以56个候选恢复全部40个语义失效对（语义精确率0.714，召回率1.0），优于document-wide的120个候选（精确率0.333）；每条候选均具有到修正条款的声明路径，其中16个在修正验证器下仍内容合法。单边关键缺失使召回降至34/40，但六个包均通过托管；独立重验证拒绝全部六个。托管测试：6/6良性包接纳、16/16受损包拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了一种受控治理机制的属性，而非企业级失效频率、机器遗忘效果、操作最优工作流或总成本降低的声明。核心结论是：仅靠记录型依赖图无法证明其完备性，因此学习制品的接纳必须独立地对每个保留的目标在当前契约下进行重验证；lineage提供影响范围与因果解释，但不构成最终安全边界。可执行的逐目标验证器在廉价时可替代lineage作为优先路径，但本研究未比较两种操作顺序或测量其成本。

title: Developing a Unified Verification and Validation Activity Standard at JPL
summary: Verification and validation practices (V&V) at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) have diverged over the past decade, creating fragmentation that increases overhead, reduces cross-project efficiencies, and inhibits institutional knowledge transfer. We present a unified V&V activity schema developed through human-centered design workshops involving 29 practitioners across multiple mission types and disciplines. The schema builds on a relationship-based architecture that allows for separating methods (Test, Analysis, Inspection, Demonstration, and Review of Design) while maintaining a common attribute set. Formalized as a platform-agnostic SysML model, the schema defines bidirectional relationships between requirements, V&V activities, venues, and evidence. Implementation in JPL's Jama platform demonstrates controlled customization through templates and modular item types, balancing rigor with agility while enabling automations, pattern reuse, and digital thread integration.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了JPL通过以人为中心的设计研讨会，开发了一套统一的V&V活动模式（schema），以解决NASA JPL过去十年V&V实践碎片化的问题。该模式基于关系架构，将方法（测试、分析、检查、演示和设计审查）与公共属性集分离，并形式化为平台无关的SysML模型，已在Jama平台上实施。
AI.motivation: NASA JPL在过去十年的V&V实践中出现了分化现象，导致各项目方法不一致，增加了管理开销，降低了跨项目效率，并阻碍了机构知识的有效转移。需要一个统一且灵活的V&V活动框架来解决这些碎片化问题。
AI.method: 采用以人为中心的设计（human-centered design）方法，举办涉及29名跨任务类型和学科从业者的研讨会；构建基于关系（relationship-based）的架构，将V&V方法（Test, Analysis, Inspection, Demonstration, Review of Design）与共同属性集解耦；使用SysML（Systems Modeling Language）将模式形式化为平台无关的模型；定义需求、V&V活动、场所（venues）和证据之间的双向关系；在Jama平台上通过模板和模块化项类型实现受控定制。
AI.result: 开发出一套统一的V&V活动模式（schema），其特点包括：基于关系架构的设计，方法与属性集分离；形式化的SysML模型实现平台无关性；在JPL的Jama平台成功实施；支持通过模板和模块化项类型进行受控定制；实现了严谨性与敏捷性的平衡；支持自动化、模式复用和数字主线（digital thread）集成。
AI.conclusion: 该统一V&V模式有效解决了JPL内部V&V实践碎片化的问题，通过关系化、模块化的设计理念，在保持灵活性和可控定制的同时，提升了跨项目效率，促进了机构知识转移，为系统工程师提供了统一且可重用的V&V框架，对数字主线集成具有重要价值。

title: Soundness Checking of Taint Flow Models
summary: Existing state-of-the-art static taint flow analyses for imperative programming languages can scale to large applications by using precise user-provided taint flow models of library methods. However, manually and precisely modeling a method's taint flows is tedious and potentially unsound. Furthermore, automatically modeling the method via an inter- procedural taint analysis can be inefficient. To solve this problem, we propose a guess-and-check approach: (1) an LLM agent that generates a precise taint flow model of a method and (2) a symbolic algorithm to check the soundness of the model. The algorithm deduces which taint flows must not occur in the method for the LLM's taint flow model to be sound, and uses lightweight static analyses (e.g., type system and pointer analysis) to prove these must-not-flows. When these analyses are insufficient, the algorithm deduces maximally-general callee models and recursively verifies their soundness, avoiding a full inter-procedural taint analysis in most cases. Since a more precise model requires fewer must-not-flows to be verified, the precision of the LLM's model directly determines the efficiency of our approach. We evaluate our approach on 97 LLM-generated taint flow models for methods in 6 large Go codebases and prove the models sound for 93% of the methods they cover. The proven-sound LLM-generated models are also precise, resulting in no new false-positives when proving taint flow properties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"猜测-验证"框架，利用LLM生成Go方法的高精度污点流模型，并通过轻量级静态分析和递归Max-SAT求解验证模型的声音性，在保证精度的同时避免昂贵的全程序污点分析。
AI.motivation: 现有的命令式语言静态污点流分析虽能通过用户提供的方法污点流模型扩展到大型应用，但手工建模繁琐且可能不 sound，全局过程间污点分析又效率低下。本文旨在利用LLM的代码理解能力猜测精确模型，并自动验证其声音性。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：(1) LLM代理生成候选污点流模型（配备分析工具如源码访问、指针分析等）；(2) 声音性检查算法——计算"最通用摘要"与候选模型的差集得到 must-not-flows，依次使用类型分析（基于非指针类型参数）、不可变性分析（基于指针分析）、读取分析（基于访问路径是否被读取）证明这些 must-not-flows 成立。当轻量分析不足时，对方法进行过程内污点分析，将内部流信息编码为 Max-SAT 问题，推导出最大通用（最不精确）的被调函数模型，并递归验证其声音性。算法依赖于数据竞争自由、无 unsafe 内存操作和无反射的假设。
AI.result: 在6个大型Go代码库中评估了97个LLM生成的污点流模型：覆盖2535个方法，93%被证明为 sound；仅5%为 unsound，2%为"soundy"（因语言特性威胁）。使用这些经验证的模型，使3个原本在30分钟内超时的应用成功完成污点分析（最慢不到3分钟），且相比基线未引入新的误报。声音性检查本身高效，prometheus仓库仅需约2.5分钟。Max-SAT求解无扩展性问题（例如NewRequest模型生成956约束仅需165微秒）。
AI.conclusion: LLM结合声音性验证可在保证精度和声音性的前提下显著提升静态污点分析的可扩展性。该方法弥补了TAJ、Andromeda、FlowDroid、Argot等需要用户手工提供且不验证声音性的模型的不足，并优于StubDroid、ModAlyzer等计算型组合分析方法。未来工作包括扩展更多轻量分析、支持其他语言如Java，以及将声音性检查应用于其他LLM模型合成方法（如Taser、STaint）。

title: Category-Based MLM: Unifying Powertypes with Superclasses
comment: Technical Report; work in progress. 12 pages, 2 figures
summary: MultiLevel software Modeling (MLM) suggests that conceptual modeling in broad subject domains might require abstraction of multiple classification levels. The MLM approach relies on philosophical arguments, claiming that faithful modeling of real-world domains involves repeated type classification as in ontologies of natural kinds. MLM leveled architecture is interwoven and defined by instance-of interlevel relationships between clabject classes in lower levels to classes termed category classes, in upper levels. The instance-of relation denotes membership of clabjects as type objects in their (powertypes) category classes, and is not transitive. All MLM approaches support forms of deep characterization, i.e., category classes can influence classes in lower levels. Deep characterization is an essential feature of superclasses and contradicts the non-transitive membership meaning of instance-of. In this paper, we introduce the Category-Based MLM (CatMLM) model, in which category classes have dual superclass and powertype facets, based on the distinction between category features that do not participate in deep characterization, and object features that do. This distinction clarifies the role of levels, provides a clear quantifiable criterion for leveling, and yields a decision rule between the subclass and instance-of relations. The contribution of this paper is to introduce a well-defined MLM model that (1) is based on simple, quantifiable level decisions; (2) clarifies how leveling emerges from domain needs; and (3) analyzes gains and losses of MLM vs. plain OO modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CatMLM（基于类别的多层次建模）模型，通过将类别类（category class）划分为"对象特征"（参与深层特征化）和"类别特征"（不参与深层特征化），统一了超类（superclass）和幂类型（powertype）两个面向，并基于此提供了可量化的层次划分标准及子类与实例化（instance-of）关系的判定规则。
AI.motivation: 现有多层次建模（MLM）方法在"instance-of"关系的语义上存在核心矛盾：一方面instance-of被定义为非传递的成员关系（membership），另一方面所有MLM方法都支持某种形式的"深层特征化"（deep characterization），即上层类别类会影响下层类——而这恰恰是超类继承的本质特征，违反了instance-of的非传递性。该矛盾导致层次划分缺乏清晰、可量化的判定准则。
AI.method: CatMLM将一个MLM模型定义为由多个层次构成的单维度有序结构（level-dimension）。核心方法是：将类别类的特征二分为"对象特征"（object features，遵循标准OO继承语义，支持深层特征化，定义类别类的"超类面向"）和"类别特征"（category features，仅刻画类别类自身实例，不被继承，定义类别类的"幂类型面向"）。基于此，instance-of关系提供部分继承——仅传递对象特征。模型还引入Category_object类型细化机制，使得仅访问对象特征的约束/操作可声明为Category_object类型，从而支持Liskov替换原则（LSP）。作者以"图书仓库"（Warehouse）四层模型（Warehouse/Catalog/Category/Product）为例进行完整说明，并给出对应的合法实例及约束验证（如popularity与location的关联）。
AI.result: 1）给出了CatMLM的形式化语法，包括层次、instance-of关系、对象/类别特征（属性、关联、约束）、跨层关联/约束的分类，以及两条语法约束（层次化要求instance-of；类别类必须含类别特征）。2）给出了语义：CatMLM模型的合法实例由各层次的合法实例组合而成，clabject对象必须通过instance-of链接到其每个类别类的对象，并满足跨关联多重性和约束。3）通过Warehouse案例展示了CatMLM如何表达四层抽象，并通过具体对象实例（如calculus1、iliadCopy1/2链接到calculus、theIliada等类别对象）验证了"popularity决定location"等跨层约束的执行。4）与相关工作（Melanee、MetaDepth、FMMLx、MLT*、MedMLM等）比较：CatMLM无需复杂的"效力标记"（potency marking）或中介器（mediators），仅通过简单的特征二分即可实现深层特征化，并支持将效力标记建模为派生操作。
AI.conclusion: CatMLM是一个定义良好的MLM模型，其特点为：(1) 基于简单、可量化的层次决策（特征二分）；(2) 阐明了层次化如何从领域需求中产生；(3) 通过Category_object类型细化扩展了类层次结构的抽象建模能力，并分析了MLM相对于纯OO建模的收益与代价。该模型简化并改进了作者先前基于中介器的MedMLM理论。未来工作包括：在MLM-USE工具中完整实现CatMLM，并开发支持Category_object与Category_category类型区分的形式化类型理论。

title: Specification-Driven Benchmarking for Automated Program Repair From Static Corpora to Executable Specifications
summary: Automated Program Repair (APR) benchmarks have traditionally been constructed as static datasets whose characteristics are inherited from the defects they contain. While this paradigm has enabled decades of progress, finite corpora provide limited experimental control, become increasingly susceptible to contamination as they are reused, and cannot be systematically regenerated or adapted as evaluation requirements evolve. We propose specification-driven benchmarking, a paradigm in which benchmarks are defined by executable specifications and realized through benchmark generation. The specification explicitly declares the intended properties of the benchmark (including program context, fault taxonomy, difficulty, validation strategy, and corpus constraints) while a generation pipeline realizes those requirements through independent generation, validation, and corpus management components. We develop the conceptual foundations of this approach by introducing a taxonomy of benchmark specification dimensions, establishing how each specification dimension maps to deterministic architectural responsibilities, and arguing that independent validation is a structural requirement for trustworthy benchmark generation. An end-to-end example illustrates how specification choices propagate through the pipeline to produce benchmark instances whose properties are independently verifiable. By treating the benchmark as an executable specification rather than a static dataset, the proposed paradigm shifts benchmark construction from artifact curation to declarative experimental design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"规格驱动的基准测试"（specification-driven benchmarking）范式，将自动化程序修复（APR）基准构建从静态数据集策展转向可执行规格声明，通过独立生成、验证和语料管理三大组件实现基准的系统化构造与可验证性，以应对数据污染、有限实验控制和静态语料难以适应评估需求演进等问题。
AI.motivation: 传统APR基准测试依赖静态数据集，存在三大局限：①有限语料对实验控制能力受限；②随着基准复用，数据集易受污染（contamination）影响；③静态数据集无法随评估需求演变而被系统性再生成或适配。需要一种新的基准构建范式以实现可控、可验证、可演化的实验设计。
AI.method: 提出规格驱动基准测试范式，包含三大核心设计：①建立基准规格维度的分类法（taxonomy），涵盖程序上下文（program context）、缺陷分类体系（fault taxonomy）、难度（difficulty）、验证策略（validation strategy）和语料约束（corpus constraints）；②规定每个规格维度映射到确定的架构职责（确定性生成、独立验证、语料管理）；③论证独立验证（independent validation）是可信基准生成的结构性必要条件。以端到端示例展示规格选择如何贯穿流水线传播，并生成属性可独立验证的基准实例。
AI.result: 未提供具体实证结果（仅展示摘要层面内容），论文定位于概念基础与范式建立层面。通过端到端示例，论证了规格驱动的可行性：将基准定义为可执行规格而非静态数据集后，基准构建从"制品策展"（artifact curation）转变为"声明式实验设计"（declarative experimental design）。
AI.conclusion: 规格驱动基准测试范式将APR基准构建从静态数据集层面提升到可执行规格声明层面，通过声明式实验设计实现基准的系统化生成、可独立验证的属性保障以及对污染与演化的鲁棒应对。该范式为APR社区提供了应对评估挑战的新方法论框架。

title: Automatic Harness Evolution for Hardware Design Verification: Can LLMs Consolidate Gains Across Discovered Harnesses?
summary: Agent behavior depends on the harness surrounding a language model, but it remains unclear whether language models can reliably improve such harnesses for hardware-design tasks. We study automatic harness evolution around a fixed subject model on 12 proprietary design-verification root-cause localization tasks. Across five trials per task, automatically evolved harnesses increased completed attempts by 71-76% and any-hit task coverage by 80-100%, while total correct attempts improved by only 18-24%. The strongest success reproducible at least twice result improved by one task, and later candidates exchanged gains across tasks rather than preserving them. An auxiliary candidate improved on a four-task validation set excluded from search but tied its baseline on a subsequent 12-task replay containing both search and validation tasks, so the selected gain did not persist across the full pool. Across the tested lineage, useful search, evidence, and finalization behaviors appeared in different candidates but did not consistently consolidate into a single harness that dominated across tasks and metrics. In a separate CVDP cross-benchmark case study, an automatically evolved defined-width repair harness produced 35.6% more functional passes than its 142-task reference baseline; the final functional verifier scored completed outputs but was not shown to the subject agent during repair. These results support archive-aware selection when evolution yields complementary specializations without consistent consolidation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在固定主题模型（subject model）下，通过自动演化大语言模型（LLM）的外部执行框架（agent harness），能否在硬件设计验证调试任务上稳定地整合（consolidate）不同候选框架所取得的增益。研究在12项专有根因定位任务和CVDP基准测试上评估了三种不同智能体框架，结果显示自动演化显著提升了任务完成率（71–76%）和单次通过覆盖（80–100%），但正确尝试总数仅提升18–24%；后续候选者之间存在权衡而非增益整合；分类存档（archive）覆盖明显优于单一提升的候选框架。
AI.motivation: 硬件设计验证调试属于"低资源领域"（lower-resource domain），公开任务示例、调试轨迹和工具使用演示稀缺，模型难以直接通过领域适配弥补。论文研究在不改变模型权重的前提下，自动演化围绕固定主题模型的运行时框架（runtime harness）和脚手架配置（scaffold configuration），是否能弥补这一缺口。具体而言，核心问题是：LLM能否可靠地将不同候选框架中互补的专门能力整合进一个统一的、跨任务稳定的框架？
AI.method: 提出存档感知的框架演化系统（archive-aware harness-evolution framework），将主题模型与优化器（optimizer）解耦。每个候选框架在隔离目录中实例化，经激活检查、评估与确认三个阶段，附带执行痕迹（trace）、得分和谱系（lineage）保留在存档中。优化器（如Claude Opus 4.5/5）观察执行结果后提出新候选。采用分支搜索（branching search）与五轮重复确认（repeated five-trial confirmation）分离廉价发现与可靠提升。评估指标包括首次试验成功率、Success≥2/5、pass@5和完成率，并区分存档联合（archive union）覆盖率。在12项专有根因定位任务和CVDP v1.1.0基准（含142项任务子集）上进行评估。
AI.result: 主要结果：在12项专有任务上，自动演化的"证据驱动"框架将首次试验成功率从2/12提升至6/12，pass@5从5/12提升至9/12，完成率从34/60提升至58/60；后续"批处理因果"框架达到60/60完成率和10/12 pass@5，但首次成功率降至5/12。二者联合覆盖11/12任务，但正确尝试总数仅从17/60提升至21/60。核心发现：经过72代MiniMax M3大规模分支演化（990分支、958评估），存档联合覆盖10/12任务，但严格提升规则下最佳继承者仅3/12，最佳存档个体仅4/12；专门行为未能整合进统一框架。在CVDP跨基准测试中，自动演化的"定宽修复"框架在142项任务中通过61项（43.0%），相比参考基线45项（31.7%）实现35.6%的功能通过率提升，但实验非受控匹配。最终功能验证器在修复时未对主体智能体公开。
AI.conclusion: 在硬件设计验证调试领域，自动框架演化能显著提升运行稳健性和任务覆盖广度，但所测试的演化谱系未能将分散的专门行为整合进一个跨任务、跨指标统一占优的框架。互补候选者之间存在权衡（trade-off）而非增益整合，存档覆盖率持续高于单一继承者。系统应将存档视为输出而非丢弃池，采用基于重复任务级评估的提升规则，并考虑路由（routing）而非无限扩展单一指令集。短期内，自动框架演化更适合发现操作性保障和专门候选者，而非替代领域能力或系统级设计。

title: Human-AI Collaboration for Multi-Line Task Adjustment Using Local Large Language Models and a Digital Twin
summary: Automation systems must adapt to changing tasks, equipment states, and staffing conditions while providing evidence for human review. This study presents a multi-line task-adjustment system integrating a local large language model, a digital twin, and human decision-making. A Propose-Verify-Decide workflow translates operator intent into structured requirements, generates a bounded set of candidate strategies, and checks semantics, simulation execution, and operational constraints. Linked records preserve traceability from requests to verification evidence and decisions. Thirty fixed test records were evaluated using four virtual surgical-instrument sorting lines: 28 assessed the workflow and two assessed model generation. Eighteen workflow cases met expectations; autonomous strategy-workflow success was 3/10, and correct rejection of invalid inputs was 7/8. All four cases that passed preceding checks, produced complete evidence, and reached final engineering review (CP6) passed that review. Together with the correct blocking of strategies that failed throughput constraints, this supports the effectiveness of staged screening and confirmation within the tested setting. Mean placement-validation pass rate across eight simulation evidence records was 97.50%. Mean times to the first reviewable response and simulation verification, excluding startup, were 12.94 and 164.39 s, respectively. Remaining failures involved semantic distortion, incomplete evidence, and missed invalid inputs. The results demonstrate a traceable strategy-review workflow, but do not establish overall reliability or long-term stability. Broader testing and physical evaluation are needed to assess generalizability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种集成本地大语言模型(LLM)、数字孪生(DT)与人工决策的多生产线任务调整系统,采用"提议-验证-决策"(Propose-Verify-Decide)三阶段工作流,在虚拟CSSD(消毒供应中心)手术器械分拣场景中进行30个固定测试记录的评估,验证了系统在策略筛选与人工评审方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 制造自动化系统需要应对产品组合变化、紧急任务、设备状态和人员可用性等动态条件,但现有可重构制造系统(RMS)和软件定义制造架构虽然提供了适应机制,实际变更仍需人员解读情况、翻译需求、检查约束并评估后果。同时,LLM生成的策略在语义正确的情况下仍可能因设备能力、器械放置或吞吐量约束而不可行。因此需要将需求语义、场景执行结果和操作约束整合到一个可审查、可拒绝、可追溯的工作流中。
AI.method: 系统采用三阶段治理架构:(1)提议阶段——本地LLM解析操作员意图,生成有界的候选策略集(每批3个);(2)验证阶段——通过可行性与约束分析模块检查场景规则,仿真适配器将候选策略转换为场景规范,在Isaac Sim 5.1.0数字孪生中执行,提取放置、KPI等执行证据;(3)决策阶段——向操作员呈现推荐策略、变更范围、约束检查结果及适用条件,支持接受/修订/取消。系统定义了CP0-CP6七个检查点,涵盖输入有效性、意图分类、结构有效性、语义一致性、仿真可执行性、约束符合性和最终工程评审。核心存储库通过标识符链接需求版本、候选策略、场景规范和执行证据,实现全链路追溯。硬件配置包括RTX A6000推理服务器,主模型为cyankiwi/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-AWQ-8bit,场景为四条UR5机器人手术器械分拣线。
AI.result: 28个工作流案例中18个符合预期,综合符合率9/20(排除负向输入注入);自主策略工作流成功率3/10,候选批次选择率3/8,正确拒绝率7/8,查询成功率5/9;8条仿真证据记录的平均放置验证通过率97.50%(XY平面容差0.06m);平均首次可审查响应时间12.94秒,仿真验证时间164.39秒,端到端测试流程时间607.69秒;4个到达CP6最终工程评审的记录全部通过(4/4);CP0-CP6各检查点通过率分别为73.33%、86.67%、100%、51.85%、77.78%、57.14%、100%。模型生成探索性比较中,Gemma、Qwen、Llama在结构有效性上均为3/3,但严格语义通过率分别为0/3、2/3、0/3。T02和T05因吞吐量约束不达标被正确阻断,体现阶段筛选价值;T06优先级语义失真、T24无效产线未被拦截,揭示剩余缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了"提议-验证-决策"工作流在多生产线任务调整中的可追溯性与阶段筛选价值,所有进入最终工程评审的策略均通过评审,验证了前置检查与证据完整性对人工确认的支持作用。然而,语义失真(T06的优先级错误)、证据不完整(T04)和无效输入漏检(T24)等失败表明系统尚未达到整体可靠性要求,自主策略工作流成功率仅3/10说明人工澄清和修正仍不可少。研究明确不声称已证明长期稳定性或泛化能力,未来需扩展需求与候选集、开展消融实验、运营商研究和物理实验,以评估语义检查、数字孪生验证与人工审查各自的独立贡献。贡献在于可追溯工作流的实现与固定案例评估,而非部署效益的证明。

title: Design, development, and preliminary validity and reliability evidence of the Software Engineering Self-Efficacy Scale (SESES)
summary: The purpose of this research is to design, develop, implement, and provide preliminary validity and reliability evidence of the Software Engineering Self-Efficacy Scale (SESES). Framed by a conceptual framework using guidance in software engineering curriculum and concepts along with the notion of self-efficacy, we generated an initial item pool of n = 87 items to operationalize and measure software engineering self-efficacy among undergraduate computing students. The conceptual framework traces five dimensions: 1) Requirements Engineering, 2) Teamwork and Collaboration, 3) Software Quality Management, 4) Software Design and Architecture, and 5) Software Agile Methodologies. We pilot tested the SESES with n = 527 undergraduate computing students who had completed a software engineering course in the current semester or a previous academic semester. We employed Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) with the Principal Axis Factoring method and an oblique (Promax) rotation to examine the underlying structure of the SESES, resulting in the same five internally consistent latent constructs in the conceptual framework with minimal cross-loading and a simple structure in the pattern matrix, explaining approximately 57% of the variability in these data. Our findings suggest that software engineering self-efficacy is a multidimensional construct of five theorized and correlated, yet distinct latent factors. We unpack the limitations and delimitations of the research while exploring undergraduate computing students' software engineering self-efficacy using necessary domain-specific measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文设计、开发并初步验证了"软件工程自我效能感量表"(SESES)，该量表包含五个维度（需求工程、团队协作、软件质量管理、软件设计与架构、软件敏捷方法），共87个条目（最终保留83个）。基于527名本科计算学生的探索性因子分析（EFA），证实软件工程自我效能感是一个多维构念，五个因子具有较高的内部一致性（Cronbach's α均≥0.94），累积方差解释率约57.2%。
AI.motivation: 软件工程课程对本科生提出了多方面的能力要求，包括技术技能和软技能。然而，计算教育研究领域缺乏针对软件工程领域特异性的自我效能感测量工具。已有的计算类自我效能感量表（如编程自我效能感、计算机自我效能感）无法全面捕捉软件工程的多维度特性。因此，需要开发一个领域特异性的、有效可靠的软件工程自我效能感测量工具，以帮助教育者、研究者和招聘人员评估学生在软件工程领域的能力信念。
AI.method: 研究基于经典测量理论(Classical Test Theory)和Bandura的自我效能感理论（特别是"掌握经验"维度），通过系统化流程开发量表：首先分析两所研究型大学的软件工程课程大纲与课程内容，构建包含五个维度的概念框架；生成87个"I can"陈述式条目；通过课程教师审查和学生think-aloud方法保证内容效度；在三所美国东南部ABET认证大学的527名已完成软件工程课程的本科生中进行试测；采用主轴因子分解法(Principal Axis Factoring)和Promax斜交旋转进行探索性因子分析(EFA)；结合Kaiser准则、平行分析、Scree图和简约性原则确定因子结构；使用Cronbach's α评估内部一致性信度；通过t检验、ANOVA和Spearman相关分析考察人口统计学差异。
AI.result: 探索性因子分析最终确定了五因子模型，保留了83个条目，累积方差解释率为57.2%。五个因子分别为：1)需求工程(22项，α=0.96，方差解释率14.20%)；2)团队协作(15项，α=0.95，方差解释率12.40%)；3)软件质量管理(16项，α=0.95，方差解释率11.50%)；4)软件设计与架构(16项，α=0.94，方差解释率9.90%)；5)软件敏捷方法(14项，α=0.94，方差解释率9.20%)。模型拟合指标显示RMSEA=0.055、SRMR=0.03达到"合理拟合"标准，但CFI=0.852和TLI=0.832未达到0.9的"良好拟合"标准。各潜变量之间均呈显著正相关(r=0.45-0.80)。描述性统计显示学生在团队协作(M=4.28)上自我效能感最高，在软件设计与架构(M=3.50)上最低。差异分析发现：女性在团队协作和软件敏捷方法上显著高于男性，男性在软件设计与架构上显著高于女性；有实习经历的学生在所有五个维度上均显著更高；高年级学生在部分维度上反而报告更低的自我效能感。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出结论：软件工程自我效能感是一个由五个相关但可区分的潜因子构成的多维构念，SESES量表为该构念的测量提供了初步的效度和信度证据，支持其用于低风险目的。研究的主要贡献在于填补了计算教育研究中软件工程自我效能感领域特异性测量工具的空白。未来研究需要通过验证性因子分析(CFA)进一步验证理论模型，开展纵向研究以检验重测信度，探索汇聚效度和区分效度证据，并考察自我效能感与学业成绩之间的关系。同时，在GenAI工具广泛应用的背景下，该量表对软件工程课程的评估与教学实践具有重要价值。

title: VidTutorAssistant: Automating Responses to Programming Tutorial Questions
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted at ASE 2026, Tools and Datasets Track. Author's accepted manuscript
summary: Programming tutorial videos on YouTube are an important information resource for software developers and students, and their comment sections have evolved into active spaces where viewers ask follow-up questions. The volume of these questions, however, often exceeds what content creators can address, leaving learners without the clarifications they need. We present VidTutorAssistant, a web platform that automates responses to viewer questions on programming video tutorials. VidTutorAssistant implements a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that extracts a video's transcript, then segments it and embeds it. It then classifies each viewer comment as being a question or non-question, retrieves the most relevant transcript segments to each identified question via cosine similarity, and then generates an answer to the question using an LLM (GPT-4), while grounding the response using the retrieved transcript segments as context. We validate VidTutorAssistant through a study on a subset of 440 user comments selected from a larger dataset of 105,553 comments extracted from 7,522 Python and Java tutorials. VidTutorAssistant is evaluated on various criteria: a) its ability to identify the programming language in a video, achieving a 0.99 accuracy; b) its ability to classify comments into questions and non-questions, reaching a 0.96 accuracy; and c) its ability to produce correct and complete answers to questions, producing 98% correct and 99.5% complete responses, compared with 89% and 90% for the original creators' answers.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 VidTutorAssistant，一个利用 RAG（检索增强生成）技术与 GPT-4 自动回复编程教程视频下观众问题的 Web 平台。该工具能有效识别视频编程语言、判断评论是否为问题，并基于视频字幕生成准确、完整的回答，在多项评估中优于原作者回复。
AI.motivation: YouTube 上的编程教程视频评论区常涌现大量观众提问，但内容创作者往往无力一一作答，导致学习者得不到解答。现有的教程视频研究多聚焦于提取代码片段、GUI 等结构化产物，或面向通用教学视频进行问答，但缺乏针对编程教程的、已部署且可直接使用的问答工具。
AI.method: 采用四模块 RAG 流水线：(1) Video Pre-Processor 利用 youtube-transcript-api 提取视频字幕，调用 GPT-4 识别编程语言，并对字幕分段（超过 1500 token 时按 300 token 分段），使用 text-embedding-3-small 生成向量嵌入；(2) Comment Classifier 利用 GPT-4 提示工程判断评论是问题还是非问题；(3) Context Provider 将问题改写为查询语句，使用余弦相似度检索最相关的字幕片段（包含相邻片段及首尾片段作为上下文锚定），由 GPT-4 进行查询改写；(4) Response Generator 结合观众评论、检索上下文和视频元数据，调用 GPT-4 生成回答。Web 平台采用 Python 后端与 Laravel（PHP）+ Livewire 前端架构，MySQL 存储数据。
AI.result: 基于 7,522 个 Python 与 Java 教程视频中的 105,553 条评论构建数据集，并手工标注 440 条评论作为评估集。三部分评估结果：(1) 编程语言识别准确率 0.99（81/82 正确）；(2) 问题/非问题分类准确率 0.96（422/440 正确），评价者间 Cohen's κ=0.97；(3) 在 220 个问题评论中，VidTutorAssistant 产生 98% 正确（216/220）、99.5% 完整（219/220）的回答，而原作者回答正确率仅 89%（195/220）、完整率 90%（198/220），Cohen's κ=0.86；(4) 用户研究（46 名计算机科学学生、438 次评价）中，66% 的回答更受偏好 VidTutorAssistant，27% 更偏好原作者，7% 无明显偏好，二项检验 p<0.001。开放编码（Krippendorff's α=0.93）表明学生偏好 VidTutorAssistant 的原因在于其详细全面、解释清晰、语气友好。
AI.conclusion: VidTutorAssistant 作为已部署的 Web 平台，能够基于 RAG 流水线自动回复编程教程评论区的观众问题，其正确性、完整性与用户偏好均优于原作者手动回复。未来工作将扩展至 Python 与 Java 之外的更多编程语言、提供创作者端草稿审阅工作流，并对比包括开源与多模态大模型在内的更新模型。

title: Orchestrating AI-Assisted Code Remediation: Socio-Technical Bottlenecks in a Large Industrial Repository
summary: Background: Code degradation in large, long-lived codebases is costly to remediate through manual refactoring and opportunistic clean-ups. LLM-based coding assistants can perform mechanical remediation at scale, but their impact on industrial workflows is underexplored. Objective: We investigate how massive AI-assisted code remediation affects build-on-commit continuous integration (CI), code review, and team coordination in a large industrial repository, and which socio-technical bottlenecks constrain such remediation when source editing becomes cheap through AI assistance. Method: We report on a 15-day exploratory single-case field study in which an experienced developer used a command-line AI coding buddy to remediate widespread issues in a closed-source industrial C++ repository. We triangulate Gerrit metadata with a developer diary and team chat, analyzed through descriptive statistics and qualitative coding. Results: AI-assisted remediation rapidly generated hundreds of commits touching thousands of lines, saturating CI and reviewer attention. Naïve per-file commits overloaded build-on-commit CI; Switching to directory-based batching and capping the number of files per change restored throughput, but still required explicit review solicitation, negotiation of acceptable commit granularity, and iterative follow-up to resolve build and static-analysis failures. Conclusion: When mechanical editing is cheap, CI capacity, review effort, and change orchestration become primary bottlenecks. Sustainable AI-assisted remediation in very large repositories requires deliberate control of commit, review, and CI batch granularity and treating semantic change sets, such as ``fix all instances of warning X'', as first-class units of work that can be sliced differently for developers, reviewers, and CI.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇在大型工业C++代码仓库中进行为期15天的探索性单案例实地研究，调查一位经验丰富的开发者使用命令行AI编码助手大规模修复代码退化问题时，build-on-commit持续集成（CI）、代码审查和团队协调所受到的影响及其面临的社会技术瓶颈。研究发现，AI辅助的大规模代码修复迅速生成数百个提交并修改数千行代码，使CI和审查者注意力饱和；通过切换到基于目录的批处理并限制每次变更的文件数可恢复吞吐量，但仍需主动寻求审查、协商合适的提交粒度，并迭代跟进以解决构建和静态分析失败。文章提出，机械编辑变得廉价时，CI容量、审查工作量和变更编排成为主要瓶颈；可持续的AI辅助修复需要将语义变更集（如"修复所有警告X实例"）视为一等可切分的工作单元。
AI.motivation: 大型长期代码库中存在严重的代码退化问题，传统手动重构和机会性清理成本高昂；虽然LLM编码助手可大规模执行机械修复，但其对工业工作流的影响尚缺乏实证研究。特别是在build-on-commit CI环境下，当源代码编辑因AI辅助变得廉价时，哪些社会技术瓶颈会显现出来尚不清楚。
AI.method: 15天探索性单案例实地研究：在一家大型国际公司封闭源码的工业级C++仓库（约1000万行代码，含数十万提交），由一位资深开发者使用基于聊天的命令行AI编码助手进行代码退化修复。通过三种数据源进行三角验证：(1) 开发者的每日日志（平均每天5条记录）；(2) 与团队的匿名聊天记录；(3) Gerrit代码审查系统的元数据（通过SSH API提取）。定量分析采用描述性统计，定性分析采用归纳式开放编码（使用Taguette工具），由非探索者作者独立初编码后与探索者协作精炼。
AI.result: (1) 修复规模庞大：共生成760+个提交（639个per-file struct初始化提交，56个布尔简化提交，20个重复include提交，24个目录批处理struct提交，13个模块重构提交，8个数据竞争修复），涉及数千文件与数十万行代码。(2) CI饱和：早期per-file提交策略瞬间压垮build-on-commit CI链，被CI维护者形容为"攻击"；需DevOps手动清空队列。(3) 粒度协商：团队协商后确定"不超过60文件/提交"作为经验准则，使审查者能在约5分钟内完成审查。(4) 主动邀审：开发者必须主动发送"低风险、已验证、有+1、请审查"等消息才能推动合并，单纯上传无法获得关注。(5) 工具集成不足：AI助手无法访问构建日志和完整静态分析输出，需手动复制粘贴错误信息。(6) 情感影响：开发者经历"胃痛"等焦虑情绪，特别是当交付停摆与大规模初始化变更冲突时。(7) 静态分析触发的滞后性：代码行年龄分布显示新规则需5.5年才能覆盖半数代码，10年才能覆盖90%。
AI.conclusion: 当机械编辑因AI变得廉价时，CI容量、审查努力和变更编排取代编辑成本成为主要瓶颈。可持续的AI辅助大规模修复需要：(1) 将语义变更集（如"修复警告X的所有实例"）视为一等工作单元，可针对开发者、审查者和CI进行不同切片；(2) 显式控制提交/审查/CI批处理粒度（commit、review、CI batch granularity）；(3) 取消commit作为唯一基本工作单元的假设，引入变更编排层将commit视为派生产物而非基础；(4) 为AI助手提供对构建系统、静态分析和问题跟踪器的结构化访问；(5) 解耦CI批处理粒度与审查粒度。

title: HistoRAG: A Citation-Grounded Question Answering Assistant for Teaching with Scanned Local History and Heritage Archives
summary: Teachers who prepare lessons on local history and cultural heritage work from material that is hard to use. The primary sources are scanned books without a text layer, and the supporting records are administrative catalogs released as spreadsheets. A general chatbot answers such questions fluently but without a verifiable source, which is the property a teacher needs most. This paper presents HistoRAG, a question answering assistant that answers from one regional collection and cites a volume and a page for every fact. HistoRAG transcribes each page with a vision language model and keeps a line level confidence from the token probabilities. It builds three stores from the same collection: a hybrid text index, a relational catalog database, and a knowledge graph extracted only from entity dense passages. A lightweight router sends each question to the stores it needs, so that counting questions reach the database and relational questions reach the graph. We build a benchmark of 516 questions over a collection of 36 scanned volumes and the heritage catalogs of the same region, covering statistical, factual, temporal, and multi-hop questions. HistoRAG answers more questions correctly than passage retrieval baselines and than a graph based retrieval system, at a far smaller cost per question. The assistant runs behind a chat interface, so a teacher can check any statement against the page it came from.

AI.tldr: HistoRAG是一个面向教师使用的、基于扫描版地方史与文化遗产档案的检索增强问答系统，能够为每个事实提供卷次和页码引用。它通过视觉语言模型转录扫描页面并保留置信度，构建文本索引、目录数据库和知识图谱三个存储，由轻量路由器按问题类型分发。
AI.motivation: 教师备课所用的一手资料为无文本层的扫描书籍和电子表格目录，通用聊天机器人无法提供可验证的来源，难以满足教学需求。现有RAG方法在OCR噪声、统计类计数查询、全量图谱抽取成本高等方面存在不足。
AI.method: 离线阶段：(1) 使用VLM转录每页并保留行级token置信度；(2) 构建混合文本索引（稠密+BM25，按置信度加权RRF融合）；(3) 将异构遗产目录归一化为关系数据库；(4) 仅对实体密度排名前ρ比例的文本块用LLM抽取知识图谱，并基于置信度门控进行实体归一化合并。在线阶段：由LLM提示路由器将问题分发到sql/kg/text子集，检索证据后生成带引用的答案。
AI.result: 在36卷扫描书籍（同地区书籍目录共20,312条记录）构建的516题基准上，HistoRAG在测试集350题上取得82.0%准确率，显著优于BM25 RAG（68.0%）等基线；统计题从54.7%提升至92.5%，多跳题从29.4%提升至48.5%；与LightRAG在匹配子集上对比，HistoRAG以77.5% vs 70.9%胜出，且每题仅用4,052 tokens（vs 122,008）。消融实验证实各路由必要，ρ=0.2时已恢复多跳题主要增益。
AI.conclusion: HistoRAG通过置信度感知的转录与检索、选择性图谱构建和多存储路由，为扫描档案教学提供了可验证、可追溯的问答方案；未来工作包括学习式路由策略、手工转录校准的置信度估计以及手写与竖排文档的扩展。

title: On the Impact of Requirement Smells in LLM-Based Code Generation
comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the 27th International Conference on Product-Focused Software Process Improvement (PROFES 2026)
summary: Software requirements are typically incorporated into prompts used in LLM-assisted software development. Recent work has shown that requirement smells can affect automated traceability between requirements and code, but empirical evidence on their effects in code generation remains limited. To address this gap, we build upon a prior study on automated traceability by reusing its dataset and requirement smell taxonomy, while extending it to evaluate the functional correctness of LLM-generated code. Using a benchmark consisting of requirements and corresponding system tests for four applications, we progressively introduced semantic, syntactic, and lexical smells into otherwise clear requirements and analyzed their influence on generated implementations. Our results suggest that increasing \textit{smell density} was generally associated with lower test-suite-based functional correctness, although non-smelly requirements could still produce faulty code. We also found that different smell categories had similar effects. These findings provide additional empirical evidence of the importance of requirement quality in LLM-assisted code generation, while showing that high-quality requirements alone do not guarantee correctness, as these depends on several factors, including the LLM. Compared with previous work, our results suggest that the impact of requirement smells depends on the software engineering task: whereas their effects on traceability were modest, code generation appears more sensitive. Overall, this work motivates further investigation into task-dependent quality effects in LLM-assisted software engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制实验研究需求异味（requirement smells）对LLM代码生成功能正确性的影响，复用Vogelsang等人的追溯实验数据集，引入语义、句法和词汇三类异味，逐步注入到四个游戏应用（Dice、Arkanoid、Snake、Scopa）的需求中，使用GPT-4o和DeepSeek-V3生成Java代码并通过JUnit/Mockito单元测试评估。结果显示：异味密度增加通常与正确性下降相关，但经Bonferroni校正后无统计显著性；不同异味类别影响相似；高质量需求不能保证正确性。与先前追溯研究相比，代码生成任务对异味更敏感。
AI.motivation: 软件需求作为LLM辅助开发中的提示，其质量（如异味）可能影响生成代码的功能正确性，但实证证据有限。先前工作仅研究了异味对自动追溯的影响，代码生成任务尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 基于GQM范式的控制实验：复用Vogelsang等人[19]的数据集和异味分类法；四个游戏应用共74条需求；手动注入语义、句法、词汇三类异味；构造五个递增的异味密度集合；每个需求映射到预定义Java骨架方法；使用JUnit+Mockito按需求级别编写单元测试；评估GPT-4o和DeepSeek-V3（temperature=0，每次配置运行5次）；采用Spearman相关（RQ2）和卡方检验+Cramér's V（RQ3），均经Bonferroni校正。
AI.result: RQ1：无异味条件下两个LLM多数测试通过，DeepSeek-V3在3/4应用中平均通过率更高，但均未达到100%。RQ2：异味密度增加总体伴随通过率下降（如DeepSeek-V3在Dice从88.0%降至77.6%，Snake从64.3%降至52.9%），但15个相关中仅少数ρ=-1.00精确p=0.0167显著，经Bonferroni校正（α*=0.0033）后全部不显著。RQ3：不同异味类别的影响因应用和LLM而异，无类别一致性地导致更大下降；24个卡方检验中最小p=0.0098（Snake-DS-V3词汇异味），经校正后均不显著。
AI.conclusion: 需求异味对LLM代码生成的影响具有任务依赖性——相比先前追溯研究的温和效应，代码生成表现出更高的描述性敏感性；影响是应用、LLM与需求表达交互的结果，而非单纯由异味类别决定；高质量需求虽必要但不充分；统计功效受限使结论需谨慎解读；未来应扩展至更大规模工业系统和更多LLM。

title: Model-Based Retargeting to Many-Core CPS: Simulink-to-OpenCL Workflow
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, and 3 tables. This is the preprint submitted to SEAA 2026. A revised short-paper version was published in LNCS 16863
summary: This paper addresses the software portability gap between Model-Based Development (MBD) and advanced many-core execution for Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS). We present a workflow-preserving retargeting approach for Simulink-based CPS applications with candidate-wise data parallelism to OpenCL-based many-core processors. Rather than manually rewriting models for new platforms, our toolchain uses MathWorks GPU Coder to extract data-parallel CUDA code, which is then translated into OpenCL host and device code via a custom framework. The conversion handles syntax rewriting, API emulation, and platform-specific argument packing. We deployed this workflow for a computationally intensive Frenet-frame trajectory planner on the Kalray MPPA Coolidge2. The results demonstrate the feasibility of a workflow-preserving retargeting pipeline for the evaluated CPS workload and platform.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对基于模型开发（MBD）的 Simulink 应用程序，提出一条"工作流保持"的重定向路径：Simulink → GPU Coder 生成 CUDA → 自研转换器翻译为 OpenCL 主机/设备代码 → 部署到 Kalray MPPA Coolidge2 多核处理器。以 Frenet 坐标系轨迹规划器（4000 条候选轨迹）为代表用例，验证在 100ms 规划周期预算下的可行性与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: MBD（Simulink）与异构多核平台之间存在可移植性鸿沟。GPU Coder 等商业代码生成器将模型锁定在特定供应商架构（如 CUDA），难以直接迁移到 OpenCL 类多核平台，导致 CPS 软件在不同并行架构间迁移代价高昂。
AI.method: 1) 建模：Simulink 中将计算密集部分封装为 MATLAB Function block；2) 中间表示：GPU Coder 抽取 CUDA 主机/设备代码；3) 翻译：Python 实现的转换器完成语法改写（grid/block→NDRange、__global__→__kernel 等）、运行时 API 仿真（cudaMalloc→clCreateBuffer 等）、针对 Kalray 核参数上限的结构化参数打包；4) 编译运行：kvx-linux-g++ 编译主机端，kvx-poclcc 编译 kernel，依赖 POCL OpenCL 运行时。映射策略：1 个 CC 作 host，其余 4 个 CC 作 device，每条候选轨迹映射到一个 work-item。
AI.result: 4000 候选轨迹下，顺序 Embedded Coder 基线中位 195.1ms（超 100ms 预算）；4 集群 OpenCL 并行中位 17.4ms、最大 18.9ms，约 11.2× 加速。集群由 1→4 时，延时从 36.4ms 降至 17.4ms（2.1×），呈次线性收益，主因是 host 端固定开销。100ms 预算内可处理候选数：1 CC 为 14000，2 CC 为 19000，3 CC 为 26000，4 CC 为 31000（2.21×）。将 POCL 等待策略从 sleep 改为 busy-wait 后消除了 ~10ms 的 OS timer 量化效应。
AI.conclusion: GPU Coder 生成的 CUDA 可作为 Simulink→OpenCL 多核平台重定向的实用中间表示；工作流保持的关键除语法改写外，还需运行时仿真层与面向硬件约束的参数打包。可扩展性受 host 编排、同步、OS/运行时行为等固定开销制约，呈边际递减。规划周期预算应被视为约束搜索空间规模的可调参数而非固定目标。本方法同样适用于其他可分解为候选/数据并行且核心逻辑封装在 MATLAB Function block 中的 CPS 工作负载。

title: Demystifying Agent Skills for Smart Contract Auditing: Design, Effectiveness, Behavioral Impact
summary: LLM agents, notably Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, are emerging as versatile tools beyond coding agents only. These agents can be enhanced with skills---reusable artifacts that package domain knowledge, workflows, and tool-use instructions. To date, however, little is known about how such skills are designed or how they affect agent effectiveness and behavior in practice. In this paper, we investigate these questions in smart contract security auditing, a domain in which agents have shown substantial promise. We systematically collect 83 smart contract audit skills from the wild and evaluate them on EVMBench across seven agent--model configurations. Our study examines three dimensions: (i) the design characteristics of audit skills, including their structure, knowledge representations, workflows, and tool dependencies; (ii) their effectiveness in improving vulnerability detection; and (iii) their influence on agent execution trajectories. We find that audit skills are mostly lightweight but heterogeneous in design, covering a broad yet imbalanced range of vulnerability types. Their effectiveness is determined primarily by the model rather than the agent harness: Codex/GPT-5.5 achieves the largest gains, improving detection score by 22.8% and captured award by 43.2%. We further find that skill triggering is a key bottleneck. When triggered, skills preserve a shared six-stage audit workflow while exhibiting distinct loading patterns and differential effects on agent behavior across configurations. We release our skill corpus and artifacts to support future research.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对LLM编码代理（如Claude Code和OpenAI Codex）在智能合约安全审计领域中使用的"技能"（skills）进行了首次系统性实证研究，从设计特征、效果和行为影响三个维度分析了83个真实审计技能。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM代理（如Claude Code和OpenAI Codex）在智能合约审计中展现潜力，"技能"（skills）作为可复用的领域知识、工作流和工具使用指令的封装形式开始涌现。然而，关于审计技能如何设计、如何影响代理的有效性和行为，目前知之甚少。现有技能研究多为黑盒评估，缺乏领域特定洞察；而智能合约安全研究主要关注LLM代理的原生能力，忽略了技能增强的审计场景。
AI.method: 研究方法包括三个核心步骤：①技能收集与策展：从9个来源（6个AI技能市场、2个GitHub仓库、1个学术基准）通过关键词检索获得155个候选技能，经两阶段去重（URL去重+内容哈希+人工审查）后形成83个唯一技能语料库；②设计分析（RQ1）：结合语料统计与基于LLM辅助的自下而上开放编码（bottom-up open coding），分析技能的结构特性、知识表示、工具依赖、工作流设计和漏洞覆盖五个方面；③效果与行为分析（RQ2/RQ3）：在EVMBench基准上评估7种代理-模型配置（Claude Code×{Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.6, DeepSeek-V4-Pro}和Codex×{GPT-5.4, GPT-5.5, DeepSeek-V4-Pro}），从Detect Score和Detect Award衡量检测效果，从执行轨迹分析技能触发、加载模式和工作流结构。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：①设计维度——审计技能大多轻量（SKILL.md中位120行/1,281 tokens，中位25KB/3文件），但设计异质，编码为混合审计手册（启发式+程序式+报告式+概念式+示例知识），漏洞覆盖广泛但失衡（DeFi和协议特定风险形成长尾）；②效果维度——技能效果主要由后端模型能力驱动而非代理外壳，Codex/GPT-5.5提升最大（Detect Score +22.8%，Detect Award +43.2%）；③行为维度——技能在7种配置中6种引起执行轨迹显著偏移，但技能触发是关键瓶颈（仅GPT-5.5能持续触发），触发后保留共享的六阶段审计工作流，但呈现不同的加载模式和行为效应。
AI.conclusion: 该论文揭示了智能合约审计技能的设计现状、有效性边界和行为机制，首次系统阐明技能效果主要由后端模型能力决定而非代理外壳，技能触发是关键瓶颈。研究发布的83个技能语料库和评测artifact为未来代理技能研究提供了重要基础设施。

title: Judgment-Centred Software Engineering Education: A Post-Hype Review and Framework for AI-Augmented Learning
summary: Generative artificial intelligence has moved from a disruptive novelty to a recurring part of software-development and computing-education workflows, while software agents are beginning to act across repositories, command lines, browsers, tests, and other tools. The educational problem is no longer whether students should be allowed to generate code, but whether software-engineering (SE) programs can preserve and assess human understanding while preparing students to work responsibly with increasingly capable AI systems. This paper presents a structured integrative review of research and practice from 2023 through 23 September 2026, supplemented by established work on AI literacy, technical debt, and human-AI collaboration. The evidence supports a conditional conclusion: GenAI can improve access to explanations, feedback, practice, and short-term task completion, but learning outcomes depend on prior knowledge, scaffolding, verification, task design, and assessment. We examine student help-seeking and authorship, faculty assessment and policy demands, and the wider SE risks created when generated artifacts persist across repositories, teams, architectures, and deployed systems. We extend the concept of comprehension debt: the deferred learning and maintenance cost that arises when AI-assisted production outpaces a learner's or team's ability to explain, test, modify, and justify the resulting software. We then refine the AI-Augmented Software Engineering Education (AASEE) framework into five non-linear integration levels and four cross-cutting evidence obligations: explain, verify, modify, and account. The framework links delegation to evidence, governance, and recovery mechanisms appropriate to its consequences.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对生成式AI与代理式AI对软件工程（SE）教育的冲击，提出"判断力中心"教育范式，并构建AASEE框架：将AI整合划分为五个非线性层级（从工具意识到代理系统工程），并贯穿四项证据义务（explain、verify、modify、account）。论文同时引入并拓展"理解债务"概念，用以诊断AI辅助产出与学习者理解能力之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已从新奇现象变为软件工程实践的常规部分，代理式AI进一步能在仓库、命令行、浏览器等多工具间自主行动。教育的核心问题已不再是"是否允许学生生成代码"，而是SE项目能否在让学生与高能力AI协作的同时，保留并评估其真实理解力。当前文献普遍存在将编程教育等同于软件工程教育、将短期产出等同于持久能力、以检测而非设计应对评估失效等问题。
AI.method: 采用结构化整合综述（structured integrative review），检索2023年1月至2026年9月23日的文献，结合AI素养、技术债、人机协作等经典文献。检索来源包括ACM DL、IEEE Xplore、SpringerLink、ScienceDirect、Frontiers、Google Scholar、arXiv及会议/机构出版页，并采用引用链方法。证据按类型进行加权：系统综述与元分析权重最高，控制/准实验研究次之，调查/感知研究、观察/定性研究、设计/工具研究、代理基准、概念/预印本分别用于不同目的。论文明确不声称PRISMA式穷尽检索。
AI.result: 1）学习收益是有条件的：AI可改善解释、反馈、练习与短期任务完成，但效果在异质性极高（I²=96.32%），经出版偏倚校正后总体效应不显著；2）生产力与完成度并非持久能力的可靠代理；3）评估有效性比AI检测更根本，需要作品集式评估；4）先验知识与信任校准至关重要——流利输出对知识最少的学习者最具说服力；5）AI辅导与反馈需精心设计；6）SE有别于编程：生成工件进入共享仓库并跨迭代持续；7）代理式AI将任务从"生成"转向"监督"，需要任务契约、权限边界、评估脚手架、回滚机制等新能力；8）操作化"理解债务"为教育评估透镜；9）AASEE框架五个层级（非线性）配合四项义务为课程与评估提供可操作设计逻辑。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI使软件生产与软件理解分离，代理式AI使行动与持续人类创作分离。这构成了SE教育的核心设计问题。AASEE框架及其配套的"理解债务"诊断支持"判断力中心"教育范式：教育目标在于培养知道委托什么、能够判断结果是否可信、能在失败时恢复、并对最终软件负责的工程师，而非最大化手工产出或AI使用。框架本身应被视为基于证据的设计假设，需要通过比较研究、跨机构验证与纵向追踪进一步检验。

title: CodeGraph: Open-Taxonomy Knowledge Graph for Source Code with Wikidata Grounding
summary: Public software repositories, like GitHub and Software Heritage Archive, store billions of files, yet extracting their implicit engineering knowledge ---i.e., the algorithms they implement, the paradigms they follow, the patterns they instantiate, and the application domains they serve--- remains challenging, as current tools are constrained to syntactic and token-level analysis. We present a pipeline for building an open-taxonomy semantic annotation of source code using a code-specialised Large Language Model. The extracted entities are grounded in Wikidata through a three-stage linking procedure: a deterministic SPARQL stage handles unambiguous entities, a Deep Research Agent resolves the residual long tail, and a hierarchy-rollup stage imports the parent-of closure of each resolved Wikidata identifier. The resulting annotations are materialised as a source-code-specific open-taxonomy knowledge graph. We further introduce a calibrated quality-assurance protocol that quantifies annotation precision by combining a small human gold set with an LLM-as-a-judge filter. We applied our pipeline to the 167 million files of the Stack-Edu corpus, creating the first known large-scale open-taxonomy knowledge graph for source code. Our graph, named CodeGraph, contains approximately 158 million nodes, which include around 145 million files, about 63,000 extracted concept entities (such as algorithms, paradigms, design patterns, and application domains), and roughly 19,800 grounded Wikidata entities. Furthermore, CodeGraph features approximately 1 billion typed edges that connect files to their respective concepts, link these concepts to their grounded Wikidata identifiers, and relate them to their parent categories, covering 14 programming languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 CodeGraph，一种针对大规模源代码的开源分类法知识图谱构建方法。它利用代码专用 LLM 从 1.67 亿个源文件中提取高层语义概念（算法、范式、设计模式、应用领域），并通过三阶段流程将其与 Wikidata 实体对齐，最终构建出约 1.58 亿节点、10 亿条边的开放分类法知识图谱。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模代码语料库（如 GitHub、Software Heritage）虽存储数十亿文件，但提取其隐含的工程知识（算法、范式、模式、应用领域）仍具挑战，因为现有工具局限于语法和词法层面的分析。已有代码知识图谱（如 GraphGen4Code）规模小且仅描述句法结构，无法支持"代码做什么、为什么这样设计"的高层语义查询。
AI.method: 三阶段构建流程：(1) 基于 Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct（MoE 架构代码专用 LLM）的开放分类法语义提取，沿四个正交轴（领域、算法、范式、设计模式）进行结构化提示抽取；(2) 三阶段 Wikidata 接地：确定性 SPARQL 查询处理无歧义实体 → Deep Research Agent（Qwen3.6-27B）处理长尾歧义 → wdt:P279 传递闭包实现层级回滚；(3) 校准的质量保证协议：基于 127 文件人类黄金标准集选择最佳 LLM 验证器（Devstral-2 2512），并以银级 LLM-as-judge 过滤器量化全语料库精度。最终以类型化属性图（Typed Property Graph）形式物化。
AI.result: 在 Stack-Edu 语料库（14 种编程语言、1.45 亿个源文件、1250 亿 token）上构建出 CodeGraph：约 1.58 亿节点（1.449 亿 :File 节点 + 语义层 + Wikidata 层）、约 10.2 亿条带类型边。语义词汇经规范化后包含 37,412 个领域、19,660 个算法、5,955 个设计模式和 193 种范式；19,807 个 Wikidata 实体被导入，其中领域（98.6%）、范式（97.4%）、设计模式（95.1%）和算法（89.0%）的对齐率较高。计算成本约 40 万 GPU 小时（256 块 NVIDIA A100，LEONARDO 超算）。验证器在六类语言间接受率均匀（87–90%）。
AI.conclusion: CodeGraph 是首个面向源代码的大规模开放分类法知识图谱，弥补了原始代码语料库与语义索引之间的空白。其双层概念结构（本地词汇 + Wikidata 全局分类法）支持语义代码搜索、跨域算法复用分析等下游应用，并揭示了相同算法原语在实质不同应用领域的跨域复用模式。源代码与可复现性样本已在 GitHub 开源，完整数据集已在 HuggingFace 发布。

title: Object-to-Source Mapping under Optimization: What a Control-Flow Trace Can Show, and Where Source-Level Coverage Breaks
summary: Within a validated interval, control-flow trace can reconstruct machine-level execution, but source-level structural coverage additionally requires a validated attribution from generated instructions and branch outcomes to source obligations. This paper defines that boundary and illustrates it with exact compiler output. Optimization can fuse multiple source conditions into one branch, replace a branch with a conditional select or move, and degrade provenance in debug and mapping information. In such cases, trace may be complete for the generated binary while condition-level source evidence remains unresolved. We therefore separate trace completeness, source attribution, and coverage satisfaction; distinguish source-to-object transformations from object-region attribution states; and explain when internal reconvergence makes aggregate branch observations insufficient and ordered per-instance condition-evaluation histories necessary. We compare measuring a less-optimized build, constraining code generation, and adding state-writing instrumentation. Finally, we describe a pre-compilation supplementation mechanism disclosed in WO 2026/162831 A1 that preserves selected source distinctions as trace-observable control flow without writes to application-resident coverage state. An appendix demonstrates the mechanism end-to-end on real silicon for the worked example: the supplemented -O3 build keeps each condition individually trace-observable, per-instance histories and an MC/DC verdict are reconstructed from a captured ETM trace, and code-size and cycle costs are measured. Its use remains subject to build-specific preservation, final-image mapping, trace-validity, and probe-effect verification.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地界定了控制流追踪在源码级结构覆盖（特别是MC/DC）中的能力边界，指出编译器优化会使条件级源信息在目标代码中消失，并提出一种基于WO 2026/162831 A1的预编译"控制流增补"机制，将源码区分以控制流形式植入且不写入应用驻留的分析状态。
AI.motivation: 在嵌入式安全关键系统（如DO-178C）中，源码级结构覆盖尤其是MC/DC需要可追溯的证据，但编译器优化（如条件融合、条件选择指令、宏展开）会破坏源码条件与目标分支的一一映射，导致纯控制流追踪无法回答条件级覆盖问题；既有工具要么依赖状态写入式插桩（影响性能与产物同一性），要么降低优化等级（影响生产性能），因此需要一种既保留优化产物又不写入分析状态的方案。
AI.method: 方法包含三个层次：（1）理论与分类框架——将"追踪完整性""源码归因""覆盖达成"分离为三个独立属性，将源义务变换与目标区域归因状态作为两条正交轴；（2）以精确编译器输出（AArch64/x86-64，-O0/-O3，clang 22.1.4）展示两类优化失效模式——条件融合为单一分支（如 `orr + cbz`）与条件选择/移动指令（如 `csel`、`cmovne`），并展示宏展开导致行表退化为 line 0；（3）提出预编译增补机制——在源码中插入功能性中立的锚点块（POI），保证各条件在优化后仍保留独立可追踪的控制流分支，并配合静态观测映射表，在目标外部重建每实例的条件求值历史以支持MC/DC判定。
AI.result: 在 Cortex-M7（NUCLEO-H7S3L8, 600 MHz）与 Cortex-M4 上以 Arm GNU 14.2.Rel1（-O3 -g3）进行的端到端实验：参考-O3构建将两条件融合为单一 `orrs + bne`，条件不可单独观测；增补构建展开为六个独立可观测站点，2 KB ETM 缓冲回放重建出四遍三向量测试集的逐实例历史 [T,T]→T、[T,F]→F、[F,-]→F，masking MC/DC 判定两条件均已覆盖。代码代价：.text 决策部分 +12 字节（5 条 nop + 1 条 2 字节连接分支），每 3 实例扫描周期 +66（平均 +22 周期/调用），为该决策的微基准数据。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了控制流追踪支撑源码级结构覆盖的精确边界：分支可观测、寄存器/标志值与条件选择结果不可观测；优化会使源码区分在目标码中消失，导致条件覆盖与MC/DC无法仅凭控制流追踪回答；WO 2026/162831 A1 披露的预编译增补机制可在不写入应用驻留分析状态的前提下使所需区分重新可追踪，并通过真实硅片实验验证了端到端链条的可行性，但适用性仍受制于构建特定的保留验证、最终映像映射、追踪有效性与探针效应验证。

title: On the Factors in Quantum Software Quality
summary: As quantum computing evolves, the demand for high-quality quantum software is increasing. Classical software quality models, such as McCall's model, provide a useful foundation, but they do not explicitly capture distinctive properties of quantum software, including probabilistic measurement outcomes, backend-dependent behavior, and hybrid quantum-classical workflows. This paper proposes a base quality model for quantum software using McCall's factor-criterion-metric structure as the organizing backbone. It broadens the set of quality factors by drawing on representative classical software quality models and standards and introduces quantum-specific extensions only where needed. We define the resulting factor set and quality criteria, provide a many-to-many mapping of core factor-to-criterion relationships, discuss representative candidate metrics together with the execution, reference, and interpretation conditions needed to use them, and illustrate how the resulting model can be applied across the quantum software lifecycle. The model is intended as a common starting point for structuring, assessing, and communicating quality concerns in quantum software while supporting context-specific adaptation. Further expert feedback, case studies, and empirical studies can be used to evaluate and refine the model and its application across different quantum software contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向量子软件的基础质量模型，以McCall的因子-准则-度量结构为组织骨架，整合经典软件质量模型并引入量子特有扩展，旨在为量子软件质量的结构化评估、沟通和针对性定制提供统一起点。
AI.motivation: 量子软件具有概率性测量结果、后端依赖行为、混合量子-经典工作流等区别于经典软件的特性，而现有的经典软件质量模型（如McCall模型、ISO/IEC 25010）未能显式涵盖这些量子特定的质量关注点，导致量子软件质量评估缺乏广泛使用的基础质量模型作为通用起点。
AI.method: 采用McCall因子-准则-度量结构作为组织骨架，通过四个设计原则（保持与经典研究的连续性、保守扩展、明确区分因子/准则/度量层、支持上下文定制）从经典模型抽取因子并按需引入量子特定因子；通过五步构建程序形成完整的因子集、准则定义、多对多因子-准则映射以及代表性候选度量；度量层细化为结构与制品度量、覆盖率度量、清单/二元度量、数值误差度量、分布度量、统计不确定性度量、资源度量、鲁棒性度量、协议一致性度量和生命周期证据度量等类型；每个候选度量均需明确测量对象、计算规则、评估上下文、参考条件和聚合规则。
AI.result: 构建了一个包含11个经典（McCall）因子、14个经典（扩展）因子、4个量子特定因子（纠缠鲁棒性、量子硬件适应性、混合量子-经典互操作性、物理有效性）的因子集；定义了约53个质量准则（含经典McCall准则、扩展经典准则和量子特定准则）；提供了因子-准则的核心多对多映射表；列出了与准则对应的代表性候选度量；通过VQA分子基态能估计的示例展示了如何针对具体项目定制质量配置文件；并将模型应用与五阶段量子软件生命周期（需求分析、设计、实现、测试、维护）相联系。
AI.conclusion: 该基础质量模型为量子软件质量的组织、评估和沟通提供了统一结构，同时支持针对不同应用领域、平台和组织上下文的定制；但模型仍需通过专家反馈、案例研究和实证研究进一步评估与精化；未来的工作重点包括建立共享的测量与报告约定、开发支持质量证据收集与解释的工具、研究在硬件/工具链演化下如何维护质量证据的有效性。

title: DSpec2Test: Specification-Driven Test Generation in Dafny
summary: Verification-aware languages, such as Dafny, integrate logical constructs into code and enable automatic verification of program correctness. However, tests remain helpful in scenarios that verification alone does not address (e.g., to support test-driven development). Existing Dafny test generation tools are implementation-based, limiting their applicability in this context. We present DSpec2Test, a specification-driven test generation tool for Dafny that automatically derives tests from formal specifications, without considering implementation details. Our tool extends Dafny's generate-tests command with a new blackbox mode based on Disjunctive Normal Form (DNF) equivalence class partitioning and optional Boundary Value Analysis (BVA). DSpec2Test relies on the Z3 SMT solver to synthesize inputs and expected outputs that meet the specification-derived constraints. We evaluate DSpec2Test on programs from DafnyBench mutated using MutDafny and compare it against Dafny's existing implementation-driven Block mode. DSpec2Test achieves a 93.9% mutation kill rate on a dataset of 131 mutants, outperforming Block's 82.4%, and uniquely killing 17 mutants. These results suggest that specification-driven testing is an effective and complementary approach for testing Dafny programs.

AI.tldr: DSpec2Test是首个针对Dafny的规约驱动测试生成工具，通过Safe DNF等价类划分和边界值分析，从方法的requires/ensures子句自动生成可运行测试，无需依赖实现代码。实验在131个可杀死的变异体上达到93.9%的杀死率，优于DTest的82.4%，并独有地杀死了17个变异体。
AI.motivation: 验证感知语言Dafny虽能自动验证程序正确性，但验证失败时的错误信息往往难以定位故障。现有Dafny测试生成工具（如DTest）基于实现生成测试，无法支持测试驱动开发（TDD）等仅有规约而无实现的早期开发场景，限制了其适用性。
AI.method: DSpec2Test作为Dafny `generate-tests`命令的新增Spec模式，采用三阶段流水线：(1) Verifier标记失败验证或带{:testEntry}的方法；(2) Modifier将方法的requires/ensures合约转换为Safe DNF分支（保留短路保护语义），并可选地进行边界值分析（BVA），通过Z3求解器合成满足约束的输入和预期输出；(3) Updater在迭代时通过追加assume语句确保测试新颖性。核心创新包括Safe DNF分解规则（对蕴含/或/等价/条件等运算符生成互斥且守卫的分支）以及将测试目标编码为assume/assert false存根以委托Z3求解。
AI.result: 在DafnyBench的20个程序（131个可现实杀死的变异体）上评估：Spec_bva杀死123个变异体（93.9%），Block杀死108个（82.4%），联合覆盖125个（95.4%），仅6个未被两者杀死。Spec_bva独有杀死17个变异体，Block独有杀死2个，验证了两种策略的互补性。代价是Spec_bva生成测试数量更多（平均6.6 vs 1.6），墙钟时间约慢1.6倍。
AI.conclusion: DSpec2Test是首个支持Dafny规约驱动测试生成的工具，证明了基于规约的测试与基于实现的测试能触达不同的故障类别，二者具有互补性。工具适用于早期和TDD风格的开发工作流，也可作为DTest等白盒工具的补充。未来工作包括通过相关性检查处理后置条件空洞满足问题、支持函数内联、可变状态（数组、类字段）以及扩大评估规模。

title: SWE-PolyVision: Benchmarking Cross-Image Abductive Reasoning for Repository-Level Software Engineering
summary: Current multimodal software-engineering benchmarks expose images as additional context, but do not test whether an agent can integrate evidence distributed across images into a verified repository-level repair. We present SWE-PolyVision, an executable benchmark of 92 real tasks from 36 open-source organizations, with 48 public tasks and 44 private holdouts. The release contains 402 static images and 6 videos, with at least two visual inputs per task. Each task pairs a fixed pre-fix repository with an isolated verifier and is evaluated under the supported conditions among three access modes: Text-only, Native Vision, and Tool-mediated Vision. Across eleven coding models, visual access changes which tasks are solved, but effects depend on both model and task. Two trace-linked Native Vision cases illustrate how complementary visual and textual clues can lead to source-localized, verified repairs; controlled interventions show that this conversion is not yet stable across inputs. SWE-PolyVision thus separates the availability of multi-image evidence from its successful use in repository-level repair, without treating patch success alone as proof of explicit reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出SWE-PolyVision基准，包含92个真实仓库级任务，每任务至少含两个视觉输入，旨在评估编码智能体在跨图像溯因推理下能否将多图证据整合为可验证的修复。
AI.motivation: 现有SWE多模态基准仅将图像作为额外上下文，未衡量智能体是否能整合跨图像关系来完成仓库级修复。该工作填补这一空白，提出"跨图像溯因推理"作为显式评估目标。
AI.method: 构建92任务（48公开+44私有）的可执行基准，覆盖36个开源组织，含402张图片和6个视频。设计三种访问模式（纯文本/原生视觉/工具中介视觉），统一任务包、固定预修复仓库与隔离验证器；提出六阶段推理框架（Observe-Align-Integrate-Abduce-Verify-Repair）；进行控制性输入干预与轨迹追溯分析。
AI.result: 在11个编码模型上测试，发现视觉访问的修复效果呈模型与任务依赖性：qwen3.8-max的原生视觉优于纯文本，而GPT-5.6-sol和Claude-Opus-5则相反。10任务控制性试点中，未检测到图像顺序或多图组合带来稳定的修复提升。两个轨迹追溯案例（ECharts与Fabric.js）展示了视觉与文本线索互补导向源码级修复的可能，但当前结果不支持"成功即证明显式跨图像推理"。
AI.conclusion: SWE-PolyVision区分了多图像证据的可用性与其在仓库级修复中的成功使用，揭示了"访问-整合差距"。图像可见不等于证据整合；当前智能体有时能将分布式证据转化为修复，但缺乏稳定依赖性。系统的轨迹标注与因果必要性验证仍是未来工作。

title: Formal Model Construction Guided by Model-Based Proof Sketches
summary: Formal modeling provides strong guarantees about system correctness, but developing and repairing formal models remains labor-intensive and requires substantial expertise in logic and formal reasoning. Recent LLM-based autoformalization agents seek to reduce this burden by generating candidate formal models and revising them using feedback from formal tools. However, the existing approaches follow a generate-and-repair paradigm, in which repairs are driven by verification failures of the generated model and therefore depend heavily on both the granularity of the feedback and the LLM's repair capability. As a consequence, a repair targeting one level of verification may invalidate properties at another level, which requires reasoning over the complete set of event guards. To address these limitations, we propose Proof-Sketch-Guided Formal Model Synthesis (ProGS), an autoformalization method centered on model-based proof sketches. A model-based proof sketch represents the proof structure of the target formal system as a tree. Internal nodes capture case splits and inductive reasoning steps, while leaf nodes correspond to concrete state-transition events that realize individual subgoals. ProGS uses LLMs to generate and repair these sketches, with verification failures mapped back to specific nodes and subtrees to provide structured guidance for iterative repair. Our evaluation on a benchmark of 27 formal systems shows that ProGS improves over state-of-the-art agentic formal modeling approaches in syntactic validity, deductive verifiability, and behavioral correctness, demonstrating the benefit of organizing formal model construction around hierarchical proof sketches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProGS（Proof-Sketch-Guided Formal Model Synthesis），一种以基于模型的证明草图（model-based proof sketches）为核心的自动形式化方法。该方法通过将证明结构组织为树形中间表示（内部节点表示案例拆分与归纳推理，叶节点对应具体状态转换事件），解决了现有"生成-修复"范式中反馈粒度不匹配、局部修复引发全局语义不一致的问题。在27个形式系统基准测试中，ProGS在语法有效性、演绎可验证性和行为正确性上均优于现有基于LLM的代理形式建模方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动形式化方法采用"生成-修复"范式，依赖形式化工具的验证反馈进行修复，但存在两个核心问题：（1）反馈粒度不匹配——模型级反馈（如死锁轨迹）定位能力差，而事件级反馈独立修复可能导致跨事件不一致；（2）修复一个验证层级的失败可能破坏另一层级的性质。这种粒度失配使得系统级形式建模不仅需要生成/修复单个组件，还需组织组件间的依赖关系以保持局部修复与全局验证的一致性。
AI.method: ProGS包含三个核心阶段：(1) 环境模型构建——生成Γ（含不变量、变量等）并识别不变量间的依赖关系（等价、蕴含、案例拆分、归纳四种类型），通过形式化义务验证；(2) 基于模型的证明草图构建与结构检查——草图为树P=(N,E)，内部节点携带guard表示中间证明/拆分条件，叶节点为具体事件。对草图执行两类结构检查：无死锁性（父节点guard蕴含子节点guard的析取）和父子guard有效性（子节点guard蕴含父节点guard）。采用"best-of-3"策略选取结构成本最低的草图；(3) 形式模型合成与子树级修复——将叶节点翻译为状态转换事件，验证失败后回溯定位到证明草图的子树，将子树级聚合信息反馈给LLM进行协调修复。结构成本定义为：(结构检查失败数/|N| + 1/depth + 1/叶节点数)/3。
AI.result: 在27个形式系统基准（覆盖顺序算法、并发系统、分布式系统）上，以Event-B为通用规范语言、GPT 5.4 mini为LLM：ProGS在Syntax(0.944)、PDR(0.967，最高)、RF(0.903，第二)、Runtime(0.777)、Trace(0.697，最高)五项指标上均取得最优或次优；建模效率方面，ProGS平均18.43分钟/21.59次LLM调用，显著优于Event-B Agent（25.98分钟/29.93次），且每修复一个证明义务仅需2.366次LLM调用（Event-B Agent需7.148次）；消融实验证实结构检查提升运行时性能，子树级修复同时提升证明与运行时性能。
AI.conclusion: ProGS证明了围绕层次化证明草图组织形式模型构建的有效性，能更好地平衡证明可验证性与行为语义正确性。其基于模型的证明草图作为中间表示，将全局验证分解为边级和节点级检查，为LLM辅助形式建模提供了新范式。未来工作可扩展更多边级和子树级形式检查，并探索与形式模型精化及轨迹验证的结合。

title: Evaluating Agent Skills for Version-Specific Plugin Migration: A Retrospective Study
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Code, data, and evaluation artifacts: this https URL
summary: Agent skills package version-specific maintenance knowledge for coding agents, but a higher diagnostic score does not by itself show that the resulting migration advice satisfies the target version's contract. We study a shipped plugin-upgrade skill through an archive of 64 reports on 16 static migration tasks, with two attempts per condition and 328 criterion decisions. With the skill, mean recorded reward rises from 93.83 to 98.75, a gain of 4.92 points (95% task-bootstrap interval [0.31, 10.86]); the gain is concentrated in one task, and eight task pairs are at the ceiling. Tracing every decision to its contract domain and reviewing ten reports in depth exposes grading errors that favor either arm; in one, a containment predicate that accepts the parent directory still receives full credit. Executable probes confirm this defect and show that a working teardown repair is excluded only by a narrower lifecycle rubric. Replacing the reviewed decisions keeps the estimate positive (4.61 to 5.39 points) but moves its interval to or across zero. Re-grading all 64 reports with judges from two other model families, without arm labels or prior scores, agrees with the original judge on 91.8% and 95.7% of decisions (weighted $\kappa=0.64$ and $0.72$) and gives gains of 10.63 and 6.09 points. The study contributes a traceable evaluation that connects aggregate reward to contract-level evidence and judge sensitivity, together with concrete review checks for migration advice. Executable end-to-end repairs, independent human annotation, and other frameworks are left to future work.

AI.tldr: 这是一项对已部署的 dsh 插件升级 Agent Skill 进行回顾性案例研究。研究基于 64 份归档报告（16 个静态迁移任务 × 2 个条件 × 2 次重复），共 328 项评分决策，发现使用 Skill 使平均得分从 93.83 提升至 98.75（增益 4.92 分，95% 任务自助法区间 [0.31, 10.86]）。但通过将每个评分决策追溯到对应的契约域，并对 10 份报告进行深入审查，发现原评分存在漏洞：例如 S11 中一个本应排除父目录的路径包含谓词实际放行了 ".." 路径，但仍获得满分；S18 中一个有效的资源拆卸修复方案被更窄的生命周期评分标准所排除。替换被审查的评分后，估计值仍为正（4.61–5.39），但置信区间触及或跨越零。两个其他模型族（Claude Opus 5.5 与 GPT-5.5）的盲法重新评分与原评分一致率分别为 91.8% 和 95.7%（加权 κ=0.64 和 0.72），给出的增益分别为 10.63 和 6.09 分。研究贡献了一种将聚合奖励与契约级证据和评分者敏感性相连接的可追溯评估方法，以及针对迁移建议的具体审查清单。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型驱动的编码代理在软件工程任务中的广泛使用，"Agent Skill" 作为一种封装版本特定维护知识的机制被引入，但其诊断分数的提升不能直接证明迁移建议满足目标版本的契约要求。作者关注的核心问题是：一个表面上更高的聚合得分是否真的代表了维护者可以依据执行的、契约一致的建议。聚合奖励无法揭示建议是否遗漏了某个 API 可用性、边界条件或运行时约束，而错误的迁移建议在实际生产中可能导致 CI 卡死或安全漏洞。研究动机源于一次具体的归档答案事件——一个提出的路径包含检查实际放行了父目录，却仍获满分，从而揭示出 LLM-as-a-judge 评分机制存在系统性盲点。
AI.method: 研究采用单案例回顾性设计（Runeson & Höst, 2009），属于 SIGSOFT 实证标准下的现场研究。研究流程包括：(1) 从 22 个静态任务池 S1–S22 中通过种子（seed 20260915）分层抽取 16 个任务，平衡问题家族和构件大小；(2) 在 "无 Skill" 与 "有 Skill" 两种条件下各执行两次重复，产出 64 份报告；(3) 使用 report-judge-v2 评分规则进行 328 项标准级决策，得到 0–100 奖励分；(4) 主分析为按任务的百分位置自助法（10,000 次，mulberry32）；(5) 将每个评分标准追溯到 6 个契约域之一（版本/发布适用性、API/数据/所有权、生命周期/排序/部署、安全/边界处理、失败归因、证据/验证/出处）；(6) 对 10 份报告进行有界深度审查；(7) 使用 Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-5.5 进行跨模型族的盲法重新评分；(8) 通过可执行探针验证 S11 的路径谓词缺陷，用 Node 子进程重建 S18 的计时器规划器；(9) 穷举 2⁸=256 种符号赋值检验稳健性。
AI.result: 主结果：在焦点对比中，平均原始奖励从 93.83 上升到 98.75（Δ=4.92，95% 任务自助法 CI [0.31, 10.86]），但增益集中于 S1 单一任务（42.5 分），八个任务对处于满分天花板，S11 和 S18 反而下降 5 分。契约分层分析显示原始满分比例在版本/发布（8→12/12）、API/数据（35→45/46）域上升，安全/边界和失败归因两域均为 10/10 和 32/32 满分。10 份报告的有界审查发现 3 项评分分歧，其中：S6 因错误将信息事件处理完全归因于主机，评分从 87.5 降至 62.5；S11 因路径谓词放行父目录但仍获满分，评分从 90 降至 80；S18 的有效拆卸修复因不符合"必须解除计时器引用"的较窄评分标准而仅获部分分。替换被审查评分后估计值为 4.61–5.39 分，但区间触及或跨越零。跨族盲法重评：Claude 与原 GLM 评分一致率 91.8%（κ=0.64），给出增益 10.63 [3.44, 19.14]；GPT 一致率 95.7%（κ=0.72），给出增益 6.09 [1.56, 11.09]。资源使用方面，技能条件下子代理 token 数是无技能条件下的 3.87 倍（3.19M vs 12.32M），时长比为 1.21。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论指出：在归档的 16 任务对比中，提供插件升级 Skill 使记录奖励提高 4.92 分，但增益集中于单一任务且受天花板效应限制。更重要的发现关乎如何解读此类增益——API 可用性与责任归属、精确的边界覆盖、进程存活性无法从看似合理的建议或聚合分数推断，必须在建议应满足的契约层面加以核验。对全部 328 项决策的完整核算、有界审查与可执行探针定位了一处被遗漏的边界缺陷（S11）与一处因较窄规则而被排除的替代修复方案（S18）。两个盲法跨族评分者保留了增益的正向但改变了其幅度。通过将契约、答案、分数与反例相互链接，研究使观察到的收益及其未决的正确性问题均成为可审查对象，并为人类验证、可执行修复与跨项目复现提供了可复用的基础。研究同时总结了三条可迁移至其他项目的维护者审查问题：(1) 验证目标版本是否暴露可调用的公共接口并明确数据产/存责任归属；(2) 对边界谓词测试确切的边界值与普通后代；(3) 将所需运行时条件与建议的清理动作分开陈述。作者明确将独立人类注释、可执行端到端修复与跨框架验证留作未来工作。

title: NEUROTESTGEN: Neuro-Symbolic Guided Test Generation with Large Language Models
summary: Ensuring high structural coverage remains a fundamental challenge in automated test generation, particularly for complex software systems where reaching specific lines or branches requires satisfying intricate control- and data-flow constraints. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated strong capabilities in producing human-like test cases; however, they often struggle to generate inputs that satisfy precise path conditions. Conversely, symbolic execution can systematically derive such constraints, but it often fails to construct realistic, executable test cases and is constrained by scalability limitations. In this paper, we introduce NEUROTESTGEN, a hybrid approach that integrates symbolic execution with LLM-driven test synthesis to generate test cases targeting on-demand code coverage. Given a set of target statements within a method, NEUROTESTGEN first employs a symbolic analysis engine (i.e., the Z3 SMT solver) to extract path-specific constraints and construct a symbolic guidance specification for the desired coverage goal. This specification is then used to guide an LLM in synthesizing concrete test cases that are both structurally valid and semantically meaningful. For paths involving complex object-related constraints that are difficult for SMT solvers to handle, NEUROTESTGEN leverages LLMs to infer plausible constraints. Furthermore, NEUROTESTGEN incorporates an iterative feedback loop that validates LLM-generated tests and provides corrective guidance until the target line or branch is covered or a limit is reached. Our empirical evaluation on a widely used benchmark demonstrates that NEUROTESTGEN significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art approach across multiple LLMs, including Llama 3.3 70B1, GPT-4o Mini, Claude 3.5 Haiku3, and Claude Sonnet 4.6.

AI.tldr: NeuroTestGen 是一种神经-符号混合测试生成方法，将符号执行与LLM驱动的测试合成相结合，通过对路径类型分类（纯数值型与对象相关型）分别采用Z3求解器和LLM推理来生成测试用例，在Defects4J基准上优于当前最优方法Panta。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM测试生成方法难以满足精确路径约束，而符号执行虽能推导路径约束但难以生成可读、可执行的开发者友好测试。NeuroTestGen旨在结合两者互补优势，按需实现目标结构覆盖率。
AI.method: 针对方法内目标语句，先用Z3 SMT求解器处理纯数值路径约束，对象相关路径则由LLM-Path-Solver推理并经LLM-Verifier验证；将求解结果作为符号引导规约输入LLM生成测试用例，并通过迭代反馈循环持续修正直至达到覆盖率目标或达到迭代上限。
AI.result: 在Defects4J的14个项目（130个类，2971个方法）上，使用Claude Sonnet 4.6达到92.91%行覆盖率和88.89%分支覆盖率，超越Panta基线；消融实验表明LLM组件对对象相关路径有持续改进作用；不同模型间性能差异显著，Claude 3.5 Haiku在性能与成本间提供了较好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 神经-符号混合方法能有效兼顾精确约束推理与高质量测试生成，且对不同能力LLM均具有泛化能力；当前局限包括符号执行可扩展性、对领域特定库的语义理解以及迭代过程的计算开销。

title: Jev in the Wild: A Data-Driven Analysis of the Jev Model's Functionality, Applications and Ecosystem
summary: Jev is a fast, low-cost decision model that answers natural-language questions with choices, binary judgments, and scores. As its public ecosystem grows rapidly, it remains unclear how Jev is used across applications and how public attention relates to project distribution. To answer these questions, we conduct a large-scale, data-driven analysis of 2,170 publicly available Jev projects collected from GitHub as of September 22, 2026. We find rapid early growth in Jev's public ecosystem, with both new projects and integration into existing repositories. Across diverse domains, projects use Jev for multiple decision purposes and combine its interfaces. Attribute judgment and scoring are widely used, while the use of action selection, content filtering, and model and tool selection varies across domains. These patterns suggest that Jev serves as a reusable decision component whose functionality varies with the surrounding workflow. Meanwhile, public attention is concentrated in routing and interface agents and does not track project counts. Our findings provide a quantitative view of Jev's emerging ecosystem and inform the design and evaluation of general-purpose decision models across diverse application contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文对 Jev（一种基于自然语言的快速低成本决策模型）的公开 GitHub 生态系统进行了大规模数据驱动分析。基于 2026 年 9 月 22 日采集的 2,170 个公开项目，研究者从增长趋势、应用领域、决策目的和接口使用等方面系统量化了该模型的早期生态。研究发现 Jev 生态增长迅速、功能多样，但公共关注度（以 GitHub stars 衡量）与项目数量分布并不一致，呈现出"路由与自动化"领域获关注多而应用分布广泛的不平衡格局。
AI.motivation: Jev 作为新近发布的零样本、低延迟决策模型，其公开生态正快速增长，但开发者社区缺乏对其实际使用模式和应用分布的系统理解。本文旨在回答三个关键问题：（1）Jev 生态的增长模式如何；（2）Jev 在不同应用中如何被使用（决策目的和接口组合）；（3）公共关注度与应用分布之间的关系。
AI.method: 研究采用三阶段数据流程构建数据集：(1) 通过关键词、API endpoint 和 SDK 引用在 GitHub 检索候选仓库；(2) 使用 GPT-6 Luna Max agent 验证每个仓库确实将 Jev 用于具体任务；(3) 由 agent 标注主要应用领域、决策目的和接口使用，并由第二个 agent 独立复核分歧之处。最终获得 2,170 个已验证的 Jev 项目作为分析对象，分类为 8 大类、18 亚类，并统计项目数、stars 数、决策目的分布（属性判断、评分/排序、动作选择、内容过滤、模型/工具选择、结果判断）及 Choice/Noul/Score 三种接口的组合使用情况。
AI.result: 生态增长：Jev 在 2026 年 9 月 15 日发布后一周内即催生 1,865 个新仓库（同时 305 个已有仓库集成 Jev），获得 43,750 个 stars，呈现爆发式早期增长。应用领域分布广泛，前两大领域 Content & Expert Tasks 与 Search & Memory 仅占 17.8% 和 17.6%，无单一主导领域。决策目的：属性判断最普遍（77%），其次是评分/排序（52%）和动作选择（31%），且 69.7% 的项目将 Jev 用于多种决策目的。接口使用方面，Choice（81.0%）、Noul（72.2%）、Score（45.4%）被广泛组合使用，36.8% 的项目同时使用全部三种接口。决策目的因领域而异（如 Simulation & Control 中动作选择占 52%，Routing & Automation 中模型/工具选择占 27%）。关键发现：公共关注度高度集中在 Routing & Automation（占 41.4% stars，Model & Tool Routing 单独占 32.6%）和 Interface Agents（共占 63.0% stars），但这两类仅占 19.6% 的项目；Content & Expert Tasks 和 Search & Memory 项目数多但平均 stars 很少。Stars 与项目数量并不对应，反映出社区注意力与实际应用广度之间的显著错配。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出四点结论：(1) Jev 公开生态早期增长极其迅速；(2) Jev 充当可复用的决策组件，其具体功能依周围工作流而异；(3) 项目倾向于组合多种决策目的和接口，类似决策模型应支持类别选择、二元判断和评分等多模态输出；(4) 公共关注度分布与项目分布严重失衡，提示在构建通用决策模型的代表性评估集时应涵盖低可见度的应用领域。本文也指出局限性：分析仅限于 2026 年 9 月 22 日的快照和公开 GitHub 仓库，私有仓库与商业应用不在分析范围内。论文通过 7 个代表性应用案例（浏览器代理、代码评审分流、工具历史压缩、工具调用风险门控、模型路由、游戏控制和税务表单分类）展示了 Jev 作为轻量级决策层的实际集成模式。

title: Drafter: A Python Library for Full-Stack Web Development in CS1
summary: Web applications are increasingly the main way to create user interfaces, and they are often the most common software beginners have encountered. However, web development relies on concepts like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and backend technologies, which are challenges beyond the scope of an introductory course. Additionally, many features of modern web frameworks conflict with CS1 principles, such as avoiding global mutable state and promoting test-driven development. Consequently, web development is rarely integrated into CS1 courses, despite its motivational potential. This paper introduces Drafter, a new open-source Python library for CS1, enabling students to develop full-stack web applications using pure functions with minimal boilerplate. Drafter has simple functions to generate HTML, eliminating the need to learn HTML or templating languages. The data model scales with students' mastery of types, from primitives to nested lists, Dataclasses, and dictionaries. Drafter supports unit testing of entire web applications and reinforces CS1 concepts like decomposition and reusability. Websites created with Drafter can be deployed through GitHub Pages, with plotting and image manipulation. Students receive extensive debug information, including unit test scaffolding, program state visualization, and enhanced error messages and tests. This paper discusses the pedagogical features and design decisions behind Drafter, along with instructor reflections on its use. We believe Drafter can significantly enhance student engagement in CS1 courses and reinforce key learning objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Drafter：一个面向CS1（计算机科学导论课程）学生的开源Python库，旨在让初学者使用纯函数和最少的样板代码开发全栈Web应用，免去学习HTML、CSS、JavaScript及后端技术的负担。Drafter通过简化API（start_server、route装饰器、Page类、State数据类、组件库）、支持可视化测试差异、自动生成单元测试脚手架、程序状态可视化、增强错误信息、客户端执行（通过Skulpt实现）以及GitHub Pages部署等功能，倡导函数式编程、模块化和单元测试，同时避免全局可变状态。作者在R1大学的两门CS1课程中部署Drafter用于期末项目，反映学生能完成项目，认为应提高要求并更早整合进课程。
AI.motivation: 初学者虽熟悉Web应用，但Web开发涉及HTML/CSS/JS及后端技术，对CS1课程而言过于复杂；现有Python Web框架普遍依赖全局可变状态、模板语言、HTML/CSS、类路由或异步等特性，与CS1教学原则相冲突。作者希望填补Python CS1中Web开发的空白，并通过纯函数方式降低认知负担，同时强化分解、复用、测试等核心编程概念。
AI.method: Drafter的核心API包括：start_server启动服务器；@route装饰器定义纯函数路由；Page数据类包装状态与内容；State数据类由用户定义（可从基元类型逐步扩展到Dataclass、嵌套列表、字典）；提供覆盖常见HTML元素的组件库（Button、TextBox、Table、MatPlotLibPlot等）；通过函数式样式修改接口操作CSS属性。附加教学特性包括：assert_equal提供图形化测试差异；自动追踪导航并生成单元测试脚手架；调试区显示状态、端点、调用历史；内置类型校验与增强错误信息；通过Skulpt实现客户端运行以支持GitHub Pages静态部署；提供分级文档（新手版与开发者版）、快速入门指南、四个渐进式练习项目以及部署教程。
AI.result: Drafter在2023-2024学年某R1大学的Python CS1课程（含面向CS专业及工科学生两门课程，每学期数百名学生）部署使用，作为为期四周的开源期末项目，要求至少7个路由、5个不同页面、4字段State（含列表）、4个输入字段、测试、静态类型和无全局变量，另设两个渐进式里程碑和GitHub Pages部署。整体运行顺利，多数学生达标，无需大量额外助教支持。作者反思并决定下一轮提高要求（如强制使用for循环、嵌套数据），并将整合时间前移，同时改进部署脚本以校验提交信息和必要文件编辑。少量技术问题包括start_server阻塞调用位置、Dataclass可变字段默认值缺乏支持等。
AI.conclusion: Drafter显著降低了CS1 Web开发门槛，使初学者能专注Python核心编程概念与良好实践（纯函数、分解、单元测试），同时避免常见反模式（全局可变状态、模板语言）。初步部署验证了可行性，未来计划扩展教学整合、加强自动化评估与部署支持、探索学生动机影响，并在更广课程中铺开。

title: Generative AI May Reinforce Social Biases in Software Engineering Education
summary: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly being deployed across a wide range of real-world applications. Without careful evaluation, reliance on these systems can have unintended consequences, such as reinforcement of stereotypes and amplification of social biases. Such risks are particularly important in educational settings, where early decisions can shape students' interests, opportunities, and career trajectories. In this paper, we investigate how GenAI use by software engineering instructors may inadvertently reinforce software-specific social biases. We focus on two representative tasks: team formation based on student profiles and the generation of visual content for educational materials. Our results reveal significant biases in both tasks. In team formation, factors such as gender and nationality affect role assignments (e.g., women are more likely to be assigned to front-end roles than equally qualified men). In the visual content generation task, models generally produce diverse and balanced representations when depicting groups of individuals. However, when generating images of a single person, the outputs are predominantly male and light-skinned. These findings highlight the persistence of demographic biases in generative models and underscore the need for domain-specific evaluation and mitigation strategies to support their responsible use in educational settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了生成式AI在软件工程教育中可能强化社会偏见的问题，聚焦于团队组建和视觉内容生成两项任务，发现LLM在团队分配中存在基于性别和国籍的偏见，图像生成模型在单人图像中倾向于生成男性和浅肤色人物。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在教育领域应用日益广泛，但其训练数据中的社会偏见可能在教育场景中被放大和强化。软件工程领域长期存在性别和种族失衡，教育场景中GenAI的偏见可能影响学生的兴趣塑造、职业发展和长期社会公平。现有研究主要关注通用场景或招聘场景，对教育场景中的软件工程特定偏见缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 研究设计两个代表性任务：(1) 团队组建任务——使用GPT-4.1、GPT-5.2和DeepSeek V3.2三个LLM，基于合成学生档案进行11,200次团队分配决策。学生档案包含通过姓名隐含的性别和国籍属性，以及三种不同信息水平的资格（Plain仅姓名、Level-based含年级、Skill-based含技能）。团队基于SWEBOK定义为四个角色（Core Development、Interface Design、Database、Quality Assurance）。(2) 视觉内容生成任务——使用GPT Image 2和Imagen 4两个文生图模型，基于真实软件工程课程材料中的25个提示生成500张图像。分析采用多项Logistic回归和二元Logistic回归评估团队分配偏差，使用卡方检验和Cramér's V评估图像中性别和肤色的表征偏差百分比（RBP）。
AI.result: 团队组建任务发现：(1) 所有模型均存在显著的性别偏见——男性比女性更可能被分配到Core Development，女性比男性更可能被分配到Interface Design和Quality Assurance；(2) 国籍偏见显著——相比中国（参考类别），尼日利亚姓名更常被分配到QA，韩国姓名更常被分配到Interface Design；(3) 年级偏见——高年级学生被分配到Core Development，低年级学生被分配到Interface Design（暗示界面设计技术含量低的隐含偏见）；(4) 即使在技能匹配的Skill-based场景中，当两个团队都合适时，模型仍倾向于按性别刻板印象分配（男性→Core Development，女性→Interface Design）。视觉内容生成任务发现：(1) 单人图像存在显著的男性过度表征（GPT Image 2: V=0.64，Imagen 4: V=0.65）和浅肤色过度表征（V=0.57和V=0.61），且在Database、Debugging、Individual Programming等类别中浅肤色占比超过95%；(2) 多人图像则呈现更平衡的性别和肤色多样性分布。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了生成式AI在软件工程教育中确实会强化社会偏见，即使提供任务相关信息也难以完全消除。偏见模式与软件工程领域现有的性别和种族失衡一致。需要在模型开发、提示设计和评估框架三个层面进行干预：改进训练数据和微调方法、明确决策标准并最小化人口统计学线索、建立领域特定的公平性评估框架。研究强调了在教育等敏感领域部署GenAI之前进行系统性偏见评估的重要性。

title: Time-Series Foundation Models That Understand Data Revisions
summary: Historical observations are not always fixed: statistical agencies revise previously published values as new evidence arrives. Forecasting from a contemporary download can therefore expose a model to information unavailable at the date it purportedly made a prediction. We propose VINTAGE-TS, a revision-aware adaptation of a time-series foundation model that distinguishes observation time from information-availability time.
